domains.name: event
domains.description: Core operational domain managing the full lifecycle of live sports and entertainment events — planning, scheduling, production logistics, competition governance, and game-day execution. Owns event identity, fixture calendars, match results, season structures, tournament brackets, and event lifecycle from announcement through post-event reconciliation. Serves as SSOT for all event-related master data across leagues, concerts, and live experiences.

products.name: fixture
products.description: Core master entity and SSOT for event identity — any scheduled live sports or entertainment event. Captures event name, type (match, concert, PPV, exhibition, all-star, draft, awards), status (announced → confirmed → in-progress → completed/cancelled), scheduled date/time with timezone, doors-open time, event tier (regular season, playoff, championship, special event), home/away designation, neutral site flag, broadcast eligibility flag, classification (league, cup, friendly, touring), and lifecycle timestamps. Anchor entity referenced by all downstream domains.

attributes.name: attendance_capacity

attributes.name: away_score

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fixture was officially cancelled or abandoned. Triggers refund processing workflows in Ticketmaster/AXS and revenue reversal entries in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fixture was confirmed by the governing body or event organizer, transitioning from announced to confirmed status. Triggers ticketing on-sale activation in Ticketmaster/AXS and broadcast rights activation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the fixture record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field for data governance, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) financial controls, and GDPR data lineage compliance.

attributes.name: doors_open_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when venue gates open to ticket holders. Critical for access control configuration in Ticketmaster/AXS gate scan systems and fan arrival experience planning.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control Standard; Archtics Venue Operations

attributes.name: event_classification
attributes.description: Competition or programming classification of the fixture indicating its governing framework (e.g., league regular season match, cup knockout tie, friendly/exhibition, touring concert). Used for league governance reporting and CBA compliance.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations; NFL Governance Office; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Compliance

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the fixture in the local venue timezone, stored as a DATE for day-level planning, fixture calendar display, and season schedule reporting. Distinct from the precise scheduled_start_timestamp used for operational systems.
attributes.references: NFL Schedule Publication Standard; NBA League Office Calendar

attributes.name: event_tier
attributes.description: Competitive tier or significance level of the fixture within its season or tournament structure. Determines pricing strategy, broadcast rights activation, and sponsorship inventory allocation. Drives dynamic pricing rules in Ticketmaster/AXS.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office Season Structure Guidelines

attributes.name: extra_time_played
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture required extra time or overtime periods beyond regulation. Affects broadcast window compliance, venue operations scheduling, and revenue reconciliation for extended event durations.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations Extra Time Rules; NFL Overtime Rules

attributes.name: fixture_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the fixture, used in operational systems such as Ticketmaster/AXS, Archtics, and SAP S/4HANA SD. Serves as the cross-system reference key for event scheduling and revenue management workflows.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Event Management Standard; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: fixture_name
attributes.description: Official human-readable name of the fixture as published to fans, broadcasters, and sponsors (e.g., 'NBA Finals Game 7', 'UFC 300', 'FIFA World Cup Final'). Used in ticketing, broadcast schedules, and fan engagement platforms.
attributes.references: NBA League Office Event Naming Standard; FIFA Event Identification Guidelines

attributes.name: home_score
attributes.description: Final score or result for the home team or primary competitor at the conclusion of the fixture. Populated post-event. Used for standings calculation, WAR (Wins Above Replacement) analytics, and league governance reporting.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; FIFA Competition Regulations Result Reporting

attributes.name: is_broadcast_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fixture is eligible for broadcast distribution under existing media rights agreements. Drives activation of broadcast workflows in Dalet Galaxy and content rights management.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy; RSN (Regional Sports Network) Rights Agreements

attributes.name: is_neutral_site
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture is played at a neutral venue with no designated home team advantage. Affects revenue sharing agreements, ticketing allocation rules, and broadcast designation.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA Competition Regulations Neutral Site Rules

attributes.name: is_ppv
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fixture is designated as a Pay-Per-View (PPV) event requiring individual purchase for broadcast access. Triggers PPV pricing and DTC distribution workflows in OTT platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Pay-Per-View Regulations; DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) Distribution Policy

attributes.name: leg_number
attributes.description: Leg sequence number for two-legged ties or multi-game series (e.g., Leg 1, Leg 2 of a UEFA tie; Game 3 of an NBA playoff series). Nullable for single-leg fixtures.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations Two-Legged Tie Rules; NBA Playoff Series Format

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the fixture within its lifecycle workflow from initial announcement through post-event reconciliation. Governs downstream system activations: ticketing goes on-sale at 'confirmed', broadcast feeds activate at 'in_progress', revenue reconciliation triggers at 'completed'.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Event Lifecycle Standard; SAP S/4HANA SD Event Management

attributes.name: local_timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the venue's local timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Required for accurate local time display in fan-facing platforms, broadcast scheduling, and ticket delivery.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ISO 8601

attributes.name: matchday_number
attributes.description: Sequential matchday or game week number within the season or competition phase (e.g., Matchday 1, Week 12). Used for fixture calendar display, standings calculation, and broadcast scheduling.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations Matchday Structure; NFL Schedule Week Numbering

attributes.name: penalty_shootout
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fixture was decided by a penalty shootout or tiebreaker procedure. Used for competition result reporting and broadcast content tagging in Dalet Galaxy.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations Penalty Shootout Rules; NHL Shootout Rules

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Official outcome classification of the fixture as determined by the governing body. Distinct from lifecycle_status — this captures the competitive result rather than the operational state. Used for standings, CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport) appeals, and league governance.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); NFL Governance Office

attributes.name: round_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the competition round or stage for this fixture (e.g., 'Quarter-Final', 'Semi-Final', 'Wild Card Round', 'Conference Championship'). Used in fan-facing communications and broadcast graphics.
attributes.references: FIFA Competition Regulations; NFL Governance Office Playoff Structure

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned end date and time of the fixture in UTC. Used for broadcast window allocation, venue turnaround scheduling, and post-event reconciliation triggers in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; FCC Broadcast Scheduling Regulations

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world scheduled date and time when the fixture is planned to begin, stored in UTC with timezone offset. Used as the primary business event timestamp for broadcast scheduling, ticketing on-sale windows, and fan engagement notifications via Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; FCC Broadcast Scheduling Regulations

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this fixture record originated (e.g., Ticketmaster/AXS, Archtics, SAP S/4HANA SD, or league data feed). Supports data lineage tracking and Silver Layer reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: surface_type

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the fixture record was last modified. Required for incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail compliance under SOX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Incremental Processing

attributes.name: var_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether Video Assistant Referee (VAR) or equivalent video review technology (e.g., TMO in rugby) was deployed during this fixture. Required for competition governance reporting and broadcast production metadata.
attributes.references: FIFA VAR (Video Assistant Referee) Protocol; TMO (Television Match Official) Rugby Regulations

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Recorded weather condition at the venue during the fixture. Used for performance analytics in SportsCode/Hudl, insurance claims, and post-event operational reporting. 'indoor' applies to enclosed venues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|snow|fog|extreme_heat|indoor — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management; OSHA Outdoor Event Safety

products.name: calendar
products.description: Master entity defining a competitive or programming season within a league or entertainment series. Serves as the SSOT for season identity AND the official published fixture calendar/schedule. Captures season name, year, sport/entertainment type, start/end dates, number of scheduled rounds/weeks, playoff structure flag, season status (planning, active, completed), governing body reference, CBA applicability flag, season format (regular, shortened, expanded), calendar publication date, calendar version, scheduling authority, blackout dates, bye weeks, international window dates, and calendar status (draft, published, amended). Owns the official release of fixture schedules to downstream consumers including broadcast, ticketing, and venue operations.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the event calendar / season record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 — Data Element Naming and Definition

attributes.name: calendar_governing_body_id

attributes.name: calendar_scheduling_authority_governing_body_id

attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; FIFA

attributes.name: governing_body_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organisational unit or external body responsible for publishing and maintaining the official fixture schedule for this season.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; FIFA

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Reference to the league or entertainment series that owns this season calendar. Links to the league master entity.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; FIFA; MLS

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific dates on which no fixtures may be scheduled due to regulatory, contractual, or operational constraints (e.g., broadcast blackout windows, public holidays, conflicting major events). Enforced by the scheduling authority.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; NFL Governance Office; FIFA

attributes.name: broadcast_rights_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic region or market for which broadcast rights have been assigned for this season (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'GLOBAL'). Drives RSN, OTT, and IPTV distribution logic in Dalet Galaxy and content rights management.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; FIFA; NFL Governance Office; DRM

attributes.name: bye_weeks
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of round/week numbers designated as bye weeks (no fixtures scheduled). Relevant primarily for NFL and similar league formats. Used by broadcast schedulers in Dalet Galaxy to fill programming gaps and by venue operations for maintenance windows.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; CBA

attributes.name: calendar_status
attributes.description: Current publication status of the fixture calendar. Controls downstream visibility and consumption: 'draft' is internal only; 'published' is the official release to broadcast, ticketing, and venue operations; 'amended' indicates a post-publication revision; 'suspended' indicates a temporary halt; 'archived' is end-of-life.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA; NBA League Office; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: cba_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the season schedule is governed by an active Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) between the league and players' association. When true, CBA constraints on game counts, rest days, and travel windows must be validated against the fixture calendar.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLBPA; NHLPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this event calendar record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR data privacy obligations apply to fan and participant data collected during this season, based on the host country and market reach. When true, data processing activities must comply with GDPR Articles 5-7 and fan consent management in Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: has_playoff_structure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this season includes a post-season playoff or knockout tournament phase beyond the regular season. When true, playoff-specific broadcast rights, ticketing tiers, and venue contracts are activated.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors; FIFA

attributes.name: host_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary host nation for this season (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'FRA'). Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, local tax), venue safety standards (OSHA, ADA), and broadcast licensing requirements (FCC).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; CCPA; OSHA; ADA; FCC

attributes.name: international_window_dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of date ranges reserved for international competition windows (e.g., FIFA international breaks, Olympic qualifying periods) during which domestic league fixtures are suspended. Critical for fixture scheduling compliance with FIFA and IOC calendars.
attributes.references: FIFA; IOC; UEFA

attributes.name: is_international_season
attributes.description: Indicates whether this season includes fixtures played in multiple countries or international markets. When true, multi-jurisdiction regulatory compliance (GDPR, local broadcast licensing, visa/work permit requirements) is triggered.
attributes.references: FIFA; IOC; GDPR; FCC

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, scheduling caveats, or amendment reasons associated with this season calendar record (e.g., 'Schedule amended due to venue unavailability in Week 7', 'Shortened season per CBA force majeure clause'). Supports audit trail and change management.
attributes.references: SOX; ISO 20121

attributes.name: number_of_participating_teams
attributes.description: Total count of teams, clubs, or acts participating in this season. Used for fixture generation, venue capacity planning in Archtics, and broadcast slot allocation. For concert series, represents the number of performing acts.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: playoff_format_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the playoff bracket or knockout structure (e.g., 'Single-elimination 12-team bracket', 'Best-of-7 series, 16 teams'). Supports broadcast production planning and fan engagement content in Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; FIFA

attributes.name: playoff_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled start date of the post-season playoff phase. Null if has_playoff_structure is false. Used to define the playoff broadcast rights window and premium ticketing on-sale dates in Ticketmaster/AXS.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the fixture calendar was publicly released by the scheduling authority. Triggers downstream on-sale windows in Ticketmaster/AXS and broadcast scheduling in Dalet Galaxy.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA; NBA League Office

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this season within the league or series (e.g., 'NFL-2024-REG', 'NBA-2024-25'). Used as the business key in integrations with SAP S/4HANA, Ticketmaster/AXS, and Archtics.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; FIFA

attributes.name: season_end_date
attributes.description: Official end date of the competitive or programming season, inclusive of any playoff or championship rounds. Defines the effective-until boundary for broadcast rights, venue contracts, and sponsorship activation periods.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; FIFA; NBA League Office; FCC

attributes.name: season_format

attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: tickets_sold
attributes.description: Total number of paid tickets sold for the event across all sales channels (box office, online, mobile, resale). Represents the commercial demand figure prior to event day.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: turnstile_count
attributes.description: Actual number of unique ticket scans recorded at venue entry points via access control systems. Represents the physical headcount of spectators who passed through gates, distinct from paid attendance.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this attendance record was most recently modified, such as during amendment, dispute resolution, or governing body verification.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: variance_count
attributes.description: Numerical difference between tickets sold (plus comps issued) and actual turnstile scan count. A non-zero variance triggers reconciliation review. Positive value indicates more tickets issued than scans; negative indicates scan anomalies.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Reconciliation Standard; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: variance_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for any material variance between tickets issued and turnstile count. Common reasons include scanner malfunction, duplicate scan prevention, late entry, or system outage.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Reconciliation Standard; Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the attendance figures were officially verified and approved by the designated venue or league official. Marks the transition from submitted to verified status.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: vip_attendance
attributes.description: Number of spectators who entered via VIP hospitality credentials, premium suite access, or club-level passes. Used for premium experience reporting and sponsor hospitality fulfillment tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Fan and Sponsor Relationship Management; Internal VIP Program Standards

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Recorded weather condition at the venue during the event. Used to contextualize attendance figures, particularly for outdoor venues where weather materially affects turnout. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|heavy_rain|snow|fog|extreme_heat|storm|postponed_weather — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management; Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: weather_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether adverse weather conditions were recorded as a contributing factor to attendance shortfall or no-show rates for this event. Supports force majeure analysis and insurance claim documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management; Internal Risk Management Standard

attributes.name: amended_attendance_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on attendance_record (amended_attendance_record_id)

attributes.name: revenue_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Ticket pricing configurations feed directly into gate revenue stream forecasting. Finance teams link pricing tiers to revenue streams for dynamic pricing analytics, gate revenue budgeting, and actual-

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the competitive season or entertainment season under which this pricing configuration is governed. Enables season-level pricing policy aggregation.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_jurisdiction. Business justification: Ticket sales are subject to entertainment taxes varying by jurisdiction. tax_jurisdiction has ticket_sales_taxable_flag and entertainment_tax_rate_pct specifically for this. Finance teams require this
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this pricing configuration was formally approved by the designated authority. Supports SOX audit trail and financial controls documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Internal Financial Controls Policy

attributes.name: base_ticket_price
attributes.description: The floor or reference ticket price for this pricing tier before any multipliers, dynamic adjustments, or promotional discounts are applied. Represents the minimum sellable price per seat in this configuration.
attributes.references: PCI SSC Payment Card Industry Security Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: config_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this pricing configuration within the ticketing system (e.g., Ticketmaster / AXS or Archtics). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing Platform; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: config_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing this pricing configuration (e.g., 'Playoff Tier A Dynamic', 'Regular Season GA Standard'). Used in reporting dashboards and operational communications.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this pricing configuration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR data retention compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 Data Retention; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts in this pricing record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-market pricing for international events.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day of the week on which the event is scheduled. Day-of-week is a primary demand driver in pricing models — weekend events typically command premium pricing versus midweek fixtures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Monday|Tuesday|Wednesday|Thursday|Friday|Saturday|Sunday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Pricing Policy

attributes.name: demand_signal_source
attributes.description: The system or data source providing real-time demand signals to the dynamic pricing engine. Determines which platform's sales velocity, search interest, or fan engagement data drives price adjustments.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Dynamic Pricing Module; Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether dynamic (demand-based) pricing is activated for this event pricing configuration. When true, the ticketing platform (Ticketmaster / AXS) will algorithmically adjust prices within the base-to-max range based on real-time demand signals.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Dynamic Pricing Module; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_model
attributes.description: The algorithmic model type used when dynamic pricing is enabled. Demand-based adjusts on real-time sales velocity; time-based adjusts based on proximity to event date; inventory-based adjusts on remaining seat availability; hybrid combines multiple signals.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Dynamic Pricing Module; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: early_bird_cutoff_date
attributes.description: The last date on which early bird pricing is available for this event. Purchases made on or before this date qualify for the early bird discount rate. Supports advance sales revenue recognition strategy.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Management Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: early_bird_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the base ticket price for purchases made on or before the early_bird_cutoff_date. Incentivizes advance ticket purchases to improve cash flow predictability.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Management Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: event_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the event type driving the pricing strategy. Playoff and championship events typically carry higher multipliers. Aligns with fixture classification in the event domain.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Governance Standards

attributes.name: facility_fee_amount
attributes.description: Per-ticket facility or venue surcharge applied to support venue operations, maintenance, and ADA compliance improvements. Separate from the base ticket price and service fee.
attributes.references: ADA Americans with Disabilities Act; OSHA Venue Safety; Internal Venue Operations Policy

attributes.name: group_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the base ticket price for qualifying group sales purchases. Expressed as a positive value (e.g., 15.00 = 15% discount). Applicable when group_sales_min_qty threshold is met.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Group Sales Module; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: group_sales_min_qty
attributes.description: Minimum number of tickets required to qualify for group sales pricing under this configuration. Group pricing typically offers a discount to incentivize bulk purchases from organizations, schools, and corporate clients.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Group Sales Module; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: inventory_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total venue capacity allocated to this pricing tier configuration. The sum of all tier allocations for a given fixture should equal 100%. Managed in Archtics seat manifest.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: max_ticket_price
attributes.description: The ceiling price for this pricing tier. In dynamic pricing models, the ticket price will not exceed this cap regardless of demand signals. Protects against fan price gouging and reputational risk.
attributes.references: PCI SSC Payment Card Industry Security Standards; Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: max_tickets_per_transaction
attributes.description: Maximum number of tickets a single purchaser may buy in one transaction under this pricing configuration. Limits scalping and ensures equitable fan access. Enforced at point of sale in Ticketmaster / AXS.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing Platform; Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplicative factor applied to the base ticket price to derive the adjusted price for this configuration. A value of 1.0000 represents no adjustment; values above 1.0 represent a premium uplift (e.g., 1.25 = 25% premium for playoff games).
attributes.references: Internal Pricing Policy; Ticketmaster / AXS Dynamic Pricing Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for revenue management staff to document special conditions, exceptions, or contextual rationale for this pricing configuration (e.g., 'Reduced pricing for community outreach game', 'Elevated due to international broadcast demand').
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: off_sale_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which ticket sales under this pricing configuration are closed. After this timestamp, no new purchases are permitted at this price tier. Supports inventory management and gate reconciliation.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing Platform; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: on_sale_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which tickets under this pricing configuration become available for public purchase. Aligns with Ticketmaster / AXS on-sale event scheduling. Critical for fan communications and marketing campaign timing.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing Platform; Adobe Experience Platform Fan Engagement

attributes.name: ppv_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event pricing configuration applies to a Pay-Per-View (PPV) broadcast product rather than (or in addition to) in-venue ticketing. PPV pricing is governed by separate broadcast rights and revenue share agreements.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Broadcast Rights Policy

attributes.name: ppv_price
attributes.description: The consumer-facing price for the Pay-Per-View (PPV) broadcast purchase of this event. Applicable only when ppv_flag is true. Governed by broadcast rights agreements and FCC regulations.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Broadcast Rights Policy; PCI SSC

attributes.name: presale_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether a presale window is activated for this pricing configuration, allowing select fan segments (e.g., CRM loyalty members, credit card holders, season ticket holders) to purchase before the general public on-sale.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Presale Module; Salesforce CRM Fan Engagement

attributes.name: presale_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the presale window closes. After this timestamp, remaining presale inventory rolls into the general public on-sale pool.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Presale Module; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: presale_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the presale window opens for eligible purchasers. Applicable only when presale_enabled is true. Drives CRM campaign scheduling in Salesforce and Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Presale Module; Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: price_adjustment_ceiling_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage by which the dynamic pricing engine may increase the base ticket price (e.g., 50.00 means prices may rise up to 50% above base). Caps upward price movement to protect fan experience and brand equity.
attributes.references: Internal Pricing Policy; Ticketmaster / AXS Dynamic Pricing Module

attributes.name: price_adjustment_floor_pct
attributes.description: Minimum percentage by which the dynamic pricing engine may reduce the base ticket price (expressed as a negative-capable percentage, e.g., -20.00 means prices may drop up to 20% below base). Prevents excessive discounting.
attributes.references: Internal Pricing Policy; Ticketmaster / AXS Dynamic Pricing Module

attributes.name: pricing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this pricing configuration. Draft indicates pending approval; Active indicates live and applied to ticket inventory; Suspended indicates temporarily halted; Expired indicates past effective window; Cancelled indicates permanently withdrawn.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; PCI SSC Payment Card Industry Security Standards

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: Categorical tier classification for this pricing configuration. Tiers include General Admission (GA), Standing Room Only (SRO), Standard, Premium, Very Important Person (VIP), and Platinum. Drives seat manifest segmentation in Archtics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|premium|vip|ga|sro|platinum|hospitality|suite — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Ticketmaster / AXS

attributes.name: revenue_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of gross ticket revenue from this pricing tier shared with the venue operator, league, or other contractual revenue-sharing partners. Feeds into SAP S/4HANA CO controlling and financial settlement processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; CBA Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: rivalry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fixture is designated as a rivalry matchup (e.g., derby, classic, historic rivalry). Rivalry designation typically triggers a positive pricing multiplier uplift in dynamic pricing models.
attributes.references: Internal Pricing Policy; Ticketmaster / AXS Dynamic Pricing Module

attributes.name: season_ticket_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event is included in season ticket packages. When true, season ticket holders receive access at their contracted rate rather than the general public pricing tier.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Internal Season Ticket Policy

attributes.name: service_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed service or convenience fee charged per ticket in addition to the face value price. Represents ticketing platform processing charges passed to the consumer. Governed by PCI-DSS for payment processing.
attributes.references: PCI SSC Payment Card Industry Security Standards; Ticketmaster / AXS Fee Schedule

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: The overarching pricing strategy applied to this configuration. Fixed means a static price; Dynamic means algorithmically adjusted; Tiered means structured price bands; Variable means manually adjusted; Promotional means a time-limited discounted offer.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Management Policy; Workday Adaptive Planning Financial Planning and Analysis

attributes.name: tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: Applicable tax rate percentage applied to ticket sales under this pricing configuration. Varies by jurisdiction and event type. Used for financial reporting and SAP S/4HANA FI tax determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Accounting; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this pricing configuration record was most recently modified. Tracks the last change event for audit, reconciliation, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 Data Retention; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: superseded_pricing_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on pricing (superseded_pricing_id)

products.name: event_type
products.description: Master reference table for event_type. Referenced by event_type_id.

attributes.name: event_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for event_type

attributes.name: broadcast_network
attributes.description: Primary broadcast or streaming network partner for events of this type (e.g., USA Network, FOX, Peacock, WWE Network). Null for non-broadcast events.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the event type into major business categories (wrestling, concert, live event, pay-per-view, television, digital, other).

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the event type (e.g., WWE_RAW, SMACKDOWN, WRESTLEMANIA, CONCERT, LIVE_EVENT). Used as a business key for integration and reporting.

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Standard content rating classification for events of this type, following broadcast and entertainment industry standards (G, PG, PG-13, TV-14, TV-MA).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this event type record was first created in the system. Used for audit and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the event type, including its purpose, format, and distinguishing characteristics.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this event type was retired or discontinued. Null for currently active event types.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this event type became active and available for scheduling. Used for historical tracking and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Delivery format of the event type: live (in-person only), broadcast (televised), streaming (digital platform), or hybrid (multiple channels).

attributes.name: international_distribution
attributes.description: Indicates whether events of this type are distributed internationally (true) or are domestic-only (false).

attributes.name: is_broadcast
attributes.description: Indicates whether events of this type are broadcast on television or streaming platforms (true) or are live-only (false).

attributes.name: is_pay_per_view
attributes.description: Indicates whether events of this type are premium pay-per-view offerings (true) or standard programming (false).

attributes.name: is_ticketed
attributes.description: Indicates whether events of this type require ticket sales (true) or are non-ticketed (false, e.g., free digital events).

attributes.name: league_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the professional league or brand associated with this event type (e.g., WWE, NXT, AEW). Null for non-league events like concerts.

attributes.name: merchandise_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether events of this type typically include merchandise sales opportunities (true) or not (false).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the event type (e.g., Monday Night Raw, SmackDown, WrestleMania, Concert, Live Event).

attributes.name: production_complexity
attributes.description: Relative complexity of production logistics for events of this type: low (minimal setup), medium (standard production), high (advanced staging/effects), premium (flagship events with maximum production value).

attributes.name: recording_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether events of this type must be recorded for archive, replay, or content library purposes (true) or are ephemeral live-only experiences (false).

attributes.name: requires_venue
attributes.description: Indicates whether events of this type require a physical venue (true) or can be virtual/digital-only (false).

attributes.name: revenue_model
attributes.description: Primary revenue generation model for events of this type: ticket sales, sponsorship, broadcast rights, merchandise, or hybrid (multiple streams).

attributes.name: season_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether events of this type are organized into seasons (true) or are standalone/ad-hoc (false).

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value used to control the display order of event types in user interfaces and reports. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: sponsorship_tier
attributes.description: Standard sponsorship tier classification for events of this type, indicating the level of sponsor engagement and investment opportunity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the event type. Active types are currently in use; inactive types are temporarily suspended; retired types are no longer used; planned types are under development.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Primary demographic or fan segment targeted by events of this type (e.g., family-friendly, adult-oriented, premium subscribers, general public).

attributes.name: tournament_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether events of this type can be part of tournament brackets or elimination structures (true) or are standalone matches/shows (false).

attributes.name: typical_capacity_range
attributes.description: Expected audience capacity range for events of this type (e.g., 5000-10000, 15000-20000, 50000+). Used for venue selection and revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: typical_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Standard or expected duration of events of this type, measured in minutes. Used for scheduling and venue planning.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this event type record was last modified. Used for audit and change tracking.

attributes.name: parent_event_type_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on event_type (parent_event_type_id)

Serves as the SSOT for all venue identity and physical characteristics consumed by event scheduling, ticketing inventory, and broadcast production planning.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: address_line1

attributes.name: address_line2

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: concession_stand_count
attributes.description: Total number of fixed concession and food-and-beverage service points within the venue. Used in event-day staffing planning, POS system configuration, and revenue forecasting for food and beverage operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD; Archtics; OSHA Food Safety

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: field_dimensions_notes

Used by event production and broadcast teams for pre-event planning.

attributes.name: gross_sqft

attributes.name: home_tenant_name

attributes.name: hvac_system_type

attributes.name: latitude

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.name: hazmat_inspection_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a hazardous materials inspection has been completed for the venue prior to the event, confirming no prohibited substances or unsafe storage conditions are present. True = inspection completed and cleared; False = not completed.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 Process Safety Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication

attributes.name: hvac_system_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) System Status
attributes.description: Operational status of the venue's Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) system as assessed during the pre-event readiness check. 'degraded' indicates partial functionality that may require mitigation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.94; ASHRAE Standard 62.1 Ventilation for Acceptable Indoor Air Quality; ISO 20121

attributes.name: items_failed_count
attributes.description: Number of checklist items that did not meet the required standard during the readiness assessment, including both critical and non-critical failures.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: items_passed_count
attributes.description: Number of checklist items that were inspected and confirmed as fully compliant during the readiness assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: items_waived_count
attributes.description: Number of checklist items formally waived for this assessment, typically due to inapplicability for the specific event type, venue configuration, or approved variance.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; OSHA Variance Procedures 29 CFR 1905

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this operational readiness record was most recently modified. Tracks revisions to the assessment, status changes, or corrections made after initial creation.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO 20121; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: medical_station_status
attributes.description: Readiness status of on-site medical stations and first-aid facilities for the event. 'partial' indicates some stations are staffed and equipped but not all required stations are fully operational.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.151 Medical Services and First Aid; ISO 20121; NFL/NBA/FIFA Event Medical Standards

attributes.name: osha_compliance_confirmed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Compliance Confirmation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all applicable Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) requirements for venue operations have been verified as compliant during this readiness assessment. True = OSHA compliance confirmed; False = compliance not confirmed or deficiencies found.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 General Industry Standards; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Construction Standards

attributes.name: parking_operations_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether parking lots, garages, and traffic management personnel are in position and operational prior to gates opening. True = parking operations ready; False = not ready.
attributes.references: ADA Americans with Disabilities Act (accessible parking); OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ISO 20121

attributes.name: pos_systems_ready
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Systems Readiness Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all Point of Sale (POS) terminals at concessions, merchandise stands, and box offices have been tested and confirmed operational prior to gates opening. True = POS systems ready; False = not ready.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard; Venue Operations SLA

attributes.name: public_address_system_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the venue's public address and emergency announcement system as verified during the pre-event readiness assessment. Critical for emergency communications and fan experience.
attributes.references: NFPA 72 National Fire Alarm and Signaling Code; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.165; ADA Americans with Disabilities Act

attributes.name: readiness_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this readiness certification record, used for audit trails, regulatory submissions, and cross-system traceability (e.g., OR-LAX001-20240915).
attributes.references: ISO 20121; OSHA Recordkeeping Rule 29 CFR 1904

attributes.name: readiness_status
attributes.description: The overall certification outcome of the pre-event operational readiness assessment. 'approved' means all critical items passed; 'conditional' means minor items failed but event may proceed with mitigations; 'rejected' means critical failures prevent event execution; 'pending' means assessment is not yet complete; 'in_review' means assessment is under management review.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ADA Americans with Disabilities Act; ISO 20121

attributes.name: reassessment_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which a reassessment must be completed when reassessment_required is True. Typically set relative to the gates_open_timestamp to ensure sufficient time for remediation and re-inspection.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; Venue Operations SLA; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: reassessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up readiness reassessment is required before the event can proceed, typically triggered by a 'conditional' or 'rejected' status with remediation actions underway. True = reassessment required; False = no reassessment needed.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Venue Operations Policy

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the primary reason(s) for a 'rejected' readiness status. Required when readiness_status = 'rejected'. Documents the critical failures that prevent the event from proceeding.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ISO 20121; Venue Operations Policy

attributes.name: scoreboard_display_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the venue's scoreboard, video boards, and digital display systems as verified during the pre-event readiness check. Impacts fan experience and broadcast production.
attributes.references: Venue Operations SLA; Broadcast Production Standards

attributes.name: security_sweep_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pre-event security sweep of the venue has been completed and cleared by the security team prior to gates opening. True = sweep completed and venue cleared; False = sweep not yet completed or venue not cleared.
attributes.references: DHS Venue Security Guidelines; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; NFL/NBA/FIFA Security Protocols

attributes.name: weather_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed weather risk level for the event based on forecasts at the time of the readiness assessment. Influences conditional readiness decisions for outdoor or partially-covered venues. Values: low, moderate, high, severe.
attributes.references: NOAA National Weather Service; ISO 20121; Venue Operations Weather Policy

attributes.name: wifi_network_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the venue's fan-facing and operational Wi-Fi network infrastructure as verified during the pre-event readiness assessment. Impacts fan engagement, Point of Sale (POS) systems, and digital ticketing.
attributes.references: Venue Digital Platform SLA; PCI-DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (for POS network)

products.name: staff_plan
products.description: Event-day staffing plan for a facility specifying required headcount by role (security, medical, ushers, concessions, parking, cleaning, AV/production) for a specific event or event type. Attributes include plan name, event reference, facility reference, role category, required headcount, confirmed headcount, staffing agency reference, shift start/end times, credential requirements, cost estimate, actual cost, and plan approval status. Distinct from workforce domain employee records — this is the venue's operational labor demand and fulfillment plan for event execution.

attributes.name: staff_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the event-day staffing plan record. Primary key for the venue_staff_plan data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: event_fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific event for which this staffing plan is created. Links the labor demand plan to the scheduled live event.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: facility_id

attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific event for which this staffing plan is created. Links the labor demand plan to the scheduled live event.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Venue staffing plans are organized by workforce org unit (e.g., Security Operations, Guest Services, Facilities). Linking to org_unit enables labor budget allocation by department, CBA compliance trac

attributes.name: staffing_agency_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external staffing agency contracted to fulfill labor demand for this plan. Null if staffing is fulfilled by in-house workforce.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master

attributes.name: staffing_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_staffing_plan. Business justification: The venue staff plan is the master event staffing document; the security staffing plan is a component of it. Venue operations directors need to reference the associated security staffing plan from the
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.vendor_contract. Business justification: Event-day staffing agency engagements are governed by specific vendor contracts. Linking venue_staff_plan to vendor_contract enables contract compliance verification, authorized headcount validation,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external staffing agency contracted to fulfill labor demand for this plan. Null if staffing is fulfilled by in-house workforce.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master

attributes.name: actual_cost_usd
attributes.description: Actual labor cost in US dollars incurred for this role category after the event, as recorded in the financial system. Compared against estimated_cost_usd for variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Controlling; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls

attributes.name: actual_headcount
attributes.description: Actual number of staff who reported and worked for this role category on event day. Captured post-event for variance analysis against required and confirmed headcount.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Time and Attendance; Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: agency_purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number issued to the staffing agency for this role category. Required for accounts payable processing and agency invoice matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order Management; PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this staffing plan was formally approved by the designated authority. Marks the transition from submitted to approved status.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls

attributes.name: briefing_location
attributes.description: Physical location within or near the venue where staff in this role category are required to report for pre-event briefing and credential check-in.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: briefing_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for the pre-event staff briefing for this role category. Must occur before shift_start_timestamp.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: cba_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Collective Bargaining Agreement governs the employment terms for staff in this role category. Triggers CBA compliance checks on pay rates, shift durations, and break requirements.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Compliance; NLRA (National Labor Relations Act)

attributes.name: confirmed_headcount
attributes.description: Number of staff positions confirmed and scheduled for this role category as of the latest plan update. Compared against required_headcount to identify fulfillment gaps.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Workforce Planning; Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: contingency_headcount
attributes.description: Number of additional staff positions held in reserve for this role category to cover no-shows, emergencies, or unexpected demand surges on event day.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this staffing plan record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls

attributes.name: credential_requirements
attributes.description: Description of required certifications, licenses, or credentials that staff in this role category must hold (e.g., CPR certification, security guard license, food handler permit, AV technician certification).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ADA Standards for Accessible Design; State Licensing Boards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this staffing plan record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations across global venues.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: deployment_zone
attributes.description: Venue zone or area where staff in this role category are assigned to operate (e.g., Gate A, Concourse Level 2, Parking Lot C, Field Level). Supports event-day logistics coordination.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard; ADA Standards for Accessible Design

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement for staff in this role category. Determines payroll processing, CBA applicability, and agency billing procedures.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — HCM; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Compliance

attributes.name: estimated_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total estimated labor cost in US dollars for this role category for the event, calculated from required headcount, shift duration, and pay rate. Used for event budget planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Controlling; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: event_type_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the event type driving this staffing plan. Used to apply standard staffing templates and benchmarks appropriate to the event category.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: fulfillment_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staffing demand for this role category is fulfilled by in-house employees, an external staffing agency, a combination of both, or volunteers.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — HCM; Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: is_ada_role
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Role Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this role category is specifically designated to support ADA accessibility services for guests with disabilities (e.g., wheelchair escorts, hearing loop operators).
attributes.references: ADA Standards for Accessible Design; ADA Title III

attributes.name: is_osha_safety_critical
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Safety-Critical Role Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this role category is classified as safety-critical under OSHA standards, requiring mandatory minimum staffing levels and specific credential verification before event approval.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; OSHA 29 CFR 1926

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this staffing plan record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls

attributes.name: minimum_headcount
attributes.description: Minimum number of staff for this role category below which the event cannot safely proceed. Used as the go/no-go threshold for operational readiness approval.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ADA Standards for Accessible Design

attributes.name: pay_rate_usd
attributes.description: Planned hourly pay rate in US dollars for staff in this role category. Used for cost estimation and budget reconciliation. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Controlling; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Compliance

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name identifying this staffing plan, typically including event name, date, and role category (e.g., 'NBA Finals 2025 – Security Plan').
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: plan_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or special instructions for this staffing plan record, such as event-specific requirements, weather contingencies, or VIP security protocols.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: plan_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this staffing plan for cross-system tracking and vendor communication (e.g., VSP-2025-0042).
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the staffing plan. Tracks progression from initial draft through approval and execution to completion or cancellation.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 (Staffing Readiness)

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Incremental version number of the staffing plan. Incremented each time the plan is revised and resubmitted for approval, enabling audit trail of changes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this staffing plan was rejected during the approval workflow. Populated only when plan_status is set to a rejected or revision-required state.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: required_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of staff positions required for this role category to safely and operationally execute the event. Represents the labor demand target.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: role_category
attributes.description: Operational role category for which this staffing plan row specifies headcount requirements. Each plan record covers one role category per event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: security|medical|usher|concessions|parking|cleaning|av_production|guest_services|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ADA Standards for Accessible Design; Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: shift_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total planned shift duration in hours for this role category, derived from shift start and end timestamps. Used for cost estimation and CBA compliance checks.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Compliance; SAP SuccessFactors — Time Management

attributes.name: shift_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when staff in this role category are scheduled to end their shift, including post-event teardown and debrief time.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Time Management; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Compliance

attributes.name: shift_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when staff in this role category are scheduled to begin their shift, including pre-event setup and briefing time.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Time Management; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Compliance

attributes.name: supervisor_name
attributes.description: Name of the designated supervisor or team lead responsible for managing staff in this role category on event day. Business reference field, not direct PII in operational context.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: uniform_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the required uniform or dress code for staff in this role category. Used for procurement planning and event-day identification of staff.
attributes.references: Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: revised_staff_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on staff_plan (revised_staff_plan_id)

attributes.name: ada_accessible_seat_count

attributes.name: ada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the venue meets all Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessibility requirements as verified by the most recent inspection. Mandatory for public event hosting and federal funding eligibility.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the venue. Used for logistics, emergency services coordination, fan-facing directions, and regulatory filings with OSHA and ADA authorities.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address detail (suite, building, gate number) for the venue. Supplements address_line1 for precise logistics and emergency response routing.

attributes.name: concession_stand_count
attributes.description: Total number of active concession stands and food and beverage service points within the venue. Used for event-day staffing plans, revenue forecasting, and health inspection scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Materials Management; OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA CO cost center code assigned to the venue for financial controlling, expense allocation, and EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization) reporting. Maps venue operational costs to the correct organizational unit.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.name: naming_rights_expiry_date

attributes.name: osha_safety_rating

attributes.name: ownership_structure

attributes.name: parking_capacity

attributes.name: postal_code

attributes.name: premium_suite_count

attributes.name: primary_sport_category

attributes.name: scoreboard_type

products.name: content_placement
products.description: This association product represents the in-venue content placement event between a facility and a digital content asset. It captures the operational and rights management record governing which asset is displayed in which physical zone of which venue, for what display window, under what rights clearance status, and approved by whom. Each record links one facility to one asset and carries attributes that exist only in the context of a specific placement — they cannot reside on the facility master or the asset master alone. Serves as the SSOT for in-venue digital signage scheduling, sponsor display rights compliance, and AV channel assignment across all Sports Entertainment venues.. Existence Justification: A facility (stadium, arena, amphitheater) actively displays digital content assets across multiple physical zones — scoreboards, concourse screens, suite AV systems, LED ribbon boards — and a single content asset (video highlight, promotional clip, sponsor creative) can be licensed and scheduled for display at many facilities simultaneously. The business operationally manages each facility-asset placement as a distinct record with its own display window, zone assignment, rights clearance status, and approval workflow. This is not an analytical correlation but an active content operations and rights management process.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the person or role who formally approved this content placement for the facility-zone-window combination. Supports audit trail and compliance requirements for in-venue content governance.

attributes.name: display_channel_type
attributes.description: The AV delivery channel or system type used to push the content asset to the display zone. Drives technical routing and encoding requirements for the placement.

attributes.name: display_end_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the content placement window closes and the asset is deactivated from display in the specified zone at this facility. Used for rights expiry enforcement and AV system deactivation.

products.name: facility_vendor_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between a physical venue facility and an external vendor providing services at that facility. It captures the operational service agreement governing which vendor delivers which service category at a given facility, including contractual terms, SLA commitments, and financial arrangements. Each record links one facility to one vendor for a specific service engagement, with attributes that exist only in the context of this facility-vendor service relationship. Serves as the SSOT for venue operator procurement teams managing the active vendor roster per facility.. Existence Justification: In sports-entertainment venue operations, a single facility (e.g., a stadium) is actively served by many vendors simultaneously — security firms, F&B operators, AV contractors, cleaning services, parking operators — each under distinct contractual terms. Conversely, a vendor (e.g., a regional security company) may hold active service agreements across multiple facilities in the same league portfolio. The business actively manages this relationship as a named operational concept — a vendor engagement or service contract — with its own lifecycle attributes (contract dates, SLA tier, revenue share, service category) that belong to neither the facility nor the vendor alone.

products.name: venue_activation
products.description: This association product represents the Activation between a facility and a sponsorship deal. It captures the operational record of a specific sponsorship deal being activated at a specific facility, including the physical or digital placement details, asset type, activation zone, and the contracted value allocated to that facility-deal pairing. Each record links one facility to one deal and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this specific facility-deal relationship — enabling multi-venue deals and multi-deal facilities to be modeled accurately.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, a single facility (e.g., a stadium) genuinely hosts multiple concurrent sponsorship deals simultaneously — naming rights, pouring rights, digital board placements, and presenting sponsorships all coexist at the same venue. Conversely, a single sponsorship deal can span multiple facilities — a regional pouring rights deal or a multi-venue naming rights package covers several arenas or stadiums under one commercial agreement. The business actively manages these facility-deal pairings as operational records with placement-specific attributes (activation zone, asset type, placement location, contracted value per facility) that belong to neither the facility nor the deal alone.

products.name: tenancy
products.description: This association product represents the Tenancy contract between a facility and a franchise. It captures the formal occupancy arrangement under which a franchise uses a specific venue asset — whether as a home stadium, practice facility, or training center — including the governing lease terms, revenue share obligations, and tenancy period. Each record links one facility to one franchise and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this specific occupancy relationship. Serves as the SSOT for all venue-franchise occupancy agreements consumed by venue operations, finance, and league governance.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, a single facility (e.g., a shared stadium) genuinely hosts multiple franchise tenants simultaneously — an NFL team and an MLS team may both call the same venue home. Conversely, a franchise may operate across multiple facilities — a home stadium, a practice facility, and a training center — each governed by distinct lease or tenancy arrangements. The business actively manages these tenancy relationships with their own terms (start/end dates, tenancy type, revenue share percentage, lease agreement reference), making this a recognized operational concept called 'Tenancy'.

products.name: facility_obligation_applicability
products.description: This association product represents the Compliance Applicability contract between a facility and a compliance obligation. It captures the operational record of which compliance obligations apply to which physical venues, including when applicability begins and ends, the current compliance status at that venue, who is responsible for maintaining compliance, and when it was last verified. Each record links one facility to one obligation and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific venue-obligation pairing — a single obligation may be compliant at one venue and in-remediation at another.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment operations, a physical venue (facility) is subject to multiple simultaneous compliance obligations — ADA Title III, OSHA safety standards, ISO 20121, local fire codes, and CBA venue requirements all apply concurrently to a single stadium. Conversely, a single obligation such as ADA Title III applies across every facility in the portfolio. The business actively manages this relationship through compliance programs that track per-facility obligation status, responsible owners, verification dates, and applicability windows — this is not derivable from transactional data but is an operationally managed compliance record.

products.name: section_pricing_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between seating_section and price_tier. It captures the operational pricing assignment that maps a specific seating section to a specific price tier for a defined effective period and event context. Each record links one seating_section to one price_tier with attributes — effective dates, face value override, and dynamic pricing flag — that exist only in the context of this section-tier assignment and cannot be stored on either entity alone.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment venue operations, a seating section is assigned to multiple price tiers across different event types, seasons, and promotional windows (e.g., Section 101 is GA-priced for a concert but VIP-priced for a playoff game). Conversely, a single price tier (e.g., 'Club Level Premium') applies to multiple seating sections simultaneously. The business actively manages these section-to-tier assignments with effective date ranges, face values, and dynamic pricing flags that belong to the assignment itself — not to either the section or the tier in isolation.
