products.name: maintenance_plan
products.description: Master reference table for maintenance_plan. Referenced by maintenance_plan_id.

attributes.name: maintenance_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for maintenance_plan

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to external vendor or contractor responsible for executing this maintenance plan. Nullable if performed by internal staff.

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the venue or facility where this maintenance plan applies.

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount in USD allocated for this maintenance plan for the fiscal year.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this maintenance plan was formally approved and authorized for implementation.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether work orders generated from this plan require managerial or operational approval before execution.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this maintenance plan for operational use.

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the asset type covered by this maintenance plan for grouping and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: auto_generate_work_orders
attributes.description: Indicates whether work orders should be automatically created by the system based on the plan schedule, or manually triggered.

attributes.name: blackout_period_restriction
attributes.description: Description of time periods when this maintenance cannot be performed due to event schedules or operational constraints (e.g., no maintenance during event days).

attributes.name: compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance plan is mandated by regulatory or safety compliance requirements (OSHA, ADA, local building codes).

attributes.name: compliance_standard
attributes.description: Specific regulatory standard, code, or requirement that this maintenance plan satisfies (e.g., OSHA 1910.147, ADA Title III, NFPA 101).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this maintenance plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the scope, objectives, and activities included in this maintenance plan.

attributes.name: downtime_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether execution of this maintenance plan requires the asset or venue area to be taken offline or closed to the public.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the maintenance plan expires or is scheduled to be retired. Nullable for open-ended plans.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the maintenance plan becomes active and work orders can be generated from it.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_per_execution
attributes.description: Budgeted cost in USD for a single execution of this maintenance plan, including labor, materials, and vendor fees.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Expected time in minutes required to complete a single execution of this maintenance plan.

attributes.name: frequency_interval
attributes.description: Numeric interval value used in conjunction with frequency_type to define exact recurrence (e.g., every 2 weeks, every 3 months).

attributes.name: frequency_type
attributes.description: Recurrence pattern defining how often maintenance activities are scheduled under this plan.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this maintenance plan was last reviewed and validated for accuracy and relevance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this maintenance plan record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this maintenance plan to ensure continued effectiveness.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes, comments, or special instructions related to this maintenance plan.

attributes.name: notification_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days in advance that responsible parties should be notified before scheduled maintenance execution.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the maintenance plan, used for reference in work orders and scheduling systems.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the maintenance plan describing its purpose and scope.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance plan based on its strategic approach and trigger mechanism.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this maintenance plan for resource allocation and scheduling decisions.

attributes.name: responsible_team
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal team or department responsible for executing this maintenance plan.

attributes.name: safety_requirements
attributes.description: Specific safety protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE), or lockout/tagout procedures required for this maintenance activity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the maintenance plan indicating its operational state.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking revisions to this maintenance plan for audit and change management purposes.

attributes.name: work_instructions
attributes.description: Step-by-step procedural instructions or reference to standard operating procedures (SOPs) for executing this maintenance plan.

attributes.name: superseded_maintenance_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on maintenance_plan (superseded_maintenance_plan_id)

domains.name: athlete
domains.description: Talent management domain owning athlete identity, contracts, performance statistics (WAR, ERA, QBR), health records, eligibility status, and career lifecycle. Manages player rosters, draft selections, trades, transfers, injury tracking, NIL agreements, agent relationships, and compliance with league regulations including anti-doping (WADA) and collective bargaining agreements (CBA). Critical for league operations and broadcast content.

products.name: roster
products.description: Master record of all athletes registered to a team or franchise within a league season. Tracks active, inactive, injured reserve (IR), practice squad, and waived status. Serves as the authoritative SSOT for athlete-team affiliation at any point in time, including jersey number, position designation, roster slot type, and activation dates. Critical for league operations, broadcast graphics, and ticketing systems.

attributes.name: roster_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each roster record. Serves as the primary key for the athlete-team-season affiliation record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Entity role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — this record represents a binding registration/affiliation between an athlete and a team within a league season.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified player agent or agency representing the athlete for this roster record. Used for contract negotiations, trade communications, and CBA-mandated agent certification compliance.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) — Agent Certification Rules; NFLPA, NBPA, MLBPA, NHLPA

attributes.name: athlete_athlete_profile_id

attributes.name: athlete_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active player contract record governing this roster slot. Links to the athlete contract master for salary, incentives, and CBA compliance details. Confidential as it references financial agreement data.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Management

attributes.name: athlete_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the athlete master record. Identifies the specific player registered on this roster slot. Used as the primary link to athlete identity, contract, and performance data.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee/Talent Record

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified player agent or agency representing the athlete for this roster record. Used for contract negotiations, trade communications, and CBA-mandated agent certification compliance.

attributes.name: franchise_id

attributes.name: league_id

attributes.name: loaned_from_team_franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating team from which the athlete is on loan to the current roster. Applicable in soccer (MLS, FIFA) and hockey (NHL) loan/conditioning assignment scenarios. Null if the athlete is not on loan.

attributes.name: primary_roster_franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the team or franchise master record to which the athlete is currently rostered. Establishes the athlete-team affiliation for the given season.
attributes.references: League Operations — Team Registry

attributes.name: roster_franchise_id
attributes.description: FK to league.franchise.franchise_id — Roster-to-franchise linkage — must know which franchise a roster belongs to for cap compliance, trade eligibility, and league governance.

attributes.name: roster_loaned_from_team_franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating team from which the athlete is on loan to the current roster. Applicable in soccer (MLS, FIFA) and hockey (NHL) loan/conditioning assignment scenarios. Null if the athlete is not on loan.
attributes.references: FIFA International Transfer Regulations; MLS Loan Rules; NHL Conditioning Assignment Rules

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the competitive season for which this roster record is valid. Enables point-in-time roster snapshots across multiple seasons.
attributes.references: League Operations — Season Registry

attributes.name: transaction_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to league.transaction_window. Business justification: Roster activations, deactivations, and IR designations must occur within valid transaction windows. Linking roster to transaction_window enables transaction window compliance validation for roster mov
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the athlete was officially activated onto this roster slot. Marks the effective start of the athlete-team affiliation for this record. Critical for CBA compliance, salary cap calculations, and eligibility verification.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); League Transaction Rules

attributes.name: cap_hit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the salary cap hit amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-league international operations where cap values may be denominated in different currencies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; CBA Financial Provisions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this roster record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance, SOX compliance, and lineage tracking in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the athlete was removed from this roster slot (via trade, waiver, release, retirement, or season end). Null if the roster record is currently active. Enables point-in-time roster reconstruction for any historical date.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); League Transaction Rules

attributes.name: depth_chart_rank
attributes.description: The athlete's positional depth chart ranking within the team (1 = starter, 2 = first backup, etc.). Used for game-day roster decisions, broadcast graphics, and performance analytics. Updated by coaching staff via SportsCode/Hudl.
attributes.references: SportsCode / Hudl Performance Analytics; League Broadcast Standards

attributes.name: draft_pick_number
attributes.description: The overall pick number at which the athlete was selected in the league draft. Used for historical analysis, WAR (Wins Above Replacement) benchmarking, and broadcast content. Null for undrafted players.
attributes.references: League Draft Rules — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS

attributes.name: draft_round
attributes.description: The round in which the athlete was selected during the league draft. Used for historical analysis, broadcast content, and talent evaluation benchmarking. Null for undrafted players.
attributes.references: League Draft Rules — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS

attributes.name: draft_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the athlete was originally drafted into the league, if applicable. Used for service time calculations, CBA eligibility tiers, and broadcast storytelling. Null for undrafted free agents or international transfers.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); League Draft Rules

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this roster record version is considered authoritative and binding. Supports Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Type 2 history tracking in the Silver Layer, enabling point-in-time roster reconstruction for any historical date.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance — SCD Type 2 Standards; CBA Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this roster record version is considered authoritative. Null indicates the current active version. Supports SCD Type 2 history tracking and point-in-time roster queries for league operations, broadcast, and compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance — SCD Type 2 Standards; CBA Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: international_slot_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this roster slot is designated as an international player slot under league rules (e.g., MLS international roster designation, NHL Entry Level Contract international provisions). Affects roster construction compliance and salary cap treatment.
attributes.references: MLS Roster Rules — International Slot Designation; NHL CBA International Provisions

attributes.name: is_captain
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete holds the official team captain designation for the current season. Used in broadcast graphics, fan engagement content, and league ceremonial protocols.
attributes.references: League Team Captain Designation Rules — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA

attributes.name: jersey_number
attributes.description: The uniform number assigned to the athlete on this roster for the current season. Used in broadcast graphics, ticketing systems, merchandise, and fan engagement platforms. Must be unique within a team roster for a given season.
attributes.references: League Uniform Regulations — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS

attributes.name: nationality_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the athlete's primary nationality. Used for international roster compliance (e.g., MLS international roster slots, FIFA international transfer rules), visa tracking, and broadcast content.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FIFA International Transfer Regulations; MLS Roster Rules

attributes.name: nil_agreement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) Agreement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete has an active NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) agreement registered with the league or team. Relevant for collegiate athletes transitioning to professional rosters and for compliance with NIL disclosure rules.
attributes.references: NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) Regulations; NCAA NIL Policy; CBA NIL Provisions

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for league operations staff to record supplementary information about this roster record, such as conditional activation clauses, special designations, or transaction context not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Internal League Operations Standards

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Standardized league-defined code for the athlete's primary playing position (e.g., QB, WR, C, PG, SG, SP, RP, LW, RW, FWD, MID, DEF, GK). Used in performance analytics, broadcast overlays, and roster compliance checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: QB|WR|RB|TE|OL|DL|LB|DB|K|P|PG|SG|SF|PF|C|SP|RP|CP|1B|2B|3B|SS|OF|LW|RW|FWD|MID|DEF|GK — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Position Classification Standards

attributes.name: position_name
attributes.description: Human-readable full name of the athlete's primary playing position (e.g., 'Quarterback', 'Point Guard', 'Starting Pitcher', 'Left Wing', 'Goalkeeper'). Used in broadcast graphics, fan-facing content, and reporting.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Position Classification Standards

attributes.name: practice_squad_elevation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete has been temporarily elevated from the practice squad to the active roster for a specific game week, per NFL and other league rules allowing short-term elevations without permanently activating the player.
attributes.references: NFL Practice Squad Elevation Rules; CBA Practice Squad Provisions

attributes.name: roster_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this roster record, typically assigned by the league operations system. Used in official league communications, broadcast graphics, and regulatory filings. Example: 'NFL-2024-KC-0042'.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS League Operations Standards

attributes.name: roster_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the athlete's roster slot. Drives eligibility for game participation, payroll processing, and broadcast credentialing. 'active' = eligible to play; 'inactive' = on roster but not eligible for current game; 'injured_reserve' = on IR per league rules; 'practice_squad' = developmental squad; 'waived' = released from roster pending waiver wire.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS; League Roster Rules

attributes.name: salary_cap_hit
attributes.description: The annual salary cap charge attributed to this athlete's roster slot for the current season, expressed in USD. Used for cap compliance reporting, trade analysis, and financial planning. Governed by CBA salary cap rules.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: service_years
attributes.description: Accumulated years of professional service for the athlete within the league, calculated per CBA rules. Determines eligibility for free agency, arbitration rights, minimum salary tiers, and pension benefits. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 3.172 years).
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS

attributes.name: slot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the roster slot category as defined by league rules. Determines salary cap implications, game eligibility, and CBA compliance. 'active_roster' = primary game-day roster; 'practice_squad' = developmental; 'injured_reserve' = IR designation; 'reserve' = non-IR reserve list; 'taxi_squad' = NHL-specific developmental designation.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this roster record was ingested. Supports data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse. 'SAP_SF' = SAP SuccessFactors HCM; 'ARCHTICS' = Archtics Venue/Roster System; 'LEAGUE_API' = direct league data feed.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance — Silver Layer Lineage Standards; SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the roster transaction (signing, trade, waiver, draft, transfer) was executed and reported to the league. May differ from activation_date if there is a processing lag.
attributes.references: League Transaction Rules — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: The type of transaction that created this roster record. Indicates how the athlete came to be on this roster slot. Used for league transaction reporting, broadcast graphics, and historical analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: signed|traded|waived|released|drafted|transferred|loaned|retired — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: League Transaction Rules — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this roster record. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, audit trails, and data freshness monitoring in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: visa_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the athlete's current work visa or immigration authorization. Used to trigger renewal workflows and ensure continuous roster eligibility for international players. Confidential HR/immigration data.
attributes.references: USCIS Immigration Regulations; SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Workforce Compliance

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: Type of work visa or immigration authorization held by the athlete for the jurisdiction in which they are rostered (e.g., P-1A for internationally recognized athletes in the USA, O-1 for extraordinary ability). Required for international roster compliance and HR onboarding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: P-1A|O-1|TN|H-1B|J-1|work_permit|citizen|permanent_resident — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USCIS P-1A Visa Classification; GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); OSHA Workforce Compliance

attributes.name: wada_clearance_status
attributes.description: Current anti-doping clearance status for the athlete as reported by WADA or the applicable league anti-doping program. 'cleared' = no active violations; 'pending' = test results under review; 'suspended' = serving a PED (Performance Enhancing Drug) suspension; 'exempted' = holds a Therapeutic Use Exemption (TUE).
attributes.references: WADA (World Anti-Doping Agency) Code; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); CBA Anti-Doping Provisions

attributes.name: wada_last_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the athlete's most recent WADA-compliant anti-doping test. Used to verify testing frequency compliance and support league anti-doping audit trails.
attributes.references: WADA (World Anti-Doping Agency) Code — Testing Frequency Requirements

products.name: athlete_profile
products.description: Core master identity record for every athlete managed by Sports Entertainment. Stores biographical data (full legal name, preferred name, date of birth, nationality, country of origin), physical attributes (height, weight, dominant hand/foot), headshot image reference, social media handles, and career status (active, retired, suspended, deceased). This is the SSOT for athlete identity — all other athlete entities reference this record. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors talent module and league registration systems.

attributes.name: athlete_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the athlete profile record. Primary key for the athlete_profile data product and the single source of truth (SSOT) reference key used by all downstream athlete entities.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Talent Module — Employee ID

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: FK to athlete.agent

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: FK to league.league

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.description: FK to league.team

attributes.name: athlete_type
attributes.description: Classification of the individual's role within the sports organization. Distinguishes active players from coaching staff, officials, prospects, and support personnel for roster management and credentialing.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Job Classification; League Registration Systems

attributes.name: bio
attributes.description: Official short-form biographical narrative for the athlete, approved for public use in broadcast, digital platforms, and media guides. Managed through the content production workflow.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy — Media Asset Management; Adobe Experience Platform — Fan Engagement

attributes.name: career_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the athlete's professional career. Drives roster eligibility, broadcast availability, contract activation, and league reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|retired|suspended|injured_reserve|deceased|inactive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: League Operations Standards; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Roster Rules; SAP SuccessFactors Employment Status

attributes.name: country_of_birth_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the athlete was born. Distinct from nationality; used for eligibility determinations, international federation registration, and demographic analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this athlete profile record was sourced or last updated (e.g., 'successfactors', 'league_registration'). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and audit purposes in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; League Registration Systems; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Athlete's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for age eligibility verification, draft classification, CBA compliance, and league registration.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players; CBA Age Eligibility Rules

attributes.name: dominant_foot
attributes.description: The athlete's dominant foot for sports where foot preference is analytically significant (e.g., soccer, rugby). Used in performance analytics, tactical planning, and broadcast commentary.
attributes.references: FIFA Technical Standards; SportsCode/Hudl Performance Analytics

attributes.name: dominant_hand
attributes.description: The athlete's dominant hand (throwing, batting, or shooting hand). Critical for performance analytics, matchup strategy, broadcast commentary, and scouting reports.
attributes.references: League Scouting Standards; SportsCode/Hudl Performance Analytics

attributes.name: draft_pick_number
attributes.description: The overall pick number at which the athlete was selected in the league draft. Used for historical analytics, contract benchmarking, and scouting model validation.
attributes.references: NFL; NBA; MLB; NHL Draft Regulations

attributes.name: draft_round
attributes.description: The round number in which the athlete was selected during the league draft. Used for contract tier classification, scouting evaluation benchmarking, and CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) rookie scale assignment.
attributes.references: NFL; NBA; MLB; NHL Draft Regulations; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: draft_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the athlete was selected in the league draft. Used for career tenure analytics, contract eligibility windows, CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) rookie scale calculations, and historical reporting.
attributes.references: NFL; NBA; MLB; NHL Draft Regulations; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: eligibility_status
attributes.description: Current league eligibility status of the athlete, reflecting compliance with CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement), anti-doping (WADA), and disciplinary rules. Distinct from career_status — an athlete may be active but temporarily ineligible.
attributes.references: WADA (World Anti-Doping Agency) Code; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); League Disciplinary Regulations

attributes.name: headshot_image_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the athlete's official headshot photograph stored in the Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. Used for broadcast overlays, fan-facing platforms, merchandise, and media kits.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy — Digital Asset Management (DAM); Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Athlete's official measured height in centimetres as recorded at league registration or combine. Used for scouting analytics, broadcast graphics, merchandise sizing, and physical eligibility assessments.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Physical Attributes; League Combine Standards

attributes.name: injury_status
attributes.description: Current injury designation for the athlete as reported to the league. Drives roster availability, broadcast commentary, fantasy sports data feeds, and medical staff workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthy|day_to_day|injured_reserve|physically_unable|out_for_season — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: League Injury Reporting Standards; OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Injury Provisions

attributes.name: jersey_number
attributes.description: The official jersey/squad number assigned to the athlete on their current roster. Used for broadcast graphics, merchandise production, ticketing displays, and fan engagement content.
attributes.references: League Operations Standards; Broadcast Production Standards

attributes.name: league_registration_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by the governing league or federation upon official registration (e.g., NFL Player ID, FIFA Registration Number). Used for inter-system reconciliation, transfer clearances, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players; NFL Player Registration; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: Athlete's legal given name as recorded on government-issued identification documents. Used for contract execution, league registration, and regulatory compliance filings.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: Athlete's legal family/surname as recorded on government-issued identification documents. Used for contract execution, league registration, and regulatory compliance filings.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players

attributes.name: legal_middle_name
attributes.description: Athlete's legal middle name or initial as recorded on government-issued identification. May be required for full legal name matching in contract and compliance contexts.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP SuccessFactors — Personal Information

attributes.name: nationality_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the athlete's nationality as declared on their passport or official registration. Governs international transfer eligibility, work permit requirements, and national team selection.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players; IOC Eligibility Rules

attributes.name: nil_agreement_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete currently has one or more active NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) agreements in force. Used to trigger compliance checks, sponsorship conflict reviews, and revenue tracking workflows.
attributes.references: NIL (Name Image and Likeness) Regulations; NCAA NIL Policy; Salesforce CRM — Athlete NIL Tracking

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the athlete prefers to be publicly known by, such as a nickname or shortened name (e.g., 'LeBron' or 'Messi'). Used in broadcast graphics, merchandise, and fan-facing content.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy — Talent Display Name; Broadcast Production Standards

attributes.name: primary_position
attributes.description: The athlete's primary playing position as designated by the league or team (e.g., 'Quarterback', 'Center Forward', 'Pitcher', 'Point Guard'). Critical for performance analytics, WAR/ERA/QBR calculations, and broadcast commentary.
attributes.references: League Operations Standards; SportsCode/Hudl Performance Analytics

attributes.name: pro_debut_date
attributes.description: The date on which the athlete made their first official professional appearance. Used for career tenure calculations, milestone tracking, broadcast storytelling, and eligibility determinations.
attributes.references: League Operations Standards; SAP SuccessFactors — Employment Start Date

products.name: athlete_contract
products.description: Athlete employment and service contracts governing the full lifecycle from initial signing through free agency. Tracks contract terms (compensation, duration, performance bonuses, trade clauses, option years, CBA-mandated terms), contract type (rookie, veteran, max, minimum, two-way), total value, guaranteed money, signing bonus, annual average value (AAV), and contract status (active, expired, voided, restructured). Includes free agency lifecycle: classification (UFA, RFA, ERFA, franchise tag, transition tag), qualifying offer amounts, tender amounts, right-of-first-refusal flags, free agency open date, signing deadline, and negotiation status. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA SD module for financial obligations and payroll processing via SAP SuccessFactors. Serves as the SSOT for an athlete's complete employment relationship from signing through free agency periods and re-signing.

attributes.name: aav
attributes.description: The Annual Average Value (AAV) of the contract, calculated as total contract value divided by contract years. Industry-standard metric used for salary cap comparisons, market benchmarking, and broadcast commentary.
attributes.references: Sports Contract Industry Standard — AAV Calculation; CBA Salary Cap Accounting

attributes.name: base_salary_year1
attributes.description: The base salary amount for the first year of the contract term. Used for payroll processing in SAP SuccessFactors and salary cap hit calculation in year one.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll — Compensation Element; CBA Minimum Salary Schedule

attributes.name: cap_hit
attributes.description: The amount of the team's salary cap consumed by this contract in the current league year, calculated per CBA rules (base salary + prorated signing bonus + likely incentives). Critical for roster construction and financial planning.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 13 — Salary Cap Accounting; NBA CBA Article VII; NHL CBA Article 50

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, league-assigned or organization-assigned unique contract reference number used in official filings, league submissions, and SAP S/4HANA SD sales contract documents.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales Contract Number; League Office Filing Standards

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the contract. Active: currently in force. Expired: term has concluded. Voided: nullified due to breach, failed physical, or mutual agreement. Restructured: terms modified via amendment. Suspended: temporarily inactive due to disciplinary action or league sanction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Status; League CBA Termination Provisions

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contract by CBA-defined category. Rookie contracts apply to newly drafted players; veteran contracts apply to experienced players; max contracts represent the maximum allowable salary under the CBA; minimum contracts are the league-mandated floor; two-way contracts span both the primary league and a developmental league. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rookie|veteran|max|minimum|two_way|10_day|exhibit_10|rest_of_season — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NBA CBA Article II; NFL CBA Article 7; MLB CBA; NHL CBA; MLS CBA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; ISO 20121

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary values on this contract are denominated (e.g., USD for US Dollar, CAD for Canadian Dollar, EUR for Euro). Required for multi-market leagues such as NHL and MLS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

attributes.name: dead_cap_amount
attributes.description: The salary cap charge that remains against the team's cap after the athlete is released or traded, representing unearned prorated signing bonus and guaranteed money. Used for financial planning and roster management.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 13 — Dead Money; SAP S/4HANA FI — Accrued Liabilities

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract term concludes. Nullable for open-ended or multi-year contracts with option years pending. Maps to SAP S/4HANA SD contract validity end date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Validity End; CBA Term Provisions

attributes.name: free_agency_class
attributes.description: The athlete's free agency classification upon contract expiration. UFA (Unrestricted Free Agent): no team rights retained. RFA (Restricted Free Agent): team retains right of first refusal. ERFA (Exclusive Rights Free Agent): team holds exclusive negotiating rights. Franchise tag and transition tag are team-applied designations preventing free agency.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 9 — Free Agency; NBA CBA Article XI; MLB CBA Article XX; NHL CBA Article 10

attributes.name: free_agency_open_date
attributes.description: The date on which the athlete becomes eligible to negotiate with other teams as a free agent, as defined by the league calendar and CBA provisions.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Calendar; CBA Free Agency Period Rules

attributes.name: guaranteed_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the total contract value that is fully guaranteed regardless of injury, performance, or termination. Critical for salary cap dead money calculations and financial liability reporting.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 26 — Guaranteed Contracts; NBA CBA Article II; SAP S/4HANA FI — Accruals

attributes.name: negotiation_status
attributes.description: Current status of free agency or contract renewal negotiations for this athlete. Tracks the negotiation lifecycle from initial contact through signing or expiration of negotiating rights.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Opportunity Stage; League Office Negotiation Reporting

attributes.name: nil_agreement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Name, Image and Likeness (NIL) Agreement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes or is associated with a Name, Image and Likeness (NIL) agreement granting the team or league rights to use the athlete's identity for commercial purposes.
attributes.references: NIL Legislation (NCAA/State Laws); CBA Image Rights Provisions; IP Law

attributes.name: no_cut_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract contains a no-cut clause preventing the team from releasing the athlete. True = no-cut clause present; False = standard release provisions apply.
attributes.references: CBA Termination Provisions; NFL CBA Article 26

attributes.name: no_trade_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract contains a no-trade clause (NTC) preventing the team from trading the athlete without their consent. True = NTC present; False = no restriction. Critical for roster transaction processing.
attributes.references: CBA Trade Clause Provisions; MLB CBA Article XIX; NHL CBA Article 11

attributes.name: option_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline date by which the option-holding party must notify the other party of their intent to exercise or decline the option year(s). Missing this deadline typically results in automatic option declination.
attributes.references: CBA Option Deadline Provisions; League Calendar

attributes.name: option_type
attributes.description: Specifies which party holds the right to exercise the option year(s): team option (team decides), player option (athlete decides), mutual option (both parties must agree), or vesting option (automatically vests upon meeting performance thresholds).
attributes.references: CBA Option Year Provisions; NBA CBA Article II Section 6

attributes.name: option_years
attributes.description: Number of option years appended to the base contract term. Option years may be exercisable by the team, the player, or mutually, as specified in the contract. Zero if no option years exist.
attributes.references: CBA Option Year Provisions; SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Extension Terms

attributes.name: performance_bonus_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes performance-based incentive bonuses (e.g., statistical thresholds, award bonuses, playoff bonuses). True = performance bonuses are included in the contract terms.
attributes.references: CBA Incentive Bonus Provisions; SAP SuccessFactors Variable Pay

attributes.name: performance_bonus_max
attributes.description: The maximum total amount the athlete can earn in performance-based incentive bonuses over the life of the contract. Used for salary cap likely/unlikely incentive classification per CBA rules.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 13 — Incentive Bonuses; NBA CBA Article II; SAP S/4HANA FI — Variable Compensation

attributes.name: physical_date
attributes.description: The date on which the athlete underwent the pre-contract medical examination. Used for compliance tracking and contract contingency resolution.
attributes.references: CBA Medical Examination Provisions; League Health and Safety Rules

attributes.name: physical_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete successfully passed the team's pre-contract medical examination. Contracts are typically contingent on passing the physical; failure may result in contract voiding or restructuring.
attributes.references: CBA Medical Examination Provisions; League Health and Safety Rules

attributes.name: qualifying_offer_amount
attributes.description: The one-year salary amount tendered to a Restricted Free Agent (RFA) as a qualifying offer, which preserves the team's right of first refusal. Calculated per CBA formula based on prior year salary.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 9 — Qualifying Offers; NBA CBA Article XI; MLB CBA Article XX

attributes.name: right_of_first_refusal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the team retains the Right of First Refusal (ROFR) to match any offer sheet signed by the athlete with another team. Applicable to Restricted Free Agents (RFA). True = ROFR applies.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 9; NBA CBA Article XI — Right of First Refusal

attributes.name: roster_status
attributes.description: The athlete's current roster designation under this contract, which affects salary cap treatment and payroll processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active_roster|practice_squad|injured_reserve|suspended|exempt|waived|non_football_injury|physically_unable_to_perform|reserve — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Roster Rules; CBA Roster Designation Provisions

attributes.name: sap_contract_doc_number
attributes.description: The document number assigned to this contract in SAP S/4HANA SD module for financial obligation tracking, payroll integration with SAP SuccessFactors, and accounts payable processing. Serves as the cross-system integration key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales Contract Document; SAP SuccessFactors Payroll Integration

attributes.name: signing_bonus
attributes.description: One-time bonus paid to the athlete upon contract execution. For salary cap purposes, signing bonuses are typically prorated across the contract years. Processed via SAP SuccessFactors Payroll and recorded in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 13 — Signing Bonus; SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: signing_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the athlete and team executed (signed) the contract. This is the principal business event timestamp for the contract lifecycle, distinct from the effective start date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Document Date; League Office Filing Deadline

attributes.name: signing_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the athlete must sign a new contract or tender to remain with the team or enter free agency. Defined by CBA and league calendar (e.g., franchise tag signing deadline).
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 10 — Franchise Player; NBA CBA Article XI; League Calendar

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract becomes effective and binding. Corresponds to the first day of the contract term per CBA rules. Maps to SAP S/4HANA SD contract validity start date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Validity Start; CBA Effective Date Provisions

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: The gross total compensation value of the contract across all years, including base salary, signing bonus, and performance incentives as stated in the contract. Expressed in the contract currency. Used for salary cap accounting and financial obligation reporting in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Financial Obligation; CBA Salary Cap Rules; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks restructures, amendments, and status changes for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA Change Document; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: wada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes WADA anti-doping compliance clauses and the athlete has acknowledged their obligations under the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) code. True = WADA compliance clause present and acknowledged.
attributes.references: WADA Code 2021; CAS Anti-Doping Arbitration; CBA Anti-Doping Provisions

attributes.name: years
attributes.description: Total number of years covered by the contract term, including option years if exercised. Used for AAV calculation, salary cap projection, and roster planning.
attributes.references: CBA Maximum Contract Length Provisions; League Roster Rules

products.name: performance_stat
products.description: Game-level and season-level performance statistics for athletes across all sports disciplines. Captures sport-specific metrics including WAR (Wins Above Replacement), ERA (Earned Run Average), QBR (Quarterback Rating), goals, assists, rebounds, tackles, saves, batting average, on-base percentage, and advanced analytics inputs. Sourced from SportsCode/Hudl performance analytics platform. Each record represents a statistical line for one athlete in one game or aggregated period, enabling broadcast overlays, fantasy sports feeds, and league standings calculations.

attributes.name: performance_stat_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each performance statistic record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Represents one statistical line for one athlete in one game or aggregated period.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Internal Data Standards

attributes.description: Reference to the athlete whose performance statistics are captured in this record. Links to the athlete master data product in the talent management domain.

attributes.name: athlete_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the athlete whose performance statistics are captured in this record. Links to the athlete master data product in the talent management domain.

attributes.name: franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the team the athlete represented during this statistical period. Captures the team context at the time of the stat, which may differ from current roster assignment due to trades or transfers.

attributes.name: game_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific game or match event for which these statistics are recorded. Links to the event or fixture product. Null for season-level or career-level aggregated stat records.

attributes.references: Sports Entertainment League Operations Standards

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Stat certification data lineage: league compliance and data governance teams must trace which pipeline run loaded or certified each performance stat record for official league audit and regulatory rep
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_performance_franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the team the athlete represented during this statistical period. Captures the team context at the time of the stat, which may differ from current roster assignment due to trades or transfers.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment League Operations Standards

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the league season or competition year to which this statistical record belongs. Enables season-over-season performance trending and standings calculations.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment League Operations Standards

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.vendor. Business justification: Sports organizations procure official stats data from vendors (e.g., Sportradar, Stats Perform). Linking each stat record to its supplying vendor enables data quality audits, vendor contract complianc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: aggregation_method_override
attributes.description: An optional override to the KPI definition's default aggregation method, applied specifically when this stat record contributes to this KPI. Allows governance teams to specify non-standard aggregation for edge-case stat-KPI combinations without altering the master KPI definition.

attributes.name: assists
attributes.description: Number of assists credited to the athlete — passes or actions directly leading to a goal or score. Applicable across soccer, hockey, basketball, and other team sports. Key metric for broadcast overlays and fantasy sports scoring.
attributes.references: FIFA, NHL, NBA, MLS Statistical Standards

attributes.name: batting_average
attributes.description: Baseball-specific metric representing the ratio of hits to official at-bats (H/AB), expressed as a three-decimal fraction (e.g., 0.315). Null for non-baseball records. Foundational hitting metric for broadcast overlays, fantasy sports, and contract evaluation.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: blocks
attributes.description: Number of blocked shots or blocked passes credited to the athlete. Applicable to basketball (NBA shot blocks) and soccer/hockey (blocked shots). Null for non-applicable sport/position combinations.
attributes.references: NBA, FIFA, NHL Statistical Standards

attributes.name: certification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the statistical record was officially certified by the league or governing body. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Null for provisional or pending records. Required for official standings calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, FIFA League Governance Standards

attributes.name: contribution_weight
attributes.description: The numeric weight (e.g., 0.0 to 1.0 or a raw multiplier) applied to this performance stat record when computing the target KPI value. Belongs to the relationship because the same stat may carry different weights for different KPIs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this performance statistic record was first ingested into the Silver layer lakehouse. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and SLA monitoring for the SportsCode/Hudl ingestion pipeline.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Data Governance Standards; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: era
attributes.description: Earned Run Average (ERA) — baseball-specific pitching metric representing the average number of earned runs allowed per nine innings pitched. Null for non-baseball records. Primary pitching performance indicator for broadcast overlays, fantasy sports, and contract evaluation.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: field_goal_percentage
attributes.description: Ratio of successful field goals made to field goals attempted. Applicable to basketball (NBA) and American football (NFL kickers). Null for non-applicable sport/position combinations. Key shooting efficiency metric for broadcast overlays.
attributes.references: NBA, NFL Statistical Standards

attributes.name: fouls_committed
attributes.description: Total number of fouls committed by the athlete in this statistical period. Applicable to basketball (NBA personal fouls), soccer (FIFA/MLS), and hockey (NHL penalties). Tracks disciplinary and gameplay conduct for compliance and broadcast context.
attributes.references: NBA, FIFA, NHL, MLS Statistical Standards

attributes.name: games_played
attributes.description: Number of games in which the athlete appeared and was credited with participation. For game-level records this is always 1; for season or career records this represents the cumulative count. Used in rate-stat calculations and eligibility determinations.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment League Operations Standards

attributes.name: games_started
attributes.description: Number of games in which the athlete was in the starting lineup. Distinguishes starter versus substitute contributions for roster management, contract incentive tracking, and broadcast narrative context.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment League Operations Standards

attributes.name: goals
attributes.description: Number of goals scored by the athlete in this statistical period. Applicable to soccer (MLS/FIFA), ice hockey (NHL), and other goal-scoring sports. Null for sports where goals are not a primary scoring unit.
attributes.references: FIFA, NHL, MLS Statistical Standards

attributes.name: hudl_stat_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by the SportsCode/Hudl performance analytics platform for this statistical entry. Used for source system traceability and reconciliation against the operational system of record.
attributes.references: SportsCode/Hudl Performance Analytics Platform

attributes.name: innings_pitched
attributes.description: Total innings pitched by a baseball pitcher in this statistical period, expressed in thirds of an inning (e.g., 6.2 = 6 innings and 2 outs). Null for non-pitcher or non-baseball records. Denominator for ERA and other rate-based pitching metrics.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: is_home_game
attributes.description: Indicates whether the athlete's team was the home team during this game. True = home team; False = away team. Null for season or career aggregate records. Enables home/away performance split analysis for broadcast storytelling and scouting.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Event Management Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_input
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance stat record is the primary driver of the KPI value (true) or a secondary/supplementary input (false). Used by reporting systems to prioritise which stat to surface in broadcast overlays and governance dashboards.

attributes.name: minutes_played
attributes.description: Total minutes of active participation recorded for the athlete in this statistical period. Used for per-minute rate statistics, workload management, and injury risk analytics. Applicable to basketball, soccer, hockey, and other timed sports.
attributes.references: NBA, NHL, MLS Performance Analytics Standards

attributes.name: on_base_percentage
attributes.description: Baseball-specific metric measuring how frequently a batter reaches base per plate appearance, including hits, walks, and hit-by-pitch. Null for non-baseball records. Advanced hitting metric used alongside batting average for comprehensive offensive evaluation.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: passing_yards
attributes.description: Total passing yards accumulated by the athlete in this statistical period. NFL-specific metric for quarterbacks and passing plays. Null for non-football records or non-passing positions. Key broadcast overlay and fantasy sports metric.
attributes.references: NFL League Office Statistical Standards

attributes.name: plus_minus
attributes.description: The plus/minus differential representing the net score differential when the athlete was on the ice or court. Applicable to ice hockey (NHL) and basketball (NBA). Positive values indicate the team outscored opponents during the athlete's time on the field. Key advanced analytics input.
attributes.references: NHL, NBA Statistical Standards

attributes.name: points_scored
attributes.description: Total points scored by the athlete in this statistical period. Applicable to basketball (NBA), American football (NFL touchdowns/field goals), and other point-based sports. Null for sports where points are not individually attributed.
attributes.references: NBA, NFL Statistical Standards

attributes.name: position_played

attributes.name: tackles

attributes.name: injury_type

attributes.name: is_conditional_pick

attributes.name: pick_number_in_round

attributes.name: pick_type
attributes.description: Classification of the draft pick by its origin. attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 6; NBA CBA; MLB CBA; MLS SuperDraft Rules

attributes.name: pre_draft_grade

attributes.name: round_number
attributes.description: The round within the draft in which this selection was made (e.g., 1 for first round, 7 for seventh round in NFL Draft). Determines salary slot value per CBA and signing bonus expectations.

attributes.name: selection_status

attributes.name: signed_date

attributes.name: signing_slot_value

products.name: eligibility_status
products.description: Authoritative single source of truth for an athlete's current and historical eligibility to compete, encompassing all factors that grant or restrict participation rights. Covers: amateur/professional status, league registration, visa and work permit status, age eligibility, and all disciplinary actions including PED suspensions, conduct violations, game misconduct bans, and CBA disciplinary procedures. Tracks eligibility type, governing body (FIFA, NFL, NBA, WADA, CAS), effective/expiry dates, restriction details, suspension type and length (games, days, indefinite), financial penalties, issuing authority, reinstatement conditions, appeal status and outcomes, and chain of custody to originating doping test or incident. Critical for CBA compliance, international transfer regulations, WADA anti-doping enforcement, broadcast rights clearances, and real-time game-day eligibility verification. Replaces any separate suspension tracking — all disciplinary restrictions are eligibility events.

attributes.references: CAS Procedural Rules; WADA Code Article 13; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the athlete or their representative formally filed an appeal against the suspension ruling. Null if no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 13; CAS Procedural Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appeal was formally resolved by the appellate body (e.g., CAS, league appeals panel). Null if the appeal is still pending or no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 13; CAS Procedural Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any appeal filed by the athlete or their representative against the suspension ruling. 'Not Appealed' means no appeal was filed; 'Appeal Filed' means an appeal has been submitted; 'Appeal Pending' means the appeal is under review; 'Appeal Upheld' means the suspension was overturned or reduced; 'Appeal Denied' means the original ruling was confirmed; 'Appeal Withdrawn' means the athlete withdrew the appeal.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 13; CAS Procedural Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures; FIFA Disciplinary Code

attributes.name: broadcast_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension includes restrictions on the athlete's appearance in broadcast content, media, or promotional materials during the suspension period. Relevant for broadcast rights compliance and content production scheduling.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulations; Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: case_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known disciplinary case number or docket identifier assigned by the issuing authority (e.g., league office, WADA, CAS). Used for cross-referencing with legal and compliance systems.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10; CAS Procedural Rules; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program

attributes.name: competition_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope of competitions from which the athlete is suspended. Some suspensions apply to all competitions (including international), while others are limited to specific competition types (e.g., league games only, international fixtures only).
attributes.references: FIFA Disciplinary Code; WADA Code Article 10.12; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this suspension record was first created in the system. Aligns with the TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Used for data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the suspension is scheduled to end and the athlete becomes eligible for reinstatement. Null for indefinite suspensions. Aligns with the TRANSACTION_HEADER EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); WADA Code Article 10; FIFA Disciplinary Code

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the suspension officially begins and the athlete is prohibited from participating in league activities. Aligns with the TRANSACTION_HEADER EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); WADA Code Article 10.11; FIFA Disciplinary Code

attributes.name: financial_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary fine or financial penalty imposed on the athlete as part of the disciplinary action, expressed in the applicable currency. Null if no financial penalty was assessed. Tracked for compliance and payroll deduction purposes.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Uniform Player Contract; SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting)

attributes.name: hearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal disciplinary hearing was conducted before the suspension was issued. Null if no formal hearing was held (e.g., automatic suspensions for certain violations).
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Disciplinary Procedures; FIFA Disciplinary Code; WADA Code Article 8

attributes.name: hearing_officer
attributes.description: Name or title of the independent arbitrator, hearing officer, or disciplinary panel chair who presided over the disciplinary hearing. Null if no formal hearing was held.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Disciplinary Procedures; WADA Code Article 8; CAS Procedural Rules

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the incident or conduct that led to the suspension. Contains factual summary of the violation as documented by the issuing authority. Classified confidential due to sensitive legal and disciplinary nature.
attributes.references: NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); WADA Code

attributes.name: is_indefinite
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension is indefinite with no fixed end date. True when the athlete is banned until further review or reinstatement conditions are met. When True, effective_end_date will be null.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10.7; FIFA Disciplinary Code; NFL Personal Conduct Policy

attributes.name: is_lifetime_ban
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension constitutes a permanent lifetime ban from the sport or league. Typically applied for second PED (Performance Enhancing Drug) violations under WADA or severe integrity violations such as match fixing.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10.7.1; FIFA Disciplinary Code Article 22; IOC Anti-Doping Rules

attributes.name: is_public_announcement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension has been publicly announced by the league or issuing authority. Some suspensions (particularly early-stage PED violations) may be kept confidential until the appeals process is exhausted.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 14.3; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: is_suspension_stayed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension has been temporarily stayed (paused) pending the outcome of an appeal. When True, the athlete may continue to participate while the appeal is resolved.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 13.2.2; CAS Procedural Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures

attributes.name: issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the suspension decision was formally issued or announced by the issuing authority. Represents the principal real-world business event timestamp (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category).
attributes.references: NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program; WADA Code; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The body or authority that issued the suspension (e.g., League Office, WADA, CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport), Team, Referee Committee, Integrity Unit, Arbitration Panel). Determines the legal and procedural framework governing the suspension. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: league_office|wada|cas|team|referee_committee|integrity_unit|arbitration_panel — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WADA Code; CAS Procedural Rules; FIFA Disciplinary Code; NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Governance Policies

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this suspension record was most recently modified. Aligns with the TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Tracks changes to appeal status, reinstatement, or penalty modifications.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: nil_agreement_impact
attributes.description: Status of the athlete's NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) agreements during the suspension period. Indicates whether NIL deals are suspended, terminated by sponsors, unaffected, or under review. Critical for commercial and sponsorship compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NIL (Name Image and Likeness) Regulations; NCAA NIL Policy; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); Salesforce CRM Sponsorship Records

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the financial penalty amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required when financial_penalty_amount is populated.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting)

attributes.name: prior_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of prior disciplinary violations of the same type on the athlete's record at the time this suspension was issued. Used to determine escalating penalty tiers under WADA and league policies (e.g., first offense vs. second offense).
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10.7; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Personal Conduct Policy

attributes.name: prohibited_substance_code
attributes.description: WADA-assigned code or name of the prohibited substance detected in the anti-doping violation (e.g., 'S1.1 — Testosterone', 'S6.A — Stimulants'). Null for non-PED (Performance Enhancing Drug) suspensions. Classified confidential due to sensitive health-adjacent nature.
attributes.references: WADA Prohibited List (annually updated); WADA Code Article 2.1; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability

attributes.name: reinstatement_conditions
attributes.description: Narrative description of any conditions the athlete must satisfy before being reinstated to active roster eligibility (e.g., completion of a treatment program, payment of fines, passing a drug test, counseling completion). Null if no conditions beyond serving the suspension period apply.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10.11; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the athlete was formally reinstated to active eligibility following completion of the suspension and any required reinstatement conditions. Null if the athlete has not yet been reinstated.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10.11; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Personal Conduct Policy

attributes.name: salary_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Total salary amount withheld from the athlete during the suspension period as a consequence of the disciplinary action, expressed in the applicable currency. Distinct from financial_penalty_amount which is a separate fine. Tracked for payroll and CBA compliance.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); SAP S/4HANA FI/CO (Financial Accounting and Controlling); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: sample_collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the biological sample (urine, blood) was collected for anti-doping testing that led to the adverse analytical finding. Null for non-PED suspensions. Classified confidential due to health-adjacent nature.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 5; WADA International Standard for Testing and Investigations (ISTI)

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or reference code from the originating operational system of record where this suspension was first captured (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors case ID, Salesforce CRM case number). Enables traceability back to the source system for reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM; Salesforce CRM; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: suspension_length_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the athlete is suspended, as specified in the suspension ruling. Null if the suspension is measured in games or is indefinite. Common in WADA anti-doping cases and FIFA disciplinary proceedings.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 10; FIFA Disciplinary Code; CAS Procedural Rules

attributes.name: suspension_length_games
attributes.description: Number of games the athlete is suspended from participating in, as specified in the suspension ruling. Null if the suspension is measured in days or is indefinite. Used for game-based suspensions common in NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program; MLB Joint Drug Prevention and Treatment Program

attributes.name: suspension_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the suspension record. 'Active' means the athlete is currently serving the suspension; 'Served' means the suspension period has been completed; 'Appealed' means the athlete has filed an appeal and the suspension may be stayed; 'Overturned' means the suspension was reversed on appeal; 'Reduced' means the original penalty was reduced; 'Pending' means the suspension has been issued but not yet commenced.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 13; CAS Procedural Rules; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures

attributes.name: suspension_type
attributes.description: Classification of the disciplinary action by the nature of the violation. PED (Performance Enhancing Drug) violations are governed by WADA; conduct violations relate to personal conduct policies; game misconduct covers in-game rule infractions; league discipline covers CBA-governed actions; match fixing and financial breach are integrity-related. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ped_violation|conduct_violation|game_misconduct|league_discipline|match_fixing|financial_breach|eligibility_violation|anti-doping — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WADA Code; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); FIFA Disciplinary Code; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Anti-Drug Program

attributes.name: testing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the anti-doping organization (ADO) or testing authority that conducted the drug test resulting in the violation (e.g., USADA, UKAD, WADA, NADO). Null for non-PED suspensions.
attributes.references: WADA Code Article 5; WADA International Standard for Testing and Investigations (ISTI)

attributes.name: union_grievance_number
attributes.description: The formal grievance or arbitration case number filed by the players' union (e.g., NFLPA, NBPA, MLBPA) on behalf of the athlete under the CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) grievance procedures. Null if no union grievance was filed.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Grievance Procedures; NFLPA; NBPA; MLBPA; NHLPA

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: Specific sub-category or rule code of the violation that triggered the suspension (e.g., 'Prohibited Substance — S1 Anabolic Agents', 'Domestic Violence', 'Gambling', 'Unsportsmanlike Conduct'). Provides granular classification beyond suspension_type for compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product given large enumeration across leagues]
attributes.references: WADA Prohibited List; NFL Personal Conduct Policy; NBA Uniform Player Contract; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); FIFA Disciplinary Code

attributes.name: arm_length_inches
attributes.description: Measured arm length of the prospect in inches from the shoulder to the tip of the middle finger. Used in NFL combine evaluations for offensive and defensive linemen, cornerbacks, and wide receivers.

attributes.name: broad_jump_inches

attributes.name: composite_score

attributes.name: drills_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect completed all required drills and measurements for their position group at this combine event. True = all required drills completed; False = one or more drills were skipped or not completed.

attributes.name: eligibility_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect's draft eligibility has been formally confirmed by the league governing body at the time of this combine evaluation. True = eligibility confirmed; False = eligibility pending or under review.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the combine result record. 'pending' = scheduled but not yet conducted; 'in_progress' = partially completed; 'completed' = all measurements and drills finalized; 'voided' = invalidated due to injury, protest, or administrative error; 'incomplete' = prospect withdrew or was unable to finish.
attributes.references: SportsCode / Hudl Evaluation Platform; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: forty_yard_dash_sec
attributes.description: Electronically timed result of the prospect's 40-yard dash in seconds. The primary speed and acceleration metric at the NFL Scouting Combine; also used in other league combines. Lower values indicate greater speed.
attributes.references: NFL Scouting Combine Official Protocol

attributes.name: hand_size_inches
attributes.description: Measured hand size of the prospect in inches (tip of thumb to tip of pinky with hand spread). Particularly relevant for NFL quarterbacks and NBA players; influences ball-handling and grip assessments.
attributes.references: NFL Scouting Combine Official Protocol

attributes.name: height_inches
attributes.description: Measured height of the prospect in inches at the time of the combine, recorded without shoes per standard combine protocol. Critical physical measurement used in position eligibility assessments and draft grade calculations.
attributes.references: NFL Scouting Combine Official Protocol; NBA Draft Combine Official Protocol

attributes.name: hudl_evaluation_reference

attributes.name: injury_flag

attributes.name: standing_reach_inches

attributes.references: NBA League Office — Draft Combine Protocol

attributes.name: ten_yard_split_sec

attributes.name: three_cone_drill_sec
attributes.description: Timed result of the L-shaped 3-cone drill in seconds. Evaluates a prospect's ability to change direction at speed, hip flexibility, and body control. Key metric for skill position players.
