domains.name: fan
domains.description: Primary customer-facing domain and SSOT for all fan identity, demographic, and relationship data. Manages fan profiles, CRM segmentation, loyalty programs, membership tiers, NPS tracking, engagement history, and consent/privacy preferences under GDPR and CCPA. Serves B2C individual fans, family accounts, season ticket holders, VIP members, and fan club memberships across all engagement channels.

products.name: fan_profile
products.description: SSOT master identity record for every individual fan across all engagement channels. Captures core demographic data (name, DOB, gender, nationality), contact details, preferred language, communication preferences, accessibility requirements, and account status. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform. Serves B2C individual fans, family account holders, season ticket holders, VIP members, and fan club members. This is the golden record for fan identity — all other fan domain entities reference this via fan_profile_id.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Contact / Adobe Experience Platform Profile

attributes.name: fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fan profile record. This is the golden record primary key for fan identity across all engagement channels. All other fan domain entities reference this via fan_profile_id.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: preferred_franchise_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to league.franchise. Business justification: Fan CRM segmentation, personalization engines, and targeted marketing campaigns depend on knowing a fan's preferred franchise. Sports-entertainment CRM systems universally store preferred team as a FK
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: preferred_venue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venue.venue. Business justification: CRM personalization and fan segmentation reports require a proper FK to the preferred venue. fan_profile.preferred_venue is a denormalized plain-text field; replacing it with preferred_venue_id enforc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accessibility_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text description of any accessibility needs or disability accommodations required by the fan for venue attendance (e.g., wheelchair access, hearing loop, visual impairment assistance). Used by venue operations to fulfill Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) obligations.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Title III; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fan's account. Controls access to digital platforms, ticketing, loyalty programs, and communications. 'merged' indicates the record was consolidated into another golden record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|suspended|pending_verification|deactivated|merged — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Status; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: aep_profile_reference
attributes.description: Unified profile identifier assigned by Adobe Experience Platform for fan engagement, personalization, and analytics. Enables cross-channel identity resolution.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Real-Time Customer Profile

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: Fan's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for age verification, age-gated content access, birthday promotions, and demographic segmentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ISO 8601

attributes.name: ccpa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Applicability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan is subject to California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) requirements based on their state of residence. Drives opt-out of sale rights and California-specific data handling procedures.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.100; CPRA Amendment

attributes.name: communication_opt_in_email
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has provided explicit consent to receive marketing and promotional communications via email. Must be True before any commercial email is sent. Governed by GDPR Article 6 and CAN-SPAM Act.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Consent); CAN-SPAM Act; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: communication_opt_in_push
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has consented to receive push notifications via the mobile application. Controls delivery of real-time event alerts, score updates, and personalized offers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; Adobe Experience Platform — Consent Management

attributes.name: communication_opt_in_sms
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has provided explicit consent to receive marketing and transactional communications via SMS/text message. Governed by GDPR Article 6 and TCPA regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: consent_capture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fan's most recent privacy consent preferences were recorded. Required for GDPR and CCPA audit trails to demonstrate lawful basis for data processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.120; ISO 27001

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the privacy policy and consent notice that the fan agreed to at the time of consent capture. Enables compliance teams to identify fans who need re-consent when policies are updated.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: country_of_residence_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the fan's current country of residence. Determines applicable privacy regulations (GDPR for EU residents, CCPA for California residents) and geo-targeted content.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fan profile record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and GDPR data inventory purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing Activities); SOX Section 404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: crm_contact_reference
attributes.description: External identifier for this fan record as stored in Salesforce CRM. Used to synchronize and reconcile the golden record with the operational CRM system.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Object

attributes.name: crm_segment_code
attributes.description: CRM segmentation code assigned to the fan based on behavioral, demographic, and transactional attributes. Used for targeted marketing campaigns, personalized offers, and Lifetime Value (LTV) optimization. Managed in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Member Segment; Internal CRM Segmentation Framework

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has consented to sharing their personal data with third-party partners, sponsors, and advertisers. Required for sponsor activation and targeted advertising programs.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; PCI SSC Guidelines

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: Preferred public-facing name or username chosen by the fan for use on digital platforms, fan clubs, and engagement channels. May differ from legal name.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Profile Attributes

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary email address used for all fan communications, account authentication, ticketing confirmations, and CRM outreach. Subject to GDPR and CCPA consent requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: fan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fan account type. Determines applicable business rules, pricing tiers, and service levels. 'family_account' indicates a parent account with linked sub-profiles. 'vip' denotes Very Important Person (VIP) status with premium service entitlements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Type; Internal Fan Segmentation Policy

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the fan as captured at registration. Used for personalized communications and identity verification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan is subject to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) requirements based on their country of residence (EU/EEA). Drives data processing rules, retention policies, and right-to-erasure workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 (Territorial Scope); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Self-reported gender identity of the fan. Used for demographic analytics, personalization, and inclusive marketing. Collected with explicit consent per GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: is_fan_club_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan is an active member of an official fan club. Fan club members receive exclusive content, early ticket access, and community engagement opportunities.
attributes.references: Internal Fan Club Management Policy; Adobe Experience Platform — Segment Membership

attributes.name: is_season_ticket_holder
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan currently holds an active season ticket for any league or team. Season ticket holders receive priority access, dedicated account management, and exclusive benefits.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS — Season Ticket Account; Archtics — Season Ticket Inventory

attributes.name: is_vip_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan holds active Very Important Person (VIP) membership status, entitling them to premium hospitality, backstage access, and dedicated concierge services.
attributes.references: Internal VIP Program Policy; Salesforce CRM — VIP Segment

attributes.name: last_engagement_date
attributes.description: Date of the fan's most recent engagement activity across any channel (ticket purchase, content view, merchandise order, event attendance, app interaction). Used for recency scoring in CRM segmentation and churn risk models.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Last Activity Date; Adobe Experience Platform — Engagement Score

attributes.name: last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the fan's most recent authenticated login to any digital platform (web, mobile app, OTT). Used for engagement recency scoring, dormancy detection, and re-engagement campaign targeting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Session Data; Internal Engagement Scoring Model

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name or surname of the fan as captured at registration. Used in combination with first_name for full identity.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fan enrolled in the loyalty program. Used to calculate program tenure, anniversary rewards, and cohort-based retention analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Policy; ISO 8601

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: Current unredeemed loyalty points balance for the fan. Points are earned through ticket purchases, merchandise, event attendance, and digital engagement. Used to determine redemption eligibility.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Policy

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: Current tier level within the fan loyalty program. Determines reward multipliers, exclusive access privileges, and personalized offers. Tier is recalculated periodically based on engagement and spend activity.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Policy; Adobe Experience Platform — Loyalty Schema

attributes.name: nationality_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the fan's nationality. Used for international market segmentation, broadcast rights geo-restrictions, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FIFA Regulations; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) provided by the fan, ranging from 0 to 10. Used to measure fan loyalty and likelihood to recommend the brand. Drives CRM segmentation into Promoters (9-10), Passives (7-8), and Detractors (0-6).
attributes.references: Bain & Company NPS Methodology; Adobe Experience Platform — Survey Response

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response was captured. Used to determine recency of sentiment data and schedule follow-up surveys.
attributes.references: Bain & Company NPS Methodology; Adobe Experience Platform — Survey Response

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary mobile or landline phone number for the fan in E.164 international format. Used for SMS notifications, two-factor authentication, and event alerts.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the fan's primary residence. Used for geographic market segmentation, venue proximity analysis, regional sponsorship targeting, and local event promotion.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: preferred_language_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the fan's preferred language for communications, digital platform content, and customer service interactions (e.g., 'en-US', 'es-MX', 'fr-FR').
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; Adobe Experience Platform — Profile Attributes

attributes.name: preferred_sport
attributes.description: The sport or sports property the fan most closely identifies with (e.g., 'NFL Football', 'NBA Basketball', 'MLS Soccer', 'UFC'). Used for content personalization, targeted promotions, and event recommendations. Free-text to accommodate multi-sport organizations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Fan Interest Profile; Adobe Experience Platform — Affinity Attributes

attributes.name: registration_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the fan originally registered their account. Used for acquisition analytics, channel attribution, and Direct-To-Consumer (DTC) strategy reporting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Channel Attribution; Internal DTC Strategy

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fan first registered their account. Used to calculate fan tenure, cohort analysis, and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Created Date; ISO 8601

attributes.name: secondary_email
attributes.description: Alternate email address for the fan, used as a fallback contact channel or for family account management. Subject to the same consent requirements as the primary email.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in the fan profile record. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; SOX Section 404; ISO 27001; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

products.name: account
products.description: Operational account record linking a fan profile to their registered digital or venue account. Tracks account type (individual, family, corporate group), account status, registration channel (web, mobile, in-venue kiosk), login credentials metadata, account tier, and tokenized payment methods on file (card brand, last four digits, expiry, default flag, PCI-DSS token). Distinct from fan_profile (identity) — this is the transactional account used for purchases, ticketing, loyalty redemptions, and stored payment instruments. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account object.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Primary key for account

attributes.name: acquisition_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that drove the fan's initial account registration. Used for Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) attribution, campaign Return on Investment (ROI) analysis, and cohort performance reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Attribution; Adobe Experience Platform; Sports Entertainment Marketing Analytics

attributes.name: fan_club_membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the official fan club membership record associated with this account. Null if the account is not enrolled in a fan club. Enables fan club benefit delivery, exclusive content access, and supporter group governance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Sports Entertainment Fan Club Governance Policy

attributes.name: fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan identity record (fan_profile) that owns this account. Links the transactional account to the underlying fan identity and demographic record managed in the fan domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account-Contact Relationship; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan's primary supported team or franchise. Used for personalized content delivery, targeted marketing, and team-specific loyalty benefit routing. Sourced from fan registration preference or CRM profile.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform Fan Personalization

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program in which this account is enrolled. A fan account may be enrolled in one active loyalty program at a time. Drives points accrual, tier progression, and redemption eligibility.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Sports Entertainment Loyalty Program Policy

attributes.name: preferred_team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan's primary supported team or franchise. Used for personalized content delivery, targeted marketing, and team-specific loyalty benefit routing. Sourced from fan registration preference or CRM profile.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform Fan Personalization

attributes.name: preferred_venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan's primary home venue for event attendance. Used for venue-specific promotions, parking pre-registration, and in-venue personalization services.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fan account. Active indicates a fully operational account; suspended indicates temporary restriction (e.g., fraud review); closed indicates permanently deactivated; pending_verification indicates registration awaiting email or identity confirmation; locked indicates security lockout after failed authentication attempts; deactivated indicates voluntary closure by the fan. Serves as LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Status; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA §1798.105

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Loyalty and service tier assigned to the fan account, determining access to benefits, priority services, and promotional offers. Tiers range from standard (base) through silver, gold, platinum, vip, and elite. Drives CRM segmentation, targeted marketing, and loyalty redemption rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|silver|gold|platinum|vip|elite — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Rating; Sports Entertainment Loyalty Program Policy

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the account by the nature of the fan relationship. Individual covers single-fan B2C accounts; family covers household multi-fan accounts; corporate_group covers B2B group purchasers; season_ticket_holder denotes dedicated season pass accounts; vip_member covers premium hospitality accounts; fan_club covers organized supporter group accounts. Serves as CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|family|corporate_group|season_ticket_holder|vip_member|fan_club — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Type Field; Sports Entertainment Fan Segmentation Policy

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: Brand of the default payment card on file (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex). Non-sensitive card metadata retained for display and routing purposes. Does not constitute PAN or sensitive authentication data under PCI-DSS.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; Salesforce CRM Payment Methods

attributes.name: card_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the default payment card on file. Used to proactively notify fans of upcoming card expiry and prompt payment method updates before renewal or purchase failures occur.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; Salesforce CRM Payment Methods

attributes.name: card_last_four
attributes.description: Last four digits of the default payment card on file. Retained as permitted truncated PAN under PCI-DSS for fan-facing display and customer service verification. Does not constitute full PAN.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3.1 (Truncated PAN); Salesforce CRM Payment Methods

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has exercised their CCPA right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information. True when the fan has submitted a Do Not Sell or Share request. Drives data sharing suppression for California-resident accounts.
attributes.references: CCPA §1798.120; CPRA Amendment; Salesforce CRM Privacy Center

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the fan account was permanently closed or deactivated. Null for accounts that remain open. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Required for GDPR right-to-erasure audit trails and churn analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account; GDPR Article 17; CCPA §1798.105

attributes.name: consent_recorded_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the fan's most recent consent preferences were recorded or last updated. Used as the audit timestamp for GDPR and CCPA consent records. Required for demonstrating lawful basis of processing under GDPR Article 7.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA §1798.120; Salesforce CRM Privacy Center

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the fan account record was first created in the source system (Salesforce CRM). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and registration cohort analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CreatedDate; GDPR Article 5(1)(e); ISO 8601

attributes.name: crm_account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric account number assigned by Salesforce CRM. Used as the business-facing identifier on correspondence, ticketing portals, and fan-facing digital platforms. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; Internal Account Numbering Standard

attributes.name: crm_segment_code
attributes.description: CRM-assigned segmentation code classifying the fan account into a marketing or engagement segment (e.g., HIGH_VALUE, LAPSED, NEW_FAN, REACTIVATED). Used by Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform for targeted campaign execution and personalization.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Segmentation; Adobe Experience Platform Audience Manager; Sports Entertainment Fan Segmentation Policy

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the fan's preferred transaction currency (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, AUD). Used for pricing display, ticketing transactions, and merchandise purchases on the fan's account.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA SD Currency Configuration; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: data_residency_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the jurisdiction in which the fan's personal data must be stored and processed. Drives data residency enforcement, GDPR adequacy decisions, and cross-border transfer controls.
attributes.references: GDPR Chapter V (International Transfers); ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; CCPA

attributes.name: default_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stored payment instrument is designated as the default payment method for this account. True when this is the primary instrument used for automated renewals, loyalty redemptions, and one-click purchases.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Payment Methods; PCI-DSS v4.0

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has provided explicit GDPR consent for personal data processing. True when valid consent has been recorded. Mandatory for fan accounts in EU jurisdictions. Drives data processing eligibility and marketing suppression lists.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(a); GDPR Article 7; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: BCP 47 language tag representing the fan's preferred language for communications and digital platform content (e.g., en-US, es-MX, fr-FR, pt-BR). Used for localized content delivery, email template selection, and multilingual customer service routing.
attributes.references: BCP 47 (IETF RFC 5646); GDPR Article 12 (Transparent Communication); Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful authentication event on the fan account. Used for dormancy detection, re-engagement campaign targeting, and security anomaly detection. Sourced from Salesforce CRM or Adobe Experience Platform session logs.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Login History; Adobe Experience Platform; GDPR Article 5(1)(e) (Storage Limitation)

attributes.name: login_failure_count
attributes.description: Number of consecutive failed login attempts since the last successful authentication. Used to trigger account lockout policies per security standards. Resets to zero upon successful login. Sourced from Salesforce CRM identity management.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS v4.0 Requirement 8.3; NIST SP 800-63B; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: Current unredeemed loyalty points balance on the fan account at the time of the last update. Raw operational balance used for redemption eligibility checks and tier qualification. Not a calculated aggregate — sourced directly from the CRM loyalty ledger.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management; Sports Entertainment Loyalty Program Policy

attributes.name: loyalty_points_ytd_earned
attributes.description: Total loyalty points earned by the fan account in the current calendar or fiscal year. Used for annual tier qualification thresholds and year-end loyalty reporting. Resets at the start of each program year.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Loyalty Program Policy; Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management

attributes.name: marketing_email_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has opted in to receive marketing and promotional email communications. True when explicit opt-in consent has been recorded. Used by CRM to control email campaign eligibility and suppression lists.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(a); CAN-SPAM Act; CASL; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: membership_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric membership identifier printed on physical or digital membership cards. Used for in-venue access control, loyalty redemption at Point of Sale (POS), and fan-facing account lookup. Distinct from crm_account_number — this is the fan-visible card number.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control

attributes.name: mfa_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is currently enabled on the fan account. True when the fan has enrolled a second authentication factor (e.g., SMS OTP, authenticator app). Used for security compliance reporting and risk-based access control.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; PCI-DSS v4.0 Requirement 8; Salesforce CRM Identity

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) recorded for this fan account, on a scale of 0–10. Collected via post-event or periodic surveys. Used for fan satisfaction tracking, churn prediction, and experience improvement initiatives. Raw survey response — not a calculated aggregate.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Adobe Experience Platform Survey; Sports Entertainment Fan Experience KPI Framework

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS survey response was recorded for this fan account. Used to determine survey recency, control survey frequency, and align NPS scores with event or season context.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Adobe Experience Platform; Sports Entertainment Fan Experience KPI Framework

attributes.name: password_last_changed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fan last changed their account password. Used for security policy enforcement, forced password rotation reminders, and breach response workflows. Does not store the password itself — credential metadata only.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Identity; NIST SP 800-63B; PCI-DSS v4.0 Requirement 8

attributes.name: pci_payment_token
attributes.description: PCI-DSS compliant tokenized representation of the fan's default payment instrument on file. The token is issued by the payment processor and replaces the actual card number (PAN). Never stores raw card data. Used for recurring purchases, loyalty redemptions, and ticketing transactions.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; PCI SSC Tokenization Guidelines; Salesforce CRM Payment

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address associated with the fan account, used for login authentication, transactional notifications, and marketing communications. Subject to GDPR and CCPA consent requirements. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account email field.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Email; GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; PCI-DSS v4.0

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the fan account in E.164 international format. Used for two-factor authentication (2FA), SMS notifications, and customer service outreach. Subject to GDPR and CCPA consent requirements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Phone; GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: push_notification_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has enabled push notifications on the mobile app. True when the fan has granted notification permissions. Used for real-time event alerts, score updates, and personalized offers via Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK; GDPR Article 6(1)(a); Apple APNS / Google FCM

attributes.name: registration_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the fan account was originally created. Web covers desktop/browser self-registration; mobile_app covers iOS/Android app registration; in_venue_kiosk covers on-site registration terminals; call_center covers agent-assisted registration; third_party_partner covers registrations via ticketing or partner platforms; pos covers Point of Sale (POS) terminal registration at venue merchandise or box office. Used for channel attribution and acquisition cost analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Channel Taxonomy; Salesforce CRM Lead Source

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the fan account was first registered and activated. Serves as EFFECTIVE_FROM for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Used for cohort analysis, loyalty tenure calculations, and anniversary-based promotions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Created Date; ISO 8601

attributes.name: season_ticket_holder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan account holds at least one active season ticket package for the current season. True when one or more season ticket entitlements are linked to this account. Used for priority access, renewal campaigns, and season ticket holder benefit eligibility.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Ticketmaster/AXS

attributes.name: sms_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has opted in to receive SMS/text message marketing communications. True when explicit opt-in consent has been recorded. Required for TCPA compliance in the US and equivalent regulations in other jurisdictions.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); GDPR Article 6(1)(a); Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the fan account record was most recently modified in the source system (Salesforce CRM). Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM LastModifiedDate; GDPR Article 5(1)(e); ISO 8601

attributes.name: username
attributes.description: Unique login username chosen by the fan for digital platform authentication. Used across web, mobile app, and OTT (Over-The-Top Streaming) platforms. Must be unique across all active accounts. Sourced from Salesforce CRM identity management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform Identity Management; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan account is designated as a Very Important Person (VIP), qualifying for premium hospitality, dedicated concierge services, and exclusive event access. Set by CRM administrators based on spend thresholds or manual designation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Sports Entertainment VIP Program Policy

products.name: household
products.description: Groups individual fan profiles into a household or family unit for B2C relationship management. Tracks household name, primary account holder reference, number of members, household address, combined lifetime value, household income band, and household segment classification. Enables family ticket packages, household-level NPS tracking, multi-member loyalty aggregation, and season ticket holder family accounts. Critical for direct mail deduplication and household-level spend analysis.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the household record in the fan domain. Primary key for the household data product. Entity role: MASTER_PARTY — represents a family/household unit that the business interacts with as a B2C counterparty.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account (Household) Object

attributes.name: fan_club_membership_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the household's official fan club membership, if applicable. Links the household to a specific fan club organization for club-level benefits, communications, and event access.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Fan Club Membership; Adobe Experience Platform — Membership

attributes.name: franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household's primary preferred team or franchise. Drives team-specific marketing, merchandise recommendations, and event notifications for home games.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Preferred Team; Adobe Experience Platform — Team Affinity

attributes.name: household_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary account holder fan profile within this household. The designated head-of-household fan who holds primary contractual and billing responsibility. Used for season ticket holder family accounts and loyalty aggregation. PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Primary Contact; Archtics — Primary Account Holder

attributes.name: merged_into_household_id
attributes.description: If this household record was merged into another household (status = 'merged'), this field references the surviving household_id. Enables data lineage tracking and ensures historical records can be traced to the canonical household.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Merge History; GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy)

attributes.name: preferred_team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household's primary preferred team or franchise. Drives team-specific marketing, merchandise recommendations, and event notifications for home games.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Preferred Team; Adobe Experience Platform — Team Affinity

attributes.name: preferred_venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household's most frequently attended or preferred venue. Used for venue-specific promotions, parking pre-sales, and facility upgrade notifications.
attributes.references: Archtics — Venue Preference; Salesforce CRM — Preferred Venue

attributes.name: primary_fan_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary account holder fan profile within this household. The designated head-of-household fan who holds primary contractual and billing responsibility. Used for season ticket holder family accounts and loyalty aggregation. PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Primary Contact; Archtics — Primary Account Holder

attributes.name: season_ticket_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ticketing.season_ticket_account. Business justification: Household-level STH management — renewal campaigns, family account benefit allocation, and household LTV reporting require a direct household-to-STH-account link. season_ticket_account_number on house
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: acquisition_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the household was first acquired as a fan relationship. 'dtc_app' refers to Direct-To-Consumer (DTC) mobile or web application. Used for Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) analysis and channel ROI (Return on Investment) reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ticketing|merchandise|dtc_app|event_registration|fan_club|referral|social_media|venue_kiosk — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Lead Source; Adobe Experience Platform — Acquisition Channel

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household was first established as a fan relationship record. Used for cohort analysis, tenure-based loyalty calculations, and LTV (Lifetime Value) trajectory modeling.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Created Date; Adobe Experience Platform — First Seen Date

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the household. Used for direct mail campaigns, season ticket holder correspondence, merchandise shipping, and deduplication of household records. Critical for direct mail deduplication per product description.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM — Billing Street

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the household (apartment, suite, unit number). Supplements address_line1 for complete postal address resolution and direct mail accuracy.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM — Billing Street 2

attributes.name: annual_spend_usd
attributes.description: Total spend in US dollars attributed to the household across all revenue streams (ticketing, merchandise, concessions, streaming) in the current or most recent fiscal year. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for household-level revenue reporting and tier qualification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Customer Revenue; Workday Adaptive Planning — Revenue Attribution

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has exercised their CCPA right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information. When True, the household's data must not be sold or shared with third parties for commercial purposes.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.120; CPRA Amendment

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the household's primary mailing address. Used for geographic market segmentation, regional event targeting, and RSN (Regional Sports Network) audience analysis.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM — Billing City

attributes.name: combined_ltv_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Combined Household Lifetime Value (LTV) in USD
attributes.description: Aggregated Lifetime Value (LTV) in US dollars across all fan members within the household, sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD and Ticketmaster transaction history. Represents total cumulative revenue attributed to the household. Used for household-level spend analysis, VIP qualification, and retention investment prioritization. Note: this is a sourced/loaded value from the operational system, not a real-time calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Customer Lifetime Value; Salesforce CRM — Household LTV

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the household's primary address (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN). Determines applicable privacy regulation (GDPR for EU households, CCPA for California/USA households) and international fan base reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the household record was first created in the system of record. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category per MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Created Date; ISO 8601

attributes.name: crm_account_reference
attributes.description: External identifier for this household as recorded in the Salesforce CRM system. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CRM. Serves as the business-facing household reference number.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account ID

attributes.name: data_enrichment_source
attributes.description: Indicates the origin of demographic and enrichment data for this household record. 'self_reported' means data was provided directly by the household; 'third_party' means sourced from a data provider; 'inferred' means derived from behavioral signals; 'crm_import' means loaded from Salesforce CRM; 'combined' means multiple sources merged.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13 (Data Source Transparency); CCPA Section 1798.110

attributes.name: deduplication_key
attributes.description: Composite hash or normalized key used for direct mail deduplication and household matching across source systems. Typically derived from a normalized combination of household name, address, and postal code. Critical for preventing duplicate mailings and double-counting in household-level spend analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Duplicate Management; USPS Address Standardization

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has provided valid GDPR consent for data processing and marketing communications. Mandatory for EU-resident households. When False, data processing must be restricted to legitimate interest or contractual necessity bases only.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 32

attributes.name: household_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name for the household unit, typically the family surname or a chosen household label (e.g., 'The Johnson Family'). Used in direct mail, CRM correspondence, and fan engagement communications. IDENTITY_LABEL category per MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Name; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: household_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the household record. 'active' indicates an engaged household with at least one active fan member. 'merged' indicates the household was consolidated into another. 'deceased' indicates all primary members are deceased. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category per MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Status; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: household_type
attributes.description: Classification of the household composition. 'family' denotes a multi-generational unit; 'couple' denotes a two-adult unit; 'individual' denotes a single-person household; 'corporate' denotes a business account grouped as a household; 'fan_club' denotes an organized fan club treated as a household unit. CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category per MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Type; Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Segment

attributes.name: income_band
attributes.description: Estimated annual household income range derived from third-party demographic enrichment or self-reported data. Used for premium product targeting (VIP packages, luxury suites, premium season tickets), sponsorship audience profiling, and household-level spend propensity modeling.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Household Income; Adobe Experience Platform — Audience Attribute

attributes.name: is_season_ticket_holder
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household currently holds at least one active season ticket package across any league or venue. Critical flag for season ticket holder family account management, priority renewal communications, and dedicated account services.
attributes.references: Archtics — Season Ticket Account; Ticketmaster — Season Ticket Holder

attributes.name: is_vip_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household holds an active VIP (Very Important Person) membership entitling members to premium hospitality, exclusive event access, and dedicated concierge services.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — VIP Flag; Archtics — VIP Account

attributes.name: last_engagement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent engagement activity recorded for any member of the household (ticket purchase, event attendance, app login, merchandise purchase, or content interaction). Used for churn risk scoring and re-engagement campaign targeting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Last Activity Date; Salesforce CRM — Last Activity

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: Current aggregate loyalty points balance accumulated across all household members. Used for redemption eligibility checks, tier qualification calculations, and household-level loyalty reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Points; Adobe Experience Platform — Loyalty Balance

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: Current loyalty program tier assigned to the household based on aggregated member spend, attendance, and engagement. Determines household-level benefits including priority ticketing access, merchandise discounts, and VIP event invitations. Supports multi-member loyalty aggregation as described in the product scope.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Tier; Adobe Experience Platform — Loyalty Program

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has opted in to receive marketing communications across all channels. Distinct from GDPR consent (which is jurisdiction-specific); this is the operational marketing suppression flag used by Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform campaign tools.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Email Opt-In; Adobe Experience Platform — Marketing Consent; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual fan profiles currently associated with this household. Used for family ticket package eligibility, loyalty tier aggregation, and household-level capacity planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Household Member Count; Archtics — Account Member Count

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) recorded for the household, ranging from 0 to 10. Captures household-level fan satisfaction and likelihood to recommend. Supports household-level NPS tracking as specified in the product scope. Used for churn risk identification and fan experience improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — NPS Survey; Salesforce CRM — NPS Score; Net Promoter Score Standard

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS survey response was recorded for the household. Used to determine survey recency, schedule follow-up surveys, and track NPS trend over time.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — NPS Survey Date; Salesforce CRM — Survey Date

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the household's primary mailing address. Used for direct mail deduplication, geographic segmentation, and proximity-based venue targeting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM — Billing Postal Code

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: Household's preferred channel for receiving marketing and operational communications. Drives outbound campaign channel selection in Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform to maximize engagement and respect household preferences.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Communication Preference; Adobe Experience Platform — Channel Preference; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: BCP 47 language tag representing the household's preferred language for communications and digital content (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'pt-BR'). Supports multilingual fan engagement across global markets.
attributes.references: BCP 47 Language Tag Standard; Adobe Experience Platform — Language Preference

attributes.name: preferred_sport
attributes.description: Primary sport preference declared or inferred for the household (e.g., 'NFL', 'NBA', 'MLB', 'NHL', 'MLS', 'UFC'). Used for targeted event recommendations, broadcast content personalization, and sponsorship audience segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NFL|NBA|MLB|NHL|MLS|UFC|ATP|FIFA|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Fan Preference; Salesforce CRM — Interest

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for household-level communications including family ticket offers, loyalty program statements, and newsletter distribution. PRIMARY_CONTACT category per MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM — Account Email

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the household. Used for outbound fan engagement calls, event notifications, and emergency contact for season ticket holders.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM — Account Phone

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: CRM-assigned segmentation code classifying the household into a strategic fan segment (e.g., 'SUPER_FAN', 'CASUAL_ATTENDEE', 'LAPSED', 'HIGH_VALUE'). Drives targeted marketing campaigns, loyalty tier assignment, and personalization strategies via Adobe Experience Platform. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product as segment codes are business-defined and numerous]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Segment; Adobe Experience Platform — Segment Membership

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the household's primary mailing address. Used for regional compliance (CCPA for California households), tax jurisdiction determination, and geographic fan base analysis.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM — Billing State

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the household record in the system of record. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Last Modified Date; ISO 8601

products.name: loyalty_program
products.description: Master definition of each fan loyalty program offered across leagues, venues, and digital platforms. Captures program name, program type (points-based, tier-based, hybrid), earning rules summary, redemption rules summary, program currency name (e.g., 'Fan Points', 'Arena Credits'), program status, effective dates, and associated league or venue scope. Reference entity that governs all loyalty enrollment and transaction records.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each loyalty program record in the Sports Entertainment fan domain. Primary key for all enrollment, transaction, and tier association records.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking this entitlement record to the specific digital content asset being made available under the loyalty program.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: contract_template_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Loyalty programs have significant operating costs (points liability fulfillment, technology, marketing) tracked against a dedicated cost center. Finance uses this link for loyalty program ROI analysis
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Reference to the league (e.g., NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, MLS) that governs or sponsors this loyalty program. Nullable for venue-only or digital-platform-scoped programs not affiliated with a specific league.

attributes.name: policy_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to legal.regulatory_license. Business justification: Loyalty programs with wagering, gambling, or sweepstakes earning components require jurisdiction-specific regulatory licenses. Legal tracks license expiry and conditions; linking to the loyalty progra

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Loyalty program revenue (paid memberships, points monetization, partner earn fees) maps to a specific finance revenue stream. Finance uses this link to budget loyalty-driven revenue separately from ti

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsorship.sponsor. Business justification: Co-branded loyalty programs (e.g., 'Visa Rewards') are governed by a sponsor relationship. Linking loyalty_program to sponsor enables sponsor-attributed loyalty reporting, renewal analysis, and replac
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.vendor. Business justification: Co-branded loyalty programs in sports entertainment are operated with specific partner vendors (retail, F&B, travel). Linking loyalty_program to vendor enables partner program management, revenue-shar
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific venue or arena associated with this loyalty program when scope_type is venue. Nullable for league-wide or digital-platform programs. Links to Archtics venue seating and inventory management.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Management; Internal Venue Registry

attributes.name: access_tier_required
attributes.description: The minimum membership tier within the loyalty program that a fan must hold in order to access this content asset. Belongs to the entitlement, not to the program or asset alone, because the same asset may require different tiers under different programs.

attributes.name: ccpa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loyalty program is subject to CCPA compliance requirements due to enrollment of California-resident fans. When True, fan data processing must comply with CCPA opt-out, data deletion, and disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Civil Code §1798.100); California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loyalty program record was first created in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Audit Standard

attributes.name: crm_program_reference
attributes.description: External identifier for this loyalty program as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the Salesforce CRM operational system of record. Enables audit traceability back to the source system.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Internal System Integration Standard

attributes.name: currency_name
attributes.description: Branded name of the loyalty currency unit used within this program (e.g., 'Fan Points', 'Arena Credits', 'Court Cash', 'Ice Coins'). Displayed to fans in all engagement touchpoints and digital wallet interfaces.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module

attributes.name: currency_symbol
attributes.description: Short symbol or abbreviation representing the loyalty currency in UI displays and statements (e.g., 'FP', 'AC', 'pts'). Used in fan-facing digital platforms and printed membership materials.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Brand Style Guide

attributes.name: digital_wallet_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether loyalty currency balances for this program are accessible via a digital wallet interface in the fan mobile app or OTT platform. Drives integration with Adobe Experience Platform digital wallet features and DTC fan engagement flows.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Internal Digital Platform Architecture Standard

attributes.name: earning_period_type
attributes.description: Defines the time window used for the max_earning_per_period cap. Season aligns with the sports league calendar; calendar_year resets on January 1; rolling_12_months is a continuous window; monthly resets each calendar month.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; NBA/NFL/MLB League Calendars

attributes.name: earning_rules_summary
attributes.description: Human-readable summary of the rules governing how fans earn loyalty currency (e.g., '1 point per $1 spent on tickets; 2x points on merchandise; 5x points on PPV purchases'). Operational detail is managed in the loyalty_earning_rule reference product; this field provides a concise program-level description for reporting and fan communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the loyalty program closes to new enrollments and earning activity. Nullable for open-ended programs with no planned sunset. Programs past this date transition to retired status.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Internal Program Governance Policy

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the loyalty program becomes active and open for fan enrollment and point/credit earning. Governs eligibility windows for all associated transactions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Internal Program Governance Policy

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel through which fans enroll in this loyalty program. Web and mobile_app channels are DTC digital; venue_kiosk and POS (Point of Sale) are in-venue; crm_agent enrollments are processed by Salesforce CRM agents; partner enrollments originate from co-branded or coalition partners.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; Ticketmaster/AXS

attributes.name: exclusive_window_end
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the exclusivity period for this content asset under this loyalty program ends. After this date the asset may become available more broadly or under other programs.

attributes.name: exclusive_window_start
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this content asset becomes exclusively available to members of this loyalty program. Defines the start of the exclusivity period during which the asset is gated to this program's members only.

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loyalty program is subject to GDPR compliance requirements due to enrollment of fans in EU jurisdictions. When True, all fan data processing under this program must comply with GDPR consent, data minimisation, and right-to-erasure requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR (EU) 2016/679; European Data Protection Board Guidelines

attributes.name: is_auto_enroll
attributes.description: Indicates whether fans are automatically enrolled in this program upon meeting eligibility criteria (e.g., purchasing a season ticket or subscribing to an OTT streaming service) without requiring an explicit opt-in action. True = automatic enrollment; False = explicit opt-in required.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (consent); CCPA; Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module

attributes.name: is_paid_membership
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollment in this loyalty program requires a recurring or one-time membership fee. True = fee-based program (e.g., premium fan club subscription); False = free-to-join program. Drives billing integration with SAP S/4HANA SD module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; Internal Revenue Policy

attributes.name: launch_market
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary market in which this loyalty program was launched (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'CAN', 'AUS'). Used for regulatory compliance scoping, market performance reporting, and multi-market program governance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR; CCPA; Internal Market Governance Policy

attributes.name: loyalty_program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the loyalty program. Active programs accept new enrollments and transactions; draft programs are in design/approval; suspended programs are temporarily halted; retired programs are closed to new activity but historical records are preserved.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: max_earning_per_period
attributes.description: Cap on the total loyalty currency units a fan can earn within a defined period (e.g., per season, per calendar year). Controls program financial liability and prevents gaming. Null if no periodic earning cap is defined.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; Internal Program Risk Policy

attributes.name: max_earning_per_transaction
attributes.description: Cap on the number of loyalty currency units a fan can earn from a single transaction (e.g., ticket purchase, merchandise order, PPV event). Prevents abuse and controls program liability. Null if no per-transaction cap is defined.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; Internal Program Risk Policy

attributes.name: membership_fee_amount
attributes.description: Annual or periodic membership fee charged to fans for enrollment in paid loyalty programs. Expressed in the program's operating currency. Null for free-to-join programs where is_paid_membership = False. Used in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; PCI-DSS; Internal Pricing Policy

attributes.name: membership_fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the membership fee amount (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR', 'CAD'). Required for multi-market programs operating across global leagues and venues.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI; GDPR (cross-border financial data)

attributes.name: membership_fee_frequency
attributes.description: Billing frequency for the loyalty program membership fee. Annual and seasonal fees align with sports league calendars; monthly fees support subscription-style DTC programs; one_time fees apply to lifetime memberships. Null for free programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; Internal Billing Policy

attributes.name: merchandise_redemption_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether fans can redeem loyalty currency for merchandise purchases through the Shopify Plus e-commerce platform. When True, the program is integrated with Shopify Plus SKU catalog for redemption workflows.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus; Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; Internal Merchandise Operations Policy

attributes.name: min_redemption_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum accumulated loyalty currency balance required before a fan is eligible to redeem points or credits. Prevents micro-redemptions and controls operational overhead (e.g., minimum 500 Fan Points before redemption is permitted).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; Internal Program Operations Policy

attributes.name: nps_tracking_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Tracking Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Net Promoter Score (NPS) surveys are triggered for fans enrolled in this loyalty program. When True, NPS survey workflows are activated in Adobe Experience Platform following key engagement events such as event attendance or redemption.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Internal Fan Experience KPI Framework; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: partner_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loyalty program is operated in partnership with an external sponsor or coalition partner (e.g., co-branded credit card loyalty, airline miles partner, retail partner). True = partner-operated or co-branded; False = wholly owned by Sports Entertainment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sponsorship Module; Internal Partnership Governance Policy

attributes.name: points_cost
attributes.description: Number of loyalty currency units a fan must spend to unlock access to this content asset under this specific loyalty program. Belongs to the entitlement because the same asset may carry different points costs across different programs.

attributes.name: points_expiry_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing when accumulated loyalty currency expires for enrolled fans. Rolling policies expire points a fixed period after earning; annual_reset clears balances at a calendar year boundary; event_based expiry ties to specific events such as season end; no_expiry means points never expire.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation); CCPA

attributes.name: ppv_earning_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether fans earn loyalty currency on Pay-Per-View (PPV) broadcast purchases. When True, PPV transactions from the broadcast platform are eligible for loyalty point accrual, driving cross-domain fan engagement between broadcast and loyalty.
attributes.references: Broadcast Domain; Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the loyalty program used in CRM, ticketing, and digital platform integrations (e.g., 'NBA_FANPTS_2024', 'ARENA_CREDITS_VIP'). Sourced from Salesforce CRM program catalog.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Program Catalog; Internal Naming Standard

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Full marketing and operational description of the loyalty program including its value proposition, target fan segment, and key benefits. Used in Adobe Experience Platform content personalization, CRM campaign materials, and fan-facing digital platforms.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; Brand Communications Standard

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the loyalty program as displayed to fans across all channels (e.g., 'Fan Points Rewards', 'Arena Credits Club', 'Season Ticket Holder Elite'). Used in Adobe Experience Platform personalization and fan-facing communications.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the loyalty program structure. Points-based programs award redeemable points per transaction; tier-based programs unlock benefits at spend thresholds; hybrid combines both; subscription requires recurring fee; coalition programs span multiple partner brands.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management Module; ISO 20121

attributes.name: program_version
attributes.description: Integer version number tracking major structural changes to the loyalty program rules, tier definitions, or earning/redemption rates. Incremented when program terms materially change. Supports historical analysis of program evolution and fan communication of rule changes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Salesforce CRM Change Management

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: Running count of the number of times fans have redeemed this specific program-asset entitlement. Belongs to the entitlement record as an operational metric tracking demand for this content under this program.

attributes.name: redemption_rate
attributes.description: Monetary value of one loyalty currency unit when redeemed (e.g., 0.01 means 1 Fan Point = $0.01 USD). Used to calculate redemption value in fan-facing statements and in SAP S/4HANA FI liability accounting for outstanding points balances.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; Internal Actuarial Policy

attributes.name: redemption_rules_summary
attributes.description: Human-readable summary of the rules governing how fans redeem accumulated loyalty currency (e.g., '100 points = $1 off ticket purchase; minimum 500 points to redeem; valid on GA and VIP tickets'). Operational detail is managed in the loyalty_redemption_rule reference product.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: scope_type
attributes.description: Defines the organizational scope at which the loyalty program operates. League-scoped programs apply across all teams in a league; venue-scoped programs are specific to a single arena or stadium; team-scoped programs are tied to a single franchise; digital_platform programs operate exclusively on OTT or DTC channels; multi-property programs span multiple business units.
attributes.references: NBA League Office; NFL Governance Office; Internal Program Governance

attributes.name: target_fan_segment
attributes.description: CRM-defined fan segment or audience profile that this loyalty program is designed to serve (e.g., 'Season Ticket Holders', 'VIP Members', 'Casual Fans', 'Family Accounts', 'Digital-Only Subscribers'). Drives Adobe Experience Platform audience targeting and Salesforce CRM campaign segmentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform; Internal Fan Segmentation Framework

attributes.name: ticket_redemption_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether fans can redeem loyalty currency toward ticket purchases or upgrades through Ticketmaster/AXS or Archtics. When True, the program is integrated with the ticketing platform redemption API.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS; Archtics Venue Seating; Internal Ticketing Policy

attributes.name: tier_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct membership tiers defined within this loyalty program (e.g., 3 for Bronze/Silver/Gold; 4 for Standard/Plus/Elite/VIP). Applicable for tier_based and hybrid program types. Zero or null for pure points-based programs with no tier structure.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Module; Internal Program Design Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this loyalty program record. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection in downstream Silver-to-Gold ETL pipelines and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Audit Standard

products.name: loyalty_enrollment
products.description: Records a fan's active enrollment in a specific loyalty program. Tracks enrollment date, current tier (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum), tier qualification date, tier expiry date, cumulative points earned lifetime, current redeemable points balance, points expiry date, enrollment channel, and enrollment status. One fan may be enrolled in multiple programs. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform loyalty modules.

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a fan's enrollment record in a specific loyalty program. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

Linking loyalty_enrollment to digital_touchp
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Reference to the fan's primary affiliated team within the loyalty program context. Used to route team-specific rewards, communications, and event access offers.

attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to league.season. Business justification: Season-based loyalty programs require enrollment records linked to a specific league season for annual tier resets, points expiry processing, and season-end loyalty reporting. No existing unlinked can
