attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program definition record that this enrollment belongs to. One fan may hold multiple enrollments across different programs.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty Module

attributes.name: primary_loyalty_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan profile record representing the individual enrolled in the loyalty program. Sourced from Salesforce CRM fan master.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Fan Object

attributes.name: referred_by_fan_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: The fan ID of the existing loyalty member who referred this fan to the program. Used to credit referral bonuses and track viral growth of the loyalty program.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Referral Management

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has opted in to automatic renewal of their loyalty membership at the end of the current enrollment period. Drives renewal billing and communication workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has exercised their California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) right to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal data associated with this loyalty enrollment.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.120; California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA)

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the fan's consent preferences (GDPR, CCPA, marketing opt-in) were last captured or updated for this enrollment. Required for regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; Adobe Experience Platform Consent Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this loyalty enrollment record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: current_points_balance
attributes.description: The fan's current redeemable points balance available for redemption against rewards, merchandise, tickets, or experiences. Reflects earned points minus redeemed and expired points.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: current_tier
attributes.description: The fan's current membership tier within the loyalty program (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond). Tier determines reward multipliers, exclusive access rights, and benefit eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Bronze|Silver|Gold|Platinum|Diamond — promote to reference product if tiers vary by program]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the fan completed their loyalty program enrollment. Supports omnichannel attribution analysis and channel effectiveness reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|venue_kiosk|pos|call_center|partner|social_media — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM Omnichannel

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the fan formally enrolled in the loyalty program. Used as the anchor date for anniversary-based rewards, tenure calculations, and cohort analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference code assigned to this enrollment at the time of registration. Used on fan-facing communications, membership cards, and CRM lookups. Format: LYL- followed by 8–16 alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Enrollment Object

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fan's enrollment in the loyalty program. 'active' indicates the fan is in good standing and accruing/redeeming points; 'suspended' indicates a temporary hold; 'terminated' indicates the enrollment has been permanently closed; 'pending' indicates awaiting verification; 'expired' indicates the enrollment lapsed due to inactivity or tier expiry.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Program Management; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: enrollment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the fan's enrollment was recorded in the source system. Supports intraday analytics and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; ISO 8601

attributes.name: fan_club_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan is also a registered fan club member in conjunction with this loyalty enrollment. Fan club membership may confer additional points multipliers or exclusive content access.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Fan Engagement; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_given
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Given Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has provided explicit GDPR-compliant consent for the processing of their personal data in connection with this loyalty enrollment. Mandatory for fans in EU jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: is_primary_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is the fan's primary or preferred loyalty program when the fan holds multiple enrollments. Used for default display, primary benefit application, and CRM segmentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Fan Relationship Management

attributes.name: lifetime_points_earned
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all loyalty points earned by the fan since enrollment inception, regardless of redemptions or expirations. Used as a long-term engagement metric and for Lifetime Value (LTV) analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has opted in to receive marketing communications (email, push, SMS) related to this loyalty program. Distinct from GDPR consent — this governs direct marketing specifically.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(a); CAN-SPAM Act; CASL; Adobe Experience Platform Consent Management

attributes.name: membership_card_issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the loyalty membership card (physical or digital) was issued to the fan. Used for card lifecycle management and replacement tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Archtics

attributes.name: membership_card_number
attributes.description: The physical or digital membership card number issued to the fan for this loyalty enrollment. Used for venue access, Point of Sale (POS) identification, and reward redemption. Classified as confidential PII as it uniquely identifies the fan.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; Salesforce CRM; Archtics Venue Seating

attributes.name: next_tier_points_required
attributes.description: Number of additional qualifying points the fan needs to earn to reach the next loyalty tier. Supports personalized upgrade progress communications and fan engagement nudges.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response (0–10) provided by this fan in relation to their loyalty program experience. Used to measure fan satisfaction and program advocacy. Null if no survey response has been recorded.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Adobe Experience Platform Fan Engagement

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent NPS survey response was collected from the fan. Used to determine survey recency and schedule follow-up outreach.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: points_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the monetary currency associated with points valuation for programs that peg points to a currency equivalent (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Null for pure point-based programs with no currency peg.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: points_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fan's current redeemable points balance will expire if not redeemed. Used to trigger expiry warning communications and drive redemption activity.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty Module

attributes.name: preferred_reward_category
attributes.description: The fan's stated or inferred preferred category for loyalty reward redemption (e.g., tickets, merchandise, experiences). Used for personalized reward recommendations and program design analytics.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Personalization; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: previous_tier
attributes.description: The fan's loyalty tier immediately prior to the most recent tier change. Used for win-back campaigns, downgrade communications, and tier transition analytics.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty Module

attributes.name: referral_source_code
attributes.description: Campaign or referral code used at the time of enrollment to attribute the fan's sign-up to a specific marketing campaign, partner promotion, or referral event. Supports Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Return on Investment (ROI) analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM Campaign Management

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fan's loyalty enrollment is scheduled for renewal. Used to trigger renewal reminders, billing events, and lapse prevention campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Program Management

attributes.name: season_ticket_holder
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan enrolled in this loyalty program is also a season ticket holder. Season ticket holders typically receive enhanced tier benefits and accelerated points earning rates.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this loyalty enrollment record was ingested into the Silver layer. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and master data management. Values: salesforce_crm, adobe_aep, archtics, manual.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this enrollment in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce CRM record ID or Adobe AEP profile ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and lineage tracing.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fan's loyalty enrollment was permanently terminated or cancelled. Null if the enrollment is still active. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure and CCPA opt-out compliance workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for the termination of the fan's loyalty enrollment. Used for churn analysis, compliance reporting, and program health monitoring.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; CCPA; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: tier_change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for the most recent change to the fan's loyalty tier. Supports audit trails, fan communications, and program governance reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Program Management

attributes.name: tier_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fan's current tier status expires if qualifying activity thresholds are not maintained. After this date, the fan may be downgraded to a lower tier per program rules.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: tier_qualification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fan qualified for their current loyalty tier. Used to determine tier anniversary, tier protection windows, and downgrade eligibility assessments.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty Module

attributes.name: tier_qualifying_points_ytd
attributes.description: Points accumulated within the current qualification period (typically a rolling 12-month or calendar year window) that count toward tier maintenance or upgrade thresholds. Distinct from redeemable balance.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Loyalty Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this loyalty enrollment record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for change detection, incremental processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: vip_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan holds Very Important Person (VIP) designation within this loyalty enrollment, granting access to premium experiences, hospitality suites, and exclusive events.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM VIP Management; Venue Operations

products.name: loyalty_transaction
products.description: Transactional ledger of all loyalty point earning and redemption events for a fan. Captures transaction type (earn, redeem, adjust, expire, transfer), points amount, transaction date, triggering activity (ticket purchase, merchandise buy, check-in, content view, referral), reference order or event ID, running balance after transaction, and transaction status. Provides full audit trail for loyalty currency movements per fan enrollment.

attributes.name: loyalty_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each loyalty point transaction record in the ledger. Primary key for the loyalty_transaction data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.digital_touchpoint. Linking loyalty_transaction to d

attributes.name: engagement_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sports or entertainment event associated with this loyalty transaction (e.g., the game or concert at which a check-in was recorded or a ticket was purchased). Enables event-level loyalty analytics and attendance-based point attribution.
attributes.references: Internal Event Domain — Event Fixture; Ticketmaster / AXS — Event Reference

attributes.name: fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan profile who is the subject of this loyalty transaction. Supports direct fan-level reporting without requiring a join through enrollment.

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan loyalty program enrollment record that owns this transaction. Links the transaction to the specific fan's program membership.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific loyalty program under which this transaction was processed. Supports organizations running multiple loyalty programs (e.g., league-wide program vs. venue-specific program vs. broadcast subscription program).

attributes.name: membership_tier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan's loyalty membership tier at the time of this transaction (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, VIP). Captures the tier context for point multiplier application and tier-based benefit eligibility at the time of the event.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Tier Object; Internal Fan Membership Tier Policy

attributes.name: nps_survey_id
attributes.description: Reference to an NPS survey completion event that triggered this loyalty transaction, if the activity_type is 'survey_completion'. Null for all other activity types. Links loyalty incentivization to fan satisfaction measurement programs.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Survey Activity; Salesforce CRM — NPS Campaign; Internal Fan Engagement KPI Framework

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch processing run that generated or confirmed this loyalty transaction, if applicable (e.g., nightly post-event check-in reconciliation batch or monthly points expiry batch). Null for real-time transactions. Supports batch reconciliation and reprocessing.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Operations — Batch Processing Standard; Salesforce CRM — Batch Job Reference

attributes.name: ppv_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to broadcast.ppv_package. Business justification: Loyalty points redeemed for PPV access must reference the specific PPV package being redeemed. loyalty_program has ppv_earning_enabled flag; this FK enables redemption fulfillment tracking and PPV-loy
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_loyalty_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan profile who is the subject of this loyalty transaction. Supports direct fan-level reporting without requiring a join through enrollment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact/Fan Object; Adobe Experience Platform — Fan Identity

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional campaign or bonus multiplier offer that influenced the points calculation for this transaction. Null if no promotion was applied. Supports promotion performance measurement and ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign / Promotion Object; Adobe Experience Platform — Offer Decisioning

attributes.name: revenue_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Loyalty points transactions must be classified against a revenue stream for deferred revenue accounting (points liability) and revenue recognition upon redemption. Finance uses this to report loyalty

attributes.name: reversal_of_transaction_loyalty_transaction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original loyalty transaction that this record reverses or corrects. Null for original transactions. Enables full audit chain reconstruction for reversed or adjusted point movements.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Ledger Audit Standard; SOX — Transaction Audit Trail

attributes.name: reward_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific reward catalog item redeemed in this transaction. Populated only for redemption-type transactions. Enables reward popularity analytics and redemption rate reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Reward Catalog; Internal Loyalty Reward Management Policy

attributes.name: ticket_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating order or purchase transaction that triggered this loyalty earn or redemption event (e.g., a ticket order in Ticketmaster/AXS or a merchandise order in Shopify Plus). Null for non-order-triggered transactions such as check-ins or content views.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS — Order Reference; Shopify Plus — Order ID; SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales Order

attributes.name: transfer_target_fan_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: For transfer-type transactions, the fan profile ID of the recipient who receives the transferred points. Null for all non-transfer transaction types. Supports family account and fan-to-fan transfer tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Fan Relationship / Household Object; Internal Loyalty Transfer Policy

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the venue where the triggering activity occurred, if applicable (e.g., in-venue check-in, POS purchase, or gate scan). Null for digital or non-venue activities. Enables venue-level loyalty analytics and location-based engagement reporting.
attributes.references: Archtics — Venue Reference; Internal Venue Operations Domain

attributes.name: wager_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gaming.wager. Business justification: Loyalty points earned on wagers: when a bettor earns loyalty points for placing a wager, the loyalty transaction must reference the originating wager for points calculation audit, dispute resolution,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: activity_channel
attributes.description: The engagement channel through which the triggering activity was performed. Distinguishes between mobile app, web portal, venue Point of Sale (POS) terminal, call center, or partner system. Supports omnichannel loyalty analytics and channel attribution.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Channel Attribution; Salesforce CRM — Omnichannel Engagement

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The specific fan activity that triggered this loyalty transaction. Identifies the business action that caused the point movement, enabling activity-level analytics and program ROI measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ticket_purchase|merchandise_purchase|event_check_in|content_view|referral|social_share|survey_completion|app_login|ppv_purchase|subscription_renewal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Fan Engagement Activity Schema; Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Activity Catalog

attributes.name: base_points_amount
attributes.description: The raw points amount calculated before any multiplier, bonus, or promotional adjustment is applied. Together with points_multiplier and points_amount, provides a full audit trail of the points calculation logic.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Points Calculation Audit; Internal Loyalty Ledger Standard

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has exercised their CCPA right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal data at the time of this transaction. True = fan has opted out; False = no opt-out recorded. Required for California market compliance.
attributes.references: CCPA — Right to Opt-Out of Sale; California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this loyalty transaction record was first created in the data platform. Audit field supporting data lineage, SLA compliance measurement, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance — Audit Trail Standard; SOX — Record Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary_value associated with this loyalty transaction (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan's GDPR consent for loyalty data processing was verified as active at the time of this transaction. True = consent confirmed; False = consent not confirmed or withdrawn. Critical for EU market compliance and data processing lawfulness.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 — Lawfulness of Processing; GDPR Article 7 — Conditions for Consent; CCPA — Consumer Rights

attributes.name: is_bonus_transaction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction represents a bonus points award outside of the standard earn rate (e.g., birthday bonus, milestone bonus, welcome bonus, special event bonus). True = bonus transaction; False = standard transaction. Supports bonus program analytics and cost tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Bonus Award; Internal Loyalty Bonus Program Policy

attributes.name: is_tier_qualifying
attributes.description: Indicates whether the points from this transaction count toward the fan's tier qualification threshold (some programs separate qualifying points from total points). True = counts toward tier qualification; False = does not count (e.g., bonus or promotional points). Supports tier progression analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Tier Qualification Rules; Internal Membership Tier Policy

attributes.name: monetary_value
attributes.description: The monetary spend amount (in the operating currency) associated with the triggering activity for this transaction. Used to calculate earn rates (points per dollar spent) and to measure the financial value of loyalty-driving purchases. Applicable for purchase-triggered transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Revenue Recognition; PCI-DSS — Transaction Amount; Internal Loyalty Earn Rate Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for customer service agents or loyalty operations staff to record contextual notes about this transaction (e.g., manual adjustment rationale, escalation context, special circumstance). Supports operational transparency and audit documentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Activity Notes; Internal Loyalty Operations Runbook

attributes.name: points_amount
attributes.description: The number of loyalty points earned, redeemed, adjusted, expired, or transferred in this transaction. Positive values represent points added to the balance; negative values represent points deducted. Decimal precision supports fractional point awards from multiplier promotions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Points Ledger; Internal Loyalty Currency Policy

attributes.name: points_balance_after
attributes.business_glossary_term: Loyalty Points Running Balance After Transaction
attributes.description: The fan's total loyalty point balance immediately after this transaction was applied. Provides a running ledger balance for audit trail purposes and enables point balance reconstruction at any point in time without aggregation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Ledger Balance; Internal Loyalty Audit Standard

attributes.name: points_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the points earned in this transaction are scheduled to expire if not redeemed, per the loyalty program's expiration policy. Null for non-earn transactions or programs with no expiry. Supports proactive fan communications and expiry-driven engagement campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Points Expiry Policy; GDPR Article 5 — Data Minimisation (fan notification obligations)

attributes.name: points_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier factor applied to the base points calculation for this transaction, driven by membership tier, active promotions, or special event bonuses. A value of 1.00 indicates no multiplier; 2.00 indicates double points. Supports audit of why a fan received a specific points amount.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Tier Multiplier; Internal Loyalty Promotion Rules Engine

attributes.name: processing_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the loyalty transaction was processed and applied to the fan's balance by the loyalty management system. May differ from transaction_timestamp for batch-processed or delayed-confirmation transactions (e.g., post-event check-in reconciliation).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Processing Date; Internal Loyalty Operations SLA

attributes.name: redemption_value
attributes.description: The monetary equivalent value of the points redeemed in this transaction, expressed in the operating currency. Populated only for redemption-type transactions. Used for loyalty liability accounting, reward cost tracking, and EBITDA impact analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Loyalty Liability Accounting; Internal Loyalty Redemption Valuation Policy; SOX — Financial Controls

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for why a transaction was reversed or adjusted. Populated only when transaction_status is 'reversed' or transaction_type is 'adjust'. Supports audit compliance and customer service resolution tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Operations Audit Policy; SOX — Financial Controls (for monetary-linked reversals)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this loyalty transaction event. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and system-of-record traceability across the loyalty ecosystem. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_crm|adobe_aep|ticketmaster|axs|shopify|sap_s4|archtics|manual — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance — System of Record Registry; Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform; Ticketmaster / AXS; Shopify Plus; SAP S/4HANA; Archtics

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Ticketmaster order number, Shopify order ID, SAP document number). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS — Order Reference; Shopify Plus — Order Name; SAP S/4HANA SD — Document Number

attributes.name: tier_qualifying_points
attributes.description: The number of points from this transaction that count specifically toward the fan's tier qualification balance, which may differ from the total points_amount when bonus or promotional points are excluded from tier calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Tier Qualification Ledger; Internal Membership Tier Governance

attributes.name: transaction_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this loyalty transaction. Used in fan-facing communications, customer service lookups, and audit trails. Format: LT- followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Transaction Reference; Internal Loyalty Program Operations Standard

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the loyalty transaction. Pending indicates awaiting confirmation from the triggering system; confirmed indicates points have been applied to the balance; reversed indicates a corrective rollback; failed indicates a processing error; cancelled indicates voided before application.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Management Module; Internal Loyalty Operations SLA

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the loyalty point event occurred in the real world (e.g., when the ticket was purchased, when the check-in was recorded, when the content was viewed). This is the principal business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Experience Event Timestamp; ISO 8601

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the loyalty point movement: earn (points awarded for qualifying activity), redeem (points spent by fan), adjust (manual correction or bonus), expire (points removed due to inactivity or policy), transfer (points moved between accounts).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Management Module; Adobe Experience Platform — Loyalty Event Schema

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this loyalty transaction record was most recently modified in the data platform (e.g., status update from pending to confirmed, or reversal applied). Supports change data capture and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance — Audit Trail Standard; SOX — Record Integrity

products.name: membership
products.description: Master record for a fan's paid or complimentary membership and its associated benefits. Tracks membership type (season ticket holder, VIP club, fan club, OTT subscription), membership number, start/end dates, renewal status, auto-renew flag, fee, payment frequency, assigned seat block, and membership status. Also defines attached benefits: benefit type (priority ticketing, parking pass, merchandise discount, VIP lounge access, meet-and-greet, exclusive content), quantity/usage limits, redemption method, benefit value, and validity period. Distinct from loyalty enrollment — membership is a paid contractual relationship with defined benefit packages, not a points program.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Sales or acquisition channel through which the fan purchased or enrolled in the membership. Used for channel attribution, CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) analysis, and marketing ROI reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the membership record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: credential_type

attributes.references: Identified in detection phase relationship data

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the membership fee and any financial values on this record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, AUD). Supports multi-market operations across global leagues.

attributes.name: discount_amount

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; Archtics Membership Module

attributes.name: exclusive_content_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this membership grants access to exclusive digital content (behind-the-scenes footage, member-only streams, editorial content) via OTT (Over-The-Top Streaming) or DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) platforms.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Content Entitlement; Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; Sports Entertainment DTC Content Policy

attributes.name: fee
attributes.description: Gross fee amount charged to the fan for the membership per payment frequency cycle, in the operating currency. Represents the contractual price before any discounts or waivers. Used in revenue recognition and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; SOX Section 606 Revenue Recognition; PCI-DSS v4.0

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has provided valid GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) consent for processing their personal data in connection with this membership. Mandatory for EU-market members. Drives data processing eligibility in Adobe Experience Platform.

attributes.name: grant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this zone access grant. Allows individual membership-zone permissions to be suspended or revoked independently of the membership status or zone status — e.g., revoking field-level access for a member under investigation without cancelling their full membership.
attributes.references: Operational lifecycle attribute required for access control management

attributes.name: is_corporate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this membership is held under a corporate account (B2B) rather than an individual fan (B2C). Corporate memberships may have different billing, benefit allocation, and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Type; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: is_vip
attributes.description: Indicates whether this membership grants VIP (Very Important Person) status, entitling the fan to premium hospitality, lounge access, and priority services. Distinct from membership_tier — a flag used operationally for real-time access control at venues.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS VIP Access Control; Sports Entertainment VIP Hospitality Policy

attributes.name: lounge_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this membership grants access to VIP (Very Important Person) lounge facilities at the venue. Operationally consumed by Ticketmaster/AXS access control and venue operations teams.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive marketing communications (email, SMS, push notifications) from the organization. Distinct from GDPR consent — this governs direct marketing specifically. Consumed by Adobe Experience Platform campaign orchestration.

attributes.name: meet_greet_allotment

attributes.name: membership_number

attributes.name: membership_status

attributes.name: membership_tier

attributes.name: membership_type

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag

attributes.description: The monetary value of the benefit as assessed for financial reporting, sponsor valuation, and VIP package costing (e.g., a meet-and-greet valued at $500, a parking pass valued at $50). attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan must provide explicit consent (e.g., for data sharing with a sponsor partner or for personalised content delivery) before this benefit can be activated. Supports GDPR and CCPA consent management workflows in Adobe Experience Platform.

attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit is automatically renewed at the start of each new membership period or season (True) or requires manual re-activation (False). Drives automated benefit provisioning workflows in Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform.

attributes.name: is_stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit can be combined with other benefits or promotions simultaneously (True) or whether it is exclusive and cannot be stacked (False). For example, a merchandise discount benefit may not be stackable with a promotional sale discount. Used by Shopify Plus and POS discount engines.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus — Discount Combination Rules; SAP S/4HANA SD — Exclusivity Group

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan may transfer this benefit to another person (True) or whether it is non-transferable and tied to the named member only (False). Relevant for guest passes, parking passes, and hospitality benefits. Enforced at the point of redemption.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Membership Terms and Conditions; Ticketmaster/AXS — Transfer Eligibility

attributes.name: last_redeemed_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent redemption of this benefit by the fan. Used for engagement analytics, benefit utilisation reporting, and identifying dormant benefits for fan re-engagement campaigns in Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Last Redemption Date; Adobe Experience Platform — Last Interaction Timestamp

attributes.name: nps_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether redemption of this benefit triggers an NPS survey to the fan for experience feedback collection. Supports fan satisfaction measurement and VIP experience improvement programmes managed via Adobe Experience Platform and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — NPS Survey Trigger; Sports Entertainment Fan Experience KPI Framework

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the priority order of this benefit relative to other benefits within the same membership tier or membership record. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used to resolve conflicts when multiple benefits apply simultaneously and to order benefit display in fan-facing portals.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Entitlement Priority; Sports Entertainment Membership Benefit Hierarchy

attributes.name: quantity_allocated
attributes.description: The total number of units of this benefit allocated to the membership or tier (e.g., 4 priority ticket windows, 2 parking passes, 1 meet-and-greet slot). Null or zero indicates unlimited allocation. Used for benefit inventory management and fulfilment tracking.
attributes.references: Archtics — Benefit Allocation; Salesforce CRM — Entitlement Quantity

attributes.name: quantity_redeemed
attributes.description: The number of benefit units that have been redeemed by the fan to date within the current validity period. Used alongside quantity_allocated to determine remaining entitlement and drive fulfilment controls.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Entitlement Used Count; Ticketmaster/AXS — Redemption Count

attributes.name: redemption_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time after which the benefit can no longer be redeemed. Provides finer-grained control than effective_until for time-sensitive benefits such as pre-event VIP access windows or flash merchandise discounts.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS — Sale Close Timestamp; Salesforce CRM — Entitlement Expiry Time

attributes.name: redemption_method
attributes.description: The technical mechanism by which the fan redeems the benefit. Drives integration with access control and POS systems. 'barcode' and 'qr_code' are used with Ticketmaster/AXS; 'rfid' with Archtics venue access; 'voucher_code' with Shopify Plus merchandise; 'auto_applied' for benefits applied automatically at checkout or entry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: barcode|qr_code|rfid|voucher_code|digital_wallet|manual|auto_applied — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS — Access Control Method; Archtics — Credential Type; Shopify Plus — Discount Application Method

attributes.name: redemption_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time from which the fan may begin redeeming this benefit. May differ from effective_from when a benefit window opens at a specific time (e.g., priority ticket sales opening at 10:00 AM on a specific date). Used for time-gated benefit activation.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS — On-Sale Timestamp; Salesforce CRM — Entitlement Activation Time

attributes.name: season_year
attributes.description: The sports season year to which this benefit applies (e.g., 2024 for the 2024 season, or 2024 for a 2024/25 season). Used to scope benefits to a specific competitive season for season ticket holders and annual membership programs.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment League Operations — Season Calendar; Archtics — Season Code

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this benefit record originated or is primarily managed. Used for data lineage, integration audit, and conflict resolution in the Silver layer of the Databricks Lakehouse. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_crm|adobe_experience_platform|archtics|ticketmaster_axs|shopify_plus|sap_s4hana|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Data Governance Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: URL linking to the full terms and conditions governing the use of this benefit. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance to ensure fans have access to the conditions under which their benefit entitlements are granted and may be revoked.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13 — Information to be Provided; CCPA Section 1798.100; Sports Entertainment Membership Terms

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this membership benefit record was last modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Accountability; SOX Section 404; Databricks Lakehouse CDC Standards

attributes.name: usage_limit_per_event
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this benefit can be redeemed at a single event. For example, a VIP lounge pass may allow entry once per event, or a priority ticket window may allow purchase of up to 4 tickets per event. Null indicates no per-event restriction.
attributes.references: Archtics — Per-Event Entitlement Cap; Ticketmaster/AXS — Per-Event Usage Rule

attributes.name: venue_zone
attributes.description: The specific zone or area within the venue where this benefit is applicable or redeemable (e.g., 'VIP Lounge Level 3', 'Club Concourse', 'Premium Parking Zone A'). Used by Archtics for access control configuration and venue operations staff for benefit fulfilment.
attributes.references: Archtics — Zone Configuration; Sports Entertainment Venue Operations

attributes.name: vip_tier_level
attributes.description: The VIP tier classification associated with this benefit, indicating the prestige level of the benefit within the fan loyalty hierarchy. Used for VIP experience management, venue access prioritisation, and fan segmentation in Adobe Experience Platform and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Loyalty Tier; Adobe Experience Platform — Segment Tier; Sports Entertainment VIP Programme

products.name: segment
products.description: CRM segmentation records classifying fans into behavioral, demographic, and value-based segments for targeted marketing and personalization. Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform audience segments and Salesforce CRM campaigns. Enables personalized fan engagement, DTC marketing, and campaign targeting.

attributes.name: target_team_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific team or franchise associated with this segment. Enables team-level fan segmentation for localized marketing, merchandise promotions, and event-specific campaigns.

attributes.name: age_band_max
attributes.description: Maximum age (in years) of fans included in this segment. Used in conjunction with age_band_min to define a demographic age range for targeted campaigns. Nullable if no upper age bound is defined.

attributes.name: age_band_min

attributes.name: ccpa_applicable

attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment includes California residents subject to CCPA regulation. When true, opt-out of sale rights and data disclosure requirements must be honored before campaign activation.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.100; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of marketing and engagement channels for which this segment is activated (e.g., 'email, push_notification, sms, in_app, paid_social, display'). Guides campaign execution teams on appropriate activation channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|push_notification|sms|in_app|paid_social|display|direct_mail — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Destinations; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Channel Configuration

attributes.name: consent_requirement
attributes.description: Specifies the consent basis required for fans to be included in this segment and activated for marketing. Explicit consent is required for GDPR-regulated EU fans; legitimate interest may apply for certain analytics use cases. Ensures compliance with GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Consent); CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment record was first created in the source system and ingested into the Silver Layer. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Provides audit trail for segment lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: definition_criteria
attributes.description: Structured or semi-structured expression of the business rules and logic used to qualify fans into this segment (e.g., SQL predicate, JSON rule set, or natural-language description of inclusion/exclusion criteria). Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform segment builder or Salesforce CRM campaign filter logic.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Segment Builder; Salesforce CRM Campaign Criteria

attributes.name: definition_format
attributes.description: Format of the definition_criteria field, indicating how the segment logic is expressed. PQL refers to Adobe Experience Platform Profile Query Language. Enables downstream systems to parse and execute the segment definition correctly.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Profile Query Language (PQL) Specification

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this segment definition is considered active and eligible for campaign use. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd. Supports time-bounded segmentation strategies such as seasonal campaigns or event-specific audiences.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Start Date; Adobe Experience Platform Segment Validity

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date after which this segment definition expires and is no longer eligible for active campaign targeting. Nullable for evergreen segments with no defined end date. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign End Date; Adobe Experience Platform Segment Validity

attributes.name: engagement_score_max
attributes.description: Maximum fan engagement score for inclusion in this segment. Used in conjunction with engagement_score_min to define a score band for precise audience targeting. Nullable if no upper bound is defined.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Fan Engagement Scoring

attributes.name: engagement_score_min
attributes.description: Minimum fan engagement score required for inclusion in this segment, as calculated by Adobe Experience Platform. Engagement scores reflect fan interaction frequency, recency, and depth across digital and physical touchpoints.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Fan Engagement Scoring

attributes.name: fan_count
attributes.description: Number of fan profiles qualifying for this segment as of the last refresh date. Represents the segment size used for campaign reach estimation, budget planning, and audience reporting. Not a real-time count — reflects the most recent batch evaluation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Audience Size Metric; Salesforce CRM Campaign Member Count

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment includes fans subject to GDPR regulation (EU/EEA residents). When true, additional consent validation and data processing restrictions apply before campaign activation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 (Territorial Scope); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the segment, expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region identifiers (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Defines the geographic boundary for campaign activation and regulatory compliance determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; GDPR Article 3; CCPA

attributes.name: is_dtc_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is approved for Direct-To-Consumer (DTC) marketing activation, including OTT streaming promotions, DTC merchandise offers, and subscription upsell campaigns. Supports DTC revenue strategy.
attributes.references: Internal DTC Marketing Policy; Adobe Experience Platform Activation Governance

attributes.name: is_suppression_list
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment functions as a suppression or exclusion list, identifying fans who should be excluded from specific campaigns (e.g., opted-out fans, recent purchasers, VIP do-not-contact lists). Critical for GDPR and CCPA compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); CCPA Section 1798.120; Salesforce CRM Suppression List

attributes.name: last_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the segment membership was most recently evaluated and the fan_count was last updated. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Critical for assessing data freshness before campaign activation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Segment Job API

attributes.name: ltv_band
attributes.description: Lifetime Value (LTV) classification band for fans in this segment, indicating their predicted or historical revenue contribution over their relationship with the organization. High-LTV segments receive premium personalization and VIP treatment. Supports ARPU and LTV analytics.
attributes.references: LTV Methodology; Adobe Experience Platform Predictive Scoring; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: membership_tier_filter
attributes.description: Fan loyalty membership tier(s) included in this segment (e.g., 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'platinum', 'vip'). Enables tier-specific personalization, exclusive offers, and loyalty program communications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bronze|silver|gold|platinum|vip|season_ticket_holder|fan_club — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Program Object; Internal Fan Membership Tier Taxonomy

attributes.name: model_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum propensity or confidence score from the predictive model required for fan inclusion in this segment. Expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.7500 = 75% confidence). Applicable only when segment_type is 'predictive'.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Customer AI Scoring; Internal ML Model Governance

attributes.name: next_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for the next segment membership evaluation run. Used by campaign operations teams to plan activation timing and ensure segment data is current before campaign launch.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Segment Scheduler

attributes.name: nps_band
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) classification band associated with fans in this segment: promoters (score 9-10), passives (score 7-8), detractors (score 0-6), or unknown if NPS data is unavailable. Enables NPS-driven personalization and retention campaigns.

attributes.name: owning_business_unit

attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Business Unit Object; Internal Organizational Taxonomy

attributes.name: owning_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary Salesforce CRM campaign or Adobe Experience Platform journey that owns or originated this segment. Links the segment to its marketing campaign context for attribution and ROI reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object; Adobe Experience Platform Journey Optimizer

attributes.name: refresh_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently the segment membership is re-evaluated and updated. Real-time segments use Adobe Experience Platform streaming segmentation; batch segments are evaluated on a scheduled cadence. Impacts campaign freshness and system resource planning.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Streaming Segmentation; Batch Segmentation Documentation

attributes.name: rfm_tier
attributes.description: RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) tier classification assigned to fans in this segment, applicable when segment_type is 'rfm'. Champions are high-value frequent buyers; lost fans have not engaged recently. Drives targeted retention and reactivation campaigns.

attributes.name: season_ticket_holder_flag

attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Season Ticket Management; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the segment, sourced from Adobe Experience Platform audience segment key or Salesforce CRM campaign segment code. Used for cross-system referencing and campaign targeting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Segment API; Salesforce CRM Campaign Object

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Free-text business description of the segment's purpose, intended use case, and strategic rationale. Authored by the campaign or analytics team to provide context for downstream users and stakeholders.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable business name of the fan segment (e.g., 'High-Value Season Ticket Holders', 'Lapsed Casual Fans', 'Gen-Z Digital Natives'). Used in campaign targeting, reporting dashboards, and personalization workflows.

attributes.name: segment_status

attributes.name: subtype

attributes.name: consent_verified

attributes.name: data_suppression_flag

attributes.name: billing_address_line1

attributes.name: billing_address_line2

attributes.name: billing_city

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the billing address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable privacy regulation (GDPR for EU/EEA, CCPA for California), currency routing, and cross-border payment processing rules.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing address. Critical input for Address Verification Service (AVS) checks on card-not-present transactions. Also used for geographic segmentation and tax jurisdiction mapping.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province component of the billing address. Used for AVS verification, tax jurisdiction determination, and CCPA/GDPR applicability assessment for fan data privacy compliance.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; CCPA §1798.140; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: bin_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bank Identification Number (BIN) / Issuer Identification Number (IIN)
attributes.description: First 6–8 digits of the payment card number identifying the issuing institution and card product type. Used for routing decisions, interchange category determination, and fraud analysis. Stored as a non-sensitive BIN (not the full PAN) per PCI-DSS truncation rules.
attributes.references: ISO 7812 BIN/IIN Standard; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3.1

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: Payment network or card scheme brand associated with the instrument (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex). Applicable for credit and debit card types. Null for non-card payment methods such as digital wallets or direct debit. Used for interchange fee analysis and brand-level reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; Visa/Mastercard Network Rules

attributes.name: card_funding_type
attributes.description: Funding classification of the payment card as determined from BIN lookup. Distinguishes credit, debit, prepaid, and charge cards. Impacts interchange fee rates, refund processing timelines, and eligibility for certain promotional financing offers on season tickets.
attributes.references: Visa/Mastercard BIN Database; ISO 7812; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: card_last_four
attributes.description: Last four digits of the payment card Primary Account Number (PAN). Displayed to the fan in account management and checkout screens to identify their saved card without exposing the full PAN. Permitted display element under PCI-DSS truncation rules.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3.1; PCI SSC Truncation Guidelines

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual as it appears on the payment card or as registered with the payment instrument. Used for display in account management screens and for AVS/identity verification during high-value transactions. Stored only where operationally required per PCI-DSS data minimization principles.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation); CCPA §1798.140

attributes.name: consent_capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fan explicitly consented to storing this payment instrument and authorizing recurring charges. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis documentation and CCPA compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 and Article 7; CCPA §1798.120; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 12.3

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the terms and conditions or privacy policy under which the fan consented to storing this payment instrument. Enables compliance teams to identify fans who consented under outdated policy versions requiring re-consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA §1798.120; Adobe Experience Platform Consent Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code associated with the payment instrument (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency fan accounts across global markets. Relevant for gift card balances, direct debit mandates, and cross-border transaction routing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: direct_debit_mandate_ref
attributes.description: Unique mandate reference number assigned for SEPA Direct Debit or ACH authorization agreements. Required for recurring direct debit collections such as installment-based season ticket payment plans. Null for non-direct-debit instruments.
attributes.references: SEPA Direct Debit Core Scheme Rulebook; NACHA ACH Operating Rules; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the fan added this payment instrument to their account. Supports fraud analysis, channel attribution, and UX optimization. 'pos' — Point of Sale terminal at venue; 'partner_api' — enrolled via third-party integration (e.g., Ticketmaster, Shopify Plus).
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Channel Attribution; Ticketmaster/AXS Integration

attributes.name: enrollment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment instrument was first added to the fan account. Used for lifecycle management, fraud velocity checks, and compliance audit trails. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10; GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing)

attributes.name: expiry_month
attributes.description: Two-digit calendar month (1–12) in which the payment card expires. Used in conjunction with expiry_year to determine card validity and trigger pre-expiry notification workflows for membership auto-renewal continuity.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; ISO 8583 Card Data Standards

attributes.name: expiry_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-expiry notification has been dispatched to the fan via their preferred communication channel (email, SMS, push) to prompt card update before membership or season ticket auto-renewal fails. Managed by Adobe Experience Platform journey automation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Journey Optimizer; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: expiry_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year in which the payment card expires. Combined with expiry_month to assess card validity. Triggers automated pre-expiry fan communications to update payment details and prevent lapsed season ticket or membership renewals.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; ISO 8583 Card Data Standards

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score (0.00–100.00) assigned to this payment instrument by the fraud detection engine at enrollment or last transaction. Higher scores indicate elevated fraud risk. Used to trigger step-up authentication, manual review, or instrument suspension. Not a calculated KPI — raw score from fraud provider.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 12.3; Adyen RevenueProtect; Stripe Radar

attributes.name: gift_card_balance
attributes.description: Current monetary balance remaining on a stored-value gift card payment instrument. Applicable only when payment_method_type is 'gift_card'. Updated after each redemption transaction. Null for non-gift-card instruments. Denominated in the currency indicated by currency_code.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Gift Card API; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment instrument is the fan's designated default method for one-click purchases, membership auto-renewals, and express checkout. Only one payment method per fan account should have this flag set to True at any time.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Fan Account Preferences; Shopify Plus Customer Payment Methods API

attributes.name: issuer_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the financial institution that issued the payment card. Derived from the card BIN (Bank Identification Number). Used for cross-border transaction fee assessment, currency mismatch detection, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ISO 7812 BIN/IIN Standard; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment method record was most recently modified (e.g., billing address update, status change, token refresh). Supports audit trail requirements and Silver Layer data lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10; GDPR Article 30; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_used_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent successful transaction processed against this payment instrument. Used to identify dormant payment methods for cleanup workflows and to assess instrument activity for fraud monitoring.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 12.3; Ticketmaster/AXS Transaction Logs

attributes.name: method_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment instrument. 'active' — valid and available for transactions; 'expired' — card expiry date has passed; 'suspended' — temporarily blocked due to fraud or dispute; 'removed' — fan has deleted the instrument; 'pending_verification' — awaiting micro-deposit or 3DS verification.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 12.3; Ticketmaster/AXS Payment Vault

attributes.name: network_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the card network (Visa, Mastercard) during the initial card-on-file enrollment authorization. Required for subsequent MIT (Merchant-Initiated Transaction) recurring charges such as season ticket auto-renewals, ensuring compliance with card network stored credential mandates.
attributes.references: Visa Stored Credential Framework; Mastercard Stored Credential Transaction Framework; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment instrument category. Drives checkout flow logic, fee structures, and refund eligibility across ticketing (Ticketmaster/AXS), merchandise (Shopify Plus), and membership auto-renewal workflows.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 12.3; ISO 20022 Payment Instrument Classification

attributes.name: pci_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Indicates the PCI-DSS compliance posture of this payment instrument record. 'compliant' — token and data handling meet PCI-DSS v4.0 requirements; 'non_compliant' — a compliance gap has been identified requiring remediation; 'pending_review' — under compliance assessment. Supports PCI SSC audit reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; PCI SSC Tokenization Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system_token_ref
attributes.description: External reference identifier for this payment token as recorded in the originating operational system (e.g., Ticketmaster/AXS vault ID, Shopify Plus payment method ID, Salesforce CRM payment record ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and lineage tracing in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Payment Vault; Shopify Plus Payment Methods API; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: token_value
attributes.description: Opaque tokenized representation of the underlying payment instrument issued by the tokenization provider (e.g., Braintree, Stripe, Adyen). Replaces the raw PAN in all downstream systems. Never stores the actual card number. Compliant with PCI-DSS tokenization standards.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.5; PCI SSC Tokenization Guidelines

attributes.name: tokenization_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party PCI-DSS compliant tokenization service provider that issued and manages the payment token. Used for routing, reconciliation, and vendor management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Braintree|Adyen|Stripe|CyberSource|Worldpay|Checkout.com|Spreedly — promote to reference product if provider list grows beyond 6]
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.5; PCI SSC Tokenization Guidelines

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the payment instrument at enrollment. '3ds' — 3-D Secure authentication (Visa Secure / Mastercard Identity Check); 'avs' — Address Verification Service; 'micro_deposit' — two small deposits for bank account verification; 'cvv_check' — card security code validation; 'none' — no additional verification performed.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 8; EMVCo 3-D Secure Specification; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the payment instrument verification process. 'verified' — successfully authenticated; 'unverified' — verification not yet completed; 'failed' — verification attempt was unsuccessful; 'pending' — verification in progress. Determines eligibility for high-value transactions such as season ticket purchases.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 8; EMVCo 3-D Secure Specification

attributes.name: wallet_provider
attributes.description: Name of the digital wallet service when payment_method_type is 'digital_wallet'. Identifies the wallet ecosystem for routing, reconciliation, and fan experience analytics. Null for non-wallet payment types.

Enables fan club community participation, event access privileges, and engagement programs.

products.name: personalization_rule
products.description: This association product represents the Content Personalization Rule — the operational contract between a fan segment and a content asset within the sports entertainment personalization engine. Each record captures a deliberate, managed assignment of a specific digital content asset to a specific fan segment, including the activation window, priority ranking, A/B test variant, and rule logic governing delivery. Records are created, updated, and retired by CRM and content operations teams as part of campaign and DTC personalization workflows.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment personalization, content teams actively assign specific digital assets (video highlights, editorial articles, social media content) to fan segments as part of campaign and personalization workflows. A single fan segment (e.g., 'High-Value Season Ticket Holders') can be targeted with many different content assets, and a single asset (e.g., a playoff highlight reel) can be assigned to multiple segments simultaneously. This relationship is operationally managed — marketers create, update, and retire these assignments with specific activation windows, priority rankings, and A/B test variants.
