attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this pricing tier configuration remains valid. Null indicates the tier is open-ended with no planned expiry. Used for seasonal pricing tier versioning and historical audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Validity; Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Configuration

attributes.name: eligibility_rule
attributes.description: Free-text or structured rule expression defining who is eligible to purchase tickets at this tier (e.g., 'Season ticket holders only', 'Members with Gold status', 'Military/First Responder ID required', 'Age 12 and under'). Enforced at point of sale in Ticketmaster/AXS.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control; Salesforce CRM Fan Segmentation

attributes.name: external_tier_code
attributes.description: The pricing tier identifier as assigned by the external ticketing system of record (Ticketmaster/AXS or Archtics). Used for system integration, reconciliation, and cross-system data lineage. Enables mapping between the internal BIGINT PK and the source system's native identifier.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS API Integration; Archtics Venue Seating Inventory

attributes.name: face_value
attributes.description: The base printed face value of a ticket at this pricing tier in the operating currency, before any fees, taxes, or dynamic pricing adjustments. This is the regulated face value used for resale compliance and financial reporting. Sourced from Archtics/Ticketmaster pricing configuration.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Configuration; PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard); SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: facility_fee
attributes.description: Per-ticket facility/venue fee charged at this tier, retained by the venue operator to fund venue operations and capital improvements. Distinct from the service fee and reported separately in venue revenue accounting.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating Inventory; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Venue Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: includes_hospitality
attributes.description: Indicates whether hospitality benefits (food and beverage, lounge access, pre-event reception) are bundled with this pricing tier. Applicable to VIP, suite, and premium club tiers. Drives hospitality operations planning.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Package Configuration; Venue Operations

attributes.name: includes_merchandise
attributes.description: Indicates whether a merchandise item or voucher (e.g., team jersey, program, gift bag) is bundled with tickets at this pricing tier as part of the package offering.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Package Configuration; Shopify Plus Merchandise E-Commerce

attributes.name: includes_parking
attributes.description: Indicates whether a parking pass is bundled with tickets at this pricing tier as part of the ticket package (e.g., VIP and suite tiers often include complimentary parking).
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Package Configuration; Archtics Venue Seating Inventory

attributes.name: inventory_class
attributes.description: Archtics inventory classification that maps this pricing tier to a physical seating inventory class within the venue manifest. Drives seat map allocation and capacity planning in Archtics Venue Seating Inventory system.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating Inventory; Ticketmaster/AXS Inventory Management

attributes.name: max_price
attributes.description: The maximum allowable price for this tier when dynamic pricing is active. The dynamic pricing engine will not price tickets above this ceiling value. Null when dynamic_pricing_enabled is False.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Configuration; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: max_tickets_per_order
attributes.description: Maximum number of tickets at this tier that a single fan/customer may purchase in one order transaction. Enforces anti-scalping and fair access policies. Configured in Ticketmaster/AXS order rules.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Order Rules Configuration; League Governance Policies

attributes.name: member_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing tier is exclusively available to registered members or season ticket holders, restricting general public purchase. Integrates with Salesforce CRM membership validation at checkout.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Fan and Sponsor Relationship Management; Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control

attributes.name: min_price
attributes.description: The minimum allowable price for this tier when dynamic pricing is active. The dynamic pricing engine will not price tickets below this floor value. Null when dynamic_pricing_enabled is False.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Configuration; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: min_tickets_per_order
attributes.description: Minimum number of tickets at this tier required per order transaction. Primarily applicable to group sales tiers where a minimum group size must be met (e.g., minimum 10 tickets for group pricing).
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Order Rules Configuration

attributes.name: presale_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets at this tier are available during presale windows (e.g., fan club presale, sponsor presale, credit card presale) before general public on-sale. Drives presale campaign configuration in Ticketmaster/AXS.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Presale Configuration

attributes.name: price_tier_description
attributes.description: Detailed marketing and operational description of the pricing tier, including benefits, inclusions, and eligibility notes. Displayed to fans on the ticketing platform and used by box office staff for customer service.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Product Content Configuration

attributes.name: price_tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing tier: active (available for sale), inactive (temporarily unavailable), draft (under configuration, not yet published), archived (retired, historical reference only), suspended (paused pending review). Controls availability in the dynamic pricing engine and order processing.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Configuration

attributes.name: resale_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether tickets at this pricing tier are eligible for listing on the secondary/resale marketplace. When False, tickets are non-transferable and resale is prohibited (e.g., certain VIP hospitality packages or promotional tickets).
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Resale Marketplace Configuration; League Governance Policies

attributes.name: resale_min_price
attributes.description: Minimum price at which a ticket of this tier may be listed on the secondary resale marketplace. Enforces floor pricing to protect face value integrity and prevent below-cost resale. Null when resale_eligible is False.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Resale Marketplace Configuration

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Financial revenue category classification for this pricing tier used in SAP S/4HANA revenue reporting and Workday Adaptive Planning financial forecasting. Segments ticket revenue streams for EBITDA and ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting; Workday Adaptive Planning Financial Planning and Analysis

attributes.name: sale_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which tickets at this pricing tier are no longer available for purchase. After this date, the tier is automatically closed in the ticketing system. Null indicates the tier remains on sale until event day.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS On-Sale Configuration

attributes.name: sale_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which tickets at this pricing tier become available for general public purchase. Used to control on-sale windows in Ticketmaster/AXS and coordinate marketing campaigns.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS On-Sale Configuration

attributes.name: seating_type
attributes.description: Physical seating configuration associated with this pricing tier: RESERVED (assigned seat), GENERAL_ADMISSION (first-come seating), STANDING (standing area), SUITE (private suite), BOX (premium box), or ACCESSIBLE (ADA-compliant seating). Determines access control and entry validation logic.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating Inventory; ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) — Venue Accessibility

attributes.name: service_fee
attributes.description: Fixed service/convenience fee charged per ticket at this tier, in addition to the face value. Represents the ticketing platform processing charge (e.g., Ticketmaster convenience fee). Used in order total calculation and revenue allocation.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Fee Configuration; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric display sort order for presenting pricing tiers in the correct sequence on ticketing platforms, box office interfaces, and fan-facing purchase flows. Lower values appear first.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS UI Configuration

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Applicable tax rate (as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.0875 for 8.75%) applied to the face value for this pricing tier, based on the jurisdiction of the venue. Used by the order processing system for tax calculation and SAP S/4HANA tax reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls

attributes.name: tier_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the pricing tier aligned with industry-standard seating categories: GA (General Admission), VIP (Very Important Person), SRO (Standing Room Only), PREMIUM, SUITE, ACCESSIBLE (ADA-compliant), CLUB, or FIELD level. Drives dynamic pricing engine segmentation and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GA|VIP|SRO|PREMIUM|SUITE|ACCESSIBLE|CLUB|FIELD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Configuration; ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) — Venue Accessibility

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the pricing tier across systems (e.g., GA01, VIP_PLAT, SRO_STD, SUITE_A). Used as the business key in Ticketmaster/AXS and Archtics integrations.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Configuration; Archtics Venue Seating Inventory

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name for the pricing tier as shown to fans and box office staff (e.g., 'General Admission', 'VIP Platinum', 'Standing Room Only', 'Club Level Premium').
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Configuration

attributes.name: tier_type
attributes.description: Classifies the commercial packaging type of the tier: SINGLE_EVENT (per-event ticket), SEASON_PACKAGE (full season ticket), GROUP_SALES (bulk group purchase), MINI_PLAN (partial season plan), or FLEX_PLAN (flexible game selection plan). Determines eligibility rules and order processing logic.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Configuration; Archtics Venue Seating Inventory

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pricing tier record was last modified. Used for change tracking, cache invalidation in the dynamic pricing engine, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

products.name: dynamic_price_rule
products.description: Business rules governing real-time dynamic pricing adjustments for ticket inventory. Captures demand signals, floor/ceiling price bounds, adjustment algorithms (demand-based, time-to-event, competitor benchmarking), activation windows, and event-specific overrides. Enables yield management across GA/VIP/SRO tiers.

attributes.name: dynamic_price_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a dynamic pricing rule record in the ticketing yield management system.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Engine; Archtics Inventory Management

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Dynamic pricing governance: revenue management approval of pricing rules is a named financial control process in sports entertainment. Linking to employee enables approval chain audits, accountability
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: event_fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific event (game, concert, match) to which this dynamic pricing rule applies. Null if the rule applies globally or at a venue/tier level.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS; Archtics

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific event (game, concert, match) to which this dynamic pricing rule applies. Null if the rule applies globally or at a venue/tier level.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS; Archtics

attributes.name: franchise_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to league.franchise. Business justification: Dynamic pricing rules are franchise-controlled — home franchises set demand-based pricing parameters for their games. Franchise-level dynamic pricing rule management and approval workflows require dir
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing league or competition body (NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA) whose events are subject to this pricing rule. Supports league-specific pricing governance and CBA compliance.
attributes.references: NBA League Office; NFL Governance; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA

attributes.name: performance_stat_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athlete.performance_stat. Business justification: Performance-Based Dynamic Ticket Pricing: Star player performance metrics (points, win streaks, milestones) are named demand signals for dynamic pricing engines. Linking dynamic_price_rule to performa
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: price_tier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ticket pricing tier (GA, VIP, SRO) to which this rule is scoped. Allows tier-specific dynamic pricing strategies.
attributes.references: Archtics Inventory Management; Ticketmaster/AXS

attributes.name: pricing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_pricing. Business justification: Dynamic price rules operate within bounds set by event_pricing (floor, ceiling, multiplier). Revenue management requires linking each rule to its parent pricing configuration to enforce pricing govern
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the league season or event season to which this pricing rule is scoped. Enables season-level yield management and financial planning alignment.
attributes.references: Archtics; SAP S/4HANA CO; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: target_fan_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.fan_segment. Business justification: Segment-aware dynamic pricing is standard in sports entertainment — loyalty members receive different price floors/ceilings than general public. Linking dynamic_price_rule to fan_segment enables segme
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.vendor. Business justification: Dynamic pricing engines (e.g., Digonex, Qcue) are third-party vendors under contract. Linking enables vendor SLA compliance tracking for pricing accuracy, contract renewal decisions, and audit trails
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the venue whose ticket inventory is governed by this pricing rule. Enables venue-level yield management across all events hosted at that facility.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: activation_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time after which this pricing rule ceases to execute. Defines the closing boundary of the rule's activation window. Null for open-ended rules. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Engine; Internal Ticketing Operations Standard

attributes.name: activation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time from which this pricing rule becomes eligible to execute. Defines the opening boundary of the rule's activation window. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Engine; Internal Ticketing Operations Standard

attributes.name: adjustment_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rule can only increase prices, only decrease prices, or move in either direction based on demand signals. 'bidirectional' rules are used in fully automated yield management.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Module

attributes.name: adjustment_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the price adjustment is calculated: 'percentage' = adjust by a percentage of the current price; 'fixed_amount' = add or subtract a fixed currency amount; 'multiplier' = multiply the base price by a factor.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Module

attributes.name: adjustment_value
attributes.description: The numeric magnitude of the price adjustment. Interpretation depends on adjustment_method: for 'percentage' this is the percent (e.g., 15.00 = 15%); for 'fixed_amount' this is the currency delta; for 'multiplier' this is the factor (e.g., 1.25). Classified confidential as it represents proprietary pricing strategy.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Module; PCI-DSS (pricing data protection)

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Governance approval state of the pricing rule. Rules must be approved by the yield management team before activation. Supports SOX financial controls and internal audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls; Internal Governance Policy

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pricing rule received formal approval from the yield management authority. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail for financial controls. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: The reference starting price from which dynamic adjustments are calculated. Typically the face value or published price for the ticket tier before any dynamic adjustment is applied.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS; Archtics Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: ceiling_price
attributes.description: Maximum allowable ticket price for this rule. The dynamic pricing engine will never increase the ticket price above this bound, managing fan experience and regulatory price-gouging considerations. Classified confidential as proprietary pricing strategy.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Engine; Internal Revenue Management Policy; Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: competitor_price_offset_pct
attributes.description: The percentage above or below the competitor benchmark price at which this rule targets ticket pricing. Positive = price above competitor; negative = price below. Classified confidential as proprietary competitive strategy.
attributes.references: Internal Market Intelligence Policy; Ticketmaster/AXS Competitor Pricing Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dynamic pricing rule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary values in this rule (floor_price, ceiling_price, base_price, adjustment_value when fixed_amount). Supports multi-currency global market operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: demand_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The inventory sold-through percentage that must be reached before this demand-based rule activates. For example, 75.00 means the rule fires when 75% of allocated inventory is sold. Applicable when rule_type = 'demand_based' or 'inventory_threshold'.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Module; Internal Yield Management Policy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this pricing rule first becomes binding for yield management operations. Used for season-level planning and financial forecasting in Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this pricing rule expires and is no longer applicable. Null for perpetual rules. Supports season-end rule lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Internal Ticketing Operations Standard; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: external_rule_reference
attributes.description: The native rule identifier from the source system (Ticketmaster, AXS, or Archtics) that corresponds to this record. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and operational ticketing systems.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS API; Archtics Integration Standards

attributes.name: floor_price
attributes.description: Minimum allowable ticket price for this rule. The dynamic pricing engine will never reduce the ticket price below this bound, protecting revenue floor commitments. Classified confidential as proprietary pricing strategy.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Engine; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: inventory_allocation_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of total ticket inventory for the applicable tier/event that is subject to this dynamic pricing rule. Allows partial inventory to be dynamically priced while the remainder is held at fixed price.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Internal Yield Management Policy

attributes.name: is_event_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule is an event-specific override that supersedes standard dynamic pricing rules for a particular event. True = override rule; False = standard rule. Supports playoff, championship, and special event pricing exceptions.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Engine; Internal Yield Management Policy

attributes.name: is_resale_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dynamic pricing rule also applies to resale/secondary market ticket listings managed through the official resale marketplace. True = rule governs resale pricing; False = primary market only.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Resale Platform; Internal Resale Policy

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dynamic pricing rule record was most recently updated. Tracks rule configuration changes for audit and compliance purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: max_adjustment_pct_per_trigger
attributes.description: The maximum percentage change allowed in a single rule trigger event. Caps runaway price movements from a single demand spike. For example, 20.00 means no single trigger can move the price more than 20%.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Module; Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: max_adjustments_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this rule may trigger a price change within a single calendar day. Prevents excessive price volatility that could damage fan trust and brand perception.
attributes.references: Internal Fan Experience Policy; Ticketmaster/AXS Rate Limiting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for yield managers to capture contextual notes, business rationale, or exception documentation related to this pricing rule. Supports operational knowledge management and audit review.
attributes.references: Internal Ticketing Operations Standard

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority order for rule execution when multiple dynamic pricing rules apply to the same ticket inventory simultaneously. Lower integer = higher priority. Prevents conflicting rule outcomes.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Engine; Internal Yield Management Policy

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the pricing rule, used in Ticketmaster/AXS and Archtics integrations for rule traceability and audit. Format: DPR- followed by 4–12 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Engine; Internal Ticketing Operations Standard

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explaining the business intent, trigger conditions, and expected outcome of the pricing rule. Supports governance documentation and audit review.
attributes.references: Internal Ticketing Operations Standard; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the pricing rule (e.g., 'NBA Finals Demand Surge – Floor Level VIP', 'Last-72hr Time Decay – GA'). Used by yield managers for identification and reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Ticketing Operations Standard

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing rule. 'draft' = under configuration; 'active' = live and executing adjustments; 'paused' = temporarily suspended; 'expired' = past effective window; 'cancelled' = permanently deactivated.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Pricing Engine; Internal Ticketing Operations Standard

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing algorithm driving this rule. 'demand_based' = adjusts price based on real-time demand signals; 'time_to_event' = adjusts based on days/hours until event; 'competitor_benchmark' = adjusts relative to competitor pricing; 'inventory_threshold' = triggers on remaining inventory levels; 'manual_override' = yield manager-initiated adjustment.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Module; Sports Ticketing Yield Management Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this pricing rule originated or is mastered. Supports data lineage tracking across Ticketmaster, AXS, and Archtics integrations in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS; Archtics; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: ticket_category
attributes.description: Ticket inventory category to which this rule applies: General Admission (GA), Very Important Person (VIP), Standing Room Only (SRO), season package, or group sales. Enables tier-specific yield management strategies.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Ticketmaster/AXS

attributes.name: time_to_event_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before the event start time at which this time-based pricing rule activates. For example, 72 means the rule fires 72 hours before the event. Applicable when rule_type = 'time_to_event'.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Dynamic Pricing Module; Internal Yield Management Policy

attributes.name: currency_code

products.name: resale
products.description: Unified lifecycle record for all secondary market and peer-to-peer ticket activity. Captures listing creation (price, channel, seller type, listing status), marketplace transaction execution (sale price, platform fees, seller proceeds, buyer reference), and peer-to-peer transfers (gift, forward). Tracks movement type, transfer timestamp, new entitlement token issuance, transfer restrictions, anti-scalping rule compliance, and revenue share calculations. SSOT for all secondary market listings, resale transactions, and fan-to-fan ticket transfers. Replaces separate listing and transaction records with a single lifecycle entity progressing through states: listed → sold/transferred/expired/withdrawn.

attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; PCI SSC Data Security Standard

attributes.name: card_network
attributes.description: The card network or scheme associated with the payment instrument (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, UnionPay). Used for interchange fee analysis, network-specific reporting, and chargeback routing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; ISO 7812 Issuer Identification Number Standard

attributes.name: chargeback_status
attributes.description: Current status of any chargeback dispute associated with this payment transaction. Tracks the chargeback lifecycle from initiation through resolution. Used for fraud management, financial loss reporting, and card network compliance. Default is 'none' for transactions with no chargeback.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 12; Visa/Mastercard Chargeback Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI Dispute Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage, PCI-DSS audit log requirements, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.3 (Audit Logs); SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Supports multi-currency operations across global markets and SAP S/4HANA FI foreign currency revaluation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Multi-Currency; IFRS 21 Foreign Currency Transactions

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary discount applied to the payment, including promotional codes, group sales discounts, season ticket holder discounts, and sponsor-funded promotions. Used for revenue leakage analysis and promotion ROI reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions; Ticketmaster/AXS Discount Management

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied at the time of payment when the transaction currency differs from the organization's functional currency (USD). Used for multi-currency financial reporting and SAP S/4HANA FI currency revaluation. Null for transactions in the functional currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Foreign Currency; IFRS 21; ISO 4217

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized decline or failure code returned by the payment processor or card network when a payment is not authorized (e.g., insufficient_funds, card_expired, do_not_honor, fraud_suspected). Used for failed payment analysis, retry logic, and fan communication. Null for successful transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 8583 Response Codes; Visa/Mastercard Decline Code Standards; Ticketmaster/AXS Error Handling

attributes.name: failure_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the payment failure reason corresponding to the failure_reason_code. Used by customer service teams in Salesforce CRM for fan outreach and dispute resolution. Null for successful transactions.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Customer Service Integration; Salesforce CRM Case Management

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numeric fraud risk score assigned by the payment processor's fraud detection engine or an internal fraud scoring model at the time of payment (0.00–100.00, where higher values indicate greater fraud risk). Used for real-time payment decisioning, fraud trend analysis, and PCI-DSS fraud monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.7 (Fraud Detection); Ticketmaster/AXS Fraud Prevention; Adobe Experience Platform Risk Scoring

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total face value of the ticket order before any discounts, promotions, or adjustments are applied. Represents the base revenue figure used in financial reporting and EBITDA calculations in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 302/404 Financial Controls

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: The sequential installment number for recurring or installment-based payments (e.g., 1 of 4 for a season ticket payment plan). Null for one-time payments. Used for installment plan tracking and revenue recognition scheduling.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Season Ticket Installment Plans; SAP S/4HANA FI Installment Processing

attributes.name: installment_total_count
attributes.description: The total number of installments in the payment plan for season ticket or group sales installment arrangements (e.g., 4 for a quarterly payment plan). Null for one-time payments. Used alongside installment_number for plan completion tracking.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Season Ticket Installment Plans; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: is_3ds_authenticated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment was authenticated using 3D Secure (3DS) protocol (e.g., Visa Secure, Mastercard Identity Check). True if 3DS authentication was completed. Used for fraud liability shift determination and PCI-DSS compliance reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 6.4; EMVCo 3DS Specification; Visa Secure / Mastercard Identity Check

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is part of a recurring payment arrangement, such as a season ticket installment plan or subscription-based fan membership. True for recurring charges. Drives card-on-file compliance and CBA-related payment plan management.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.6 (Card-on-File); Ticketmaster/AXS Installment Plans

attributes.name: masked_card_reference
attributes.description: Masked representation of the payment card number or digital wallet identifier (e.g., last 4 digits of card, masked wallet token). Stored in PCI-DSS compliant masked format for customer service, receipt display, and dispute identification without exposing full PAN.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3 (Masking of PAN); PCI SSC Data Security Standard

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount charged to the fan after applying discounts and adding service fees and taxes (gross_amount - discount_amount + service_fee_amount + tax_amount). This is the actual amount captured from the fan's payment instrument. SSOT for revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 302/404; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The interface or touchpoint through which the fan submitted the payment (e.g., web browser, mobile app, venue box office, self-service kiosk, call center, third-party resale platform). Distinct from payment method type; used for channel analytics and fraud detection.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Channel Attribution; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment instrument used by the fan (e.g., credit card, debit card, digital wallet such as Apple Pay/Google Pay, bank transfer, gift card, cash at box office). Drives PCI-DSS scope determination and payment processing routing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1; ISO 20022 Payment Instrument Classification

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments associated with the payment transaction, entered by customer service agents or system processes (e.g., manual override justification, special handling instructions for VIP fan payments, dispute context). Used in Salesforce CRM case management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Notes; Ticketmaster/AXS Agent Notes

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable payment reference number assigned by the payment processor or ticketing platform (e.g., Ticketmaster/AXS transaction reference). Used for customer-facing receipts, dispute resolution, and reconciliation with external systems.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Payment Reference; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment transaction. Tracks the workflow from authorization through capture, failure, or refund. Critical for revenue recognition, reconciliation, and PCI-DSS compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: authorized|captured|failed|refunded|voided|pending — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Processing

attributes.name: pci_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment record falls within the PCI-DSS cardholder data environment (CDE) scope. True for card-based payments subject to PCI-DSS controls. Used for PCI-DSS scope boundary management, audit reporting, and data classification governance.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 2.2 (Scope Definition); PCI SSC Scoping Guidelines

attributes.name: processor_transaction_token
attributes.description: Tokenized reference assigned by the payment processor to uniquely identify this transaction within the processor's system. Replaces raw card data per PCI-DSS tokenization requirements. Used for refund initiation, dispute management, and settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.5 (Tokenization); PCI SSC Token Service Provider Guidelines

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount refunded to the fan for this payment transaction, applicable when payment_status is 'refunded'. May be a partial or full refund. Used for revenue reversal accounting in SAP S/4HANA FI and fan satisfaction tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Memo Processing; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; Ticketmaster/AXS Refund Policy

attributes.name: refund_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for the refund when payment_status is 'refunded'. Supports refund trend analysis, event cancellation financial impact reporting, and fraud detection. Null for non-refunded transactions.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Refund Management; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Memo

attributes.name: refunded_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the refund was processed and submitted to the payment processor. Null for non-refunded transactions. Used for refund SLA monitoring and fan experience reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.3; Ticketmaster/AXS Refund SLA

attributes.name: service_fee_amount
attributes.description: Ticketing service and convenience fees charged to the fan on top of the ticket face value (e.g., Ticketmaster facility charge, order processing fee). Reported separately for revenue transparency and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Fee Schedule; FTC Transparency in Ticketing Guidelines

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was settled by the acquiring bank and funds were transferred to the organization's account. Critical for cash flow reporting, SAP S/4HANA FI bank reconciliation, and revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Reconciliation; SOX Section 302; ISO 20022

attributes.name: settlement_reference
attributes.description: The batch settlement reference number assigned by the payment processor or acquiring bank when the transaction is included in a settlement batch. Used for bank reconciliation, SAP S/4HANA FI bank statement matching, and financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Reconciliation; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; ISO 20022 Payment Settlement

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system that generated this payment record (e.g., Ticketmaster, AXS, Archtics box office, resale marketplace). Used for data lineage tracking, system reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Integration; Archtics Venue Seating; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the ticket payment, including applicable sales tax, VAT, or entertainment tax based on the venue jurisdiction. Required for tax remittance reporting and SAP S/4HANA FI tax accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Accounting; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis for Processing)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was last modified (e.g., status change from authorized to captured, or refund applied). Supports change data capture, audit trails, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.3; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: wallet_provider
attributes.description: Name of the digital wallet provider used for payment when payment_method_type is digital_wallet (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Venmo). Null for non-wallet payment methods. Supports DTC fan engagement analytics and wallet adoption reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; Ticketmaster/AXS Digital Wallet Integration

products.name: refund
products.description: Transactional record of a ticket refund or credit issued to a fan. Captures originating order reference, refund reason (event cancellation, postponement, fan request, fraud), refund amount, refund method (original payment, credit wallet, voucher), processing status, and approval workflow state. Supports PCI-DSS refund audit requirements.

attributes.name: refund_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the ticket refund record. Primary key for the refund data product in the ticketing domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10

attributes.name: approval_agent_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service agent or system user who approved the refund request. Null for auto-approved refunds triggered by event cancellation rules. Supports SOX segregation-of-duties audit.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Segregation of Duties; SAP S/4HANA FI Approval Workflow

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service agent or system user who approved the refund request. Null for auto-approved refunds triggered by event cancellation rules. Supports SOX segregation-of-duties audit.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Segregation of Duties; SAP S/4HANA FI Approval Workflow

attributes.name: event_fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sports or entertainment event associated with the refunded ticket. Enables event-level refund aggregation for cancellation and postponement analysis.
attributes.references: Event Planning and Scheduling Domain

attributes.name: fan_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan (customer) account requesting or receiving the refund. Supports CRM-linked fan engagement tracking and PCI-DSS audit trail for cardholder refund activity.

attributes.name: fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan (customer) account requesting or receiving the refund. Supports CRM-linked fan engagement tracking and PCI-DSS audit trail for cardholder refund activity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Fan Record; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sports or entertainment event associated with the refunded ticket. Enables event-level refund aggregation for cancellation and postponement analysis.
attributes.references: Event Planning and Scheduling Domain

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: security_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_incident. Business justification: Refunds are operationally triggered by security incidents — event suspension due to emergency activation, fan ejection leading to ticket refund, or venue evacuation. Linking refund to security_inciden
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_status_history. Business justification: refund.is_event_initiated flags refunds triggered by event status changes (cancellation, postponement). Linking to the specific event_status_history record enables financial reconciliation of event-in
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ticket_inventory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific ticket being refunded. A single order may contain multiple tickets; this field identifies the individual ticket entitlement subject to the refund.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticket Entitlement

attributes.name: ticket_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating ticket order from which this refund was initiated. Links the refund back to the original purchase transaction in Ticketmaster/AXS.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Order Management

attributes.name: ticket_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ticketing.ticket_payment. Business justification: A refund must trace back to the original payment transaction for PCI-DSS compliance, financial reconciliation, and chargeback management. refund.payment_transaction_ref is a STRING external processor
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ticket_ticket_inventory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific ticket being refunded. A single order may contain multiple tickets; this field identifies the individual ticket entitlement subject to the refund.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticket Entitlement

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The authorization tier at which the refund was approved. AUTO indicates system-triggered approval (e.g., event cancellation policy); AGENT, SUPERVISOR, and FINANCE indicate escalating human approval tiers based on refund amount thresholds.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the refund request was approved by an authorized agent or automated rule engine. Null if the refund has not yet been approved or was rejected. Supports approval SLA reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2.1; SOX Section 404 Approval Controls

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the refund was confirmed as successfully received by the fan's payment instrument or wallet. Represents the final settled state of the refund lifecycle.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10; SAP S/4HANA FI Clearing

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the refund record was first created in the system of record (Ticketmaster/AXS). Audit trail field for data lineage and PCI-DSS compliance logging.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the refund transaction (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations across global markets and SAP FI foreign currency revaluation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Multi-Currency

attributes.name: gross_refund_amount
attributes.description: The total face value of the ticket(s) being refunded before any deductions such as service fees or processing charges. Represents the base monetary amount subject to reversal in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Reversal; PCI DSS v4.0; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_event_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refund was triggered by an event-level action (cancellation, postponement, force majeure) rather than a fan-initiated request. Drives bulk refund processing workflows and league governance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability; League Governance (NFL/NBA/FIFA)

attributes.name: is_fraud_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refund was initiated due to a confirmed or suspected fraudulent transaction. When true, triggers PCI-DSS fraud incident reporting and Salesforce CRM fraud case creation.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2.1; FCC Broadcast Fraud Regulations

attributes.name: net_refund_amount
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount returned to the fan after deducting any non-refundable fees or processing charges from the gross refund amount. This is the amount posted to the fan's payment instrument or credit wallet.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Net Payment; PCI DSS v4.0; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Unstructured operational notes added by customer service agents or automated systems during the refund lifecycle. May include escalation context, fan communication history, or special handling instructions. Subject to GDPR data minimisation principles.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Notes; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: original_payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used in the original ticket purchase transaction. Determines eligibility for ORIGINAL_PAYMENT refund routing and informs PCI-DSS cardholder data handling requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 9; Ticketmaster/AXS Payment Processing

attributes.name: payment_transaction_ref
attributes.description: The external payment processor transaction reference number for the refund settlement (e.g., Stripe charge ID, Adyen PSP reference). Used for reconciliation between Ticketmaster/AXS and the payment gateway. Never stores raw card data.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2; SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the refund was submitted to the payment processor or credit wallet system for execution. Distinct from approved_timestamp; marks the point of financial commitment.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Run

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the business reason for the refund. EVENT_CANCELLED and EVENT_POSTPONED are league/venue-initiated; FAN_REQUEST is voluntary; FRAUD triggers PCI-DSS fraud reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EVENT_CANCELLED|EVENT_POSTPONED|FAN_REQUEST|FRAUD|DUPLICATE_PURCHASE|VENUE_ISSUE|WEATHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2.1; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the refund reason beyond the standardized reason code. Captured by customer service agents or automated system messages in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Notes; GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation)

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: The channel or instrument through which the refund value is returned to the fan. ORIGINAL_PAYMENT reverses to the card/account used at purchase; CREDIT_WALLET posts to the fan's digital wallet; VOUCHER issues a future-use ticket credit. Governs SAP FI posting type.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 9.4; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Method

attributes.name: refund_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable refund reference number issued to the fan and used in customer service communications. Formatted as RFD- followed by a 10-digit sequence. Sourced from Ticketmaster/AXS refund workflow.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Refund Reference; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the refund request within the approval and processing workflow. Drives operational queues in Ticketmaster/AXS and SAP FI posting logic.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10; SAP S/4HANA FI Refund Workflow

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refund covers the full ticket face value (FULL), a portion of the ticket value (PARTIAL), or is issued as a credit/voucher rather than a monetary return (CREDIT). Drives revenue recognition reversal logic in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Revenue Recognition; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided when a refund request is rejected. Populated only when refund_status is 'rejected'. Required for customer service follow-up and regulatory dispute resolution under GDPR Article 12.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12; Salesforce CRM Case Resolution

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the fan or system initiated the refund request. Represents the principal business event time for the refund lifecycle. Used for SLA measurement and PCI-DSS audit trail.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2; GDPR Article 12 (response timelines)

attributes.name: resale_refund_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refund relates to a ticket purchased through the secondary/resale marketplace rather than the primary box office. Resale refunds may follow different policy rules and fee structures.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Resale Marketplace Policy

attributes.name: service_fee_refund_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the refund attributable to service fees originally charged on the ticket purchase. May be zero if service fees are non-refundable per the event's refund policy. Tracked separately for revenue accounting in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Allocation; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refund processing exceeded the defined SLA target hours. Set to true when the elapsed time between approved_timestamp and processed_timestamp exceeds sla_target_hours. Drives escalation workflows.
attributes.references: SLA Policy; GDPR Article 12

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: The contracted or policy-defined maximum number of hours within which the refund must be processed from the point of approval. Used for SLA compliance monitoring and customer service KPI reporting.
attributes.references: SLA Policy; GDPR Article 12 (30-day response); PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the refund record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer and reconciliation across Ticketmaster/AXS, Archtics, and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage; SAP S/4HANA Integration

attributes.name: source_system_refund_code
attributes.description: The native refund identifier as recorded in the originating operational system (e.g., Ticketmaster refund transaction ID, SAP FI document number). Enables cross-system reconciliation and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Refund API; SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number

attributes.name: tax_refund_amount
attributes.description: The tax component being reversed as part of the refund. Required for VAT/GST compliance reporting in applicable jurisdictions and SAP FI tax reversal postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Management; GDPR Article 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the refund record was last modified in the system of record. Tracks state transitions through the approval workflow for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10.2; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: voucher_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric voucher code issued to the fan when refund_method is VOUCHER. Redeemable against future ticket purchases in Ticketmaster/AXS. Null for non-voucher refund methods.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Voucher Management

attributes.name: voucher_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the issued refund voucher expires and can no longer be redeemed. Applicable only when refund_method is VOUCHER. Null for monetary refund methods.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Voucher Policy; GDPR Article 5

Manages inventory allocation before public on-sale and enables tiered on-sale sequencing.

products.name: waitlist
products.description: Queue management record for fans seeking ticket access to sold-out events, season ticket packages, or premium seating upgrades. Captures fan reference, requested product (single event, STH package, suite), priority rank, registration timestamp, queue position, notification preferences, conversion status, and offer expiry. Supports season ticket holder waitlist management (often 5,000+ deep at major franchises), sold-out event demand capture, and premium upgrade queues. Enables demand signaling for dynamic pricing and capacity planning.

attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: is_kill_seat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seat is designated as a kill seat — permanently or temporarily removed from saleable inventory due to production equipment placement (e.g., camera platforms, lighting rigs, sound towers, mixing boards). Kill seats cannot be sold or allocated.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: is_obstructed_view
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seat has a partially or fully obstructed sightline to the stage or field of play due to structural columns, equipment, or other physical barriers. Required disclosure for consumer protection and pricing accuracy.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control); Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.name: is_premium_seat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this seat is classified as a premium inventory seat (e.g., club seat, courtside, field-level, VIP box). Premium seats are subject to distinct pricing tiers, hospitality entitlements, and season ticket package eligibility rules.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: is_resale_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether seats in this manifest section are eligible for listing on the secondary resale marketplace. Certain sections (e.g., suite holds, sponsor allocations, comp seats) may be restricted from resale per contractual or league governance rules.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: kill_reason
attributes.description: The operational reason why this seat has been designated as a kill seat and removed from saleable inventory. Null for non-kill seats. Supports production planning and inventory reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production_equipment|camera_platform|lighting_rig|sound_tower|structural|safety_clearance|sponsor_activation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.name: manifest_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this manifest configuration within the venue. Used as the business identifier in Archtics and Ticketmaster/AXS integrations.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: manifest_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing this manifest configuration (e.g., 'Full House Basketball', 'Concert End-Stage', 'Football GA Floor'). Used by operations staff to identify the correct seating layout.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.name: manifest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the manifest configuration. 'draft' indicates under construction; 'active' is the live configuration used for ticketing; 'inactive' is temporarily disabled; 'archived' is retired.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.name: manifest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the seating configuration type. Determines whether seats are individually assigned (reserved_seating), open floor (general_admission / GA), or a hybrid layout. SRO (Standing Room Only) is a distinct configuration for overflow capacity.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: manifest_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this manifest configuration (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3'). Incremented when structural changes are made to the seat map (e.g., new kill seats, ADA redesignation, section reconfiguration). Supports audit trail and change management.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act - Financial Controls for Public Companies)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes associated with this manifest record, capturing special configurations, temporary modifications, or production-specific instructions not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.name: obstruction_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the nature of the view obstruction for seats flagged as obstructed (e.g., 'Structural column blocks left 20% of stage', 'Partial view of scoreboard only'). Null for unobstructed seats.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: price_zone_code
attributes.description: The pricing zone designation assigned to this seat/section in the manifest (e.g., 'ZONE-A', 'PREMIUM', 'VALUE'). Maps to the price_tier reference and drives face value assignment during inventory allocation.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: row_count
attributes.description: Total number of rows within this section as defined in the manifest. Used for capacity planning, inventory validation, and seat map rendering.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.name: row_label
attributes.description: The alphanumeric label identifying the row within the section (e.g., 'A', '1', 'AA'). Null for GA/floor sections where individual rows are not assigned.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.name: seat_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of individual seats or standing positions represented by this manifest record. For reserved seating this is typically 1; for GA sections this reflects the total capacity of the section or zone.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act - Venue Accessibility)

attributes.name: seat_count_per_row
attributes.description: Number of individual seats in each row of this section. May vary by row in curved bowl configurations; this field captures the standard or average count for the section.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.name: seat_number
attributes.description: The individual seat number within the row (e.g., '1', '14', '101A'). Null for GA/SRO configurations where individual seat assignment is not applicable.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: seat_tier
attributes.description: The commercial tier classification of the seat within the venue manifest. Drives pricing, hospitality entitlements, and season ticket package eligibility. VIP (Very Important Person), GA (General Admission), SRO (Standing Room Only) are industry-standard designations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|premium|vip|suite|club|ga|sro — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: seating_orientation
attributes.description: The directional orientation of the seating section relative to the primary performance or playing surface. Relevant for multi-configuration venues that host both sports and entertainment events with different stage/field orientations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: end_stage|center_stage|in_the_round|field_facing|court_facing|ice_facing|pitch_facing — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); ISO 20121 (Event Sustainability Management Systems)

attributes.name: section_label
attributes.description: The alphanumeric label identifying the seating section within the venue (e.g., '101', 'A', 'FLOOR', 'SUITE-12'). Corresponds to the section designation printed on tickets and displayed on venue maps.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.name: sight_line_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the sightline quality from this seat or section to the primary performance or playing surface. Used in fan-facing seat selection tools and dynamic pricing models to differentiate seat value.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: ticketmaster_map_code
attributes.description: The seat map identifier assigned by Ticketmaster/AXS for this manifest configuration. Required for inventory synchronization and digital ticket delivery through the Ticketmaster distribution platform.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: total_ada_seat_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Seat Count
attributes.description: Total number of ADA-designated seats or spaces in this manifest configuration. Used for ADA compliance reporting and accommodation fulfillment tracking.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act - Venue Accessibility)

attributes.name: total_kill_seat_count
attributes.description: Total number of seats designated as kill seats in this manifest configuration. Used for production planning, capacity reconciliation, and revenue impact analysis.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.name: total_sellable_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of seats or positions in this manifest that are eligible for sale, excluding kill seats, ADA companion holds, and structural exclusions. The principal quantitative fact for revenue capacity planning.
attributes.references: Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management); Ticketmaster / AXS (Ticketing and Access Control)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this venue manifest record was last modified. Tracks configuration changes such as kill seat updates, ADA redesignations, or section reconfiguration events.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act - Financial Controls for Public Companies); Archtics (Venue Seating and Inventory Management)

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on venue_manifest (superseded_venue_manifest_id)

attributes.name: event_fixture_id

attributes.name: fan_profile_id

attributes.name: fixture_id

attributes.name: primary_ticket_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Fan account identifier of the ticket holder initiating the transfer (the sender). Used for CRM tracking, season ticket holder (STH) loyalty attribution, and transfer eligibility validation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Fan and Sponsor Relationship Management; Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: prior_transfer_ticket_transfer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding transfer record for this ticket, enabling chain-of-custody tracking across multiple transfers. Null for the first transfer of a ticket.

attributes.name: recipient_fan_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Fan account identifier of the fan receiving the transferred ticket. Populated upon successful transfer acceptance. Null if the recipient has not yet accepted or does not have an existing fan account.

attributes.name: season_ticket_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the season ticket package associated with the transferred ticket, if applicable. Used to enforce STH forward ticket rules, loyalty point attribution, and package-level transfer limits.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: ticket_inventory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific ticket inventory record being transferred between fan accounts. Links to the originating ticket entitlement.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: ticket_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original ticket order from which the transferred ticket was purchased. Maintains the financial and transactional lineage of the ticket.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: ticket_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ticketing.ticket_order_line.
