attributes.name: ticket_ticket_inventory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific ticket inventory record being transferred between fan accounts. Links to the originating ticket entitlement.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the venue where the event associated with the transferred ticket will take place. Used for venue-level transfer analytics, access zone validation, and ADA accommodation routing.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: accepted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the recipient accepted the ticket transfer. Null if the transfer has not yet been accepted. Triggers entitlement re-issuance to the recipient fan account.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why the transfer was cancelled, declined, or revoked. Populated only when transfer_status is 'cancelled', 'declined', or 'revoked'. Used for operational reporting and fraud analytics.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer reached a terminal state (accepted, declined, cancelled, expired, or revoked). Used for SLA measurement and transfer lifecycle reporting.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transfer record was first created in the data platform (Silver layer ingestion). Audit field for data lineage and record provenance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time after which the transfer invitation is no longer valid for acceptance. If the recipient does not accept before this timestamp, the transfer status transitions to 'expired' and the entitlement reverts to the sender.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: fraud_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transfer was flagged by the fraud detection system as potentially suspicious (e.g., rapid successive transfers, transfers to unknown accounts, high-value event tickets). Triggers manual review workflow.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS; Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sender fan account had valid GDPR consent on file at the time of transfer initiation, permitting the sharing of recipient contact data (email/phone) with the platform for transfer delivery. Required for EU market compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; CCPA

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sender initiated the ticket transfer request. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transfer lifecycle. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: is_ada_accessible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transferred ticket is for an Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessible seat. Ensures that ADA accommodations are preserved and communicated to the recipient during the transfer process.
attributes.references: ADA Americans with Disabilities Act; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: is_return_transfer
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transfer represents a ticket being returned to the original sender after a prior outbound transfer. Supports STH account reconciliation and loyalty point reversal workflows.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ticket was eligible for peer-to-peer transfer at the time the transfer was initiated, based on price tier rules, season ticket package terms, and event-level transfer restrictions.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: new_entitlement_token
attributes.description: The new digital access token (barcode, QR code, or NFC token) issued to the recipient fan account upon successful transfer acceptance. Replaces the original entitlement token for gate access validation.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: original_entitlement_token
attributes.description: The original digital access token held by the sender prior to transfer. Voided upon successful transfer acceptance to prevent duplicate access. Retained for audit and fraud investigation purposes.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: recipient_display_name
attributes.description: Display name or full name of the recipient as entered by the sender or resolved from the recipient fan account. Used for sender confirmation UI and customer service. Classified as restricted PII per GDPR Article 4.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: recipient_email
attributes.description: Email address used to deliver the transfer invitation to the recipient. May belong to a fan without an existing account, enabling new fan account creation upon acceptance. Classified as restricted PII per GDPR Article 4 and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: recipient_phone
attributes.description: Mobile phone number used to deliver the transfer invitation via SMS when transfer_method is 'sms'. Classified as restricted PII per GDPR Article 4 and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: recipient_terms_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recipient explicitly accepted the transfer terms and conditions upon claiming the ticket. Required for entitlement issuance and compliance with consumer protection regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: seat_number
attributes.description: Individual seat number within the row for the transferred ticket. Denormalized from ticket inventory for operational convenience and recipient confirmation.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: seat_row
attributes.description: Row label of the seat associated with the transferred ticket within the section. Denormalized from ticket inventory for operational convenience.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: seat_section
attributes.description: Section label of the seat associated with the transferred ticket, as defined in the venue seating manifest. Denormalized from ticket inventory for operational convenience and access control validation.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this transfer record was ingested. Supports multi-platform environments where both Ticketmaster and AXS may be in use across different venues or events.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: source_system_transfer_code
attributes.description: Native transfer identifier from the originating operational system (Ticketmaster or AXS). Used for cross-system reconciliation, support case lookup, and data lineage tracing between the Silver layer and the source system of record.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: terms_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sender explicitly accepted the transfer terms and conditions at the time of initiating the transfer. Required for compliance with Ticketmaster/AXS transfer policy and consumer protection regulations.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: terms_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the transfer terms and conditions accepted by the sender at the time of transfer initiation. Enables legal and compliance teams to audit which version of terms governed each transfer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: token_format
attributes.description: Format of the digital access token used for the transferred ticket. Determines the gate scanning technology required for admission. 'barcode' — 1D/2D barcode; 'qr_code' — QR code; 'nfc' — Near Field Communication tap; 'mobile_id' — rotating mobile ticket ID.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: transfer_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of times this specific ticket has been transferred between fan accounts, including the current transfer. Used to enforce maximum transfer limits per ticket and detect potential scalping or policy violations.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: transfer_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the directional nature of the transfer relative to the originating account. 'outbound' — sender is giving away the ticket; 'inbound' — recipient is receiving; 'return' — ticket returned to original holder after a prior transfer.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: transfer_method
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism used to deliver the transfer invitation to the recipient. 'mobile_app' — in-app transfer via Ticketmaster/AXS mobile; 'email' — transfer link sent via email; 'sms' — transfer link sent via SMS; 'platform_link' — shareable URL generated for transfer.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; Adobe Experience Platform Fan Engagement

attributes.name: transfer_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to the transfer transaction, used for fan-facing communication, customer service lookup, and audit trail. Sourced from Ticketmaster/AXS transfer workflow.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: transfer_restriction_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a transfer was restricted or blocked. 'none' — no restriction; 'price_tier_restricted' — price tier does not permit transfer; 'event_restricted' — event-level transfer lockout; 'package_restricted' — season ticket package terms prohibit transfer; 'compliance_hold' — regulatory or compliance hold; 'fraud_hold' — fraud risk flag applied.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; PCI-DSS; GDPR

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ticket transfer. 'pending' — transfer initiated, awaiting recipient acceptance; 'accepted' — recipient accepted and entitlement re-issued; 'declined' — recipient declined; 'cancelled' — sender cancelled before acceptance; 'expired' — acceptance window elapsed; 'revoked' — transfer voided by operator or compliance action.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transfer by business context. 'standard' — ad hoc peer-to-peer transfer; 'season_ticket_forward' — STH forwarding a game ticket; 'group_forward' — group sale ticket forwarded to individual attendee; 'comp_forward' — complimentary ticket forwarded by recipient.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS Ticketing and Access Control; Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transfer record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

products.name: presale_access
products.description: This association product represents the Presale Access contract between a hold_allocation and a fan_segment. It captures the operational grant of access rights that a specific fan segment holds against a specific ticket inventory block, including the quantity allocated to that segment, its priority rank among competing segments, any segment-specific presale window overrides, and post-sale conversion performance. Each record links one hold_allocation to one fan_segment with attributes that exist only in the context of this per-segment access entitlement and cannot be stored on either parent entity.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment operations, a presale hold allocation is deliberately made accessible to multiple fan segments simultaneously — for example, a sponsor comp block may be opened to both 'Season Ticket Holders' and 'Credit Card Partner Members' with different priority ranks and quantities per segment. Conversely, a single fan segment (e.g., 'High-Value Loyalists') can have access to multiple hold allocations across different events and hold types throughout a season. The business actively manages these per-segment access grants as operational records, tracking allocation quantities, priority ordering, presale window overrides, and post-sale conversion rates for each segment-allocation pairing.

attributes.name: presale_access_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the presale_access association
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.name: fan_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the fan segment that is granted access to this hold allocation
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: hold_allocation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the hold allocation block to which this segment access entitlement applies
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: allocation_quantity
attributes.description: Number of tickets from the parent hold allocation reserved for exclusive or priority access by this fan segment. Cannot live on hold_allocation (one record per block, not per segment) nor on fan_segment (a reference master with no event-specific inventory data).
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: Post-sale metric expressing the percentage of this segment's allocated quantity that was actually purchased during the presale window. Computed at the segment-allocation level and used for future presale sizing decisions. Cannot live on hold_allocation (aggregates across all segments) nor on fan_segment (aggregates across all events).
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment access entitlement was first created in the system, recording when the ticketing team granted this segment access to the hold block.
attributes.references: ISO 8601

attributes.name: eligibility_group_code
attributes.description: Structured code identifying the fan segment, loyalty tier, or partner group eligible for this hold (e.g., 'SEASON_HOLDER', 'FAN_CLUB_GOLD', 'SPONSOR_GUEST'). Enables programmatic eligibility enforcement and CRM-driven targeting via Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform. [Moved from hold_allocation: This field on hold_allocation is a single-value text code that attempts to capture the fan segment or loyalty group eligible for the hold. In the true M:N model, multiple segments can be entitled to the same hold allocation, each with their own priority and quantity. The eligibility_group_code becomes redundant and misleading once the presale_access association table exists — segment identity is now captured via the FK to fan_segment. The field should be deprecated from hold_allocation and replaced by the association records.]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Fan and Sponsor Relationship Management); Adobe Experience Platform; Ticketmaster/AXS

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this presale access record was last updated, supporting audit and change tracking for inventory management operations.
attributes.references: ISO 8601

attributes.name: presale_access_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this segment's access entitlement against the hold allocation. Tracks whether the access grant is active, expired, released, or consumed.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank determining the access priority order when multiple fan segments are entitled to the same hold allocation. Lower values indicate higher priority. Belongs to the relationship because priority is relative to the specific hold block, not an intrinsic property of the segment or the hold.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: quantity_consumed
attributes.description: Number of tickets from this segment's allocation that have been purchased or issued during the presale window. Enables per-segment consumption tracking distinct from the hold-level quantity_consumed aggregate.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: window_end
attributes.description: Date and time when the presale window closes specifically for this fan segment against this hold allocation. Unallocated quantity after this time may be released or reassigned per hold release rules.
attributes.references: ISO 8601

attributes.name: window_start
attributes.description: Date and time when the presale window opens specifically for this fan segment against this hold allocation. May override the hold-level presale_window_start to provide staggered or segment-specific access timing. Belongs to the relationship because different segments on the same hold may have different window schedules.
attributes.references: ISO 8601

domains.name: broadcast
domains.description: Media rights and distribution domain managing broadcast schedules, regional sports networks (RSN), OTT/IPTV streaming platforms, PPV event packaging, content delivery networks (CDN), and rights agreements. Owns media asset metadata, live feed distribution, blackout rules, DRM policies, replay content, and multi-platform delivery including linear TV and DTC streaming services. Critical for revenue generation through media rights deals.

products.name: media_rights_deal
products.description: Master record of media rights agreements with broadcast partners (RSN, OTT, linear TV networks), including granular rights window definitions. Captures rights holder, territory, sport/league, exclusivity type, deal value, contract term, revenue share structure, rights categories (live, replay, highlights, PPV), and per-window platform/territory/time-period entitlements with sublicensing permissions. SSOT for all broadcast rights ownership, licensing terms, and rights window enforcement. Sourced from Dalet Galaxy and Salesforce CRM.

attributes.description: The business condition that activates this blackout rule: 'ticket_sales_threshold' (blackout lifted when ticket sales meet threshold), 'rsn_exclusivity' (RSN holds exclusive rights), 'league_mandate' (governing body requirement), 'rights_agreement' (contractual obligation), 'ppv_purchase' (PPV event requiring purchase), 'sellout_rule' (event sold out). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ticket_sales_threshold|rsn_exclusivity|league_mandate|rights_agreement|ppv_purchase|sellout_rule|capacity_threshold|broadcast_window — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL Blackout Policy; FCC Sports Blackout Rules; NBA Media Rights Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this blackout rule record, supporting audit trail and change management requirements.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version number tracking amendments and revisions to this blackout rule over its lifecycle. Supports audit trail and change management for rights compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; SOX Compliance

products.name: broadcast_drm_policy
products.description: Digital Rights Management policy definitions governing content protection, encryption standards, device authentication, and playback restrictions for OTT, IPTV, and DTC streaming platforms. Captures DRM technology (Widevine, FairPlay, PlayReady), content tier, geo-restriction rules, concurrent stream limits, download permissions, and watermarking requirements. Ensures IP protection and rights compliance.

attributes.name: broadcast_drm_policy_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Broadcast Digital Rights Management (DRM) Policy ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a Digital Rights Management (DRM) policy record governing content protection and playback restrictions across OTT, IPTV, and DTC streaming platforms.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 23009 (MPEG-DASH), W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME)

attributes.name: parent_policy_broadcast_drm_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent DRM policy from which this policy inherits base settings. Supports hierarchical policy structures where sport-specific or event-specific policies extend a master DRM policy template.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management

attributes.name: analytics_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether playback analytics and DRM license event tracking are enabled for content governed by this policy. Supports ARPU analysis, concurrent stream monitoring, and rights compliance reporting in Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; GDPR Article 6; CCPA

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the rights management or legal authority who approved this DRM policy for production deployment. Supports governance and audit trail requirements for IP protection compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; IP Protection Policy; CAS

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DRM policy was formally approved for production use. Distinct from created_timestamp; captures the approval lifecycle event for governance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: blackout_rule_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether local or regional blackout rules are enforced under this DRM policy. Blackout rules restrict live event streaming in local broadcast markets to protect RSN and linear TV rights agreements.
attributes.references: RSN Blackout Rules; FCC Broadcast Regulation; NFL/MLB Broadcast Rights

attributes.name: cdn_profile_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the CDN delivery profile associated with this DRM policy. CDN profiles define token authentication, signed URL parameters, and edge caching rules that complement DRM enforcement.
attributes.references: CDN SLA; Dalet Galaxy Broadcast Workflow

attributes.name: compliance_standard
attributes.description: Regulatory or industry compliance standard that this DRM policy is designed to satisfy (e.g., 'GDPR', 'CCPA', 'PCI-DSS', 'FCC'). Supports compliance reporting and audit trail requirements for content protection governance.
attributes.references: GDPR; CCPA; PCI-DSS; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: concurrent_stream_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active streams permitted per subscriber entitlement under this DRM policy. Enforced at the CDN and streaming platform level to prevent credential sharing and protect media rights revenue.
attributes.references: Media Rights Agreement; CDN SLA

attributes.name: content_tier
attributes.description: Content access tier to which this DRM policy applies, aligning with subscription or entitlement levels. VIP tiers may include exclusive live events or athlete content; PPV tiers apply to pay-per-view events such as UFC or boxing matches.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Entitlement Management; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DRM policy record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX Audit Requirements; ISO 8601

attributes.name: device_authentication_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether device-level authentication and registration is required before DRM license issuance. When true, only registered and authenticated devices may receive license keys for protected content.
attributes.references: DRM Vendor License Agreement; PCI-DSS; GDPR Article 32

attributes.name: download_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether offline download of protected content is permitted under this DRM policy. When true, download-to-own or rental download workflows are enabled subject to license expiry rules.
attributes.references: DRM Vendor License Agreement; IP Protection Policy

attributes.name: drm_technology
attributes.description: The DRM technology stack applied to enforce content protection. Widevine is used for Android/Chrome, FairPlay for Apple devices, PlayReady for Microsoft/Smart TVs, and multi_drm indicates a combined approach for cross-platform delivery.
attributes.references: W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); Google Widevine; Apple FairPlay; Microsoft PlayReady

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this DRM policy becomes active and enforceable on streaming platforms. Aligns with the start of the associated media rights agreement or broadcast season.
attributes.references: Media Rights Agreement; ISO 8601

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this DRM policy expires and is no longer enforceable. Null for open-ended policies. Aligns with the expiry of the associated media rights agreement.
attributes.references: Media Rights Agreement; ISO 8601

attributes.name: encryption_standard
attributes.description: Cryptographic encryption standard applied to protected content streams. AES-128 and AES-256 are common for HLS, CENC (Common Encryption) is used for DASH multi-DRM, and CBCS is the Apple FairPlay encryption scheme.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 23001-7 (CENC); NIST AES Standard; Apple FairPlay Streaming

attributes.name: geo_blocked_territories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes explicitly blocked from content playback under this DRM policy. Supports blackout rules for RSN exclusivity and international rights restrictions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; RSN Blackout Rules; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: geo_permitted_territories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (e.g., 'USA,CAN,GBR') where content playback is permitted under this DRM policy. Used to enforce broadcast rights territorial restrictions for RSN, OTT, and DTC platforms.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FIFA Media Rights; NFL Broadcast Rights Agreement

attributes.name: geo_restriction_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic access restrictions are enforced under this DRM policy. When true, content playback is limited to permitted territories defined in the geo_permitted_territories and geo_blocked_territories fields.
attributes.references: FIFA Media Rights; NFL Broadcast Rights; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: hdcp_version_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP) Version Required
attributes.description: Minimum HDCP version required on the display output for content playback under this DRM policy. HDCP 2.2 or higher is typically required for 4K UHD premium sports content.
attributes.references: HDCP Specification; Digital Content Protection LLC

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DRM policy record was last updated. Tracks policy changes for audit, compliance, and version control purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX Audit Requirements; ISO 8601

attributes.name: license_duration_hours
attributes.description: Duration in hours for which a DRM license key is valid after issuance to a device. After expiry, the device must re-request a license from the license server. Controls content access windows for rental and PPV models.
attributes.references: W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); DRM Vendor SLA

attributes.name: license_renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DRM license must be renewed (re-fetched from the license server) during active playback sessions. When true, the player must periodically contact the license server to maintain uninterrupted playback.
attributes.references: W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); Google Widevine

attributes.name: license_server_url
attributes.description: HTTPS endpoint URL of the DRM license server responsible for issuing and validating license keys for content governed by this policy. Must use HTTPS. Configured per DRM technology (Widevine, FairPlay, PlayReady).
attributes.references: W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); DRM Vendor SLA

attributes.name: max_registered_devices
attributes.description: Maximum number of devices a subscriber may register for DRM license delivery under this policy. Limits credential sharing and protects media rights revenue across OTT and DTC platforms.
attributes.references: DRM Vendor License Agreement; Media Rights Agreement

attributes.name: offline_playback_duration_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours a downloaded content item may be played back offline before the DRM license expires and re-authentication is required. Null when download is not permitted.
attributes.references: DRM Vendor License Agreement; ISO/IEC 23009

attributes.name: output_protection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether HDCP (High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection) or equivalent output protection is required on connected display outputs. Enforced for premium and PPV content to prevent unauthorized recording.
attributes.references: HDCP Specification; Microsoft PlayReady; Google Widevine

attributes.name: platform_type
attributes.description: Delivery platform category to which this DRM policy applies. OTT (Over-The-Top), IPTV (Internet Protocol Television), DTC (Direct-To-Consumer), linear TV broadcast, mobile app, or web browser. Determines applicable DRM technology and encryption requirements.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; IPTV Industry Standards

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the DRM policy, used in rights agreements, vendor contracts, and system integrations with Dalet Galaxy and CDN platforms. Format: DRM- followed by 4-20 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; DRM Vendor SLA

attributes.name: policy_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the DRM policy's purpose, scope, and any special enforcement conditions. Used by rights management and broadcast operations teams for policy governance and documentation.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the DRM policy used for identification in broadcast operations, rights management workflows, and reporting dashboards (e.g., 'NFL Sunday Ticket PPV Standard', 'OTT Premium Tier FairPlay').
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the DRM policy. Active policies are enforced on streaming platforms; deprecated policies are retained for historical audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; DRM Vendor SLA

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DRM policy by monetization model: subscription (SVOD), pay-per-view (PPV), rental (TVOD), download-to-own (EST), free ad-supported (AVOD), or preview. Drives entitlement logic and revenue reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: subscription|ppv|rental|download_to_own|free_ad_supported|preview — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; OTT Industry Standards

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Version number of the DRM policy definition, following semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0', '2.1.3'). Enables tracking of policy changes over time and supports rollback in case of compliance issues.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; DRM Vendor SLA

attributes.name: resolution_restriction
attributes.description: Maximum video resolution permitted for playback under this DRM policy. Resolution restrictions may be applied based on device capability, subscription tier, or rights agreement terms (e.g., SD-only for non-authenticated devices).
attributes.references: Media Rights Agreement; CDN Delivery Standards

attributes.name: rights_agreement_ref
attributes.description: External reference code or contract number of the media rights agreement that mandates this DRM policy. Links DRM enforcement requirements back to the contractual obligation with leagues (NFL, NBA, FIFA) or broadcast partners.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/FIFA Media Rights Agreement; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: rights_window_type
attributes.description: Type of content rights window governed by this DRM policy: live (real-time broadcast), VOD (video on demand), replay (post-event catch-up), archive (long-term library), or preview (short promotional clip). Determines applicable DRM enforcement rules.
attributes.references: Media Rights Agreement; Dalet Galaxy; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: robustness_level
attributes.description: Widevine/PlayReady robustness level required for license issuance, defining the security tier of the decryption environment. HW_SECURE_ALL requires hardware-level TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) and is mandated for 4K UHD premium sports content.
attributes.references: Google Widevine Robustness Levels; Microsoft PlayReady Security Levels

attributes.name: screen_capture_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether screen capture and screen recording are blocked on supported platforms under this DRM policy. Enforced via OS-level DRM APIs on Android (Widevine) and iOS (FairPlay) to prevent unauthorized content capture.
attributes.references: Google Widevine; Apple FairPlay; IP Protection Policy

attributes.name: token_auth_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed authentication token (e.g., JWT) is required when requesting a DRM license. Token authentication prevents unauthorized license acquisition and is standard for premium and PPV content.
attributes.references: OAuth 2.0; JWT RFC 7519; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: token_expiry_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds after which the authentication token used for DRM license requests expires. Short expiry windows reduce the risk of token replay attacks on premium sports content.
attributes.references: JWT RFC 7519; OAuth 2.0; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: watermark_type
attributes.description: Type of watermarking applied to protected content: forensic (invisible, embedded in bitstream for piracy tracing), visible (on-screen overlay), both, or none. Forensic watermarking is standard for live PPV and premium sports events.
attributes.references: IP Protection Policy; Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management

attributes.name: watermarking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether forensic or visible watermarking must be applied to content streams under this DRM policy. Watermarking enables source tracing of unauthorized redistribution and piracy detection.
attributes.references: WADA Anti-Piracy; IP Protection Policy; Dalet Galaxy

products.name: live_feed
products.description: Operational record of each live broadcast feed produced and distributed for a scheduled event. Captures source venue, OB (Outside Broadcast) unit assignment, signal type (satellite, fiber, IP), encoding format (H.264/H.265), resolution (SD/HD/4K/8K), audio tracks, commentary language, feed status (active, standby, failed, backup), CDN origin endpoint, and redundancy configuration. Core operational entity for live broadcast production, distribution monitoring, and failover management.

attributes.name: live_feed_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each live broadcast feed record in the Sports Entertainment broadcast domain. Primary key for the live_feed data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: backup_feed_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designated backup or failover live feed that will be activated if this primary feed fails. Enables automated failover management and redundancy tracking in broadcast operations.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2022-7; Internal Broadcast Continuity Standard

attributes.name: broadcast_channel_id

Business justification: live_feed has drm_policy_id → content.drm_policy (cross-domain) but no FK to the in-domain broadcast.broadcast_drm_policy. The broadcast DRM policy governs encryption, device limits, and geo-restricti
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: broadcast_production_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to broadcast.production. Business justification: A live feed is the technical output of a broadcast production. Linking live_feed to production enables crew, equipment, and production metadata to be associated with the feed. This supports post-event
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: broadcast_rights_window_id
attributes.description: Reference to the media rights agreement governing distribution of this live feed across licensed territories and platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Rights Management Standard

attributes.name: broadcast_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to broadcast.broadcast_schedule. Business justification: A live feed is produced for a specific broadcast schedule window. This FK links the operational feed record to its scheduled broadcast slot, enabling operational tracking of which feed serves which sc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: content_rights_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_rights_window. Business justification: Live feed activation for a territory/platform must be validated against the content rights window to confirm live streaming rights are active. Feed operations teams perform this rights check before en
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Live feeds incur significant costs (CDN delivery, OB unit operations, satellite uplinks) tracked against cost centers in finance. Finance requires live feed-to-cost-center linkage for production cost
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: dalet_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding media asset record in the Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management (MAM) system. Enables traceability between the operational live feed record and the media asset management workflow for ingest, archiving, and content repurposing.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management Standard; Internal DAM (Digital Asset Management) Governance

attributes.name: event_fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled sporting or entertainment event for which this live feed is being produced and distributed.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled sporting or entertainment event for which this live feed is being produced and distributed.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: media_rights_deal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the media rights agreement governing distribution of this live feed across licensed territories and platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Rights Management Standard

attributes.name: platform_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.platform_channel. Business justification: Live feed OTT distribution requires referencing the content platform channel to configure CDN endpoints, DRM requirements, and geo-restriction rules. Feed engineers need this link to route live feeds
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sla_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.sla_policy. Business justification: Live feeds during events are governed by SLA policies defining uptime targets, CDN failover thresholds, and latency SLAs. Operations teams reference the SLA policy to trigger failover and report SLA c
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.vendor_contract. Business justification: Live feed delivery (OB units, CDN services) is governed by specific vendor contracts. Linking enables SLA breach tracking, invoice reconciliation, and vendor performance reporting against actual feed
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source venue from which this live feed originates, used for routing and signal path management.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time (UTC) when this live feed concluded transmission. Used for post-event reporting, content ingest triggering, and broadcast duration billing. Null if feed is still active.
attributes.references: Internal Broadcast Operations Standard; Dalet Galaxy Workflow

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time (UTC) when this live feed began transmitting. Compared against scheduled_start_time to measure on-air punctuality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance. Null if feed has not yet started.
attributes.references: Internal Broadcast SLA Standard; Dalet Galaxy Workflow

attributes.name: aspect_ratio
attributes.description: Width-to-height ratio of the video frame for this live feed. 16:9 is the standard widescreen format for HD and 4K broadcast; 4:3 is legacy SD format. Determines display compatibility across linear TV and OTT (Over-The-Top) platforms.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2036; ITU-R BT.1543

attributes.name: audio_format
attributes.description: Audio channel configuration and encoding format for the primary audio track of the live feed. Dolby Atmos and 7.1 surround are premium formats for high-end broadcast and streaming platforms.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2110-30; Dolby Atmos Broadcast Specification; EBU R 68

attributes.name: audio_track_count
attributes.description: Total number of discrete audio tracks embedded in the live feed. Multiple tracks support stereo, 5.1 surround, and separate commentary language channels. Relevant for multi-language broadcast distribution and accessibility compliance.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2110-30; EBU R 48; ADA Accessibility Standard

attributes.name: bitrate_kbps
attributes.description: Target encoding bitrate of the live feed in kilobits per second (Kbps). Determines bandwidth consumption, CDN (Content Delivery Network) capacity requirements, and viewer quality of experience. Typical values range from 1,500 Kbps (SD) to 50,000+ Kbps (4K HDR).
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2048; ITU-T H.265; EBU R 143

attributes.name: blackout_rule_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a territorial blackout restriction is currently applied to this live feed, preventing distribution in specific geographic markets per media rights agreements. Critical for rights compliance and RSN (Regional Sports Network) exclusivity enforcement.
attributes.references: FCC Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76); NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL League Broadcast Agreements

attributes.name: blackout_territory
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or designated market area codes where this live feed is blacked out per media rights agreements. Null if no blackout applies. Used for geo-fencing enforcement on DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) and OTT (Over-The-Top) platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76); ISO 3166-1; League Broadcast Rights Agreements

attributes.name: cdn_origin_endpoint
attributes.business_glossary_term: Content Delivery Network (CDN) Origin Endpoint URL
attributes.description: Primary CDN (Content Delivery Network) origin ingest URL or endpoint address from which the live feed is distributed to downstream delivery nodes and OTT (Over-The-Top) platforms. Core operational field for live distribution monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal CDN Operations Standard; IETF RFC 3986

attributes.name: commentary_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-2 language code for the primary commentary audio track on this live feed (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish, 'fr' for French). Drives regional distribution routing and RSN (Regional Sports Network) assignment.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ISO 639-2; EBU R 48

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when this live feed record was first created in the system, typically during pre-event broadcast planning. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: distribution_tier
attributes.description: Geographic scope of distribution authorized for this live feed under the applicable media rights agreement. Global feeds are distributed worldwide; regional feeds are limited to a geographic zone; national feeds are country-specific; local feeds are limited to a designated market area (DMA).
attributes.references: League Broadcast Rights Agreements; FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Rights Distribution Standard

attributes.name: encoding_format
attributes.description: Video codec standard used to compress and encode the live feed signal. H.264 (AVC) and H.265 (HEVC) are the dominant standards for broadcast and OTT (Over-The-Top) streaming delivery. Impacts bandwidth, quality, and platform compatibility.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2048; ITU-T H.264; ITU-T H.265; EBU R 143

attributes.name: failover_activated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the backup or redundancy failover mechanism was triggered during this live feed's transmission. Used for post-event incident analysis, SLA (Service Level Agreement) reporting, and broadcast reliability KPI (Key Performance Indicator) tracking.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2022-7; Internal Broadcast SLA Standard

attributes.name: failover_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when the failover mechanism was activated for this live feed. Null if failover_activated is false. Used for incident root cause analysis and SLA (Service Level Agreement) breach assessment.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2022-7; Internal Broadcast Incident Management Standard

attributes.name: feed_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this live feed within broadcast operations and Dalet Galaxy media asset management workflows. Used for signal routing, scheduling, and inter-system reference.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management Standard; SMPTE ST 2110

attributes.name: feed_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the live feed, typically including event name, feed type, and language (e.g., 'NFL Championship - World Feed - English'). Used in operational dashboards and scheduling systems.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management Standard

attributes.name: feed_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the live feed. Active indicates the feed is live and distributing; standby is ready but not transmitting; failed indicates a signal loss or error condition; backup indicates a redundancy feed has taken over; scheduled indicates pre-event readiness; terminated indicates the feed has ended.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2110; Internal Broadcast Operations SLA Standard

attributes.name: feed_type
attributes.description: Classification of the live feed by its production and distribution purpose. World feed is the primary international signal; clean feed has no graphics; ISO feed is an isolated camera angle; PPV (Pay-Per-View) and OTT (Over-The-Top) feeds are platform-specific variants. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: world_feed|clean_feed|commentary_feed|iso_feed|backup_feed|ppv_feed|ott_feed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SMPTE Standards; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: frame_rate
attributes.description: Number of video frames per second (fps) for this live feed. Common values include 25, 29.97, 50, 59.94, and 60 fps. Affects motion smoothness, storage requirements, and compatibility with broadcast standards across regions (PAL vs NTSC).
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 12-1; ITU-R BT.1359; EBU R 23

attributes.name: hdr_format
attributes.description: High Dynamic Range (HDR) format applied to the live feed for enhanced color and brightness reproduction. HDR10 and HLG (Hybrid Log-Gamma) are the broadcast standards; Dolby Vision is a premium streaming format. None indicates standard dynamic range (SDR).
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2084; ITU-R BT.2100; EBU R 103

attributes.name: is_iptv_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this live feed is authorized and configured for distribution via IPTV (Internet Protocol Television) networks, including managed IPTV services provided by telecommunications operators.
attributes.references: Internal IPTV Distribution Standard; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: is_linear_tv_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this live feed is authorized and configured for distribution via traditional linear television broadcast channels, including RSN (Regional Sports Network) and national broadcast network affiliates.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Rights Distribution Standard

attributes.name: is_ott_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this live feed is authorized and technically configured for distribution via OTT (Over-The-Top) streaming platforms, including DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) services and third-party streaming partners.
attributes.references: Internal OTT Distribution Standard; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: is_ppv
attributes.description: Indicates whether this live feed is designated as a PPV (Pay-Per-View) event feed, requiring consumer purchase or entitlement before access is granted. Drives entitlement checks on DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) and OTT (Over-The-Top) platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Pay-Per-View Regulations; Internal Revenue Management Standard

attributes.name: latency_mode
attributes.description: Configured latency mode for this live feed delivery. Ultra-low latency (sub-3 seconds) is required for interactive and betting-adjacent use cases; low latency (3-10 seconds) for OTT (Over-The-Top) sports streaming; standard (10-30 seconds) for traditional broadcast; high for archive-quality delivery.
attributes.references: Internal OTT SLA Standard; CMAF Low Latency Specification (ISO/IEC 23000-19)

attributes.name: ob_unit_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Outside Broadcast (OB) truck or mobile production unit assigned to capture and produce this live feed at the source venue. Critical for resource scheduling and operational accountability.
attributes.references: Internal Broadcast Operations Standard; EBU R 68

attributes.name: production_region
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary production region where this live feed is originated and managed. Used for regulatory compliance, rights territory management, and broadcast operations routing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Rights Management Standard

attributes.name: redundancy_config
attributes.description: Redundancy architecture configured for this live feed to ensure continuity in case of primary signal failure. 1+1 means one active and one standby path; N+1 means N active feeds with one shared backup. Critical for broadcast SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2022-7; Internal Broadcast SLA Standard; EBU R 68

attributes.name: replay_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this live feed is authorized and configured to generate replay or catch-up content after the live event concludes. Drives post-event content ingest workflows in Dalet Galaxy and DRM (Digital Rights Management) policy application for replay windows.
attributes.references: Internal Content Rights Standard; DRM Policy Governance

attributes.name: replay_window_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours after the live event ends during which replay content derived from this feed is available to authorized viewers. Defined by the media rights agreement and DRM (Digital Rights Management) policy. Null if replay_enabled is false.

attributes.description: Classification of the audience measurement metric captured in this record. GRP (Gross Rating Point) represents total delivery; CPM (Cost Per Mille) supports advertiser rate card justification; Reach measures unique audience; Frequency measures average exposures; AMA (Average Minute Audience) is the standard linear TV metric; Share is the percentage of viewing universe. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GRP|CPM|Reach|Frequency|Viewership|AMA|Share — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; MRC (Media Rating Council) Standards

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Total number of unique individuals who viewed at least one minute of the broadcast during the measured window. Distinct from total_viewers which may count repeat viewing. Used for unduplicated audience reporting to sponsors and rights holders.
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: Defines the time-shifted viewing window included in this measurement record per Nielsen and BARB standards. Live = real-time only; Live+1 includes same-day DVR; Live+3 includes 3-day playback; Live+7 includes 7-day playback; Live+35 is the C35 standard; VOD is on-demand only.
attributes.references: Nielsen Live+3 / Live+7 / C35 Standards; BARB VOSDAL; MRC

attributes.name: share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total viewing universe (all households/individuals with TV/streaming access) that watched this broadcast during the window. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 12.500 = 12.5%). Core metric for competitive scheduling analysis.
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: sport_type
attributes.description: The sport or entertainment category of the broadcast content (e.g., NFL Football, NBA Basketball, FIFA Soccer, UFC MMA, Concert). Enables sport-specific audience trend analysis and rights valuation benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NFL Football|NBA Basketball|MLB Baseball|NHL Hockey|MLS Soccer|FIFA Soccer|UFC MMA|Tennis|Concert|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL; NBA; MLB; NHL; MLS; FIFA; UFC; ATP Governing Body Standards

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the geographic territory in which the audience measurement was conducted. Critical for regional rights valuation, blackout rule enforcement, and RSN (Regional Sports Network) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FIFA; NFL; NBA; NHL; MLB; MLS Broadcast Rights Agreements

attributes.name: time_shifted_viewers
attributes.description: Number of viewers who watched the broadcast on a time-shifted basis (DVR, catch-up, VOD replay) within the measurement window. Reported separately per Nielsen Live+3 and Live+7 standards for contractual audience guarantee reconciliation.
attributes.references: Nielsen Live+3 / Live+7 Standards; BARB VOSDAL (Viewed on Same Day as Live)

attributes.name: total_viewers
attributes.description: Total number of individual viewers who watched the broadcast during the measured window. The primary headline metric used in media rights negotiations, advertiser rate cards, and contractual audience guarantees.
attributes.references: Nielsen; BARB; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: universe_size
attributes.description: Total size of the viewing universe (total TV households or individuals) used as the denominator for rating_pct and share_pct calculations in the given territory and demographic. Provided by the measurement source.
attributes.references: Nielsen Universe Estimates; BARB Universe Estimates; OzTAM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audience rating record was last modified, typically when preliminary ratings are revised or confirmed by the measurement provider. Supports audit trail and revised-rating reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: window_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the measured broadcast window ended. Combined with window_start_timestamp to define the exact measurement interval for AMA and share calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Nielsen Measurement Standards

attributes.name: window_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the measured broadcast window began, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used as the principal business event timestamp for scheduling optimization and rights valuation.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; FCC Broadcast Regulation

products.name: broadcast_ad_inventory

SSOT for broadcast advertising inventory management and placement execution. Distinct from sponsorship domain brand activations.

attributes.name: audience_demographic_target
attributes.description: Primary audience demographic target for this ad slot as defined in the media plan (e.g., 'Adults 18-49', 'Males 25-54', 'Households'). Used for audience delivery validation against Nielsen GRP guarantees and CPM pricing.

attributes.name: blackout_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether broadcast blackout rules apply to this ad slot in the specified territory, restricting distribution based on media rights agreements. True = blackout rules apply; False = no blackout restriction. Critical for rights compliance.

attributes.name: break_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the commercial break within the broadcast window to which this slot belongs (e.g., Break 1, Break 2). Used for scheduling and trafficking coordination.

attributes.name: cdn_delivery_endpoint
attributes.description: The Content Delivery Network (CDN) endpoint URL or identifier used to serve the ad creative for OTT and streaming platform delivery. Null for linear TV slots. Used by ad operations for trafficking and delivery verification.

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Audience content rating of the broadcast window in which this ad slot appears, used to enforce advertiser brand safety requirements and regulatory compliance. Restricts certain ad categories from appearing in age-restricted content.

attributes.name: cpm_floor_rate
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable Cost Per Mille (CPM) rate in USD for this advertising slot, below which the slot will not be sold. Set by revenue management based on platform, slot type, and audience reach. Used as the baseline for programmatic and direct sales negotiations.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab CPM Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this advertising inventory slot record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to CPM rates and revenue values for this slot (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-territory revenue reporting and FX conversion.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: gross_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total gross revenue in the slot currency generated from the sale of this advertising slot, before agency commissions or discounts. Populated upon sale confirmation. Used for revenue recognition and financial reporting per SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: grp_value
attributes.description: Gross Rating Point (GRP) value associated with this ad slot, representing the percentage of the target audience reached multiplied by frequency. Used for media planning, audience delivery validation, and make-good calculations.
attributes.references: Nielsen GRP Methodology; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: impressions_delivered
attributes.description: Actual number of audience impressions delivered for this slot as measured post-broadcast by audience measurement systems (e.g., Nielsen). Null until slot has aired. Compared against impressions_guaranteed for make-good liability assessment.
attributes.references: Nielsen Audience Measurement; IAB Impression Standards

attributes.name: impressions_guaranteed
attributes.description: The number of audience impressions contractually guaranteed to the advertiser for this slot, based on audience ratings projections (GRP-based). Used for make-good calculations if delivery falls short.
attributes.references: Nielsen Audience Measurement; IAB Impression Standards; GRP Methodology

attributes.name: is_makegood
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot is a make-good placement issued to compensate an advertiser for under-delivery of impressions on a previously aired slot. True = make-good; False = standard placement. Tracked for liability management and client relations.
attributes.references: IAB Make-Good Standards; Broadcast Industry Practice

attributes.name: is_programmatic
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot was sold via programmatic advertising technology (e.g., programmatic direct, private marketplace) rather than direct sales. True = programmatic; False = direct/manual sale. Used for channel mix analysis and yield optimization.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Programmatic Standards

attributes.name: is_sold
attributes.description: Indicates whether this advertising slot has been sold to an advertiser. True = sold; False = available or unsold inventory. Primary flag for inventory availability dashboards and yield management reporting.

attributes.name: is_sponsorship_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot carries a sponsorship exclusivity restriction, preventing competing brands in the same product category from advertising within the same broadcast window. True = exclusive; False = non-exclusive. Governed by sponsorship partnership agreements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sponsorship Module; Internal Sponsorship Policy

attributes.name: market_region
attributes.description: Broadcast market or designated market area (DMA) name for this ad slot (e.g., 'New York DMA', 'Los Angeles DMA', 'UK National'). Used for regional sales targeting and RSN-specific inventory management.

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Net revenue in the slot currency after deducting agency commissions and applicable discounts from gross revenue. Used for P&L reporting, EBITDA calculation, and broadcast rights deal performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by ad operations or sales teams regarding special instructions, client requests, competitive separation requirements, or trafficking exceptions for this slot.

attributes.name: placement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the advertiser creative was formally trafficked and placed into this slot by the ad operations team. Marks the transition from sold to trafficked status.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which this ad slot was sold or allocated. Values: direct (direct sales team), programmatic (automated buying platform), agency (media agency buy), house (internal/house ad), barter (trade/barter arrangement). Used for revenue attribution and sales performance reporting.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Channel

attributes.name: scheduled_air_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned broadcast date and time when this advertising slot is scheduled to air, expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Principal business event timestamp for scheduling and trafficking workflows.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Broadcast Workflow; IAB Tech Lab

attributes.name: slot_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this advertising inventory slot, used in trafficking systems, sales orders, and agency communications (e.g., 'SLOT-ESPN-MR-001'). Unique within a broadcast schedule.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Ad Slot Standards; Dalet Galaxy

attributes.name: slot_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Length of the advertising slot in seconds. Standard broadcast durations include 15, 30, 60, and 90 seconds. Used for scheduling, pricing, and trafficking validation.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab VAST Standard; FCC Broadcast Standards

attributes.name: slot_position
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this ad slot within its commercial break or content block (e.g., 1 = first position, 2 = second position). First and last positions typically command premium CPM rates.

attributes.name: slot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the advertising inventory slot. Drives revenue recognition, trafficking workflows, and inventory availability reporting. Values: available (open for sale), reserved (held pending contract), sold (contracted), trafficked (creative assigned and scheduled), aired (broadcast confirmed), cancelled (removed from schedule).

attributes.name: slot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the advertising slot by its position and format within the broadcast window. Drives pricing, trafficking rules, and CPM floor rates. Values: pre-roll (before content), mid-roll (during content break), post-roll (after content), billboard (opening/closing brand card), in-break (standard commercial break), sponsorship-billboard (branded segment opener/closer).

products.name: rights_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between a broadcast channel and a league governing the rights to distribute league content. It captures the operational terms of each channel-league broadcast rights deal — including rights tier, exclusivity, territory, and effective dates — that exist only in the context of this specific channel-league pairing. Each record is a discrete, actively managed rights agreement that the business creates, renegotiates, and terminates as part of its media rights operations.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, a single broadcast channel (e.g., ESPN) simultaneously carries multiple leagues (NFL, NBA, MLB), and a single league (e.g., NFL) is distributed across multiple channels (ESPN, Fox, NBC, CBS) under distinct rights agreements. The business actively manages these channel-league broadcast rights relationships as named contracts with their own attributes — rights tier, exclusivity type, territory, and effective dates — that belong to neither the channel nor the league alone. This is a genuine operational M:N where rights deals are created, renegotiated, and terminated as discrete business events.

products.name: platform_rights_grant
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between media_rights_deal and digital_touchpoint. It captures the formal authorization granting a specific digital touchpoint the right to deliver content under a specific media rights deal, including the platform-level rights type, exclusivity terms, effective period, territory scope, and revenue share applicable to that specific deal-touchpoint combination. Each record links one media_rights_deal to one digital_touchpoint with attributes that exist only in the context of this per-platform rights authorization.. Existence Justification: A media rights deal licenses content delivery rights to multiple digital touchpoints simultaneously (e.g., an NFL deal may cover the OTT app, web portal, and IPTV endpoint under different terms), and each digital touchpoint can be covered by multiple rights deals across different sports, leagues, and territories. The business actively manages which touchpoints are authorized to deliver which rights, with per-touchpoint exclusivity flags, territory scopes, and revenue share terms that belong neither to the deal nor the touchpoint alone. This is a recognized operational concept in broadcast rights licensing — the authorization or 'platform rights grant' — that rights operations teams create, update, and enforce.

products.description: This association product represents the Contract between broadcast_rights_window and platform_channel. It captures the formal authorization record that grants a specific platform channel the right to distribute content under a specific broadcast rights window, including the technical compliance terms, exclusivity scope, DRM requirements, and stream limits that govern that specific channel-window combination. Each record links one broadcast_rights_window to one platform_channel with attributes that exist only in the context of this authorization relationship.. Existence Justification: In sports media rights operations, a single broadcast rights window (e.g., 'NFL Sunday Ticket, OTT, USA, 2024-2025') is actively distributed across multiple platform channels simultaneously — an OTT app, an IPTV portal, and a DTC streaming endpoint may all be authorized under the same window. Manages the full sponsorship lifecycle from prospecting through renewal.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary adjustment applied to the scheduled amount for this milestone, including contractual discounts, performance-based deductions, early payment incentives, or penalty surcharges. Negative values represent reductions; positive values represent surcharges.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Discount/Surcharge Conditions; Sponsorship Contract Addendum

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) cost center code associated with the business unit responsible for fulfilling the sponsorship obligations tied to this payment milestone. Supports internal profitability analysis and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment schedule milestone record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
