attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment milestone amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AUD). Supports multi-currency sponsorship deals across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Multi-Currency

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this payment milestone is past its due_date without confirmed receipt. Calculated as current date minus due_date when payment_status is 'overdue'. Used for accounts receivable aging buckets and collections escalation triggers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — AR Aging; GAAP Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: dispute_raised_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor formally raised a dispute for this payment milestone. Null if no dispute has been raised. Used to track dispute resolution SLA compliance and aging.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Date; SLA Compliance

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the sponsor for disputing this payment milestone. Populated when payment_status is 'disputed'. Supports dispute resolution tracking and contract management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case/Dispute Management; Sponsorship Contract Governance

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractually agreed date by which the sponsor must remit this payment milestone. Used for accounts receivable aging, overdue detection, and cash flow forecasting in Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Net Due Date; Sponsorship Contract Terms

attributes.name: dunning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent dunning (collections) notice was issued to the sponsor for this overdue payment milestone. Null if no dunning has been initiated. Used to track collections activity and enforce escalation timelines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Dunning Date; Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning (collections escalation) level for this overdue payment milestone, as managed in SAP S/4HANA FI dunning procedures. Level 0 = no dunning initiated; higher levels indicate escalating collection notices sent to the sponsor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Dunning Procedure; Accounts Receivable Collections

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_date
attributes.description: Last date by which the sponsor must remit payment to qualify for the early payment discount on this milestone. Null if no early payment discount applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Cash Discount Date; Payment Terms

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered to the sponsor for early payment of this milestone, as defined in the payment terms (e.g., 2.00 for a 2% early payment discount). Null if no early payment discount applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Cash Discount; Sponsorship Contract Terms

attributes.name: forecast_period
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter in which this payment milestone is expected to be received for cash flow forecasting purposes, formatted as YYYY-Q{N} (e.g., 2025-Q2). Used in Workday Adaptive Planning for sponsorship revenue forecasting and EBITDA projections.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Revenue Forecast; EBITDA Reporting

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice was formally issued to the sponsor for this payment milestone. Establishes the billing cycle start for payment terms calculation and revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Billing Date; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Contractual late payment penalty fee assessed against the sponsor for overdue payment of this milestone, as defined in the sponsorship deal terms. Expressed in the deal currency. Zero or null if no late fee applies or has been assessed.
attributes.references: Sponsorship Contract Terms; SAP S/4HANA FI — Dunning Charges

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Descriptive label for this payment milestone as defined in the sponsorship contract (e.g., 'Q1 Installment', 'Season Opener Activation Fee', 'Signing Bonus', 'Annual Naming Rights Fee'). Used in sponsor communications and invoice descriptions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contract Milestone

attributes.name: milestone_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this payment milestone within the overall deal payment schedule (e.g., 1 = first installment, 2 = second installment). Supports chronological ordering and installment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Plan Item Sequence

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount due after applying all adjustments to the scheduled amount (scheduled_amount + adjustment_amount). This is the amount reflected on the issued invoice and tracked in SAP S/4HANA accounts receivable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Net Invoice Amount; ASC 606

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal commentary, or special instructions related to this payment milestone (e.g., 'Sponsor requested 30-day extension per email dated 2025-01-15', 'VIK to be fulfilled via stadium signage Q2'). For internal use by the sponsorship and finance teams.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Notes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Text Field

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used by the sponsor to remit this payment (e.g., wire_transfer, ACH, check, credit_card, direct_debit, offset). Distinct from payment_type which captures the consideration form. Used for treasury reconciliation and PCI-DSS compliance tracking.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS — Payment Processing; SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Method

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Sponsor-provided remittance reference or bank transaction reference number accompanying the payment. Used for automated cash application and matching in SAP S/4HANA accounts receivable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Reference; Bank Statement Processing

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this payment milestone. 'scheduled' = not yet invoiced; 'invoiced' = invoice issued awaiting receipt; 'received' = funds confirmed; 'overdue' = past due date without receipt; 'cancelled' = milestone voided; 'disputed' = sponsor has raised a formal dispute.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Accounts Receivable Item Status

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA payment terms code governing the due date calculation and early payment discount conditions for this milestone (e.g., 'NET30', 'NET60', '2/10NET30'). Derived from the sponsorship deal contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Terms; Sponsorship Contract

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment consideration form. 'cash' = monetary wire/ACH/check; 'VIK' = Value-In-Kind (goods or services in lieu of cash); 'barter' = reciprocal exchange of services; 'offset' = applied against a credit balance; 'credit_note' = formal credit adjustment. Drives revenue recognition treatment under ASC 606.
attributes.references: ASC 606 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) profit center code for revenue attribution of this payment milestone. Enables segment-level P&L reporting by league, venue, or business unit for management accounting and ROI analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Profit Center Accounting; ROI Reporting

attributes.name: received_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount received from the sponsor for this milestone. May differ from net_amount in cases of partial payment, short payment, or currency conversion variance. Null until payment is received.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Clearing Amount; Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the sponsor's payment was confirmed as received and cleared in the bank or SAP FI clearing account. Null when payment has not yet been received. Used for days-sales-outstanding (DSO) calculation and cash flow actuals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Clearing Date; Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the revenue associated with this payment milestone is recognized in the financial statements under ASC 606 / IFRS 15. May differ from the received_date for multi-period or performance-obligation-based sponsorship deals.
attributes.references: ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code representing the legal entity within Sports Entertainment that is the contracting party for this sponsorship deal. Required for intercompany accounting, financial consolidation, and SOX compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Company Code; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting document number associated with the accounts receivable posting for this payment milestone. Serves as the primary cross-reference between the sponsorship data product and the general ledger for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — FI Document Number; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this payment schedule milestone, formatted as PS-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Used in sponsor-facing invoices, SAP FI correspondence, and accounts receivable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Billing Document Numbering

attributes.name: scheduled_amount
attributes.description: Gross contractual amount due for this payment milestone as specified in the sponsorship deal. Represents the base obligation before any adjustments, discounts, or withholding taxes. Expressed in the deal currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Billing Plan Item Amount; ASC 606

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment schedule milestone record was most recently modified. Tracks the latest change for audit trail, data lineage, and change management purposes.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Record Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Accuracy

attributes.name: vik_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the goods or services provided as Value-In-Kind (VIK) consideration for this milestone when payment_type is 'VIK' or 'barter'. Captures the nature, quantity, and estimated fair market value of the non-cash consideration for revenue recognition purposes.
attributes.references: ASC 606 — Non-Cash Consideration; FASB ASU 2014-09

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from this payment milestone by the sponsor, applicable for cross-border sponsorship deals subject to bilateral tax treaties. Impacts net cash received and requires separate GL posting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Withholding Tax; OECD Model Tax Convention

products.name: hospitality_entitlement
products.description: Master record for VIP hospitality benefits and entitlements included in sponsorship deals, with integrated line-item redemption tracking. Captures entitlement type (suite access, VIP tickets, field/pitch access passes, meet-and-greet packages, athlete appearance, executive box, travel and accommodation), quantity per event, event scope (all home games, playoffs, specific events), remaining balance. Includes redemption line items: redemption date, event, entitlement type redeemed, quantity used, sponsor contact who redeemed, redemption channel (online portal, account manager), and satisfaction rating. Supports sponsor relationship management, entitlement balance tracking, utilization reporting, and informs renewal package design.

products.name: creator_deal
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between a sponsor and a creator_profile in the Sports Entertainment ecosystem. It captures the commercial terms, exclusivity scope, NIL agreement linkage, content rights territory, revenue share, and contract lifecycle for each unique sponsor-creator partnership. Each record links one sponsor to one creator_profile and holds attributes that exist only in the context of that specific commercial agreement — not on the sponsor master record nor on the creator profile master record.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, sponsors actively partner with multiple content creators (influencers, NIL athletes) for branded content campaigns simultaneously, and a creator works with multiple sponsors across different brands and categories at the same time. This relationship is operationally managed as a 'Sponsorship Deal' or 'Creator Partnership' — a recognized business contract with its own terms, exclusivity scope, NIL agreement references, revenue share percentages, flat fees, and contract dates that belong to neither the sponsor nor the creator alone. Business teams actively create, negotiate, amend, and terminate these agreements as distinct commercial records.

products.name: channel_activation
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between a sponsorship deal and a distribution platform channel. It captures the specific commercial activation terms — impression commitments, CPM rates, exclusivity scope, and territory — that apply to a single deal on a single platform channel. Each record is an operationally managed entity created when a deal is activated on a channel, updated as delivery metrics are tracked, and closed when the activation period ends.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment sponsorship, a single deal (e.g., a digital platform partnership or broadcast integration) is contractually activated across multiple distribution platform channels simultaneously — an OTT app, a social media channel, and a broadcast slot may all be covered under one deal with distinct impression commitments and CPM rates per channel. Conversely, a single platform channel (e.g., ESPN+ OTT) carries activations from many concurrent sponsorship deals across different sponsors and deal types. The business actively manages these per-channel activation records, tracking impression commitments, CPM rates, exclusivity scope, and territory at the deal-channel intersection — data that belongs to neither the deal nor the channel alone.

products.name: audience_targeting_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between a sponsor and a fan_segment within the sponsorship audience planning process. It captures the operational record of a sponsor's contracted rights to reach a specific fan audience segment through defined activation channels, including targeting priority, category exclusivity, reach commitments, and contractual validity dates. Each record links one sponsor to one fan_segment with attributes that exist only in the context of this sponsor-segment targeting agreement.. Existence Justification: In sports-entertainment sponsorship operations, a sponsor actively targets multiple fan segments (e.g., a beer brand targets millennials, high-LTV fans, and season ticket holders simultaneously), and each fan segment is targeted by multiple sponsors across different industry categories. The business manages these pairings as named 'Audience Targeting' or 'Sponsorship Audience Allocation' records with contractual attributes — targeting priority, exclusivity rights per segment, activation channel, and contracted reach commitments — that belong to neither the sponsor nor the segment alone. This is an operationally managed relationship that sponsorship sales teams create, negotiate, and update as part of the audience planning and activation workflow.

attributes.name: maximum_purchase_quantity

attributes.name: measurement_unit

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be purchased for this inventory category. Null if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: parent_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent inventory category in a hierarchical classification structure. Null for top-level categories.

attributes.name: performance_metric_type
attributes.description: Primary performance metric used to measure and report effectiveness of this inventory category (e.g., CPM, GRP, engagement rate, brand lift, ROI). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cpm|grp|reach|frequency|engagement_rate|click_through_rate|brand_lift|conversion_rate|roi — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Standard frequency for delivering performance reports to sponsors for this inventory category.

attributes.name: requires_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether sponsor creative or activation plans for this inventory category require league, venue, or broadcast partner approval before execution.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales channel through which this inventory category is typically sold: direct (internal sales team), agency (through advertising agencies), marketplace (programmatic/self-service), or partnership (co-sold with partners).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventory category. Active categories are available for sale and fulfillment; inactive categories are temporarily unavailable; deprecated categories are phased out; pending_approval categories await commercial approval.

attributes.name: typical_contract_term_months
attributes.description: Standard contract duration in months for this inventory category. Null if not applicable or highly variable.

attributes.name: venue_type
attributes.description: Type of venue or platform where this inventory category is typically delivered. Null for non-venue-specific categories.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this inventory category record.

attributes.name: parent_inventory_category_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on inventory_category (parent_inventory_category_id)

domains.name: merchandise

Owns product master data, licensing agreements, royalty tracking, IP protection, brand compliance, and omnichannel sales across venue stores, online platforms, and third-party retailers.

Serves as the SSOT for product identity, descriptions, brand classifications, league/team associations, and product lifecycle status across all sales channels (Shopify Plus, POS, third-party retail). Tracks SKU codes, product names, categories, sizes, colors, materials, MSRP, and licensing requirements.

attributes.name: color_hex_code

attributes.name: compliance_approved_date

attributes.name: cost_price
attributes.description: Standard cost of goods for this SKU representing the landed cost per unit including manufacturing, materials, and inbound freight. Used for gross margin calculation, inventory valuation, and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was manufactured (e.g., USA, CHN, BGD, VNM). Required for customs declarations, import duty calculation, and consumer labeling compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SKU record was first created in the merchandise catalog system. Audit trail field supporting data lineage, SOX compliance, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Created On; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the MSRP and cost price fields (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency pricing for international merchandise operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SKU was or is scheduled to be discontinued and removed from active sales channels. Null for currently active SKUs. Supports end-of-life inventory planning and catalog archival.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Discontinuation Date; Shopify Plus Unpublished At

attributes.name: edition_size
attributes.description: Total number of units in the limited edition production run. Applicable only when is_limited_edition is True. Used for scarcity marketing, collector value assessment, and inventory allocation.
attributes.references: Brand Licensing Agreement; Shopify Plus Inventory Quantity

attributes.name: gender_target
attributes.description: Target gender or age demographic for the SKU used for product classification, catalog filtering, and merchandising segmentation across sales channels.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Product Tags; SAP S/4HANA MM Classification

attributes.name: harmonized_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code used for international trade, customs clearance, and import duty determination. Required for cross-border merchandise distribution and third-party retail export compliance.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System; US HTS Schedule; EU Combined Nomenclature

attributes.name: is_autographed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is an autographed memorabilia item. True triggers certificate of authenticity (COA) requirements, premium pricing tiers, and specialized inventory handling protocols.
attributes.references: Sports Memorabilia Authentication Standards; PSA/DNA; JSA Authentication

attributes.name: is_game_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is a game-used item (equipment or apparel actually used during an official game or event). True requires provenance documentation, chain-of-custody tracking, and premium authentication certification.
attributes.references: League Authentication Programs (MLB Authenticated, NFL Shield); Sports Memorabilia Authentication Standards

attributes.name: is_limited_edition
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is a limited edition release with a defined production run cap. True triggers limited edition pricing strategy, scarcity marketing, and edition size tracking.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Inventory Policy; Brand Licensing Agreement

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which the SKU was first made available for sale across authorized channels. Used for product lifecycle management, seasonal planning, and marketing campaign alignment.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Published At; SAP S/4HANA MM Valid From Date

attributes.name: license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU requires an active licensing agreement to manufacture, distribute, or sell. True for all officially licensed league, team, or athlete-branded merchandise. Drives compliance checks in the licensing workflow.
attributes.references: League IP Licensing Policy; CBA Group Licensing Provisions

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Classification of the licensing arrangement governing this SKU. 'league' = league-wide IP license; 'team' = team-specific marks; 'athlete_nil' = individual Name Image and Likeness (NIL) rights; 'event' = event-specific (e.g., Super Bowl, World Series); 'co_branded' = joint brand partnership; 'unlicensed' = generic merchandise without IP.
attributes.references: NFL Properties; NBA Properties; NFLPA/NBPA NIL Licensing; CBA

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the SKU within its product lifecycle. 'active' = available for sale across channels; 'discontinued' = no longer produced or sold; 'draft' = pending approval before activation; 'seasonal' = available only during defined seasonal windows; 'archived' = retained for historical reference only; 'blocked' = temporarily suspended from sale (e.g., IP dispute, quality hold).
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Product Status; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Status (MMSTA)

attributes.name: material_composition
attributes.description: Fabric or material composition of the product (e.g., '100% Polyester', '60% Cotton 40% Polyester', 'Genuine Leather'). Required for product labeling compliance, customs declarations, and consumer transparency regulations.
attributes.references: FTC Textile Fiber Products Identification Act; EU Textile Regulation 1007/2011; OSHA Material Safety

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price in the base currency (USD) for this SKU. Serves as the reference price point for all sales channels including Shopify Plus e-commerce, venue POS, and third-party retail. Does not represent actual transaction price.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Compare-At Price; SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Type PR00; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Detailed marketing and operational description of the product including materials, features, fit, and intended use. Used for e-commerce listings, catalog publishing, and digital asset management.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Product Body HTML; SAP S/4HANA MM Long Text

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the merchandise product as displayed on sales channels, e-commerce storefronts, and POS systems (e.g., 'Los Angeles Lakers City Edition Jersey – LeBron James #23').
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Product Title; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Description

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU represents a physical tangible good, a digital product (e.g., digital collectible, downloadable content), or a bundle of multiple items. Drives fulfillment routing and revenue recognition treatment.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Product Type; SAP S/4HANA SD Item Category; SEC Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: requires_authentication
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU requires a certificate of authenticity (COA) or third-party authentication (e.g., PSA/DNA, JSA) before sale. Applies to autographed memorabilia, game-used items, and high-value collectibles.
attributes.references: Sports Memorabilia Authentication Standards; PSA/DNA; JSA Authentication; League Authentication Programs

attributes.name: royalty_rate
attributes.description: Contractual royalty rate expressed as a decimal fraction of net sales revenue payable to the licensor (league, team, or athlete) for each unit sold. For example, 0.1500 = 15% royalty. Used in royalty tracking and financial reporting per licensing agreements.
attributes.references: Licensing Agreement Terms; SAP S/4HANA FI Royalty Management; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: sales_channel_availability
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of sales channels where this SKU is authorized for sale (e.g., 'shopify_online|venue_pos|third_party_retail|dtc_app'). attributes.description: Standardized size designation for the SKU variant (e.g., XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL, 3XL, 7, 7.5, 32x30). Null for non-sized items such as collectibles or accessories. Aligns with Shopify Plus variant option for size.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Variant Option (Size); SAP S/4HANA MM Classification Characteristic

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies a specific product variant (team, style, size, color combination) across all sales channels including Shopify Plus, POS, and third-party retail. Serves as the SSOT business identifier for omnichannel product lookup.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Variant SKU; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Number (MATNR)

attributes.name: taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is subject to sales tax. Drives tax calculation at POS and e-commerce checkout. Certain memorabilia or resale items may have different tax treatment depending on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the SKU record in the merchandise catalog. Supports change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Change Document; Shopify Plus Updated At; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: weight_grams
attributes.description: Physical weight of the SKU in grams used for shipping rate calculation, customs documentation, and carrier SLA compliance across e-commerce fulfillment and third-party retail distribution.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Variant Weight; SAP S/4HANA MM Gross Weight (BRGEW); IATA Shipping Standards

Sourced from Shopify Plus inventory sync, POS systems, and warehouse management. Supports omnichannel inventory optimization, event-day venue stocking, and inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit_cost and inventory_value fields (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-market merchandise operations across global venues.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Company Code Currency

attributes.name: in_transit_qty
attributes.description: Units of the SKU currently in transit to this location from another storage location (warehouse, venue, or third-party). Included in inventory planning but not yet physically received.

attributes.name: inventory_value

attributes.name: is_consignment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventory at this location is held on consignment with a third-party retailer. Consignment stock requires separate royalty tracking and licensing compliance under IP agreements.

attributes.name: is_event_allocated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory position has been specifically allocated for an upcoming event (e.g., game day, concert, championship). Event-allocated stock is excluded from general omnichannel availability.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus — Inventory Reservation; SAP S/4HANA MM — Special Stock

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent stock movement (sale, transfer, adjustment, receipt) that changed the on-hand quantity for this SKU-location combination. Critical for real-time inventory sync validation.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus — Inventory Updated At; SAP S/4HANA MM — Last Movement Date

attributes.name: last_movement_type
attributes.description: Type of the most recent stock movement that updated this inventory position. Used for audit trail and inventory reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sale|return|transfer_in|transfer_out|adjustment|receipt|write_off|event_allocation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Movement Type; Shopify Plus — Inventory Adjustment Reason

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory count was conducted for this SKU at this location. Used to assess count freshness and schedule cycle counts per SOX and internal audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Physical Inventory; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: last_physical_count_qty
attributes.description: Actual unit count recorded during the most recent physical inventory count for this SKU at this location. Compared against system on-hand quantity to identify shrinkage or discrepancies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Physical Inventory Count; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the physical storage location (e.g., venue store bin, warehouse zone, consignment shelf). Used for warehouse management and event-day stocking operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location Code; Shopify Plus — Location Name

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage location where inventory is held. Drives omnichannel fulfillment routing, event-day stocking logic, and consignment royalty tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: venue_store|warehouse|consignment|pop_up|online_fulfillment|third_party_retail — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Shopify Plus — Location Type; SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Type

attributes.name: max_stock_qty
attributes.description: Upper capacity limit for this SKU at this storage location. Prevents over-stocking and supports space planning for venue stores and warehouse zones.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Maximum Stock Level

attributes.name: on_hand_qty
attributes.description: Total physical units of the SKU currently present at the storage location, including reserved and blocked stock. Sourced from Shopify Plus inventory sync or warehouse management system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Unrestricted Stock + Reserved Stock; Shopify Plus — Available + Committed

attributes.name: pos_location_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the POS terminal or venue store location as registered in the POS system. Used to reconcile POS transaction-driven inventory deductions with Shopify Plus and SAP inventory records.
attributes.references: POS System — Terminal/Location Code; SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales Point

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventory position record. 'blocked' indicates stock held for quality inspection or compliance review; 'pending_audit' indicates a physical count discrepancy under investigation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Stock Status; Shopify Plus — Inventory Item Status

attributes.name: reorder_point_qty
attributes.description: Stock level threshold at which a replenishment order should be initiated for this SKU at this location. Accounts for lead time and safety stock. Used by merchandise operations for automated reorder triggers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Reorder Point; Shopify Plus — Inventory Policy

attributes.name: reorder_qty
attributes.description: Standard replenishment order quantity for this SKU at this location when the reorder point is reached. Reflects economic order quantity or vendor minimum order quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Lot Size / EOQ; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: reserved_qty
attributes.description: Units of the SKU at this location that are committed to open orders, event-day allocations, or transfer requests and are not available for new sales. Sourced from Shopify Plus committed inventory.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus — Committed Inventory; SAP S/4HANA MM — Reserved Stock

Supports unified omnichannel sales reporting, revenue attribution at SKU level, and PCI-DSS compliant payment data handling. Single source of truth for 'a sale happened' regardless of channel.

'partial' indicates some lines fulfilled and others pending. Drives warehouse operations, customer notifications, and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Fulfillment API; Internal Logistics SLA Standard

attributes.name: gift_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the merchandise order was designated as a gift by the purchaser. When true, triggers gift wrapping, suppresses price disclosure on packing slip, and enables gift receipt generation. Relevant for holiday and event-driven merchandise campaigns.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus; Internal Merchandise Operations Standard

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total pre-discount, pre-tax merchandise value of all line items in the order. Represents the sum of unit prices multiplied by quantities before any adjustments. Used as the base for revenue reporting and discount analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; PCI DSS; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device used to place the e-commerce order via Shopify Plus. Used for fraud detection, geographic analytics, and GDPR/CCPA compliance audit trails. Null for in-venue POS transactions. Classified as confidential per GDPR Article 4 as it may constitute personal data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; PCI DSS Requirement 10; Shopify Plus

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of fan loyalty program points awarded to the customer for this merchandise purchase. Used for loyalty program accrual accounting, fan engagement reporting, and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) / Lifetime Value (LTV) analytics.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; Internal Fan Loyalty Program Standard

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of fan loyalty program points redeemed against this order as a payment offset. Used for loyalty program liability accounting, fan engagement analytics, and Net Promoter Score (NPS) correlation analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; Internal Fan Loyalty Program Standard

attributes.name: net_total
attributes.description: Final amount charged to the customer: gross_amount minus discount_amount plus tax_amount plus shipping_amount. Represents the actual revenue collected for this order. Used as the primary revenue figure for financial reporting and reconciliation against payment records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; PCI DSS; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with the order, entered by the customer at checkout or by staff during order processing. May include gift messages, personalization requests, or customer service annotations. Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus; Internal Customer Service Standard

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world timestamp when the merchandise order was placed by the customer or captured at the Point of Sale (POS) terminal. Represents the business event time, distinct from system audit timestamps. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus; PCI DSS Requirement 10

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable order reference number surfaced to fans, retail staff, and wholesale partners. Sourced from Shopify Plus for e-commerce orders or the POS system for in-venue transactions. Used for customer service lookups and order tracking.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the merchandise order workflow. Drives fulfillment operations, customer communications, and revenue recognition. 'pending' = awaiting payment confirmation; 'confirmed' = payment captured; 'processing' = being picked/packed; 'fulfilled' = shipped or handed over; 'cancelled' = voided before fulfillment; 'refunded' = post-fulfillment reversal.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Order Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument type used to settle the merchandise order. Drives PCI DSS compliance scope determination and tender-type reporting. 'credit_card' and 'debit_card' are in-scope for PCI DSS. 'digital_wallet' includes Apple Pay, Google Pay. 'invoice' applies to wholesale B2B orders.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 3; Shopify Plus; Internal POS Standard

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Payment gateway transaction reference or authorization code for the order. For PCI DSS compliance, this stores only the tokenized or masked payment reference — never raw card numbers, CVV, or full PAN. Used for payment reconciliation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 3.4; Shopify Plus Payments; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current state of the payment transaction associated with this order. Distinct from order_status which tracks fulfillment lifecycle. Used for financial reconciliation, accounts receivable management, and PCI DSS audit trails.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 10; SAP S/4HANA FI; Shopify Plus

attributes.name: pos_terminal_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) terminal device that processed the in-venue transaction. Populated only for venue_pos channel orders. Used for reconciliation, audit trails, and PCI DSS compliance reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 9; Internal Venue Operations Standard

attributes.name: return_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order is eligible for return or exchange under the current merchandise return policy. May be false for event-day clearance items, personalized/customized merchandise, or items past the return window. Drives customer service and reverse logistics workflows.
attributes.references: Internal Merchandise Return Policy; Shopify Plus

attributes.name: return_window_expiry
attributes.description: The last date on which a return or exchange can be initiated for this order, calculated from the order date based on the applicable return policy. Used by customer service to validate return eligibility and by operations to manage reverse logistics SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Merchandise Return Policy; Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: shipping_amount
attributes.description: Shipping and handling charges applied to the order. Populated for e-commerce orders with physical delivery. Zero or null for in-venue POS transactions where goods are handed over at point of purchase.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: shipping_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the shipping destination for e-commerce orders (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN). Used for international shipping compliance, tax jurisdiction determination, and geographic sales reporting. Null for in-venue POS transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 44; Shopify Plus

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: The delivery method selected for the order (e.g., Standard Ground, Express 2-Day, Overnight, In-Store Pickup, Will Call). Populated for e-commerce orders. Null for in-venue POS transactions. Used for logistics planning and shipping cost analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard_ground|express_2day|overnight|in_store_pickup|will_call|international — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Shopify Plus; Internal Logistics Standard

attributes.name: shipping_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the shipping destination for e-commerce orders. Used for geographic sales analysis, regional fan merchandise demand mapping, and shipping carrier zone determination. Classified as confidential address data per GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Shopify Plus

attributes.name: source_order_reference
attributes.description: The native order identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Shopify Plus order ID, POS transaction ID, wholesale portal order number). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation, dispute resolution, and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus; Internal Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this merchandise order record. Enables data lineage tracking and system-of-record attribution in the lakehouse silver layer. 'shopify_plus' = Shopify Plus e-commerce platform; 'venue_pos' = in-venue POS system; 'wholesale_portal' = B2B wholesale ordering portal; 'manual' = manually entered order.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the merchandise order, including applicable sales tax, VAT, or GST based on the jurisdiction of the transaction. Required for financial reporting, tax remittance, and SAP S/4HANA FI tax reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Module; SOX; GDPR

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order is exempt from sales tax, typically applicable to wholesale B2B orders with a valid tax exemption certificate or reseller permit. Drives tax calculation logic and financial reporting for SAP S/4HANA FI tax reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Module; Internal Tax Compliance Policy

attributes.name: tax_exemption_ref
attributes.description: Tax exemption certificate number or reseller permit reference for tax-exempt orders. Populated only when tax_exempt_flag is true. Required for tax audit documentation and compliance with applicable sales tax regulations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Module; Internal Tax Compliance Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this merchandise order record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX IT Controls

products.name: order_line
products.description: Individual line item within a merchandise order representing a single SKU quantity purchased. Captures SKU reference, quantity ordered, unit price, line-level discount, line total, fulfillment status, and return eligibility. Supports revenue attribution at the product level and enables SKU-level sales performance tracking across channels.

attributes.name: event_fixture_id

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Order Reference; Event Domain

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sports or entertainment event associated with this merchandise purchase (e.g., a game-day jersey purchase linked to a specific fixture). Enables event-level merchandise revenue attribution and post-event sales analysis.

attributes.description: Reference to the active licensing agreement governing the intellectual property (IP) rights for the merchandise on this line. Required for royalty tracking, IP compliance, and licensor reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract; IP Licensing Governance

attributes.name: merch_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent merchandise order header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header-detail relationship for order processing and revenue attribution.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Order Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Order

attributes.name: price_list_id

attributes.name: sku_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) purchased on this line. Enables SKU-level sales performance tracking, inventory reconciliation, and product-level revenue attribution across channels.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Product Variant; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: sku_sku_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) purchased on this line. Enables SKU-level sales performance tracking, inventory reconciliation, and product-level revenue attribution across channels.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Product Variant; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: team_franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sports team or franchise whose branding, intellectual property (IP), or licensing rights are associated with the merchandise SKU on this line. Enables team-level revenue attribution and royalty calculation.

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the venue where this line item was purchased (applicable for venue Point of Sale (POS) transactions). Supports venue-level sales performance reporting and inventory management.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Inventory; SAP S/4HANA SD Plant

attributes.name: brand_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the merchandise SKU on this line has been verified as compliant with the applicable league or team brand standards and licensing requirements prior to sale. Supports IP protection and brand governance.
attributes.references: FIFA Brand Compliance; NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL Licensing Standards; IP Governance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this order line record was first created in the source system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for order processing SLA measurement and audit trail.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Created At; SAP S/4HANA SD Creation Date

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this line item are expressed (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Shopify Plus Presentment Currency

attributes.name: fulfillment_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment origin for this line item, distinguishing between central warehouse, venue retail store, third-party logistics (3PL) provider, or direct drop-ship from supplier. Supports omnichannel fulfillment analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping Point; Shopify Plus Fulfillment Service

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment state of this line item within the order lifecycle. Drives warehouse operations, customer notifications, and order completion tracking.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Fulfillment Status; SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Status

attributes.name: is_gift
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was purchased as a gift, triggering gift wrapping, gift receipt generation, and suppression of price information on packing slips.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Gift Options

attributes.name: is_personalized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item includes a personalization or customization (e.g., player name/number printing on a jersey). Personalized items typically have different return eligibility and production lead times.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Line Item Properties; SAP S/4HANA PP Production Order

attributes.name: is_return_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is eligible for return based on product type, licensing restrictions, event-specific merchandise policies, or return window expiry. Drives customer-facing return eligibility checks.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Return Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD Return Reason

attributes.name: line_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary discount applied to this specific line item, including promotional codes, loyalty discounts, and manual overrides. Expressed in the order currency.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Line Item Discount Allocations; SAP S/4HANA SD Discount Condition

attributes.name: line_discount_pct
attributes.description: Discount rate applied to this line item expressed as a percentage of the unit price multiplied by quantity. Supports promotional effectiveness analysis and margin impact reporting.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Discount Allocation; SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Rate

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this line item within the parent order, starting at 1. Used for ordering, display, and reconciliation of multi-line orders.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Order Line Position; SAP S/4HANA SD Item Number

attributes.name: line_subtotal
attributes.description: Pre-tax line total calculated as (unit_price × quantity_ordered) minus line_discount_amount. Represents the net merchandise value of this line before tax. Used for revenue attribution and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Line Item Pre-Tax Price; SAP S/4HANA SD Net Value

attributes.name: line_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on this line item, aggregating all applicable tax lines (e.g., state, local, VAT). Required for tax remittance reporting and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Line Item Tax Lines; SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Condition; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: line_total
attributes.description: Final total for this line item inclusive of tax and after all discounts (line_subtotal + line_tax_amount). Represents the amount the customer is charged for this specific line. Used for revenue reporting and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Line Item Total; SAP S/4HANA SD Total Value

attributes.name: personalization_detail
attributes.description: Free-text description of the personalization applied to this line item (e.g., 'Name: JOHNSON, Number: 23'). Populated only when is_personalized is true. Drives production instructions for customization fulfillment.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Line Item Properties

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Display name of the merchandise product at the time of purchase (e.g., 'Home Jersey 2024 – Size L'). Captured as a point-in-time snapshot to preserve historical accuracy independent of catalog changes.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Line Item Title

attributes.name: quantity_fulfilled
attributes.description: Number of units of this line item that have been physically picked, packed, and shipped or handed over to the customer. Enables partial fulfillment tracking and backorder identification.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Fulfillment Line Item Quantity

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU ordered on this line item. Used for inventory reservation, fulfillment picking, and sales volume reporting.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Line Item Quantity; SAP S/4HANA SD Order Quantity

attributes.name: quantity_returned
attributes.description: Number of units of this line item that have been returned by the customer. Supports return rate analysis, refund processing, and net revenue calculation at the SKU level.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Refund Line Item Quantity

attributes.name: requires_shipping
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item requires physical shipment to the customer, as opposed to in-venue pickup or digital delivery. Drives shipping cost allocation and logistics workflow routing.

attributes.name: return_status
attributes.description: Current status of any return or refund request associated with this line item. Supports returns management, refund authorization workflows, and customer service operations.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Refund Status; SAP S/4HANA SD Returns Order

attributes.name: return_window_expiry_date
attributes.description: The last date on which a return for this line item can be initiated, calculated from the fulfillment date based on the applicable return policy. Used to enforce return eligibility and automate policy expiry.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Return Policy; Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: royalty_amount
attributes.description: Calculated royalty obligation for this line item (line_subtotal × royalty_rate). Supports licensor payment processing, royalty accrual accounting, and IP rights holder reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Royalty Accrual; NIL Agreement; CBA

attributes.name: royalty_rate
attributes.description: Contractual royalty percentage applicable to this line item's net sales value, sourced from the associated licensing agreement. Used to calculate royalty obligations payable to licensors (leagues, athletes, IP holders).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Royalty Condition; NIL Agreement Terms; CBA

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The omnichannel sales channel through which this line item was transacted. Supports Direct-To-Consumer (DTC) vs. wholesale vs. venue Point of Sale (POS) revenue attribution and channel performance analytics.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Sales Channel; SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Human-readable alphanumeric Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code identifying the specific product variant (e.g., team, size, color) at the time of purchase. Denormalized for auditability and reporting without requiring a join to the product catalog.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Variant SKU; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Number

attributes.name: source_system_line_ref
attributes.description: The native line item identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Shopify Plus line item ID or SAP S/4HANA SD item number). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: Shopify Plus Line Item ID; SAP S/4HANA SD Item Number

attributes.name: tax_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is exempt from sales tax, applicable for wholesale transactions, reseller purchases, or tax-exempt organizations. Supports tax compliance and audit reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Exemption; SOX; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost of goods sold (COGS) per unit for this SKU at the time of order, sourced from the product catalog or inventory valuation. Used for gross margin analysis and profitability reporting at the line level.

attributes.name: unit_price

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary values on this goods receipt (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency operations across global merchandise markets.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_number

attributes.name: delivery_note_number

attributes.name: inspection_date

attributes.name: inspection_status

attributes.name: inventory_update_status

attributes.name: po_number

attributes.name: po_quantity

attributes.name: receipt_date

attributes.name: receipt_notes

attributes.name: receipt_number

attributes.name: receipt_status

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the goods receipt was recorded in the system. Used for intraday inventory tracking, shift-level reporting, and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: rejected_quantity

attributes.name: return_to_vendor_initiated

attributes.name: sku_code

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: promotion_sku_inclusion
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between sku_catalog and promotion. It captures the operational record of which specific SKUs are included in a promotional campaign and under what per-SKU terms. Each record links one SKU to one promotion and carries attributes — discount overrides, channel restrictions, and effective date windows — that exist only in the context of this specific SKU-promotion pairing and cannot be stored on either the SKU catalog or the promotion campaign alone.. Existence Justification: In sports merchandise retail, promotions are explicitly multi-SKU campaigns (e.g., 'all championship gear 30% off', 'BOGO on team jerseys') where a single promotion applies to many SKUs simultaneously, and a single SKU participates in multiple promotions across a season (e.g., a jersey SKU is included in a championship launch promo, a fan loyalty redemption promo, and an event-day discount promo). The current model stores applicable_sku_list as a denormalized STRING on the promotion record, which is a textbook normalization deficiency signaling an unmodeled M:N. The business actively manages which specific SKUs are included in each promotion, with per-SKU discount overrides, channel restrictions, and effective date windows that belong to the inclusion record itself — not to either the SKU catalog or the promotion campaign.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Promotion Sku Inclusion - Promotion Sku Inclusion Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the promotion_sku_inclusion association
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the promotional campaign that includes this SKU.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: sku_catalog_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Promotion Sku Inclusion - Sku Catalog Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific SKU in the merchandise catalog that is included in this promotion.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: applicable_discount_value
attributes.description: The effective discount value applied to this specific SKU within the promotion. May differ from the promotion-level discount_value when a per-SKU override is in effect. Interpreted according to the parent promotion's discount_value_type.
attributes.references: Sourced from detection phase relationship_data: applicable_discount_value

attributes.name: applicable_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) codes to which this promotion is restricted when applicable_scope is 'specific_skus'. Populated from the merchandise SKU catalog managed in Shopify Plus. Null when scope is broader than individual SKUs. [Moved from promotion: This comma-delimited STRING on promotion is a denormalized encoding of the M:N relationship between promotions and SKUs. Once the promotion_sku_inclusion association table exists, individual SKU inclusions are represented as rows in that table, making this field redundant and harmful to referential integrity. It should be removed from promotion and replaced by querying promotion_sku_inclusion.]
attributes.references: Shopify Plus - Entitled Product Variants; GS1 SKU Standards

attributes.name: channel_restriction_override
attributes.description: Per-SKU channel restriction that supersedes the promotion-level channel_restriction for this specific SKU inclusion. Specifies the sales channel(s) through which this SKU is eligible for the promotion (e.g., online_only, in_venue_only, all_channels). Null if the promotion-level channel_restriction applies without override.
attributes.references: Sourced from detection phase relationship_data: channel_restriction_override

attributes.name: inclusion_end_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU's eligibility within the promotion expires. May be equal to or earlier than the parent promotion's end_date, allowing early removal of specific SKUs from an active campaign.
attributes.references: Sourced from detection phase relationship_data: inclusion_end_date

attributes.name: inclusion_start_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU becomes eligible within the promotion window. May be equal to or later than the parent promotion's start_date, allowing phased SKU inclusion within a single campaign.
attributes.references: Sourced from detection phase relationship_data: inclusion_start_date

attributes.name: sku_specific_discount_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicable_discount_value on this inclusion record overrides the promotion-level discount. When true, the applicable_discount_value on this record takes precedence over the parent promotion's discount_value for this SKU.
attributes.references: Sourced from detection phase relationship_data: sku_specific_discount_override

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: merchandise_class

attributes.name: meta_description

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement

attributes.name: seo_keywords

domains.name: content
domains.description: Digital asset management domain owning video highlights, photography, social media assets, user-generated content (UGC), audio, and editorial content managed through Dalet Galaxy DAM. Manages content production workflows, metadata tagging, rights clearance (DRM), and CDN distribution for OTT, digital platforms, and social channels. SSOT for all content asset identity and rights metadata.

products.name: asset
products.description: Core master entity representing every digital content asset managed in Dalet Galaxy DAM — video highlights, photography, audio clips, editorial articles, social media assets, and UGC. SSOT for all content asset identity, format metadata, file specifications, ingest status, lifecycle state, and tag associations across OTT, broadcast, and digital platforms. Serves as the central node connecting rights, production, distribution, and analytics workflows.

attributes.name: asset_description

attributes.name: bitrate_kbps

attributes.name: broadcast_channel

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the asset record was first created in the DAM master catalogue. Distinct from ingest_timestamp which reflects the media file arrival; this reflects the metadata record creation event.

attributes.name: dam_asset_reference
attributes.description: Native asset identifier assigned by Dalet Galaxy DAM system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and direct lookup within the DAM platform.

attributes.name: drm_status
attributes.description: Current rights clearance status of the asset under the DRM framework. Controls whether the asset can be distributed via OTT, broadcast, or social channels. Cleared = fully rights-cleared for distribution; Embargoed = time-restricted; Expired = rights window has lapsed.

attributes.name: duration_seconds

attributes.name: file_format

attributes.name: file_name

attributes.name: file_size_bytes

attributes.name: frame_rate

attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM — Technical Metadata; SMPTE ST 12-1 Timecode Standard; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: ingest_source

attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM — Ingest Workflow; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: ingest_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the asset was first ingested into the Dalet Galaxy DAM system. Used for SLA tracking, content freshness reporting, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: is_live_clip

attributes.name: is_ppv_restricted

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: start_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DRM policy record was first created in the system. Populated automatically at record insertion. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 (Audit Trail); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: drm_system
attributes.description: The DRM technology system used to enforce license-based playback protection. 'Widevine' = Google/Android/Chrome; 'PlayReady' = Microsoft/Xbox; 'FairPlay' = Apple/iOS/tvOS; 'multi_drm' = simultaneous multi-system packaging for cross-platform OTT distribution.
attributes.references: W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); Google Widevine DRM Specification; Microsoft PlayReady Documentation; Apple FairPlay Streaming

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this DRM policy becomes active and can be applied to content packaging workflows. Aligns with the start of the underlying rights agreement period. Used by Dalet Galaxy DAM to determine applicable policies at content publish time.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM Policy Lifecycle Management; Rights Agreement Effective Date Standards

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this DRM policy expires and can no longer be applied to new content packages. Null for open-ended policies with no defined expiry. Triggers policy review workflows in Dalet Galaxy DAM when approaching expiry.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM Policy Lifecycle Management; Rights Agreement Expiry Standards

attributes.name: encryption_scheme
attributes.description: Cryptographic encryption standard applied to content packages under this DRM policy. 'CENC' (Common Encryption) and 'CBCS' are ISO 23001-7 standards used for multi-DRM packaging across Widevine, PlayReady, and FairPlay systems. Governs how content is encrypted at the CDN packaging layer.
attributes.references: ISO 23001-7 Common Encryption (CENC); W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); DRM Industry Forum (DRMIF)

attributes.name: geo_blocking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic access restrictions are enforced under this DRM policy. When True, the allowed_territory_codes and blocked_territory_codes fields define the geographic enforcement scope. Critical for RSN blackout rules, international broadcast rights, and FIFA/IOC territorial licensing.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; FIFA Territorial Licensing; IOC Broadcast Rights Framework; GDPR Article 44 (Cross-Border Data Transfers)

attributes.name: license_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Maximum duration in seconds for which a DRM license issued under this policy remains valid for playback. Controls license renewal frequency and session persistence. A value of 0 indicates a persistent license with no expiry. Critical for PPV and live event access control.
attributes.references: W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); Widevine License Server Specification

attributes.name: license_renewal_type
attributes.description: Defines the license persistence and renewal behavior for content playback under this DRM policy. 'persistent' = license stored on device across sessions; 'session' = license valid only for current playback session; 'renewable' = license auto-renews before expiry; 'non_renewable' = single-use license.
attributes.references: W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); Widevine License Server Specification; PlayReady License Chaining

attributes.name: max_resolution
attributes.description: Maximum video resolution permitted for playback under this DRM policy. 'SD' = Standard Definition (up to 480p); 'HD' = High Definition (720p); 'FHD' = Full HD (1080p); 'UHD_4K' = Ultra HD 4K (2160p); 'UHD_8K' = Ultra HD 8K. Enforces resolution caps based on subscription tier and device security level.
attributes.references: Widevine Security Level L1/L3 Resolution Caps; PlayReady Security Level Resolution Enforcement

attributes.name: offline_download_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DRM policy permits subscribers to download content for offline playback on authorized devices. When True, offline_download_expiry_hours governs the download window. Governed by rights agreements and CBA terms for league content.
attributes.references: W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); FairPlay Streaming Offline Playback; Widevine Offline License

attributes.name: offline_download_expiry_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours after which an offline downloaded content license expires and the content becomes unplayable without re-authentication. Null when offline_download_enabled is False. Enforces time-limited offline access per rights agreements.
attributes.references: W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); Widevine Offline License Specification

attributes.name: output_protection_level
attributes.description: Hardware output protection standard required on playback devices under this DRM policy. 'hdcp_1x' / 'hdcp_2x' = High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection for HDMI/DisplayPort; 'cgms_a' = Copy Generation Management System for analog outputs; 'macrovision' = legacy analog copy protection. Governs content security on connected TV and set-top box devices.
attributes.references: HDCP Specification (Digital Content Protection LLC); CGMS-A Standard; PlayReady Output Protection Levels

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the DRM policy, used in content packaging workflows, API calls, and CDN configuration references (e.g., DRM-OTT-LIVE-001). Sourced from Dalet Galaxy DAM policy registry.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM — Policy Registry; DRM Industry Forum (DRMIF) Policy Naming Standards

attributes.name: policy_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the business intent, scope, and enforcement rules of this DRM policy. Used by rights clearance teams, legal, and broadcast operations for governance documentation.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM — Policy Registry; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the DRM policy used by content operations teams and rights administrators (e.g., 'NFL Sunday Ticket OTT Premium', 'UFC PPV Geo-Restricted LATAM'). Displayed in Dalet Galaxy DAM and Adobe Experience Platform configuration UIs.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM — Policy Registry

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the DRM policy governing whether it can be applied to new content packages. 'draft' = under review; 'active' = in production use; 'suspended' = temporarily disabled; 'deprecated' = superseded by newer policy; 'archived' = retired from use.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM — Policy Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DRM policy by content delivery modality. 'live_stream' = real-time OTT streaming; 'vod' = video-on-demand; 'ppv' = Pay-Per-View (PPV) event; 'download' = offline download; 'broadcast' = linear broadcast; 'ugc' = User-Generated Content (UGC) protection.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; DRM Industry Forum (DRMIF); OTT Platform Standards

attributes.name: purchase_window_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours from license issuance within which the subscriber must initiate first playback before the license expires unused. Null for subscription-based policies. Enforces time-to-first-play restrictions on transactional DTC content purchases.
attributes.references: DRM Industry Forum (DRMIF) Transactional VOD Standards; DTC Platform Rights Terms

attributes.name: rental_window_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours from first playback initiation during which the content remains accessible under a rental or PPV license. Null for subscription-based or permanent access policies. Applies to PPV event replays and transactional VOD content.
attributes.references: DRM Industry Forum (DRMIF) Transactional VOD Standards; PPV Rights Agreement Terms

attributes.name: rights_clearance_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this DRM policy to the underlying rights clearance agreement or contract in the rights management system. Enables audit traceability between DRM enforcement rules and the legal rights instruments that authorize them. Confidential business data.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM Rights Management Module; IP Rights Clearance Standards; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: rights_owner
attributes.description: Name of the entity that holds the intellectual property (IP) and distribution rights governing this DRM policy (e.g., 'NFL Media', 'UFC/TKO Group', 'FIFA Media Rights'). Used for rights clearance audit trails and DRM policy attribution in Dalet Galaxy DAM.
attributes.references: IP Rights Management Standards; FIFA Media Rights Framework; NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL Broadcast Rights Agreements; CAS Arbitration Records

attributes.name: screen_capture_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether screen capture and screen recording are blocked on devices playing content under this DRM policy. Enforced via OS-level DRM APIs (e.g., Android FLAG_SECURE, iOS DRM restrictions). Critical for PPV and premium live event content protection.
attributes.references: Widevine Security Level Specification; Apple FairPlay Screen Recording Restrictions; DRM Industry Forum Anti-Piracy Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating system record for this DRM policy (e.g., Dalet Galaxy DAM policy object ID). Enables traceability from the Databricks Silver Layer back to the operational system of record for reconciliation and lineage purposes.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM — Policy Registry; Enterprise Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: subscriber_tier_restriction
attributes.description: Minimum subscription tier required to receive a DRM license under this policy. 'all' = no tier restriction; 'basic' = entry-level subscription; 'standard' = mid-tier; 'premium' = top-tier subscription; 'vip' = VIP/exclusive access; 'ppv_only' = Pay-Per-View (PPV) purchase required. Enforced at license issuance by the entitlement system.
attributes.references: OTT Subscription Tier Standards; DTC Platform Entitlement Management; PPV Rights Agreement Terms

attributes.name: token_expiry_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds for which a CDN signed URL token remains valid under this DRM policy. Null when cdn_token_auth_enabled is False. Short expiry windows (e.g., 300 seconds) reduce the risk of URL sharing for premium live events.
attributes.references: CDN Token Authentication Standards; Akamai EdgeAuth Token Specification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DRM policy record was last modified. Updated automatically on any field change. Used for change detection, incremental processing in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline, and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 (Audit Trail); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version number of this DRM policy definition (e.g., '1.0', '2.3.1'). Incremented when policy parameters are updated. Enables content packages to reference the specific policy version applied at packaging time for audit and compliance traceability.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM Version Control; SOX Financial Controls (Audit Trail Requirements)

attributes.name: watermark_type
attributes.description: Type of watermarking applied to content under this DRM policy. 'forensic' = invisible session-level watermark for piracy tracing; 'visible' = on-screen branding/logo overlay; 'session' = per-viewer session identifier embedded in stream; 'broadcast' = Nielsen/Kantar audience measurement watermark; 'none' = no watermarking applied.
attributes.references: DRMIF Watermarking Standards; Nielsen Watermarking; Nagra Forensic Watermarking Specification

attributes.name: watermarking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether forensic or visible watermarking is applied to content distributed under this DRM policy. Watermarking enables source tracing for piracy detection and leak attribution. Critical for PPV events, premium OTT content, and broadcast feeds.
attributes.references: DRMIF Watermarking Standards; Nagra Forensic Watermarking; Nielsen Watermarking (Broadcast Audience Measurement)
