attributes.name: generation_method
attributes.description: Method by which the transcript was produced. Human-generated transcripts are manually authored by professional captioners. ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) automated transcripts are machine-generated without human review. ASR human-reviewed transcripts are machine-generated then corrected by a human editor. Third-party vendor transcripts are sourced from external captioning service providers. Impacts accuracy score thresholds and ADA/FCC compliance eligibility.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 79; ADA Title III; WGBH DCMP Captioning Key

attributes.name: is_live_caption
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transcript was generated in real-time during a live broadcast or live streaming event (True) versus being produced post-production for a pre-recorded asset (False). Live captions have different FCC accuracy thresholds and are typically ASR-generated. Impacts compliance evaluation criteria.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 79; 21st Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA)

attributes.name: is_primary_track
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transcript is the designated primary text track for the associated content asset and language (True) or a supplementary/alternative track (False). Only one primary track per asset per language code should exist. Used by OTT packaging and broadcast playout systems to select the default caption track.
attributes.references: W3C WebVTT; SMPTE ST 2052; Dalet Galaxy DAM

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: BCP-47 language tag identifying the language of the transcript text (e.g., en-US, es-MX, fr-FR, pt-BR). Drives platform routing for multi-language OTT delivery and subtitle track selection on broadcast and social channels.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this transcript record was most recently modified. Updated on every write operation including status changes, accuracy score updates, compliance reviews, and version increments. Used for incremental lakehouse processing and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5(2); SOX; Dalet Galaxy DAM

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when the transcript was published and made available for CDN delivery and platform distribution. Marks the transition to published lifecycle status. Used for SLA tracking and distribution reporting.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM; ISO 8601

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the transcript record, used in Dalet Galaxy DAM workflows, vendor communications, and compliance reporting. Follows the pattern TRX-{alphanumeric}.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM; ADA Title III

attributes.name: sound_effects_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transcript includes non-speech audio cues and sound effect descriptions (e.g., [CROWD CHEERING], [WHISTLE BLOWS]) required for full ADA closed-caption compliance. Sound effect captioning is mandatory for broadcast closed captions under FCC Part 79.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 79; ADA Title III; WGBH DCMP Captioning Key

attributes.name: speaker_identification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transcript includes speaker identification labels (e.g., [ANNOUNCER], [ATHLETE NAME]) within the caption text. Speaker identification is a best-practice requirement under WGBH DCMP Captioning Key and enhances accessibility for deaf and hard-of-hearing audiences.
attributes.references: WGBH DCMP Captioning Key; ADA Title III; FCC 47 CFR Part 79

attributes.name: sport_discipline
attributes.description: Sport or entertainment discipline associated with the content asset for which this transcript was produced (e.g., NFL Football, NBA Basketball, UFC, FIFA Soccer, Concert, Esports). Used for metadata tagging, content routing, and analytics segmentation across the sports-entertainment portfolio. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nfl_football|nba_basketball|mlb_baseball|nhl_hockey|mls_soccer|ufc|tennis_atp|concert|esports|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: content.metadata_tag; FIFA; NFL; NBA; MLB; NHL; UFC

attributes.name: storage_uri
attributes.description: Cloud storage URI (e.g., s3://, abfss://) pointing to the transcript file in its native format (SRT, VTT, TTML, etc.) within the lakehouse storage layer. Used by CDN packaging workflows and OTT platform delivery pipelines to retrieve the text track file.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM; CDN Distribution Standards

attributes.name: sync_offset_ms
attributes.description: Timing offset in milliseconds applied to align the transcript text track with the audio/video stream. Positive values indicate the transcript leads the audio; negative values indicate it lags. Critical for broadcast-grade synchronization compliance and viewer experience quality on OTT and live streaming platforms.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 79; SMPTE ST 2052; W3C WebVTT

attributes.name: timecode_in
attributes.description: SMPTE timecode marking the start point of the transcript within the associated content asset, in HH:MM:SS;FF (drop-frame) or HH:MM:SS:FF (non-drop-frame) format. Used for precise synchronization with video editing systems, broadcast playout, and CDN packaging workflows in Dalet Galaxy.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 12-1; Dalet Galaxy DAM

attributes.name: timecode_out
attributes.description: SMPTE timecode marking the end point of the transcript within the associated content asset, in HH:MM:SS;FF (drop-frame) or HH:MM:SS:FF (non-drop-frame) format. Together with timecode_in, defines the exact temporal scope of the text track within the media asset.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 12-1; Dalet Galaxy DAM

attributes.name: transcript_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the transcript record within the content production and compliance pipeline. Controls eligibility for CDN distribution and OTT platform delivery. Approved and published statuses are required before distribution.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM; ADA Title III; FCC 47 CFR Part 79

attributes.name: transcript_type
attributes.description: Classification of the text track by its functional purpose. Closed captions include speaker identification and non-speech audio cues for deaf/hard-of-hearing audiences (ADA/FCC compliance). Subtitles are translation-only tracks. Full transcripts are verbatim text representations. Audio descriptions narrate visual content for visually impaired audiences. Forced narratives are mandatory subtitle overlays for foreign-language dialogue.
attributes.references: ADA Title III; FCC 47 CFR Part 79; WCAG 2.1 SC 1.2

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the transcript, incremented each time the transcript content is revised (e.g., accuracy corrections, format updates, compliance remediation). Version 1 is the initial submission. Enables version history tracking and rollback in Dalet Galaxy.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DAM; FCC 47 CFR Part 79

attributes.name: word_error_rate
attributes.description: Raw Word Error Rate (WER) metric expressed as a decimal proportion (0.0000–1.0000) calculated by comparing the transcript against a reference ground-truth text. Lower values indicate higher accuracy. Used by QC workflows to determine whether ASR output meets broadcast-grade quality standards before ADA/FCC compliance certification.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 79; NIST Speech Evaluation Standards

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on transcript (revised_transcript_id)

products.name: license
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between a digital content asset and an external vendor (broadcaster, OTT platform, RSN, or distributor). It captures the formal licensing agreement under which Sports Entertainment grants a vendor the right to use a specific asset within defined territorial, exclusivity, and temporal boundaries. Each record links one asset to one vendor and carries the financial, geographic, and rights-scope attributes that exist only in the context of that specific license grant — not on the asset master or the vendor master alone.. Existence Justification: In sports-entertainment rights management, a single digital content asset (e.g., an NFL highlight reel) is simultaneously licensed to multiple vendors — a broadcast partner, an OTT platform, and a regional sports network — each under distinct territorial, exclusivity, and financial terms. Conversely, a single vendor (e.g., ESPN) holds active licenses to thousands of assets across multiple sports disciplines. The business actively creates, negotiates, renews, and terminates these license agreements as a core rights-management process, and each agreement carries its own fee, territory scope, exclusivity flag, and validity window that cannot reside on either the asset or vendor record alone.

products.name: revenue_attribution
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between asset and revenue_stream. It captures the operational record of how a specific digital content asset is monetised under a specific revenue stream, including the geographic territory, distribution platform, monetisation window, and allocated revenue amount. Each record links one asset to one revenue_stream with attributes that exist only in the context of this rights-window attribution relationship, supporting rights valuation, royalty calculation, and segment P&L reporting.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, a single digital content asset (e.g., a broadcast highlight reel) genuinely generates revenue across multiple simultaneous streams — broadcast rights, OTT subscription, and PPV — while each revenue stream (e.g., 'Broadcast Rights') contains revenue attributable to many distinct assets. Finance actively manages this relationship for rights valuation, royalty calculation, and P&L attribution, making it an operationally managed entity, not a derived analytical correlation. The relationship carries its own data (territory, platform, window dates, allocated revenue amounts) that belongs to neither the asset nor the revenue stream alone.

products.name: channel_jurisdiction_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory Authorization contract between a platform_channel and a gaming_jurisdiction. It captures the per-channel, per-jurisdiction compliance record that governs whether and how a distribution platform channel is permitted to deliver wagering-related content within a specific gaming regulatory jurisdiction. Each record links one platform_channel to one gaming_jurisdiction and carries the authorization status, effective dates, and regulatory approval reference that exist only in the context of this specific channel-jurisdiction pairing.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, a streaming or broadcast platform channel (e.g., an OTT app or DTC streaming service) must obtain regulatory authorization to operate in each gaming jurisdiction where it distributes wagering-related content. A single platform channel operates across many jurisdictions (e.g., a national OTT app active in 15 licensed US states), and each jurisdiction governs multiple platform channels (e.g., New Jersey authorizes ESPN+, FanDuel TV, and a DTC app). The business actively manages this relationship as a named compliance process — tracking per-jurisdiction authorization status, effective dates, and regulatory approval references for each platform-channel/jurisdiction combination.

attributes.description: The contractually agreed percentage of gate revenue allocated to the visiting (away) franchise for this game, as defined in the league's revenue sharing agreement. Confidential financial term used by SAP S/4HANA (SD/FI modules) for revenue recognition and intercompany settlement.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS Revenue Sharing Agreements; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls; SAP S/4HANA SD/FI

attributes.name: international_broadcast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this game has international broadcast rights activated beyond the domestic market. Triggers GDPR-compliant geo-restriction logic for OTT/DTC streaming platforms and international media rights window management in Dalet Galaxy.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation); FCC Broadcast Regulation; FIFA, IOC International Broadcast Rights Standards

attributes.name: is_home_away_reversed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard home/away designation has been reversed for this game (e.g., a team plays a 'home' game at the opponent's venue due to facility unavailability or international series). Used for scheduling balance audits and CBA home game count compliance.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Home Game Provisions; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS Rules

attributes.name: is_neutral_site
attributes.description: Indicates whether the game is played at a neutral venue not affiliated with either franchise (e.g., Super Bowl, NBA Finals, FIFA World Cup Final, international series games). Affects home/away revenue allocation, venue selection logic, and scheduling balance calculations.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Neutral Site Game Policies

attributes.name: matchday_label
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the scheduling period as published by the league (e.g., 'Matchday 12', 'Week 7', 'Round of 16', 'Wild Card Weekend', 'Opening Day'). Used in fan-facing communications, broadcast graphics, and digital content distribution.
attributes.references: FIFA, MLS, NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL Official Schedule Publications

attributes.name: original_scheduled_date
attributes.description: The initially published league calendar date for this game before any postponement or rescheduling. Retained for audit trail, rescheduling impact analysis, and CBA transaction window compliance verification. Null if the game has never been rescheduled.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Compliance; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Governance

attributes.name: original_start_time
attributes.description: The initially published start timestamp for this game before any time change or rescheduling. Retained alongside original_scheduled_date for complete rescheduling audit trail and broadcast rights window compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; CBA Compliance Standards

attributes.name: postponement_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for a game postponement or cancellation. Required for league governance reporting, insurance claims, broadcast rights force majeure provisions, and ISO 20121 event sustainability documentation. Null when scheduling_status is 'confirmed'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weather|facility_issue|public_safety|broadcast_conflict|force_majeure|covid_protocol|labor_dispute|bereavement|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Force Majeure Provisions; OSHA

attributes.name: ppv_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this game is designated as a Pay-Per-View (PPV) broadcast event, requiring separate consumer purchase beyond standard subscription. Affects OTT/DTC revenue recognition, broadcast rights activation, and FCC PPV reporting requirements.
attributes.references: FCC (Federal Communications Commission) PPV Regulations; NFL, NBA, UFC, FIFA PPV Distribution Agreements

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when this schedule record was officially published by the league to external stakeholders (teams, broadcasters, ticketing partners, fans). Represents the business event time of schedule release, distinct from internal record creation.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Official Schedule Release Standards

attributes.name: round_number
attributes.description: The round or matchday number within the season or tournament phase (e.g., FIFA Matchday 12, MLB Series Game 3, NBA Playoff Round 2). Used for bracket progression, standings, and competition governance. Null for week-based league formats.
attributes.references: FIFA, MLS, MLB, NBA Playoff Competition Rules

attributes.name: salary_cap_window_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this game date falls within a salary cap compliance reporting window as defined by the applicable CBA. Used by league finance and compliance teams to trigger cap audit checkpoints aligned to the competitive calendar.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Salary Cap Provisions; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS Salary Cap Rules

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The official league-published calendar date on which the game is scheduled to be played (yyyy-MM-dd). Used as the primary planning date for event operations, venue staffing, and broadcast scheduling. Represents the current confirmed date (may differ from original_scheduled_date if rescheduled).
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Season Calendar Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The precise date and timestamp (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) at which the game is scheduled to begin, including timezone offset. Used for broadcast slot coordination, gate opening logistics, and fan notification via Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: scheduling_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the scheduled game. Drives downstream event operations, broadcast slot management, ticketing refund workflows (Ticketmaster/AXS), and standings calculation eligibility. Confirmed = league-approved and published; Postponed = delayed with new date TBD; Cancelled = permanently removed; Rescheduled = new date assigned; Pending = awaiting league confirmation; Suspended = mid-game stoppage requiring resumption.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Competition Governance Rules; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability

attributes.name: season_phase
attributes.description: The phase of the competitive season in which this game falls. Drives CBA transaction window rules (e.g., trade deadlines, roster eligibility), salary cap compliance windows, and broadcast rights tier activation.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Competition Rules

attributes.name: series_game_number
attributes.description: The sequential game number within a playoff or regular-season series between the same two franchises (e.g., Game 3 of 7 in an NBA Playoff series, Game 2 of 3 in an MLB series). Null for non-series single-game matchups.
attributes.references: NBA, MLB, NHL Playoff Series Rules; FIFA, MLS Competition Governance

attributes.name: series_game_total
attributes.description: The maximum number of games in the series to which this game belongs (e.g., best-of-7 = 7, best-of-5 = 5, two-game series = 2). Used alongside series_game_number for bracket progression logic and playoff scheduling management.
attributes.references: NBA, MLB, NHL Playoff Series Rules; FIFA, MLS Competition Governance

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this schedule record originated (e.g., TICKETMASTER, AXS, SAP_SD, ARCHTICS, LEAGUE_API). Required for data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD; Ticketmaster/AXS; Archtics

attributes.name: ticket_on_sale_date
attributes.description: The date on which tickets for this game become available for public purchase via Ticketmaster/AXS and DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) channels. Drives fan engagement campaign scheduling in Adobe Experience Platform and Salesforce CRM outreach workflows.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing Standards; PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the venue location where the game is played (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo'). Required for accurate broadcast scheduling, fan notification timing, and international rights window management.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; FCC Broadcast Scheduling Standards; FIFA International Match Standards

attributes.name: transaction_window_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this game falls within a CBA-defined transaction window (e.g., trade deadline, waiver period, roster freeze). Critical for league compliance officers to validate that no prohibited roster moves occurred in the window surrounding this game.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Transaction Window Rules; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS League Offices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when this schedule record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer, downstream broadcast and ticketing system synchronization, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; Databricks Lakehouse CDC Standards

attributes.name: var_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Video Assistant Referee (VAR) or equivalent video review technology (e.g., TMO in rugby, instant replay in NFL/NBA/MLB) is activated for this game. Drives broadcast production requirements (OB truck setup) and officiating crew composition.
attributes.references: FIFA VAR Protocol; NFL Instant Replay Rules; NBA Replay Center Standards; TMO (Television Match Official) Protocols

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Categorized weather condition at game time for outdoor or open-air venues. Used for operational planning, OSHA safety compliance, postponement risk assessment, and post-event reporting. 'Indoor' applies to fully enclosed venues regardless of external conditions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|snow|fog|extreme_heat|wind_advisory|indoor — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA Venue Safety Standards; ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management

attributes.name: week_number
attributes.description: The sequential week number within the season calendar (e.g., NFL Week 1 through Week 18). Used for standings calculations, bye week tracking, and scheduling balance analysis. Applicable primarily to weekly-format leagues (NFL, NHL, NBA). Null for round-based or matchday-based competitions.
attributes.references: NFL, NHL, NBA Scheduling Standards; CBA Scheduling Provisions

products.name: standing
products.description: Periodic snapshot of competitive standings for a franchise within a division, conference, and league for a given season. Tracks wins, losses, ties/draws, overtime losses, points (hockey/soccer), winning percentage, games behind leader, home/away/divisional/conference records, goal/run/point differential, current streak, last-10 record, strength of schedule, clinch/elimination status, and standings rank. Updated after each official game result. Drives playoff qualification logic and tiebreaker resolution.

attributes.name: standing_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a competitive standing snapshot record within the league data domain.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: conference_id
attributes.description: Reference to the conference (e.g., AFC, NFC, Eastern, Western) within which the franchise competes for this standing snapshot.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: division_id
attributes.description: Reference to the division within which the franchise competes and is ranked for this standing snapshot.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the team franchise whose competitive standing is captured in this record.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Reference to the professional league (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA) under whose governance this standing is recorded.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA

attributes.name: playoff_bracket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to league.playoff_bracket. Business justification: Standings determine playoff seeding and bracket placement. Adding playoff_bracket_id to standing links a franchise's standing snapshot to the playoff bracket it feeds into, enabling seed-to-bracket ma
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the competitive season (e.g., 2024-25 NBA season) for which this standing snapshot applies.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: away_losses
attributes.description: Total number of losses recorded in away (road) games as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: away_ties
attributes.description: Total number of ties or draws recorded in away (road) games. Applicable in MLS, FIFA, and NFL regular season formats.
attributes.references: MLS; FIFA; NFL League Office

attributes.name: away_wins
attributes.description: Total number of wins recorded in away (road) games as of the snapshot date. Used in tiebreaker resolution.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: clinch_indicator
attributes.description: Standard league clinch/elimination indicator code displayed in standings: x = clinched playoff berth, y = clinched division title, z = clinched best record in conference, e = eliminated from playoff contention, w = clinched best overall record, p = clinched home-field advantage. Null if no clinch or elimination status applies.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: conference_losses
attributes.description: Total number of losses recorded against conference opponents as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: conference_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of the franchise within its conference as of the snapshot date. Used for playoff seeding and wild card qualification.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: conference_wins
attributes.description: Total number of wins recorded against conference opponents as of the snapshot date. Used as a tiebreaker criterion in NFL, NBA, and NHL standings.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this standing snapshot record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 20121

attributes.name: current_streak_count
attributes.description: Number of consecutive games in the current streak of the same result type (wins, losses, or ties). Combined with current_streak_type to express the full streak.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: current_streak_type
attributes.description: Type of the franchise's current consecutive result streak: W (Win), L (Loss), T (Tie), or D (Draw). Combined with current_streak_count to express the full streak (e.g., W5 = five consecutive wins).
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: division_losses
attributes.description: Total number of losses recorded against divisional opponents as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: division_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of the franchise within its division as of the snapshot date. Rank 1 indicates the division leader. Used for playoff seeding and tiebreaker resolution.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: division_wins
attributes.description: Total number of wins recorded against divisional opponents as of the snapshot date. A primary tiebreaker criterion in NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL standings.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: elimination_number
attributes.description: Combined number of losses by the trailing team and wins by the leading competitor that would result in mathematical elimination from playoff contention. Null when already eliminated or clinched.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: games_behind
attributes.description: Number of games the franchise trails the division or conference leader in the standings. A value of 0.0 indicates the franchise is tied for or holds the lead. Calculated as ((leader_wins - team_wins) + (team_losses - leader_losses)) / 2.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NBA League Office; NFL League Office

attributes.name: games_played
attributes.description: Total number of official regular season or applicable competition games played by the franchise as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: home_losses
attributes.description: Total number of losses recorded in home venue games as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: home_ties
attributes.description: Total number of ties or draws recorded in home venue games. Applicable in MLS, FIFA, and NFL regular season formats.
attributes.references: MLS; FIFA; NFL League Office

attributes.name: home_wins
attributes.description: Total number of wins recorded in home venue games as of the snapshot date. Used in tiebreaker resolution and home-field advantage analysis.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: last10_losses
attributes.description: Number of losses in the franchise's most recent 10 official games. Combined with last10_wins to express the last-10 record (e.g., 7-3).
attributes.references: NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: last10_wins
attributes.description: Number of wins in the franchise's most recent 10 official games. Used as a recent form indicator in standings displays and playoff race analysis.
attributes.references: NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: league_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of the franchise across the entire league as of the snapshot date. Used for draft order determination and overall competitive positioning.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: losses
attributes.description: Total number of official games lost by the franchise in regulation, overtime, or shootout as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: magic_number
attributes.description: Combined number of wins by the leading team and losses by the closest competitor needed to clinch a division title or playoff berth. Null when not applicable or when already clinched/eliminated.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: overtime_losses
attributes.description: Total number of games lost in overtime or shootout. Used primarily in NHL standings where an overtime loss earns one point. Null or zero for leagues without overtime loss distinction.
attributes.references: NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: playoff_seed
attributes.description: Projected or confirmed playoff seeding position for the franchise based on current standings. Determines bracket placement, home-field advantage, and first-round matchups. Null if the franchise is eliminated or the playoff field is not yet determined.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: Total standings points accumulated by the franchise. Used in NHL (2 pts per win, 1 pt per OTL), MLS, and FIFA competition formats. Null for leagues using winning percentage as the primary ranking metric.
attributes.references: NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA

attributes.name: run_differential
attributes.description: Net difference between total runs/goals/points scored and total runs/goals/points allowed across all games. Positive values indicate the franchise scores more than it concedes. Used as a tiebreaker and competitive health indicator across MLB (runs), NHL/MLS/FIFA (goals), and NBA (points).
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA; NBA League Office

attributes.name: runs_allowed
attributes.description: Total runs (MLB), goals (NHL/MLS/FIFA), or points (NBA/NFL) allowed by the franchise across all applicable games as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA; NBA League Office; NFL League Office

attributes.name: runs_scored
attributes.description: Total runs (MLB), goals (NHL/MLS/FIFA), or points (NBA/NFL) scored by the franchise across all applicable games as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA; NBA League Office; NFL League Office

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this standings snapshot was captured, typically updated after each official game result is processed.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

attributes.name: standing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this standing record: active (season in progress), clinched (playoff berth secured), eliminated (mathematically eliminated from playoff contention), pending (awaiting game result), or final (season concluded).
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: standings_type
attributes.description: Classification of the standings context: regular season, postseason, preseason, tournament group stage, or playoff bracket. Determines which game results are included in the standing calculation.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; FIFA

attributes.name: strength_of_schedule
attributes.description: Composite metric representing the combined winning percentage of all opponents faced by the franchise as of the snapshot date. Used as a tiebreaker criterion in NFL standings and for playoff seeding analysis.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office

attributes.name: ties
attributes.description: Total number of official games ending in a tie or draw (applicable in MLS, FIFA, and NFL regular season). Null or zero for leagues that do not permit ties.
attributes.references: MLS; FIFA; NFL League Office

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this standing snapshot record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated after each official game result is processed and standings are recalculated.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 20121

attributes.name: wild_card_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of the franchise among wild card contenders within its conference or league. Null if the franchise has clinched a division title or is eliminated from wild card contention.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: win_pct
attributes.description: Winning percentage calculated as wins divided by games played (ties count as half a win in applicable leagues). Primary ranking metric in MLB and NBA standings.
attributes.references: MLB Commissioner's Office; NBA League Office; NFL League Office

attributes.name: wins
attributes.description: Total number of official games won by the franchise in regulation, overtime, or shootout as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: NFL League Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS

products.name: playoff_bracket
products.description: Defines the postseason bracket structure for a league season, including bracket format (single elimination, best-of-series), number of rounds, seeding methodology, bye rules, home-court/field advantage rules, and bracket position assignments per franchise. Tracks advancement status and series results through each round to championship.

attributes.name: playoff_bracket_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the playoff bracket record. Primary key for the playoff_bracket data product in the league domain.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: athlete_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the athlete awarded the Most Valuable Player (MVP) honor for the playoff bracket/championship series. Populated upon bracket completion. Drives NIL, sponsorship, and award management processes.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; NIL (Name Image and Likeness)

attributes.name: broadcast_rights_package_media_rights_deal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast and media rights package governing playoff coverage, including OTT, RSN, PPV, and DTC distribution rights for this bracket's games.
attributes.references: FCC (Federal Communications Commission); Dalet Galaxy; Internal Broadcast Rights Management

attributes.name: championship_venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pre-designated venue for the championship game or final series, applicable when neutral_site_final is true. Used for venue operations, ticketing, and broadcast planning.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS; Archtics; NFL Governance Office

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Reference to the professional league (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA) that owns and governs this playoff bracket.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; MLS; FIFA

attributes.name: media_rights_deal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast and media rights package governing playoff coverage, including OTT, RSN, PPV, and DTC distribution rights for this bracket's games.
attributes.references: FCC (Federal Communications Commission); Dalet Galaxy; Internal Broadcast Rights Management

attributes.name: mvp_athlete_athlete_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the athlete awarded the Most Valuable Player (MVP) honor for the playoff bracket/championship series. Populated upon bracket completion. Drives NIL, sponsorship, and award management processes.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; NIL (Name Image and Likeness)

attributes.name: primary_playoff_champion_franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the franchise that won the championship in this playoff bracket. Populated only upon bracket completion. Used for historical records, trophy management, and league governance reporting.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the league season for which this playoff bracket is defined. Links the bracket to the regular-season standings and schedule that determine seeding.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: ada_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all venues hosting games in this playoff bracket must meet ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) accessibility standards. Mandatory for all US-based professional league events.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); OSHA

attributes.name: bracket_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this playoff bracket within the league and season (e.g., 'NFL-2024-PLAYOFFS', 'NBA-2024-EAST'). Used in broadcast, ticketing, and fan-facing systems.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office

attributes.name: bracket_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the final championship game is scheduled or was completed. Used for season close-out, financial reporting, and broadcast rights expiry.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; SOX; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: bracket_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the playoff bracket (e.g., 'NFL 2024 AFC Playoffs', 'NBA 2024 Eastern Conference Bracket'). Used in fan-facing platforms, broadcast graphics, and reporting.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office

attributes.name: bracket_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for league administrators to record special circumstances, rule exceptions, force-majeure events, or governance decisions affecting this playoff bracket (e.g., COVID-19 bubble format, relocated games).
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; CAS

attributes.name: bracket_region
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational region label for the bracket (e.g., 'AFC', 'NFC', 'Eastern Conference', 'Western Conference', 'Americas', 'Europe'). Used for multi-region league structures and broadcast rights segmentation.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; FIFA; IOC

attributes.name: bracket_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the first playoff game in this bracket is scheduled to be played. Used for scheduling, ticketing, and broadcast rights activation.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; Ticketmaster/AXS

attributes.name: bracket_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the playoff bracket. 'draft' indicates the bracket is being configured; 'published' means seeding is finalized and publicly released; 'in_progress' means competition is underway; 'completed' means a champion has been crowned; 'cancelled' covers force-majeure scenarios.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport)

attributes.name: bracket_type
attributes.description: Format of the playoff bracket structure governing how teams advance. Determines match scheduling logic and advancement rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single_elimination|double_elimination|best_of_series|round_robin|seeded_bracket — promote to reference product if additional formats are needed]
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; FIFA

attributes.name: bye_rounds_count
attributes.description: Number of first-round byes awarded to top-seeded teams. A value of 0 indicates no byes are granted. Bye rules are defined in the league's CBA and playoff format documentation.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; CBA

attributes.name: championship_game_name
attributes.description: Official branded name of the final championship game or series in this bracket (e.g., 'Super Bowl', 'NBA Finals', 'Stanley Cup Finals', 'World Series'). Used in broadcast, sponsorship, and fan engagement contexts.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: conference_division_scope
attributes.description: Organizational scope of the bracket indicating whether it covers the full league, a single conference, a division, or a wild-card pool. Drives seeding and matchup logic.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; NHL Board of Governors

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this playoff bracket record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: current_round
attributes.description: The round number currently in progress within the bracket (1 = first round, incrementing through to the championship). Null if the bracket has not yet started or has been completed.
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; Internal Bracket Tracking

attributes.name: disciplinary_review_body
attributes.description: Name of the governing body or panel responsible for adjudicating disciplinary actions, appeals, and rule enforcement during this playoff bracket (e.g., 'NFL Commissioner's Office', 'NBA Basketball Operations', 'CAS').

attributes.name: draft_eligibility_rules

attributes.name: drug_testing_program

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: free_agency_eligibility_years

attributes.description: Minimum number of years of credited service a player must accumulate before becoming eligible for unrestricted free agency under this CBA. Core rule referenced by athlete.free_agency_status.
attributes.references: NFL CBA Article 9; NBA CBA Article XI; MLB CBA; NHL CBA Article 10; MLS CBA; NLRA

attributes.name: grievance_procedure_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the multi-step grievance and dispute resolution procedure established by the CBA, including filing deadlines, hearing steps, and final appeal mechanisms. Supports labor relations governance and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: international_player_provisions

attributes.name: lockout_provision

attributes.name: luxury_tax_rate
attributes.description: Dollar-for-dollar or multiplier rate applied to payroll exceeding the luxury tax threshold, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 150.00 for $1.50 per $1.00 over threshold). Governs financial penalties for cap overages.

attributes.name: luxury_tax_threshold_usd

attributes.name: matter_phase
attributes.description: The phase of the CBA lifecycle for which this outside counsel firm is engaged. A firm may be retained only for the arbitration phase of a CBA while a different firm handles the negotiation phase. Belongs to the engagement record, not to either master.

attributes.name: max_annual_salary_increase_pct

attributes.name: max_contract_years

attributes.name: minimum_player_salary_usd
attributes.description: Lowest annual salary that any player on an active roster may be paid under the CBA, expressed in US dollars. Varies by years of service; this field captures the base rookie minimum for the agreement period.

attributes.name: hard_cap_amount
attributes.description: The absolute maximum total player payroll permitted under the league's hard cap rule for the cap year. Franchises may not exceed this amount under any circumstance. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: luxury_tax_liability

attributes.name: broadcast_segment_id

attributes.name: draft_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent draft event to which this pick belongs (e.g., 2024 NFL Draft, 2024 NBA Draft). Links the pick to its governing draft event.

attributes.name: last_trade_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the most recent trade transaction record in which this pick was transferred. Enables full trade audit trail linkage.

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Reference to the professional league (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA, etc.) that governs this draft pick and its associated rules.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS/FIFA League Governance Standards

attributes.name: primary_draft_current_owner_franchise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the franchise that currently holds the rights to exercise this draft pick. May differ from the original owning franchise if the pick has been traded.

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the league season associated with this draft pick. Links the pick to the competitive season calendar for standings-based draft order determination.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Season Calendar; League Competition Governance

attributes.name: selected_athlete_athlete_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the athlete selected with this pick upon exercise. Null until the pick is exercised. Links to the athlete profile for post-draft roster and contract management.

attributes.name: cba_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current CBA compliance status of this draft pick record. 'compliant' = meets all CBA requirements; 'under_review' = pending league review; 'violation' = CBA rule breach identified; 'waived' = compliance requirement formally waived by league.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS CBA Compliance Framework; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: competitive_integrity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pick has been flagged for competitive integrity review by the league office (e.g., suspected tanking, collusion, or improper trade). Triggers compliance investigation workflow.

attributes.name: condition_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the conditions governing a conditional pick (e.g., 'Converts to 1st round if franchise wins division; otherwise 2nd round'). Populated only when is_conditional is true.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this draft pick record was first created in the system, including timezone offset. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 20121 Event Sustainability

attributes.name: draft_position_tier
attributes.description: Categorical tier classification of this pick's position within the draft (e.g., 'lottery' for NBA lottery picks, 'top_10', 'first_round', 'second_round', 'later_round'). Used for pick valuation segmentation and trade analysis.
attributes.references: NBA Draft Lottery Rules; NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Draft Tier Classification

attributes.name: draft_year
attributes.description: The calendar year of the draft event in which this pick is to be exercised. Critical for future pick tracking and multi-year trade asset management.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Office Draft Calendar

attributes.name: exercise_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pick was exercised (i.e., used to select an athlete during the draft event). Null until the pick is exercised.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Draft Day Procedures

attributes.name: exercise_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which this pick was exercised during the draft event, including timezone offset. Supports real-time draft broadcast and pick clock compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Draft Clock Rules; Broadcast Operations

attributes.name: external_ref
attributes.description: The externally-known identifier for this pick as published by the league office or official transaction systems (e.g., league transaction ID, official pick number code). Supports system-of-record reconciliation.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Official Transaction Records; League Office Systems

attributes.name: forfeiture_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason this pick was forfeited, if applicable (e.g., salary cap violation, tampering penalty, CBA non-compliance). Populated only when pick_status is 'forfeited'.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Disciplinary Rules; CBA Compliance; WADA (if PED-related)

attributes.name: forfeiture_ruling_date
attributes.description: The date on which the league office issued the ruling to forfeit this pick. Populated only when pick_status is 'forfeited'.

attributes.name: is_compensatory_pick
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pick was awarded as a compensatory pick by the league office (e.g., NFL compensatory picks for lost free agents). Compensatory picks are subject to special trade restrictions in some leagues.

attributes.name: is_conditional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pick is subject to conditions that may alter its round, year, or validity (e.g., 'becomes a 1st round pick if team makes playoffs'). When true, condition_description provides the governing terms.

attributes.name: is_lottery_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pick is eligible to be determined by a lottery mechanism (e.g., NBA Draft Lottery). Relevant for protected pick valuation and conditional pick resolution.

attributes.name: is_tradeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pick is currently eligible to be traded under league rules. Some picks (e.g., compensatory picks in certain leagues, picks under CBA restrictions) may be non-tradeable.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS CBA; Trade Eligibility Rules

attributes.name: last_trade_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pick was most recently traded to its current owning franchise. Null if the pick has never been traded.

attributes.name: pick_announcement_name
attributes.description: The official name announced for this pick during the draft broadcast (e.g., 'The Dallas Cowboys select...'). Used for broadcast production, content, and DAM (Digital Asset Management) workflows.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; Broadcast Production Standards

attributes.name: pick_clock_seconds_remaining
attributes.description: The number of seconds remaining on the pick clock when the pick was submitted. Used for draft broadcast analytics and compliance with league pick clock rules.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Draft Clock Rules

attributes.name: pick_number
attributes.description: The sequential overall pick number within the entire draft event (e.g., pick #1 through #259 in the NFL Draft). Used for pick valuation models and historical analysis.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Draft Order Rules

attributes.name: pick_source_league_rule
attributes.description: The specific league rule, CBA article, or governing provision under which this pick was created or awarded (e.g., 'CBA Article 5, Section 3 - Compensatory Pick Formula', 'Expansion Draft Rule 12'). Supports compliance and audit.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS CBA; League Constitution and Bylaws

attributes.name: pick_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the draft pick. 'available' = held and ready to use; 'traded' = transferred to another franchise; 'exercised' = used to select an athlete; 'forfeited' = surrendered as penalty; 'voided' = invalidated by league ruling.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Disciplinary and Draft Rules; CBA Compliance

attributes.name: pick_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pick by its origin type. 'standard' = regular draft order pick; 'compensatory' = awarded by league for free agent losses; 'supplemental' = mid-year supplemental draft; 'expansion' = awarded to expansion franchise; 'traded' = acquired via trade.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Draft Classification Rules; CBA

attributes.name: pick_valuation_score
attributes.description: Quantitative valuation score assigned to this pick based on the league's or franchise's draft pick value chart (e.g., NFL Jimmy Johnson Chart, Chase Stuart Chart). Used for trade analysis and asset management. Not a calculated aggregate — represents the chart-assigned value for this pick position.
attributes.references: NFL Draft Pick Value Chart; NBA Draft Pick Valuation Models; League Trade Analysis Standards

attributes.name: pick_within_round
attributes.description: The sequential pick number within the specific round (e.g., 3rd pick in Round 2). Combined with round_number provides the full pick address (e.g., Round 2, Pick 3).
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Draft Order Rules

attributes.name: protection_level
attributes.description: The top-N protection threshold for this pick (e.g., 3 = top-3 protected, meaning if the pick falls in the top 3 overall, it does not convey to the trading partner and rolls over). Null if unprotected.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Trade and Pick Protection Rules

attributes.name: protection_rollover_year_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of years a protected pick can roll over before it must convey regardless of protection status. Governs the expiry of pick protection in multi-year trade agreements.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Trade and Pick Protection Rules

attributes.name: round_number
attributes.description: The round within the draft event in which this pick falls (e.g., Round 1, Round 2, Round 7). Determines pick tier and associated contract slot values in CBA-governed leagues.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS CBA; Draft Round Structure Rules

attributes.name: salary_cap_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the salary cap slot value (e.g., USD for NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL, EUR for FIFA leagues). Supports multi-league and international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; CBA Financial Provisions

attributes.name: salary_cap_slot_value
attributes.description: The CBA-mandated salary cap slot value associated with this pick position, expressed in the league's designated currency. Governs the rookie contract value for the selected athlete. Critical for salary cap compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS CBA Rookie Salary Scale; Salary Cap Compliance Rules

attributes.name: trade_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this pick has been traded between franchises. Used for trade complexity analysis and pick valuation models.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Trade Reporting Rules

attributes.name: trade_history
attributes.description: Serialized summary of the full trade chain for this pick, recording each franchise that has held the pick in sequence (e.g., 'FranchiseA → FranchiseB → FranchiseC'). Supports trade analysis and pick provenance auditing.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Trade Reporting Rules; League Transaction Records

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this draft pick record was most recently modified, including timezone offset. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: roster_compliance_status
