attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Office Compliance Rules; CBA

attributes.name: roster_date
attributes.description: The official calendar date as of which this roster snapshot is certified and filed with the league. Represents the point-in-time for roster composition — distinct from submission timestamp.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Office Roster Filing Rules

attributes.name: roster_minimum
attributes.description: The minimum number of players required on the active roster as mandated by the league rules applicable to this filing. Stored at filing time to capture the rule in effect.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Roster Rules; CBA

attributes.name: roster_size_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of players permitted on the active roster as mandated by the league rules applicable to this filing. Stored at filing time to capture the rule in effect (e.g., NFL = 53, NBA = 15, MLB = 26).
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Roster Rules

attributes.name: salary_cap_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the franchise's total roster salary obligations as of the roster_date are within the league-mandated salary cap ceiling. True = compliant; False = cap violation identified.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA); Salary Cap Rules

attributes.name: salary_cap_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the salary cap figures reported in this roster filing (e.g., USD for NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL, EUR for UEFA clubs).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS/FIFA Financial Rules

attributes.name: salary_cap_space_remaining
attributes.description: The franchise's remaining salary cap space as of the roster_date, calculated as the league salary cap ceiling minus total committed salary obligations on this roster. Expressed in the league's operating currency. Confidential financial data.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA); Salary Cap Rules

attributes.name: season_phase
attributes.description: The phase of the competitive season during which this roster filing is effective. Different roster rules, size limits, and eligibility requirements apply depending on the season phase.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Roster Rules

attributes.name: sport_type
attributes.description: The sport discipline for which this roster filing applies. Determines applicable roster rules, CBA provisions, and compliance frameworks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: football|basketball|baseball|hockey|soccer|tennis|mma|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS/FIFA/IOC Governing Body Standards

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) at which the franchise submitted this roster filing to the league office. Used for deadline compliance verification and audit trail.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Office Roster Filing Rules; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: suspended_player_count
attributes.description: Number of players on this roster filing who are currently serving a league-imposed suspension (disciplinary, PED, or conduct-related) as of the roster_date. Suspended players may still count against the roster and salary cap.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Disciplinary Rules; WADA Code

attributes.name: taxi_squad_count
attributes.description: Number of players on the taxi squad (NHL-specific developmental roster designation) as of the roster_date. Taxi squad players are not on the active roster but travel with the team. Null for non-applicable leagues.
attributes.references: NHL Board of Governors Roster Rules; NHL Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA)

attributes.name: total_roster_count
attributes.description: Total number of players under any roster designation (active + IR + practice squad + two-way + reserve + taxi squad) as of the roster_date. Represents the full organizational depth of the franchise's player pool.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Roster Rules

attributes.name: transaction_trigger
attributes.description: The business event that triggered this roster filing submission. Identifies the type of roster transaction that necessitated a new official filing with the league office. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trade|free_agent_signing|waiver_claim|draft|injury|suspension|contract_termination|elevation|option_exercise|retirement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS League Transaction Rules

attributes.name: two_way_contract_count
attributes.description: Number of players under two-way contracts as of the roster_date. Two-way contracts allow players to move between the NBA and G League (or equivalent developmental league) without occupying a full roster spot. Null for non-applicable leagues.
attributes.references: NBA Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA); NBA Two-Way Contract Rules

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this roster_filing record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental load detection, change data capture, and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: wada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all players on this roster filing have met World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) testing and clearance requirements as of the roster_date. Relevant for international competitions and leagues subject to WADA oversight.
attributes.references: World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) Code; CAS Arbitration Standards

products.name: transaction_window
products.description: Defines official league transaction periods (trade deadline, free agency window, waiver period, DFA window, international signing period) with open/close dates, eligible transaction types, franchise participation rules, and penalty provisions for violations. Anchors all roster movement and trade activity to authorized periods. Supports compliance validation for league_trade_transaction and waiver_claim records.

attributes.name: transaction_window_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the league transaction window record. Primary key for the transaction_window data product in the league domain.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: cba_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) that authorizes and governs the rules of this transaction window, including eligible transaction types and penalty provisions.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; NFL CBA; NBA CBA; MLB CBA; NHL CBA; MLS CBA

attributes.name: cba_cba_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) that authorizes and governs the rules of this transaction window, including eligible transaction types and penalty provisions.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; NFL CBA; NBA CBA; MLB CBA; NHL CBA; MLS CBA

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Reference to the league that owns and governs this transaction window. Determines which league's rules and CBA provisions apply.
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA Governance Rules

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the league season during which this transaction window is active. Anchors the window to a specific competitive year and salary cap period.
attributes.references: League Season Calendar; CBA Agreement

attributes.name: announcement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the league officially announced this transaction window to franchises and the public. Establishes the notice period for franchise preparation.
attributes.references: League Operations Manual; CBA Agreement

attributes.name: approval_turnaround_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which the league office must approve or reject a transaction submitted during this window. Defines the Service Level Agreement (SLA) for transaction processing.
attributes.references: League Operations Manual; SLA Standards

attributes.name: cap_year
attributes.description: The salary cap year (four-digit year) applicable to transactions executed within this window. Determines which cap year's limits and exceptions apply for compliance validation.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; NFL CBA; NBA CBA; NHL CPA

attributes.name: cba_article_reference
attributes.description: Specific article, section, or clause of the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) that authorizes and governs this transaction window (e.g., 'Article VI, Section 4'). Supports compliance audit and legal review.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; NFL CBA; NBA CBA; MLB CBA; NHL CPA; MLS CBA

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: The official calendar date on which the transaction window closes and no further transactions may be submitted. Null for open-ended windows such as certain waiver periods.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Operations Manual; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS Governance

attributes.name: close_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) at which the transaction window officially closes. Critical for trade deadline compliance — transactions submitted after this timestamp are invalid.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Operations Manual

attributes.name: competitive_integrity_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions executed during this window are subject to a competitive integrity review by the league office to prevent collusion, tanking, or other violations of fair competition standards.
attributes.references: League Competitive Integrity Policy; CBA Agreement; CAS Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transaction window record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary limits and penalty amounts defined within this transaction window (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: eligible_transaction_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transaction types authorized during this window (e.g., 'trade,waiver_claim,free_agent_signing,dfa,option_exercise'). Defines the scope of permissible roster movements for compliance validation of league_trade_transaction and waiver_claim records.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Operations Manual

attributes.name: franchise_participation_scope
attributes.description: Defines which franchises are eligible to participate in this transaction window. 'all_franchises' applies league-wide; other values restrict participation to a subset of franchises.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Operations Manual

attributes.name: governing_body_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary governing body that oversees and enforces the rules of this transaction window (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA, IOC). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NFL|NBA|MLB|NHL|MLS|FIFA|IOC|UFC|ATP|OTHER — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA, IOC Governance

attributes.name: international_transfer_rules_apply
attributes.description: Indicates whether FIFA Transfer Regulations or equivalent international governing body transfer rules apply to transactions within this window. Relevant for MLS, international soccer, and cross-border athlete movements.
attributes.references: FIFA Transfer Regulations; IOC Rules; CBA Agreement

attributes.name: is_free_agency_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether free agent signings are permitted during this transaction window. Governs whether franchises may negotiate and execute contracts with unrestricted or restricted free agents.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; NFL CBA; NBA CBA; MLB CBA

attributes.name: is_international_signing_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether international player signings are authorized during this window. Relevant for MLB International Signing Period, FIFA transfer windows, and MLS international roster slots.
attributes.references: MLB International Signing Rules; FIFA Transfer Regulations; MLS Roster Rules

attributes.name: is_trade_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether player-for-player or player-for-pick trades are permitted during this transaction window. False for windows restricted to free agency or waiver activity only.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; NFL CBA Article 6; NBA CBA Article VII

attributes.name: is_waiver_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether waiver claims and waiver wire transactions are permitted during this transaction window. Determines whether waiver_claim records may be anchored to this window.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; MLB Rules; NFL CBA

attributes.name: league_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions executed during this window require explicit league office approval before becoming effective. When true, transactions remain pending until the league approves.
attributes.references: League Operations Manual; CBA Agreement

attributes.name: max_cash_consideration_usd
attributes.description: Maximum cash consideration in US dollars permitted in a single transaction during this window, as governed by CBA provisions. Null if no cash limit applies. Used for compliance validation of league_trade_transaction records.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; NFL CBA Article 6; NBA CBA Article VII

attributes.name: max_transactions_per_franchise
attributes.description: Maximum number of transactions a single franchise may execute during this window, as defined by league rules or CBA provisions. Null indicates no per-franchise limit.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Operations Manual

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: The official calendar date on which the transaction window opens and franchises may begin submitting eligible transactions. Established by the league calendar and CBA provisions.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Operations Manual; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS Governance

attributes.name: open_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) at which the transaction window officially opens. Used for compliance validation of transaction submission timestamps, particularly for trade deadline enforcement.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Operations Manual

attributes.name: penalty_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the penalty provisions applicable to violations of this transaction window, including fine schedules, draft pick forfeiture rules, and suspension terms as defined in the CBA or league governance documents.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Operations Manual

attributes.name: penalty_draft_pick_loss
attributes.description: Indicates whether violation of this transaction window's rules may result in forfeiture of draft picks as a disciplinary penalty, per CBA or league governance provisions.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Disciplinary Rules

attributes.name: penalty_fine_amount
attributes.description: Monetary fine amount imposed on a franchise for executing a transaction outside the authorized window or in violation of window rules. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Disciplinary Rules; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS Governance

attributes.name: penalty_suspension_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether franchise personnel (e.g., general managers, coaches) may be suspended for violations of this transaction window's rules.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Disciplinary Rules

attributes.name: physical_exam_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical physical examination of the athlete is required before a transaction executed during this window becomes effective. Common for trade transactions involving player health risk.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; NFL CBA; NBA CBA

attributes.name: roster_freeze_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether a roster freeze is in effect during this transaction window, prohibiting certain roster moves. Common during playoff periods or immediately preceding the trade deadline.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Operations Manual

attributes.name: salary_cap_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether salary cap compliance checks are required for transactions executed during this window. When true, all transactions must be validated against the franchise's cap space before league approval.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; NFL CBA; NBA CBA; NHL CPA

attributes.name: season_phase
attributes.description: The phase of the competitive season during which this transaction window is active. Determines applicable roster rules, salary cap treatment, and CBA provisions for transactions executed within the window.
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; League Season Calendar

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this transaction window record originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce CRM, league operations platform). Supports data lineage and Silver layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: sport_type
attributes.description: The sport discipline to which this transaction window applies. Determines sport-specific CBA rules, roster size limits, and eligible transaction types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: football|basketball|baseball|hockey|soccer|tennis|mma|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA, IOC Governance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this transaction window record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and downstream incremental processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: wada_clearance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) Clearance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) clearance is required for athletes involved in transactions during this window. Applicable for international transfers and leagues with mandatory anti-doping compliance.
attributes.references: WADA Code; CAS Arbitration Rules; CBA Agreement

attributes.name: window_name
attributes.description: Official human-readable name of the transaction window as published by the league (e.g., 'NFL Trade Deadline 2024', 'NBA Free Agency Window 2024-25', 'MLB International Signing Period 2024').
attributes.references: League Operations Manual; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS Governance

attributes.name: window_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for league operations staff to record supplementary information about this transaction window, including special conditions, amendments, or exceptions not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: window_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned by the league office to uniquely identify this transaction window for official communications, compliance filings, and franchise notifications.
attributes.references: League Operations Manual; NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS Governance

attributes.name: window_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transaction window. 'scheduled' = announced but not yet open; 'open' = active and accepting transactions; 'closed' = period has ended; 'suspended' = temporarily halted by league order; 'cancelled' = voided before opening.
attributes.references: League Operations Manual; CBA Agreement

attributes.name: window_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transaction window by its primary business purpose. Determines which roster movement and trade activity types are authorized. DFA = Designated for Assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trade_deadline|free_agency|waiver_period|dfa_window|international_signing|supplemental_draft — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: CBA Agreement; MLB Rules; NFL CBA Article 6; NBA CBA Article VII

attributes.name: extended_transaction_window_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on transaction_window (extended_transaction_window_id)

products.name: international_federation
products.description: Master record for international sports governing bodies and their hierarchical structure — FIFA, IOC, World Athletics, ICC — capturing federation name, jurisdiction level (global/continental/national), parent federation reference, member associations, and governance authority scope.

attributes.name: international_federation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the international sports governing body record within the Sports Entertainment lakehouse. Primary key for the international_federation master entity.
attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management; IOC Governance Framework

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: International federations are separate legal entities requiring their own company codes for intercompany settlement, consolidated financial reporting, and statutory compliance. The league's financial
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: corporate_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to legal.corporate_entity. Business justification: International federations (FIFA, FIBA) are corporate entities. Legal compliance, IP ownership negotiations, broadcast rights agreements, and anti-doping governance require linking the federation to it
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: governing_body_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.governing_body. Business justification: International federations (FIFA, FIBA, WADA) are governing bodies in the compliance sense, with enforcement authority, anti-doping programs, and regulatory obligations. Linking international_federatio
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: parent_federation_international_federation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent international federation in the governance hierarchy (e.g., a continental confederation's parent is the global federation such as FIFA). Null for apex governing bodies with no parent.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes Article 20; IOC Charter Rule 28

attributes.name: acronym
attributes.description: Widely recognized abbreviation or acronym for the federation used in broadcast, media, and fan-facing communications (e.g., FIFA, IOC, FIBA, ICC, WA, UFC, ATP, WTA).
attributes.references: IOC Governance Framework; FIFA Statutes

attributes.name: anti_doping_program
attributes.description: Name or description of the federation's anti-doping testing and enforcement program (e.g., FIFA Anti-Doping Regulations, IOC Anti-Doping Rules, USADA partnership). Captures the specific program framework governing PED testing for athletes under this federation.
attributes.references: WADA Code; FIFA Anti-Doping Regulations; IOC Anti-Doping Rules

attributes.name: broadcast_rights_model
attributes.description: Model governing how broadcast and media rights are sold and distributed for competitions under this federation. Centralized means the federation sells rights collectively; decentralized means clubs/teams sell individually; hybrid is a combination. Drives revenue sharing and OTT/DTC platform strategy.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; FIFA Media Rights Regulations; IOC Broadcast Guidelines; DRM Policy

attributes.name: cas_arbitration_accepted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) Arbitration Accepted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this federation accepts the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) as the final arbitration authority for disputes, appeals, and disciplinary rulings. Required for IOC-recognized federations and FIFA member associations.
attributes.references: CAS Code of Sports-related Arbitration; IOC Charter Rule 61; FIFA Statutes Article 58

attributes.name: competition_cycle_years
attributes.description: Frequency in years at which the federation's primary championship competition is held (e.g., 4 for FIFA World Cup and Olympic Games, 2 for UEFA European Championship, 1 for annual leagues). Drives broadcast rights deal structuring and revenue planning.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes; IOC Charter; Workday Adaptive Planning FP&A

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Official organizational contact email address for the federation's administrative or media relations office. Used for regulatory correspondence, broadcast rights negotiations, and partnership communications. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM; FIFA Statutes

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Official organizational telephone number for the federation's headquarters or administrative office. Used for regulatory correspondence and partnership communications. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM; FIFA Statutes

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this international federation master record was first created in the Sports Entertainment lakehouse Silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR data processing record requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; SOX Section 404; ISO 20121; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: federation_code
attributes.description: Externally-known short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the federation across systems and partner integrations (e.g., FIFA, IOC, FIBA, ICC, WA). Used as the business key in cross-system references and broadcast rights agreements.
attributes.references: IOC Governance Framework; FIFA Statutes; ISO 3166

attributes.name: federation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the international federation record. Active indicates full governance authority; suspended indicates temporary loss of rights (e.g., due to government interference per FIFA Statutes Article 14); dissolved indicates permanent cessation; provisional indicates conditional membership; observer indicates non-voting participation.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes Article 14; IOC Charter Rule 28; CAS Arbitration Standards

attributes.name: federation_type
attributes.description: Organizational classification of the federation entity distinguishing governing bodies (FIFA, IOC), confederations (UEFA, CONCACAF), national associations, unions (e.g., rugby unions), committees (Olympic committees), and councils.
attributes.references: IOC Charter; FIFA Statutes; CAS Governance Standards

attributes.name: financial_fair_play_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this federation enforces Financial Fair Play (FFP) or financial sustainability regulations requiring clubs/franchises to balance revenues against expenditures. Applicable primarily to UEFA and FIFA-affiliated competitions.
attributes.references: UEFA Financial Fair Play Regulations; FIFA Club Licensing Regulations; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: founding_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the international federation was formally established or constituted. Used for historical analysis, governance tenure reporting, and federation profile displays.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes; IOC Charter; Historical Governance Records

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this federation's operations are subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) due to processing personal data of EU-based athletes, fans, or staff. Drives data handling, consent management, and breach notification obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; GDPR Article 4; EU Data Protection Board Guidelines

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic region or continent under the federation's jurisdiction (e.g., Europe for UEFA, North/Central America and Caribbean for CONCACAF, Global for FIFA/IOC). Used for broadcast rights territory mapping and regulatory compliance routing.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes Article 20; IOC Charter; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: governance_authority_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of the federation's governance mandate and authority scope, including rule-making powers, competition sanctioning authority, disciplinary jurisdiction, anti-doping oversight, and IP rights management. Captures the breadth of regulatory control.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes; IOC Charter; CAS Arbitration Standards; WADA Code

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the federation's principal administrative headquarters is located (e.g., Zurich for FIFA, Lausanne for IOC, New York for NBA League Office). Used for regulatory jurisdiction, tax treaty, and operational contact purposes.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes; IOC Charter; OSHA Venue Safety Standards

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the nation where the federation's principal headquarters is domiciled (e.g., CHE for Switzerland/FIFA, USA for NFL). Drives applicable regulatory frameworks including GDPR, CCPA, and SOX reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; SOX

attributes.name: ioc_recognized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this international federation holds official recognition from the International Olympic Committee (IOC), which is required for inclusion in the Olympic Games programme and access to IOC funding and governance frameworks.
attributes.references: IOC Charter Rule 25; IOC Recognition Criteria

attributes.name: ip_ownership_policy
attributes.description: Summary of the federation's Intellectual Property (IP) ownership policy covering trademarks, logos, competition names, broadcast footage, and Digital Rights Management (DRM) frameworks. Governs licensing agreements with broadcasters, sponsors, and merchandise partners.
attributes.references: FIFA IP Regulations; IOC Charter Rule 7; DRM Standards; SEC IP Disclosure

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical governance scope of the federation indicating whether it operates at a global (e.g., FIFA, IOC), continental (e.g., UEFA, CONCACAF), regional, national, or sub-national level. Drives hierarchy traversal and authority scope determination.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes Article 20; IOC Charter Rule 28; CAS Arbitration Standards

attributes.name: member_association_count
attributes.description: Total number of member associations, national federations, or affiliated bodies currently recognized under this federation's governance authority. For FIFA this is 211 member associations. Used for governance scope reporting and voting rights calculations.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes Article 10; IOC Charter Rule 28

attributes.name: membership_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this federation's membership or recognition status became effective within the Sports Entertainment governance hierarchy. Marks the start of the federation's active governance relationship for compliance and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes Article 10; IOC Charter Rule 28; CAS Arbitration Standards

attributes.name: next_congress_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date of the federation's next congress, general assembly, or governing body meeting where rule changes, elections, and major governance decisions are made. Used for event planning, broadcast scheduling, and stakeholder communications.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes Article 25; IOC Charter Rule 16; ISO 20121

attributes.name: nil_policy_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Name Image and Likeness (NIL) Policy Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this federation has adopted or is subject to Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) rights policies governing athletes' ability to commercialize their personal brand. Particularly relevant for NCAA-affiliated and amateur sports federations.
attributes.references: NIL Legislation; NCAA NIL Policy; CBA NIL Rights Provisions

attributes.name: official_languages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639-1 language codes for all official languages recognized by the federation for governance, rulebooks, and official communications (e.g., 'en,fr,es,de,ar,ru' for FIFA). Supports multilingual content distribution and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; FIFA Statutes Article 1; IOC Charter Rule 23

attributes.name: official_name
attributes.description: Full legal and official name of the international sports governing body as registered with the relevant national or international authority (e.g., Fédération Internationale de Football Association, International Olympic Committee).
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes Article 1; IOC Charter Rule 15; CAS Arbitration Standards

attributes.name: official_website_url
attributes.description: Official public-facing website URL for the international federation, used for fan engagement, media relations, and regulatory reference (e.g., https://www.fifa.com, https://olympics.com). Sourced from Salesforce CRM federation profile.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Federation Profile; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: primary_competition
attributes.description: Name of the flagship competition or championship event sanctioned and governed by this federation (e.g., FIFA World Cup, Olympic Games, ICC Cricket World Cup, ATP Finals, UEFA Champions League). Central to broadcast rights and sponsorship valuation.
attributes.references: FIFA Statutes; IOC Charter; FCC Broadcast Regulation; PCI-DSS Ticketing

attributes.name: primary_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-2 language code for the federation's primary official working language (e.g., en for English, fr for French, es for Spanish). Drives localization of broadcast content, official communications, and fan engagement platforms.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ISO 639-2; FIFA Statutes Article 1; IOC Charter

attributes.name: recognition_body
attributes.description: Name of the apex authority that officially recognizes this federation's governance legitimacy (e.g., IOC recognition for Olympic sports federations, FIFA recognition for continental confederations). Critical for determining competition sanctioning validity.
attributes.references: IOC Charter Rule 25; FIFA Statutes Article 20; CAS Arbitration Standards

attributes.name: salary_cap_policy
attributes.description: Federation-level salary cap framework applicable to member leagues and clubs under this federation's governance. products.name: partnership
products.description: This association product represents the official contracted Partnership between a league and a vendor. It captures the operational record of each league-vendor partnership agreement including designation category, exclusivity scope, financial terms, and partnership lifecycle dates. Each record links one league to one vendor and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this specific partnership relationship — not on the league or vendor master records alone.. Existence Justification: In professional sports entertainment, leagues actively manage official partnerships with vendors — the NFL has an official ball supplier (Wilson), an official timing partner (Daktronics), and an official apparel partner (Nike), while Nike simultaneously holds official partnerships with the NFL, NBA, and MLB. This is a genuine operational M:N relationship where the business creates, manages, and terminates partnership agreements that carry their own financial terms, exclusivity scopes, and official designation categories. The relationship is not derivable from transactional data — it is a first-class business contract that procurement and league operations teams actively govern.

The business explicitly tracks per-franchise-stream allocation percentages, revenue sharing rates, and effective date ranges — this is an operationally managed financial allocation record, not a derived analytical correlation. products.name: crew_member_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Role-based assignment between an individual official and an officiating crew for a specific game. It captures the full crew roster composition that the league officiating bureau actively manages — including each official's designated role, conflict-of-interest clearance status, individual performance evaluation, and substitution events. Each record links one official to one officiating crew with attributes that exist only in the context of this per-game, per-role assignment. Supports officiating quality management, CBA compliance, conflict-of-interest screening, and workload tracking at the individual official level.. Existence Justification: In professional sports, officiating crew composition is a genuine operational M:N relationship: each officiating crew is assembled from a pool of certified officials (a crew may have 5–8 officials), and each official works across many different crew assignments throughout a season. The league actively manages crew_member_assignment as a business concept — assigning specific roles (crew chief, referee, linesman, VAR operator), tracking conflict-of-interest clearance per assignment, and evaluating individual performance per game. The current officiating_crew product only captures crew_chief_official_id and var_operator_official_id as named FKs, which cannot represent the full crew roster and leaves all other officials untracked.

products.description: This association product represents the Contract between a franchise and a digital touchpoint governing the official distribution of that franchise's content and brand on a specific fan-facing digital channel. It captures the authorized rights tier, exclusivity terms, touchpoint role, and effective period for each franchise-channel pairing. Each record links one franchise to one digital touchpoint with attributes that exist only in the context of this distribution rights arrangement — managed by digital rights and DTC operations teams.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment DTC operations, a franchise (e.g., LA Lakers) is officially distributed across multiple digital touchpoints (team app, league OTT platform, web portal, venue kiosk), and each digital touchpoint hosts multiple franchises. This is not an analytical correlation — it is an actively managed distribution rights arrangement where the business must track which franchises are authorized on which channels, under what content rights tier, with what exclusivity terms, and for what effective period. Business stakeholders in digital distribution and rights management explicitly manage these pairings as 'franchise distribution agreements' or 'channel distribution rights.'

products.name: regulatory_oversight
products.description: This association product represents the formal regulatory oversight relationship (Contract/Registration) between a franchise and a governing body. It captures the specific compliance obligations, registration standing, and jurisdictional scope that apply to each franchise-governing body pairing. Each record documents one governing body's authority over one franchise, including the type of oversight exercised, the franchise's registration or membership identifier with that body, current compliance status, and the effective dates of the oversight relationship. This is the system of record for franchise-level regulatory compliance tracking.. Existence Justification: A franchise is simultaneously subject to oversight from multiple governing bodies — the league office (NFL/NBA/etc.), anti-doping authorities (WADA), broadcast regulators (FCC), labor/safety bodies (OSHA/ADA), and potentially state athletic commissions — all at the same time. Conversely, each governing body (e.g., WADA, OSHA) oversees many franchises across the league. This is an active, operationally managed compliance relationship: franchises must register with each body, maintain compliance status per body, and track jurisdiction-specific obligations — none of which can be captured by a single FK on either entity.

products.name: streaming_rights_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between season and digital_touchpoint. It captures the formal authorization granting a specific digital touchpoint the right to distribute content from a specific league season under defined broadcast rights terms, geographic scope, and validity window. Each record links one season to one digital_touchpoint with attributes that exist only in the context of this rights grant — including the rights tier, streaming type, geo-restriction scope, and effective dates. This is the system of record for digital broadcast rights compliance across all fan-facing channels.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, broadcast rights are actively managed contracts that authorize specific digital touchpoints (OTT app, mobile app, web portal) to stream content from specific seasons under defined rights tiers, geo-restrictions, and time windows. A single season's content is distributed across multiple authorized digital channels simultaneously, and each digital touchpoint carries content from multiple seasons (live current season plus archived past seasons). This relationship — a broadcast rights authorization — is a core compliance and rights management operation that the business actively creates, updates, and audits.

products.description: General ledger account master record defining a specific financial classification node within the enterprise chart of accounts. Each GL account represents a unique posting target (e.g., ticket revenue, broadcast rights income, venue operating expense, player salary, naming rights deferred revenue). Stores account number, description, account type (P&L vs balance sheet), currency, tax category, reconciliation account flag, cost element category, account group, and posting block status. SSOT for all account classification, financial statement line mapping, and cost element definitions across all Sports Entertainment legal entities in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the GL account master record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for all downstream joins and lineage tracking. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: GL accounts in SAP FI are defined within a specific company code's chart of accounts. The company_code string field is a denormalized reference that should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: account_changed_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Last Changed By User
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this GL account master record (SKA1.AEDTM user). Required for SOX audit trail, segregation of duties compliance, and internal audit reviews. Supports detection of unauthorized changes to chart of accounts master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: account_changed_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Last Changed Date
attributes.description: Date on which this GL account master record was last modified (SKA1.LAEDA). Used for change management tracking, SOX compliance, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer. Triggers downstream reprocessing of dependent financial reporting datasets when account attributes change.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_created_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Created By User
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created this GL account master record (SKA1.ERNAM). Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties (SoD) compliance. Enables identification of unauthorized account creation and supports internal audit reviews of chart of accounts governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: account_created_date
attributes.description: Date on which this GL account master record was first created in the chart of accounts (SKA1.ERDAT). Used for audit trail, SOX compliance documentation, and chart of accounts change management reporting. Supports identification of accounts created outside of standard change control processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404; ISO 20121

attributes.name: account_group_code
attributes.description: SAP account group (SKA1.KTOKS) that controls the number range and field selection for the GL account. Groups accounts by business function, e.g., revenue accounts, expense accounts, balance sheet accounts. Determines which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during account maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: account_long_name
attributes.description: Extended descriptive name of the GL account (SKAT.TXT50) providing full business context. Used in detailed financial disclosures, audit documentation, and SEC reporting narratives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKAT; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the GL account as maintained in SAP S/4HANA (SKAT.TXT20). Used on financial reports, trial balances, and chart of accounts listings. Examples: 'Ticket Revenue', 'Broadcast Rights Income', 'Player Salary Expense', 'Naming Rights Deferred Revenue'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKAT; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known, human-readable GL account number as defined in the SAP S/4HANA chart of accounts (SKA1.SAKNR). Uniquely identifies the posting target within a chart of accounts. Used on all journal entries, financial statements, and cost element assignments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account master record. 'active' accounts accept postings; 'blocked' accounts are temporarily prevented from receiving new journal entries; 'marked_for_deletion' accounts are pending archival after period-end close. Controls posting eligibility across all Sports Entertainment legal entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1/SKB1; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Fundamental financial classification of the GL account indicating its role in the financial statements (SKA1.KTOKS mapped to account type). 'asset' and 'liability' and 'equity' are balance sheet accounts; 'revenue' and 'expense' are profit and loss (P&L) accounts. Drives financial statement line assignment and period-end closing behavior.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Alternative account number used for country-specific or group reporting chart of accounts mapping (SKA1.ALTKT). Enables mapping between the operational chart of accounts and a group consolidation chart of accounts or statutory reporting chart of accounts for international league entities operating under different GAAP/IFRS frameworks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; IFRS IAS 1; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: balance_sheet_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a balance sheet account (True) or a profit and loss (P&L) income statement account (False) (SKA1.XBILK). Balance sheet accounts carry forward balances at year-end; P&L accounts are closed to retained earnings. Fundamental for period-end close processing and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP chart of accounts key (SKA1.KTOPL) to which this GL account belongs. Sports Entertainment may maintain multiple charts of accounts for different legal entity frameworks (e.g., US GAAP vs IFRS for international leagues). Determines the account structure and financial statement mapping.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; IFRS IAS 1; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: commitment_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether commitment management (purchase order commitments and funds reservations) is active for this GL account. When True, purchase orders and contracts posted against this account create budget commitments visible in FP&A reporting. Relevant for player contract commitments, venue capital expenditure, and broadcast production cost commitments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Four-character SAP Controlling area code to which this GL account's cost element is assigned (SKA1 CO integration). The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost and revenue accounting is performed. Enables cross-company-code cost allocation, internal order settlement, and EBITDA reporting across Sports Entertainment's multi-entity structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: cost_center_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cost center assignment is mandatory when posting to this GL account. When True, all journal entries must include a valid cost center (e.g., venue operations cost center, broadcast production cost center, athlete management cost center). Enforces cost allocation discipline for EBITDA reporting and FP&A variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Defines the cost element category in SAP Controlling (CO) module when this GL account is also a primary cost element (SKA1.KATYP). 'primary' cost elements correspond directly to P&L GL accounts (e.g., player salary expense, venue operating cost, broadcast production cost); 'secondary' cost elements are used for internal allocations and settlements between cost centers; 'none' for balance sheet accounts not used in CO. Critical for EBITDA reporting and cost center allocation in FP&A.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; GAAP ASC 420; EBITDA reporting standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the account currency in which balances are maintained (SKB1.WAERS). Sports Entertainment operates across global markets with revenues in USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, and other currencies. Accounts may be maintained in local currency, group currency (USD), or hard currency. Drives foreign currency revaluation and translation for consolidated SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 830; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: deletion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account has been flagged for deletion from the chart of accounts (SKA1.XLOEV). Accounts flagged for deletion cannot receive new postings and are scheduled for archival after all dependent records are cleared. Supports chart of accounts rationalization and SOX control compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: SAP field status group code assigned to the GL account that controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during document entry (SKB1.FSTAG). Ensures data completeness for postings — for example, cost center is required on expense accounts, profit center on revenue accounts, and business area on intercompany settlement accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: financial_statement_item
attributes.description: The financial statement version item code to which this GL account is assigned for external reporting (SKA1.BILKT). Maps the account to a specific line on the income statement, balance sheet, or cash flow statement as required for SEC 10-K/10-Q filings and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SEC Regulation S-X; GAAP ASC 205; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Business functional area to which this GL account is assigned for segment and functional reporting (SKA1.FUNC_AREA). Enables profit and loss reporting by business function such as event operations, broadcast, athlete management, venue operations, merchandise, sponsorship, and corporate. Supports SEC segment reporting requirements under GAAP ASC 280.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP ASC 280; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: house_bank_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a house bank account used for cash management and bank reconciliation (SKB1.XINTB). When True, the account is linked to a physical bank account for automated bank statement processing, cash pooling, and treasury operations. Relevant for Sports Entertainment's multi-entity cash management across leagues and venues.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; GAAP ASC 230; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: intercompany_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is designated for intercompany transactions between Sports Entertainment legal entities (e.g., between the league holding company, individual team entities, broadcast subsidiaries, and venue operating companies). When True, intercompany partner must be specified on postings for automated elimination in consolidated financial statements. Required for SOX-compliant intercompany reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP ASC 810; IFRS IAS 27; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: interest_calculation
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic interest calculation is activated for this GL account (SKB1.XINTB for interest indicator). Relevant for intercompany loan accounts, deferred revenue accounts (naming rights, multi-year broadcast deals), and overdue receivable accounts where interest accrual is contractually required.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; GAAP ASC 835; IFRS IAS 39

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items are stored and displayable for this GL account (SKB1.XKRES). When True, each posting line is retained for drill-down reporting and audit trail purposes. Required for SOX-compliant audit trails on revenue accounts (ticket revenue, broadcast rights income, sponsorship fees) and significant expense accounts (player salaries, venue operating costs).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether open item management is activated for this GL account (SKB1.XOPVW). When True, individual line items remain open until explicitly cleared against an offsetting entry (e.g., deferred revenue accounts for naming rights, advance ticket deposits, broadcast rights prepayments). Enables aging analysis and outstanding item tracking for FP&A.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IFRS 15

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: Planning level code that controls how this GL account participates in financial planning and budgeting processes in SAP CO and Workday Adaptive Planning integration. Determines the granularity at which budget vs. actual variance analysis is performed — account level, cost center level, or profit center level. Supports FP&A EBITDA budgeting and ARR tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; Workday Adaptive Planning; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: posting_block
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether postings to this GL account are currently blocked at the chart of accounts level (SKA1.XSPEA). When True, no journal entries can be posted to this account regardless of company code settings. Used during account restructuring, period-end close, or SOX control enforcement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: profit_center_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a profit center assignment is mandatory when posting to this GL account. When True, all postings must include a valid profit center enabling segment-level profitability reporting (e.g., by league, by venue, by broadcast network). Supports SEC segment reporting under GAAP ASC 280 and internal EBITDA reporting by business unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA; GAAP ASC 280; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account serves as a reconciliation account for a subledger and, if so, which subledger type (SKA1.MITKZ). 'customer' reconciliation accounts aggregate accounts receivable subledger balances (e.g., fan ticket receivables, sponsor invoices); 'vendor' for accounts payable (e.g., venue contractor payables); 'asset' for fixed asset subledger (e.g., stadium infrastructure); 'none' for non-reconciliation accounts. Direct postings to reconciliation accounts are blocked.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS IAS 39

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_category
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue recognition pattern applicable to this GL account under GAAP ASC 606 / IFRS 15. 'point_in_time' for single-event revenues (e.g., individual ticket sales, PPV events, merchandise sales); 'over_time' for performance obligations satisfied over a period (e.g., season ticket packages, multi-year broadcast rights, naming rights); 'deferred' for advance payments not yet earned (e.g., prepaid sponsorship fees, advance broadcast rights payments); 'not_applicable' for non-revenue accounts. Critical for SEC revenue disclosure and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SEC SAB 104; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Three-digit sort key code that determines the assignment field populated in the allocation field of line items posted to this account (SKB1.ZUAWA). Controls how line items are sorted and grouped in account displays and reports. Common sort keys include posting date, document number, and external document reference for reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this GL account master record was extracted (e.g., 'SAP_S4HANA_PROD', 'SAP_S4HANA_EU'). Supports multi-instance SAP landscapes where Sports Entertainment operates separate SAP systems for different regions or leagues. Enables data lineage tracking and conflict resolution in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: sports_revenue_stream
attributes.description: Sports Entertainment-specific revenue stream classification for this GL account, enabling industry-specific financial analytics and KPI reporting. Examples: 'ticket_revenue', 'broadcast_rights_income', 'naming_rights_revenue', 'sponsorship_fees', 'merchandise_licensing', 'ppv_revenue', 'concession_revenue', 'player_transfer_fee', 'nil_licensing_income', 'venue_rental'. Used for EBITDA decomposition, ARR tracking, and league financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ticket_revenue|broadcast_rights_income|naming_rights_revenue|sponsorship_fees|merchandise_licensing|ppv_revenue|concession_revenue|player_transfer_fee|nil_licensing_income|venue_rental — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NBA/NFL/MLB/NHL/MLS League Financial Reporting Standards; GAAP ASC 606; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax category assigned to the GL account controlling tax code entry behavior during posting (SKB1.MWSKZ). Determines whether tax codes are required, optional, or not allowed on journal entries to this account. Relevant for VAT/GST on international broadcast rights, ticket sales tax, merchandise sales tax, and venue concession tax compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; IRS Publication 15; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: tax_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is subject to tax reporting and requires a tax code on postings (SKB1.XMWNO negated). When True, postings must include a valid tax code for VAT, sales tax, or withholding tax compliance. Critical for international broadcast rights distribution, PPV revenue, and merchandise sales across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; IRS; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: Tolerance group code assigned to the GL account that defines acceptable variance thresholds for payment differences, rounding, and clearing (SKB1.ZUAWA tolerance reference). Controls automatic clearing of small differences on high-volume accounts such as ticket revenue clearing, merchandise POS settlement, and concession cash accounts. Supports SOX-compliant payment processing controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1; SOX Section 404; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Valid From Date
attributes.description: Date from which this GL account is valid and available for posting. Supports time-dependent account activation for new business lines (e.g., a new OTT streaming revenue account activated at the start of a new broadcast deal, or a new NIL licensing income account activated upon regulatory approval). Enables historical accuracy in financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Valid To Date
attributes.description: Date until which this GL account is valid for posting. Null indicates the account has no planned expiry. Used to retire accounts associated with discontinued business lines (e.g., a closed venue, an expired broadcast rights agreement, a divested team entity) while preserving historical posting data for audit and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 205; SOX Section 404

products.name: cost_center
products.description: SAP CO cost center master representing an organizational unit responsible for incurring costs — e.g., venue operations, broadcast production, athlete performance, league administration, merchandise fulfillment. Tracks cost center hierarchy, responsible manager, controlling area, validity period, and budget allocation. SSOT for cost accountability across all Sports Entertainment business units.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cost center record in the Sports Entertainment lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key generated by the platform.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Cost centers in SAP CO belong to a specific company code (legal entity). The company_code string field is a denormalized reference that should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.company_code_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager accountable for cost center budget adherence and operational performance. Maps to the SAP CO 'Person Responsible' field and is used for budget approval workflows and variance escalation in Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM; SOX Section 302 — Management Certification

attributes.name: primary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager accountable for cost center budget adherence and operational performance. Maps to the SAP CO 'Person Responsible' field and is used for budget approval workflows and variance escalation in Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM; SOX Section 302 — Management Certification

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Cost centers are assigned to profit centers in SAP CO for segment reporting. The profit_center_code string field is a denormalized reference that should be replaced with a typed FK to profit_center.pr
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_jurisdiction. Business justification: Cost centers have a tax jurisdiction for withholding tax and local tax compliance (especially relevant for sports venues across multiple jurisdictions). The tax_jurisdiction_code string field should b
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical venue or facility primarily associated with this cost center, where applicable (e.g., a venue operations cost center linked to a specific arena). Enables venue-level cost analysis and facility management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; Sports Entertainment Venue Master Data

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: Primary SAP CO activity type associated with this cost center, representing the unit of output or service provided (e.g., 'BROADCAST_HR' for broadcast production hours, 'VENUE_DAY' for venue operating days). Used for activity-based cost allocation and internal service pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-ACT; Activity-Based Costing

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate or settle costs from this cost center to other cost objects at period end: direct (direct activity allocation), assessment (using assessment cycles), distribution (using distribution cycles), activity_based (ABC costing), or statistical (for reporting only, no actual settlement).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; IFRS 2; Activity-Based Costing Standards

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved annual budget allocated to this cost center for the current fiscal year, expressed in the cost center's primary currency. Sourced from Workday Adaptive Planning and loaded into SAP CO for variance reporting. Used in EBITDA forecasting and FP&A dashboards.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: business_domain
attributes.description: Sports Entertainment business domain that this cost center primarily supports. Enables cross-domain EBITDA analysis and cost attribution across the enterprise (e.g., 'venue' for arena operations, 'broadcast' for OTT/RSN production costs). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: venue|broadcast|athlete|league|sponsorship|merchandise|ticketing|fan_engagement|content|finance|workforce|compliance|digital_platform — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Enterprise Data Model; SAP S/4HANA CO-OM

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Sports Entertainment business unit or division that owns this cost center (e.g., 'NFL Operations', 'OTT Streaming', 'Venue Management', 'Athlete Performance'). Used for segment-level EBITDA reporting and ARR tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS 8; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area to which this cost center belongs. The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed and cross-company cost allocations are managed (e.g., 'SE01' for Sports Entertainment North America).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS 8 — Operating Segments

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Single-character or two-character SAP CO cost center category code that controls which activity types and statistical key figures can be posted (e.g., 'A' = general, 'B' = production, 'F' = financial). Determines default allocation rules and reporting groupings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the cost center within the controlling area, as defined in SAP CO. This is the externally-known business identifier used in journal entries, purchase orders, and budget allocations (e.g., 'VEN-OPS-001', 'BCAST-PROD-02').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the cost center's business purpose, scope of operations, and cost accountability. Provides context for financial analysts, auditors, and FP&A teams beyond what the name and code convey (e.g., 'Responsible for all operational costs of the home venue including HVAC, BMS, security, and event-day staffing').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404 — Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost center as maintained in SAP CO master data (e.g., 'Venue Operations — Staples Center', 'Broadcast Production — NFL Sunday Package'). Used in financial reports, budget dashboards, and FP&A outputs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center in SAP CO: active (accepting postings), inactive (temporarily suspended), locked (blocked for all postings), pending_activation (created but not yet effective), or archived (historical, no postings allowed). Drives period-end close controls and SOX compliance checks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center category classifying the nature of cost incurrence: overhead (administrative/support), production (direct event/broadcast output), service (shared services), profit (revenue-generating unit tracked as cost center), or investment (capital project support). Drives allocation methodology and EBITDA reporting treatment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; IFRS 8; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: SAP CO cost element group defining the set of primary cost elements (GL accounts) that can be posted to this cost center. Controls which expense categories are tracked here (e.g., 'VENUE_OPEX' for venue operating expenses, 'TALENT_COSTS' for athlete/performer costs).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SAP FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary country where this cost center operates. Used for statutory reporting, VAT/tax jurisdiction assignment, and GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 44; CCPA; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center master record was first created in SAP CO. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance documentation, and data lineage tracking in the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary transaction currency for this cost center (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Drives currency translation in SAP FI/CO and multi-currency EBITDA consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department code associated with this cost center, aligned to the SAP SuccessFactors organizational hierarchy. Enables workforce cost attribution and headcount-to-cost analysis across Sports Entertainment business units.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM; SAP S/4HANA CO-OM

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which the budget amount and planning data for this cost center applies (e.g., 2024, 2025). Aligns with the Sports Entertainment fiscal calendar defined in SAP FI company code settings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 404; SEC Annual Report (Form 10-K)

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO functional area classifying the cost center by business function for cost-of-sales accounting and segment reporting (e.g., 'ADMIN', 'SALES', 'PROD', 'R&D'). Required for SEC income statement presentation under US GAAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; US GAAP ASC 220; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market where this cost center primarily operates (e.g., 'North America', 'EMEA', 'APAC'). Supports regional cost allocation, transfer pricing compliance, and multi-market EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS 8 — Operating Segments; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: gl_account_group
attributes.description: SAP FI GL account group associated with this cost center, defining the range of general ledger accounts used for cost postings. Ensures chart-of-accounts alignment and supports automated financial statement mapping for SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; US GAAP; IFRS; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this cost center within the standard cost center hierarchy (e.g., 1 = enterprise, 2 = division, 3 = department, 4 = operational unit). Used for rollup reporting in Workday Adaptive Planning and SAP CO standard hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Standard Hierarchy; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center participates in intercompany cost settlements between Sports Entertainment legal entities (True = intercompany). Triggers intercompany elimination entries in consolidated financial statements and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Intercompany; IFRS 10 — Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent change to this cost center master record in SAP CO. Supports change detection for incremental lakehouse loads, SOX audit trails, and master data governance reviews.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: plan_lock

attributes.name: posting_lock
