attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which the subscriber or partner is invoiced for this recurring revenue stream. Used to normalize MRR and ARR calculations and to align cash flow forecasting in Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 606; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: churn_amount
attributes.description: The ARR value lost during the reporting period due to cancellations, non-renewals, or contract terminations for this revenue stream. A key metric in investor churn disclosures and subscription health reporting. Expressed as a positive value representing lost ARR.
attributes.references: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: churn_reason_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the primary reason for ARR churn when a subscriber or partner cancels or does not renew. Populated only when churn_amount > 0. Drives churn root-cause analysis and retention strategy reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: churned_subscriber_count
attributes.description: The number of subscribers or partners who cancelled or did not renew during the reporting period. Used to compute gross churn rate and validate churn_amount figures in investor disclosures.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled expiration date of the underlying commercial agreement. Nullable for open-ended or auto-renewing agreements. Used for renewal pipeline forecasting and ARR at-risk analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Workday Adaptive Planning; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known contract or agreement number from the source system of record (SAP S/4HANA SD or Salesforce CRM) that uniquely identifies the commercial agreement generating this ARR entry. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the underlying commercial agreement generating this recurring revenue. Used to determine contract tenure, cohort analysis, and ARR vintage reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the underlying commercial agreement contributing to this ARR entry. Drives inclusion/exclusion logic in ARR calculations and investor disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: contract_term_years
attributes.description: The total duration of the underlying commercial agreement in years (e.g., 1.0, 2.5, 5.0). Used for ARR normalization on multi-year deals and for weighted average contract length (WACL) reporting in investor materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; FASB ASC 606; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: contracted_arr_amount
attributes.description: The total ARR value as explicitly stated in the signed commercial contract, before any adjustments for churn, expansion, or discounts. Used as the baseline for variance analysis against recognized ARR and for multi-year deal tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: contraction_amount
attributes.description: The ARR reduction during the reporting period due to downgrades, seat reductions, or renegotiated contract terms for existing subscribers or partners, without full cancellation. Distinct from churn_amount which represents full cancellations.
attributes.references: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ARR tracker record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX Section 302/404 and data lineage tracking for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; ISO 20121

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this ARR record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency ARR reporting for global markets including international broadcast rights and overseas sponsorship deals.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this ARR entry was sourced (e.g., SAP S/4HANA for broadcast rights, Salesforce CRM for sponsorship contracts, Adobe Experience Platform for OTT subscriptions). Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The total contractual discount applied to the recurring revenue for this period, reducing the billed amount from the list price. Used in revenue quality analysis and margin reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The commercial channel through which this recurring revenue is generated. Enables ARR waterfall analysis by channel (DTC OTT vs RSN broadcast vs season ticket vs sponsorship) for investor and board reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dtc_ott|rsn_broadcast|season_ticket|corporate_sponsorship|licensing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Workday Adaptive Planning; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: expansion_amount
attributes.description: The incremental ARR gained during the reporting period from upsells, upgrades, seat additions, or contract amendments for existing subscribers or partners. Drives net revenue retention (NRR) calculations in investor reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the primary geographic market for this recurring revenue stream. Supports regional ARR segmentation for international broadcast rights, OTT DTC markets, and global sponsorship reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; SEC Financial Reporting; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: list_price_arr_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: List Price Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) Amount
attributes.description: The undiscounted ARR value at standard list pricing before any contractual discounts, promotional credits, or negotiated reductions. Used for discount rate analysis and pricing strategy reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Workday Adaptive Planning; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: mrr_amount
attributes.description: The normalized monthly recurring revenue amount for this contract or subscription in the reporting period currency. MRR is the foundational metric for subscription business health, used in ARPU calculations and investor KPI dashboards. Excludes one-time fees and variable usage charges.
attributes.references: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: multi_year_deal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ARR entry is derived from a multi-year contract (e.g., a 3-year broadcast rights agreement or 5-year naming rights sponsorship). Multi-year deals require special ARR normalization and disclosure treatment in SEC filings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: net_arr_movement
attributes.description: The net change in ARR for this record during the reporting period, calculated as new ARR + expansion ARR − churn ARR − contraction ARR. The primary waterfall metric for ARR bridge reporting in board and investor presentations.
attributes.references: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: new_subscriber_count
attributes.description: The number of net-new subscribers or partners added during the reporting period for this ARR component type. Used in subscriber acquisition analysis and CAC/LTV modeling.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: product_tier
attributes.description: The subscription or partnership tier level for this recurring revenue entry (e.g., Basic OTT, Premium OTT, VIP Season Membership, Enterprise Sponsorship). Used for ARPU segmentation and upsell/expansion analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: renewal_probability_pct
attributes.description: The estimated probability (0.00–100.00) that this contract or subscription will renew at expiry, as assessed by the commercial or FP&A team. Used in ARR forecasting, at-risk ARR identification, and Workday Adaptive Planning pipeline models.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; Salesforce CRM; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: The last day of the fiscal reporting period to which this ARR snapshot applies. Paired with reporting_period_start to define the measurement window for ARR, MRR, churn, and expansion calculations.
attributes.references: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: The first day of the fiscal reporting period (month or quarter) to which this ARR snapshot applies. Used to align ARR metrics with SEC quarterly and annual financial disclosures.
attributes.references: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: The ASC 606-compliant method used to recognize revenue from this recurring stream over the contract term. Distinct from the commercial ARR metric — this field links the ARR tracker to the revenue_recognition_schedule product for accounting treatment alignment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ARR record is subject to SOX internal control review as part of the financial reporting control environment for publicly traded entities. Flagged records require additional audit trail documentation and management sign-off.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: subscriber_count
attributes.description: The number of active subscribers, season ticket holders, or contracted partners contributing to this ARR entry at the end of the reporting period. Used to compute ARPU and track subscriber base growth for investor KPIs.
attributes.references: SEC Financial Reporting; Adobe Experience Platform; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this ARR tracker record. Used for change data capture, audit trail compliance under SOX, and incremental Silver Layer processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.references: AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; IRS Publication 15-T

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the jurisdiction (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, DEU). Supports multi-national operations across FIFA, UEFA, and global league markets.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAP S/4HANA Country Configuration (T005)

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the county or parish within the state/province, where applicable. Relevant for county-level sales tax and entertainment tax jurisdictions (e.g., Los Angeles County, Cook County).
attributes.references: AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; Multistate Tax Commission (MTC)

attributes.name: county_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: The county-level component of the combined tax rate, expressed as a percentage. Null when no county-level tax applies. Used for accurate tax remittance to county taxing authorities.
attributes.references: AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; Multistate Tax Commission (MTC)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax jurisdiction record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports SOX audit trail requirements for financial master data.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this tax jurisdiction record and its associated rates become effective. Supports temporal versioning of tax rates as jurisdictions change rates over time. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Rate Validity (FTXP); AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this tax jurisdiction record and its associated rates expire or are superseded. Null indicates the record is currently active with no known end date. Supports historical rate lookups for amended tax filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Rate Validity (FTXP); AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: entertainment_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: Specific entertainment or amusement tax rate levied on live event admissions, PPV (Pay-Per-View) transactions, and concert ticket sales. Separate from general sales tax. Applicable in jurisdictions such as Chicago (amusement tax) and New York City.
attributes.references: AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; IRS Publication 15; Chicago Amusement Tax Ordinance

attributes.name: filing_due_day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1–31) by which the tax return and remittance must be submitted to the taxing authority following the close of the filing period. Used to drive automated tax calendar alerts in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Calendar Configuration

attributes.name: filing_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for tax return filing and remittance to this jurisdiction's taxing authority. Event-based applies to jurisdictions requiring per-event filing (common for entertainment taxes on individual concerts or sporting events).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; SOX Section 302 (financial reporting controls)

attributes.name: interest_rate_pct
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to unpaid or underpaid tax balances in this jurisdiction. Used in tax liability accrual calculations and EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization) impact modeling.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: jock_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: Non-resident income tax rate applied to athlete compensation earned while performing in this jurisdiction. Calculated based on duty days or games played in the jurisdiction. Critical for multi-state athlete payroll compliance under CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) obligations across NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, and MLS.
attributes.references: Multistate Tax Commission (MTC) Jock Tax Guidelines; IRS Publication 519; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Tax Provisions

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tax jurisdiction, aligned with SAP S/4HANA tax jurisdiction code (field TXJCD). Used as the business key for cross-system lookups and referenced in finance.cost_center.tax_jurisdiction_code, finance.profit_center.tax_jurisdiction_code, and finance.company_code.tax_jurisdiction_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Jurisdiction Code (TXJCD); IRS Publication 15; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the tax jurisdiction (e.g., 'State of California', 'New York City', 'Cook County Illinois'). Used in financial reports, tax filings, and regulatory disclosures.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax jurisdiction level within the governmental hierarchy. Federal covers national-level taxes; state covers US state or equivalent; county covers sub-state regional; city covers municipal; district covers special taxing districts (e.g., stadium districts, entertainment zones); special covers other jurisdictions such as tribal or port authorities.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; Multistate Tax Commission (MTC)

attributes.name: merchandise_taxable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether merchandise and licensed product sales (SKU-based) are subject to sales tax in this jurisdiction. True = taxable; False = exempt. Drives tax calculation in Shopify Plus POS (Point of Sale) and e-commerce transactions.
attributes.references: AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; Shopify Plus Tax Configuration; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: nexus_established_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Sports Entertainment has established tax nexus in this jurisdiction and is currently obligated to collect and remit taxes. True = nexus confirmed; False = no nexus or below threshold.
attributes.references: South Dakota v. Wayfair Inc. (2018); Multistate Tax Commission (MTC); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: nexus_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum revenue threshold (in jurisdiction currency) above which Sports Entertainment establishes economic nexus and becomes obligated to collect and remit sales or entertainment tax in this jurisdiction. Post-South Dakota v. Wayfair (2018) economic nexus standard.
attributes.references: South Dakota v. Wayfair Inc. (2018); Multistate Tax Commission (MTC) Economic Nexus Standards; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards

attributes.name: nexus_threshold_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the nexus threshold amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency international jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration

attributes.name: nexus_transaction_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of transactions above which economic nexus is established in this jurisdiction, independent of revenue amount. Many states use a dual threshold (e.g., 200 transactions OR $100,000 revenue). Null if jurisdiction uses revenue-only threshold.
attributes.references: South Dakota v. Wayfair Inc. (2018); Multistate Tax Commission (MTC) Economic Nexus Standards

attributes.name: nil_income_taxable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) income earned by athletes in this jurisdiction is subject to state income or withholding tax. True = taxable; False = exempt or not yet legislated. Reflects evolving NIL regulatory landscape post-2021.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 519; Multistate Tax Commission (MTC); NCAA NIL Policy; CBA NIL Provisions

attributes.name: penalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Penalty rate expressed as a percentage of unpaid tax applied for late filing or late remittance in this jurisdiction. Used in tax risk modeling and FP&A (Financial Planning and Analysis) for tax liability forecasting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; SOX Section 302 (financial risk disclosure)

attributes.name: remittance_method
attributes.description: Required or preferred method for remitting tax payments to the taxing authority. EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) is the most common for large filers; check for smaller jurisdictions; online portal for state-specific web filing; EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) for automated bulk remittance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Configuration; PCI-DSS (for electronic payment security)

attributes.name: sap_tax_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI tax code (field MWSKZ) associated with this jurisdiction, used for tax determination in FI/CO postings, AP invoices, AR invoices, and journal entries. Links this reference record to SAP tax procedure configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Code Configuration (T-code FTXP); SAP Note 1039474

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this tax jurisdiction record originates. SAP_S4HANA is the primary SSOT; VERTEX, AVALARA, and ONESOURCE are third-party tax engines that may feed jurisdiction data; MANUAL indicates records maintained directly by the tax team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX Section 404 (system of record controls)

attributes.name: special_district_rate_pct
attributes.description: Tax rate for special taxing districts such as stadium financing districts, sports authority districts, or entertainment zones. Null when no special district tax applies. Relevant for venues funded through public stadium bonds.
attributes.references: AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; Multistate Tax Commission (MTC); ISO 20121 Event Sustainability

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 sub-national code for the state or province within the country (e.g., CA for California, NY for New York, ON for Ontario). Required for US multi-state jock tax filings and state income tax withholding for athlete compensation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; IRS Form W-2; Multistate Tax Commission (MTC) Jock Tax Guidelines

attributes.name: state_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: The state-level component of the combined tax rate, expressed as a percentage. Enables decomposition of combined rates into state, county, and city components for accurate tax remittance and reporting.
attributes.references: Multistate Tax Commission (MTC); IRS Publication 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration

attributes.name: tax_basis
attributes.description: The taxable base upon which the tax rate is applied. Gross Receipts includes all revenue; Net Receipts excludes certain deductions; Admission Price is the ticket face value for entertainment tax; Face Value is the printed ticket price excluding fees; Duty Days is the allocation method for jock tax based on days worked in jurisdiction.
attributes.references: Multistate Tax Commission (MTC); IRS Publication 15; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Primary category of tax governed by this jurisdiction record. Sales Tax applies to merchandise and ticket sales; Entertainment Tax is a levy on live event admissions and PPV (Pay-Per-View) revenue; Jock Tax is a non-resident income tax on athlete compensation earned in the jurisdiction; Withholding Tax covers multi-state athlete payroll withholding; VAT (Value Added Tax) applies in international markets; Use Tax applies to goods used but not purchased in the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Multistate Tax Commission (MTC) Jock Tax Guidelines; GDPR Article 5 (for EU VAT jurisdictions); PCI-DSS (for ticket sales tax)

attributes.name: tax_exempt_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of revenue or transaction categories that are explicitly exempt from taxation in this jurisdiction (e.g., 'food_and_beverage,nonprofit_events,youth_sports'). Null if no exemptions apply. Supports accurate tax calculation by excluding exempt revenue streams.
attributes.references: AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; IRS Publication 557 (Tax-Exempt Organizations); ISO 20121

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax jurisdiction record. Active = currently in use for tax calculations; Inactive = no longer applicable; Pending = approved but not yet effective; Superseded = replaced by a newer version of the same jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards

attributes.name: tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 8.25000 for 8.25%). For combined jurisdictions, this represents the total combined rate. Precision to five decimal places supports fractional rates common in US state and local tax structures.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; SAP S/4HANA Tax Rate Configuration (FTXP); AICPA State & Local Tax Standards

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Sports Entertainment's tax registration or seller's permit number issued by this jurisdiction's taxing authority. Required for tax remittance and filing. Confidential business identifier. Examples: state sales tax permit number, VAT registration number.
attributes.references: IRS EIN; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: taxing_authority_code
attributes.description: Short code identifying the taxing authority for system integration and SAP S/4HANA FI tax authority configuration. Used in automated tax remittance workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Authority Configuration; AICPA State & Local Tax Standards

attributes.name: taxing_authority_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the government agency or taxing authority responsible for administering this jurisdiction's taxes (e.g., 'California Department of Tax and Fee Administration', 'New York State Department of Taxation and Finance', 'HM Revenue and Customs').
attributes.references: AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Authority Configuration

attributes.name: ticket_sales_taxable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ticket sales (general admission, VIP, SRO) are subject to sales or entertainment tax in this jurisdiction. True = taxable; False = exempt. Drives tax calculation in Ticketmaster/AXS and Archtics ticketing systems.
attributes.references: AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; Ticketmaster/AXS Tax Configuration; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax jurisdiction record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Required for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer and SOX audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Change Log; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: vat_rate_pct
attributes.description: VAT (Value Added Tax) rate applicable in international jurisdictions (e.g., EU member states, UK, Canada GST/HST). Null for US domestic jurisdictions. Required for FIFA, UEFA, and international broadcast rights transactions subject to VAT.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; GDPR Article 5 (EU data); SAP S/4HANA FI VAT Configuration

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: Income tax withholding rate applicable to non-resident athlete and performer compensation paid in this jurisdiction. Used for payroll processing in SAP SuccessFactors and SAP S/4HANA FI/CO for multi-state athlete salary withholding.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Form 1042-S; Multistate Tax Commission (MTC); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: parent_tax_jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on tax_jurisdiction (parent_tax_jurisdiction_id)

products.name: revenue_stream
products.description: Revenue stream classification and tracking master — ticketing, broadcast rights, sponsorship, merchandise, gaming, venue rentals — with budget allocation, growth targets, and seasonal patterns.

attributes.name: revenue_stream_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each revenue stream classification record in the Sports Entertainment enterprise. Primary key for the finance.revenue_stream master data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Revenue Category Master

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Revenue streams are scoped to a specific legal entity for SEC reporting and intercompany elimination. The company_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.company_code_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue streams are mapped to specific GL accounts in the chart of accounts for financial reporting. The gl_account_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to gl_account.gl_account_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ip_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to legal.ip_portfolio. Business justification: Revenue streams in Sports Entertainment (broadcast rights fees, trademark licensing, content syndication) are directly generated by specific IP assets. Linking revenue_stream to ip_portfolio enables I
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the business owner accountable for this revenue stream's performance, budget attainment, and SOX control compliance. Typically a VP or Director of Finance, Revenue, or the relevant business unit. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors HCM.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM; SOX Section 302 Management Certification

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Revenue streams are attributed to profit centers (e.g., broadcast rights revenue → broadcast profit center). The profit_center_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to profit_center.pro
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Approved annual revenue budget for this stream in the stream's transactional currency, sourced from Workday Adaptive Planning FP&A models. Used as the baseline for variance analysis, EBITDA forecasting, and board-level revenue target reporting.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Planning; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: annual_growth_target_pct
attributes.description: Board-approved year-over-year revenue growth target for this stream expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.1200 = 12.00%). Used in FP&A scenario modeling, investor relations KPI reporting, and ARR growth tracking for subscription-based streams.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SEC MD&A Disclosure; ARR Growth Benchmarks

attributes.name: arr_tracking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue stream contributes to the enterprise's Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) metric tracked for investor reporting and subscription business health. True for OTT subscriptions, DTC memberships, multi-year sponsorship contracts, and naming rights deals with fixed annual payments.
attributes.references: ARR Reporting Standards; SEC MD&A Disclosure; Workday Adaptive Planning ARR Module

attributes.name: cpg_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Cost Per Mille (CPM) pricing methodology applies to this revenue stream. True for broadcast advertising inventory, digital display sponsorships, and OTT pre-roll ad placements where revenue is calculated on a per-thousand-impressions basis. Drives ad inventory valuation in broadcast ad placement workflows.
attributes.references: IAB CPM Advertising Standards; FCC Broadcast Advertising Regulation; Dalet Galaxy Ad Inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue stream master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation event required for SOX internal controls documentation and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the primary transactional currency of this revenue stream (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Used for FX translation to group reporting currency in SAP S/4HANA and Workday Adaptive Planning consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: drm_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Digital Rights Management (DRM) controls apply to the content or media assets generating this revenue stream. True for OTT, PPV, IPTV, and broadcast rights streams where content protection is mandated by rights agreements. Triggers DRM policy enforcement in Dalet Galaxy and CDN configurations.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy DRM Policy; FCC Broadcast Regulation; WIPO Copyright Treaty

attributes.name: ebitda_contribution_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Contribution Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue stream is included in the enterprise EBITDA calculation reported to investors, lenders, and the SEC. False for pass-through revenue streams (e.g., league revenue sharing remittances) that are excluded from EBITDA by accounting policy.
attributes.references: SEC Non-GAAP Financial Measures Guidance; EBITDA Reporting Standards; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this revenue stream classification record is valid and active for financial posting and reporting. Supports time-variant master data management in SAP S/4HANA and enables historical revenue stream analysis across fiscal periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Time Dependency; ASC 606 Contract Effective Date

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this revenue stream classification record expires or is superseded. Null for open-ended streams. Used in SAP S/4HANA time-dependent master data management and to enforce revenue stream sunset dates aligned with contract expirations or league restructuring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Time Dependency; ASC 606 Contract Term

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this revenue stream budget and growth targets apply, aligned to the company's SAP S/4HANA fiscal year variant. Enables period-specific revenue planning, variance reporting, and multi-year trend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: Primary geographic market for this revenue stream expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN, AUS). Drives GDPR/CCPA compliance scoping, tax jurisdiction assignment, currency hedging strategy, and international broadcast rights window management.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue stream involves intercompany transactions between legal entities within the Sports Entertainment group (e.g., broadcast rights fees from a subsidiary RSN to the parent league entity). Triggers intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements and SAP S/4HANA intercompany settlement workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Accounting; ASC 810 Consolidation; SEC Consolidated Reporting

attributes.name: ip_rights_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IP rights position underlying this revenue stream. 'owned' applies to proprietary league marks and team IP; 'licensed_out' applies to broadcast rights deals and merchandise licensing; 'licensed_in' applies to third-party content distribution; 'shared' applies to co-branded sponsorship activations. Drives DRM policy assignment and IP royalty accounting.
attributes.references: IP Rights Management Framework; DRM Policy Standards; FIFA/NFL/NBA IP Licensing Rules

attributes.name: league_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the sports league or governing body associated with this revenue stream (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA, UFC, ATP). Enables league-level revenue segmentation for CBA compliance reporting, league office revenue sharing calculations, and governing body regulatory filings.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS/FIFA/UFC/ATP League Governance; CBA Revenue Sharing Rules

attributes.name: pci_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue stream involves payment card transactions subject to PCI-DSS compliance requirements. True for ticketing (Ticketmaster/AXS), merchandise e-commerce (Shopify Plus), and venue POS transactions. Triggers PCI-DSS control requirements and quarterly compliance attestation.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; PCI SSC Standards; Ticketmaster/AXS Payment Processing

attributes.name: peak_season_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the primary revenue-generating season concludes for this stream (e.g., Super Bowl, NBA Finals, World Series). Paired with peak_season_start_date to define the active revenue window for seasonal cash flow modeling.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Official Season Calendars; ISO 20121 Event Management

attributes.name: peak_season_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the primary revenue-generating season begins for this stream (e.g., NFL regular season kickoff, NBA opening night, concert tour launch). Used in cash flow forecasting, staffing plans, and venue operations scheduling.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Official Season Calendars; ISO 20121 Event Management

attributes.name: prior_year_actual_amount
attributes.description: Audited actual revenue recognized for this stream in the immediately preceding fiscal year, in the stream's transactional currency. Serves as the comparative baseline for SEC annual report (10-K) year-over-year revenue disclosures and EBITDA bridge analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Actual Postings; SEC 10-K Annual Report; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reporting_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this revenue stream within the enterprise revenue reporting hierarchy (1 = top-level category, 2 = subcategory, 3 = detailed stream). Enables hierarchical roll-up in FP&A dashboards, EBITDA waterfall charts, and SEC segment disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Hierarchy; Workday Adaptive Planning Hierarchy

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition method applied to this stream. 'point_in_time' for single-event ticket sales; 'over_time' for multi-year broadcast rights deals and season sponsorships; 'usage_based' for PPV and gaming; 'milestone' for performance-based NIL agreements; 'ratable' for subscription OTT/DTC services.
attributes.references: ASC 606 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers); IFRS 15; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: revenue_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue stream is subject to league-mandated revenue sharing obligations under the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) or league constitution (e.g., NFL national media revenue pool, NBA Basketball Related Income sharing). Triggers intercompany settlement workflows in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL CBA Revenue Sharing Provisions; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Settlement

attributes.name: revenue_sharing_pct
attributes.description: The contractually mandated percentage of gross revenue from this stream that must be shared with the league office or other member clubs under the applicable CBA or revenue sharing agreement (e.g., 0.3400 = 34.00% of national broadcast revenue to league pool). Null when revenue_sharing_flag is False.
attributes.references: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL CBA Revenue Sharing Provisions; CAS Arbitration Standards

attributes.name: revenue_stream_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue stream master record. 'active' streams are live and generating revenue; 'pending' are approved but not yet launched; 'seasonal' are active only during defined event seasons; 'discontinued' are retired streams retained for historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Lifecycle; SOX Control Framework

attributes.name: seasonality_pattern
attributes.description: Describes the temporal revenue generation pattern for this stream. 'in_season' applies to gate receipts and broadcast rights tied to league calendars; 'event_driven' applies to PPV, concerts, and one-off events; 'year_round' applies to OTT subscriptions and naming rights; 'quarterly'/'monthly' applies to ratable sponsorship and licensing fees.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning Seasonal Modeling; NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL Season Calendars

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Operating segment identifier for this revenue stream as defined under ASC 280 / IFRS 8 segment reporting requirements. Maps to the reportable segments disclosed in SEC filings (e.g., 'Live Events', 'Media & Broadcasting', 'Consumer Products', 'Digital & Gaming'). Enables segment-level P&L reporting.
attributes.references: ASC 280 Segment Reporting; IFRS 8; SEC 10-K Segment Disclosures

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this revenue stream master record originates. Enables data lineage tracking, reconciliation between source systems, and Silver Layer provenance documentation. SAP_S4HANA is the primary SSOT for financial master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Workday Adaptive Planning; Databricks Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: sox_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue stream is within scope for SOX Section 302/404 internal controls over financial reporting. True for all material revenue streams contributing to SEC-reported financials. Triggers mandatory SOX control testing, documentation, and sign-off workflows.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; SEC Financial Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: sport_type
attributes.description: The sport or entertainment discipline generating this revenue stream (e.g., 'American Football', 'Basketball', 'Baseball', 'Ice Hockey', 'Soccer', 'Mixed Martial Arts', 'Tennis', 'Concert', 'Esports'). Supports cross-sport revenue benchmarking and TAM analysis.
attributes.references: FIFA/IOC/NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL Sport Classification Standards

attributes.name: stream_category
attributes.description: Top-level classification of the revenue stream aligned to Sports Entertainment's primary revenue pillars: ticketing (gate receipts, VIP, SRO), broadcast (RSN, OTT, PPV, DTC), sponsorship (naming rights, jersey, digital), merchandise (licensed SKUs, e-commerce), venue_rental (facility hire, HVAC services), gaming (fantasy, wagering), content (UGC licensing, DAM syndication), other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ticketing|broadcast|sponsorship|merchandise|venue_rental|gaming|content|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NBA/NFL/MLB/NHL League Office Revenue Classification; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Category

attributes.name: stream_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the revenue stream, used in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO chart of accounts mapping, Workday Adaptive Planning budget models, and cross-system reconciliation. Examples: TICK_GA, BCAST_OTT, SPON_NAMING.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Chart of Accounts; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: stream_description
attributes.description: Free-text business description of the revenue stream, including its commercial rationale, key contractual drivers, and relationship to league or event operations. Used in FP&A narrative reporting, board presentations, and SEC MD&A disclosures.
attributes.references: SEC MD&A Disclosure Requirements; Workday Adaptive Planning Narrative Reporting

attributes.name: stream_name
attributes.description: Human-readable business name of the revenue stream (e.g., 'General Admission Ticketing', 'OTT Broadcast Subscription', 'Naming Rights Sponsorship', 'Licensed Merchandise'). Used in FP&A dashboards, EBITDA reporting, and SEC financial disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Category; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: stream_subcategory
attributes.description: Second-level classification providing granular segmentation within the parent category. Examples: within ticketing — 'GA', 'VIP', 'SRO', 'Season Pass'; within broadcast — 'PPV', 'OTT', 'RSN', 'DTC'; within sponsorship — 'Naming Rights', 'Jersey Patch', 'Digital Activation'. Supports drill-down analytics in FP&A and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Profit Center Hierarchy; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax treatment classification for this revenue stream, determining applicable VAT/GST/sales tax rates and withholding tax obligations. attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: The realised cash inflow or outflow amount for the period, sourced from SAP FI actuals. Populated after period close to enable forecast-vs-actual variance analysis and FP&A reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Actual Postings; SOX; SEC

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for this forecast record. Pending awaits review; approved has been authorised by the designated FP&A approver; rejected has been returned for revision; escalated has been referred to senior management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI — Workflow; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this forecast record was approved by the designated approver. Provides the SOX-required audit timestamp for the approval event.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI — Workflow

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Organisational business unit responsible for this forecast record (e.g., League Operations, Venue Operations, Broadcast & Media, Athlete Management, Merchandise). Drives EBITDA reporting segmentation and FP&A roll-up hierarchies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Profit Center Hierarchy; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: cash_flow_category
attributes.description: Directional classification of the cash flow record. Inflow represents projected receipts (ticket sales, broadcast payments, sponsorship instalments, merchandise revenue); outflow represents projected disbursements (payroll, venue operations, content production costs).
attributes.references: IAS 7 — Statement of Cash Flows; SAP S/4HANA FI Liquidity Planning

attributes.name: cash_flow_type
attributes.description: IAS 7 / ASC 230 classification of the cash flow into operating, investing, or financing activities. Operating covers day-to-day business receipts and payments; investing covers capital expenditure and asset disposals; financing covers debt, equity, and dividend transactions.
attributes.references: IAS 7 — Statement of Cash Flows; ASC 230; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this cash flow forecast record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation timestamp required for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency of this forecast record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Sports Entertainment operates across global markets with multi-currency broadcast rights and sponsorship deals.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to translate the transaction currency amount to the reporting currency. Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate tables; critical for multi-currency broadcast rights and international sponsorship cash flows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Exchange Rate; IAS 21

attributes.name: expense_category
attributes.description: Sports Entertainment-specific expense category for outflow records. Examples include payroll and athlete salaries, venue operations, content production, broadcast production, travel and logistics, marketing, and capital expenditure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: payroll|athlete_salaries|venue_ops|content_production|broadcast_production|travel|marketing|capex|licensing_fees|insurance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Cost Element Accounting; OSHA; CBA

attributes.name: forecast_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the forecast record, formatted as CFF-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Used for cross-system reference and audit trail in SAP S/4HANA Liquidity Planning and Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Liquidity Planning; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the forecast record. Draft indicates work-in-progress; submitted awaits approval; approved is the authorised version; locked is period-closed; superseded is replaced by a newer version; cancelled is voided.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Liquidity Planning; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Methodological classification of the forecast. Rolling forecasts are continuously updated; static forecasts are point-in-time; budget forecasts align to the annual operating plan; reforecasts are mid-cycle revisions triggered by material business events.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; AICPA FP&A Standards

attributes.name: forecast_version
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for the forecast record within a given period and business unit. Enables tracking of iterative revisions and scenario comparisons over the planning cycle.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cash flow represents an intercompany transaction between legal entities within the Sports Entertainment group. Intercompany cash flows are subject to elimination in consolidated financial statements and require arm's-length pricing documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Intercompany Processing; IAS 27; SOX

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cash flow is a recurring item (e.g., monthly broadcast rights instalment, weekly payroll run) as opposed to a one-time or event-driven cash flow. Supports ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) tracking and automated forecast generation.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; ARR Tracking — finance.recurring_revenue

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text commentary provided by the FP&A analyst or finance controller explaining assumptions, drivers, or material changes underlying this forecast record. Supports management review and audit documentation.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA FI — Document Header Text

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual or expected date on which the cash inflow is due to be received or the outflow is due to be paid. Critical for short-term liquidity management and working capital planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Terms; IAS 7

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms code governing the timing of cash receipt or disbursement (e.g., NET30, NET60, immediate). Drives the cash flow timing model in liquidity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar end date of the forecast period covered by this record. Defines the closing boundary of the projected cash flow window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Posting Period; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: period_granularity
attributes.description: Time granularity at which this forecast record is expressed. Monthly is the standard for FP&A; weekly or daily granularity is used for short-term liquidity management; quarterly and annual for strategic planning horizons.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Liquidity Planning

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar start date of the forecast period covered by this record. Combined with period_end_date, defines the precise time window for projected cash flows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Posting Period; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: probability_pct
attributes.description: Estimated probability (0–100%) that this projected cash flow will materialise as forecast. Used in risk-weighted cash flow models and scenario analysis, particularly for variable consideration items such as PPV revenue and performance-based sponsorship bonuses.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; ASC 606 — Variable Consideration; FP&A Best Practice

attributes.name: projected_amount
attributes.description: The gross projected cash inflow or outflow amount for the forecast period in the transaction currency. Represents the base forecast before any adjustments or variance calculations.
attributes.references: IAS 7; ASC 230; SAP S/4HANA FI Liquidity Planning

attributes.name: reporting_currency_amount
attributes.description: Projected cash flow amount translated to the group reporting currency (typically USD) using the applicable exchange rate. Required for consolidated EBITDA reporting and SEC financial disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Group Currency; IAS 21; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: revised_projected_amount
attributes.description: Updated projected cash flow amount following a mid-cycle reforecast or management adjustment. Captures the most current forecast estimate when the original projection has been revised.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA FI Liquidity Planning

attributes.name: scenario_type
attributes.description: Planning scenario classification for this forecast record. Base is the primary operating plan; optimistic and pessimistic represent upside/downside sensitivities; stress is a regulatory or risk-driven scenario; actuals captures realised cash flows for variance analysis.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; FP&A Best Practice — AICPA

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this forecast record originated. SAP_S4HANA for FI/CO actuals and liquidity planning; WORKDAY_ADAPTIVE for FP&A planning inputs; MANUAL for analyst-entered adjustments; TICKETMASTER for ticket sales projections; SALESFORCE_CRM for sponsorship pipeline forecasts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Workday Adaptive Planning; Ticketmaster; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: sox_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cash flow forecast record is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control requirements. SOX-relevant records require documented approval workflows, segregation of duties, and audit trail preservation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this cash flow forecast record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update for change management, version control, and SOX audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Absolute difference between the projected (or revised projected) amount and the actual amount for the period. Positive variance indicates actuals exceeded forecast (favourable for inflows, unfavourable for outflows); negative indicates shortfall.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; FP&A Best Practice — AICPA

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: Variance expressed as a percentage of the projected amount. Enables proportional comparison across business units and periods for FP&A dashboards and KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; FP&A Best Practice — AICPA

attributes.name: revised_cash_flow_forecast_id

attributes.name: approver_user_employee_id

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id

attributes.name: reviewed_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the SOX control tester or internal auditor who reviewed and signed off this audit trail record. Provides evidence of the review procedure required under SOX Section 404 management assessment.

attributes.name: sox_control_id

attributes.name: approval_chain

attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow (SWI); PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for the audited financial change. BYPASSED indicates a SOX control exception where the normal approval chain was circumvented, requiring immediate escalation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Status; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the final approval action was recorded for this financial change. Used to measure approval cycle time and detect post-period approvals that may indicate SOX control deficiencies.

attributes.name: audit_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable sequential reference number assigned to this audit event (e.g., AUD-2024-0001234). Used for cross-referencing in SOX control documentation and external audit packages.

attributes.name: audit_trail_status

attributes.name: audited_object_number

attributes.name: audited_object_reference
attributes.description: Surrogate key of the specific financial record that was modified (e.g., the journal_entry_id, ap_invoice_id, or payment_id). Used to join back to the source entity for full context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Change Documents (CDHDR/CDPOS)

attributes.name: audited_object_type
attributes.description: The type of financial object that was modified and captured in this audit record. Identifies which SAP S/4HANA FI/CO entity class the change applies to. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: JOURNAL_ENTRY|AP_INVOICE|AR_INVOICE|PAYMENT|BUDGET|WBS_ELEMENT|FIXED_ASSET|COST_CENTER|GL_ACCOUNT|REVENUE_RECOGNITION — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: before_value
attributes.description: The field value immediately before the change was applied (old value). Stored as STRING to accommodate all field types. Essential for SOX before/after comparison and financial restatement investigations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA CDPOS (VALOLD); PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: change_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the financial record modification occurred in the source system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the audit record. Sourced from SAP CDHDR UDATE/UTIME.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CDHDR (Change Document Header); SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: The nature of the modification captured in this audit record. Distinguishes between initial creation, field-level updates, reversals, approvals, rejections, and posting locks. Critical for SOX segregation-of-duties analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CREATE|UPDATE|DELETE|REVERSE|APPROVE|REJECT|LOCK|UNLOCK — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA CDHDR Change Type

attributes.name: changed_by_role
attributes.description: The SAP authorization role or job function of the user who made the change at the time of the event (e.g., 'AP_CLERK', 'GL_ACCOUNTANT', 'FINANCE_CONTROLLER'). Used for segregation-of-duties (SOD) analysis in SOX testing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Segregation of Duties; SAP GRC Access Control

attributes.name: changed_by_user_name
attributes.description: Full display name of the user who performed the modification. Provides human-readable identity for audit reports and SOX control testing packages without requiring a join to HR master data.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: changed_field_label
attributes.description: Human-readable business label for the changed field (e.g., 'Posting Date', 'Transaction Amount', 'Approval Status'). Derived from SAP data element text to support non-technical audit reviewers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Data Element Text; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: changed_field_name
attributes.description: The technical or business name of the specific field that was modified within the audited financial object (e.g., 'posting_date', 'transaction_amount', 'approval_status'). Sourced from SAP CDPOS field name.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CDPOS (Change Document Items); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: control_exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates that this audit event represents a deviation from the expected SOX control procedure (e.g., approval bypass, retroactive posting, unauthorized field change). Triggers escalation workflow to the SOX control owner.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; PCAOB AS 2201 — Control Deficiency Classification

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code to which the audited transaction is assigned. Supports cost allocation audit trails and FP&A variance investigations across venue operations, broadcast, and league management cost centers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this audit trail record was first captured and written to the Silver Layer lakehouse. Distinct from change_timestamp which reflects the source system event time.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Ingestion Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and EBITDA consolidation across global Sports Entertainment entities.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Key; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for why a control exception occurred (e.g., 'Emergency posting — system outage', 'Approval threshold exceeded without secondary sign-off'). Required when control_exception_flag is True.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201 — Deficiency Documentation

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code associated with the audited financial transaction. Enables financial statement impact assessment and supports SOX control mapping to specific P&L or balance sheet line items.

attributes.name: intercompany_flag

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Processing; SOX Section 404; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 3A-02

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the workstation or session from which the financial change was initiated. Used for IT General Controls (ITGC) audit evidence and unauthorized access investigations under SOX IT controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — IT General Controls; GDPR Article 4 (IP as personal data); CCPA

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting posting date of the audited financial transaction at the time of the change. Captured in the audit trail to detect retroactive postings and period-end cut-off violations that are key SOX risk indicators.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date; SOX Section 404 — Period-End Close Controls

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP profit center code associated with the audited transaction. Enables EBITDA-level audit trail tracing by business segment (e.g., ticketing, broadcast rights, merchandise) for SEC segment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting; SEC ASC 280 Segment Reporting

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audited financial transaction is a reversal of a previously posted document. Reversals require specific SOX approval controls and are flagged for period-end close review.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the SOX control tester completed their review of this audit trail record. Used to demonstrate timely review of financial changes as required by SOX 404 control procedures.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: sap_change_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP change document number (CDHDR-CHANGENR) that uniquely identifies the change document in the SAP S/4HANA system. Enables direct traceability back to the source system change record for external auditor verification.

attributes.name: sap_object_class

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the audited financial transaction at the time of the change event. Used for approval threshold validation — changes above defined materiality thresholds require additional SOX approval levels.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 — Materiality Thresholds; SAP S/4HANA FI Document Amount

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this audit trail record was last modified in the Silver Layer (e.g., enrichment, reclassification). Supports data lineage tracking and late-arriving data reconciliation.

products.name: budget_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the Budget Allocation contract between a budget planning record and an organizational unit. It captures the formal assignment of planned, revised, committed, and forecast financial amounts — as well as approved headcount — to a specific org unit for a given fiscal period, budget version, and scenario. Each record links one budget to one org_unit and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation relationship, including allocated amounts, headcount approvals, and allocation-level approval status. Managed jointly by Finance (FP&A) and HR as part of the annual budgeting, reforecast, and headcount planning cycles.. Existence Justification: In Sports Entertainment, a single budget record (e.g., FY2025 OPEX for Event Operations) is allocated across multiple org units (team ops, broadcast, venue, events), and each org unit receives funding from multiple budget line items across OPEX, CAPEX, and headcount categories. Finance and HR jointly manage these allocations as a formal business process — creating, revising, and approving budget allocations per org-unit-budget combination with tracked amounts, headcount approvals, and fiscal versioning. This is an operationally managed relationship, not an analytical derivation.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the budget_allocation association
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking this allocation record to the parent budget planning record in the Finance domain.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking this allocation record to the organizational unit receiving the budget allocation.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The planned budget amount allocated to this specific org unit from the parent budget record for the fiscal period. Sourced from the relationship_data field 'budget_amount' identified in the detection phase. This amount belongs to the allocation, not to the budget or org unit alone.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 currency per budget_currency_code

attributes.name: allocated_headcount_budget
attributes.description: Approved full-time equivalent (FTE) headcount budget allocated to this org unit under this specific budget record and fiscal year. Sourced from relationship_data 'headcount_budget'. Moved from org_unit because headcount budget varies by fiscal year and budget version — it is a property of the allocation, not a static org unit attribute.
attributes.references: FTE units

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of this specific org-unit-level budget allocation: draft, submitted, approved, rejected, locked. Sourced from relationship_data 'approval_status'. Distinct from the parent budget's approval_status — an individual org unit allocation may be approved while others in the same budget cycle remain in draft.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: annual_opex_budget
attributes.description: Approved annual operating expenditure budget allocated to this organizational unit in the budget currency. Sourced from Workday Adaptive Planning. Used for budget vs. actual variance reporting, EBITDA analysis by division, and financial planning cycles. [Moved from org_unit: The annual OPEX budget is a per-fiscal-year, per-budget-version value that varies with each planning cycle. Storing it as a static attribute on org_unit conflates the current approved budget with the org unit's identity. It belongs on the budget_allocation association where it can be versioned, revised, and tracked per fiscal year and budget scenario.]
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning Budget Module; SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Budget Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the operating budget of this organizational unit (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Used for multi-currency financial consolidation in SAP S/4HANA and Workday Adaptive Planning. [Moved from org_unit: The operating budget currency for an org unit is relevant only in the context of a specific budget allocation. As a static org_unit attribute it cannot accommodate multi-currency allocations across different fiscal years or budget scenarios. It belongs on the allocation record as 'currency_code'.]
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Multi-Currency Configuration; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget allocation record was first created in the source system, supporting audit trail and allocation history tracking.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the allocated amounts in this allocation record. Sourced from relationship_data 'budget_currency_code'. May differ from the parent budget's currency_code if the org unit operates in a different functional currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this budget allocation to the org unit is effective and valid for financial reporting and commitment purposes.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date through which this budget allocation to the org unit remains valid. Aligns with the fiscal period end date of the parent budget record.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this org-unit-level budget allocation applies. Sourced from relationship_data 'fiscal_year'. Retained on the association to support direct querying of allocations by fiscal year without joining back to the parent budget record.
attributes.references: Fiscal calendar

attributes.name: fte_count_actual
attributes.description: Actual full-time equivalent count for this org unit as recorded at the time of this budget allocation, used for variance analysis against allocated_headcount_budget. Sourced from relationship_data 'fte_count_actual'. Moved from org_unit because actual FTE is point-in-time per fiscal period, not a static org unit property.
attributes.references: FTE units

attributes.name: headcount_budget
attributes.description: Approved full-time equivalent (FTE) headcount budget for this organizational unit as authorized in the annual workforce plan. Used for headcount variance reporting, recruitment approval workflows, and span-of-control governance. [Moved from org_unit: Approved FTE headcount budget is a planning-cycle attribute that changes with each annual budget and reforecast. It is not a static property of the org unit — it is a property of the allocation of headcount to that org unit for a specific fiscal year and budget version. Moving it to the association enables proper versioning and variance tracking against fte_count_actual.]
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning Headcount Plan; SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; Sports Entertainment Workforce Planning Policy
