attributes.name: cost_element
attributes.description: The cost element code in SAP Controlling (CO) module that links this general ledger account to cost accounting for expense allocation, cost center assignment, and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who created this chart of accounts entry. Required for SOX compliance and master data governance audit trails.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this chart of accounts entry was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and master data governance tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for accounts that are maintained in a specific currency. For multi-currency accounts, this may be null or indicate the local currency.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the account's purpose, usage guidelines, and the types of transactions that should be posted to this account for proper financial classification and reporting.

attributes.name: ebitda_classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is included in or excluded from EBITDA calculations for management reporting and investor relations. Depreciation, amortization, interest, and tax accounts are excluded.

attributes.name: financial_statement_line
attributes.description: The specific line item on the financial statement (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement) where this account balance is reported for external financial reporting.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional area classification used for segment reporting and financial statement version assignment in SAP S/4HANA, representing business functions such as production, sales, administration, or research and development.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions that require elimination during corporate consolidation for group financial reporting.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this chart of accounts entry. Required for SOX compliance and change management audit trails.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this chart of accounts entry was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and master data governance.

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account normally carries a debit or credit balance based on its account type. Assets and expenses have debit balances; liabilities, equity, and revenue have credit balances.

attributes.name: posting_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether direct transaction postings are allowed to this account. Some accounts may be used only for consolidation or reporting purposes and do not accept direct postings.

attributes.name: profit_center_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a profit center assignment is mandatory when posting transactions to this account for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reconciliation_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a reconciliation account that is automatically updated from subsidiary ledgers (accounts receivable, accounts payable, fixed assets) and cannot be posted to directly.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: For revenue accounts, indicates the revenue recognition method under ASC 606 / IFRS 15: recognized at a point in time when control transfers, or over time as performance obligations are satisfied.

attributes.name: sox_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act internal control requirements and requires enhanced documentation, approval workflows, and audit trails for compliance with SOX Section 404.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the chart of accounts entry indicating whether it is available for posting transactions, blocked from use, or pending approval for activation.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax treatment category for this account indicating whether transactions posted to it are subject to sales tax, VAT, or other tax regulations, or are tax-exempt.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this chart of accounts entry becomes effective and available for transaction posting. Used for time-dependent master data management.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this chart of accounts entry remains effective. After this date, the account is no longer available for new postings. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: parent_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on chart_of_accounts (parent_chart_of_accounts_id)

products.name: payment_program
products.description: Master reference table for payment_program. Referenced by payment_program_id.

attributes.name: payment_program_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payment_program

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether payments under this program require managerial or financial approval before processing.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the payment program for activation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment program was formally approved for activation.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed audit trails must be maintained for all payments processed under this program.

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment program automatically renews upon expiration or requires manual renewal.

attributes.name: base_rate
attributes.description: Base payment rate or percentage used as the foundation for calculating payments under this program.

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the business unit or division responsible for managing and funding this payment program.

attributes.name: contract_template_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the standard contract template associated with this payment program for legal and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code for expense allocation and budgetary control of payments made under this program.

attributes.name: created_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the payment program record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which payments under this program are denominated.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the payment program including its purpose, scope, and key terms.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment program expires or is terminated. Null for open-ended programs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment program becomes active and eligible for processing payments.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which payments under this program are posted for financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after payment due date during which late fees or penalties are not applied.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified the payment program record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment program record was last updated.

attributes.name: late_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage fee applied to late payments under this program after the grace period expires.

attributes.name: maximum_payment_amount
attributes.description: Maximum payment cap that limits the amount that can be paid in a single payment cycle under this program.

attributes.name: minimum_payment_amount
attributes.description: Minimum payment threshold that must be met for a payment to be processed under this program.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments about the payment program for internal reference.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which payments are processed and distributed under this program.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Default payment instrument or mechanism used to disburse payments under this program.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice or event date until payment is due under this program.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the payment program used in external communications and financial reporting.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the payment program as displayed to users and in financial reports.

attributes.name: program_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee responsible for managing and overseeing this payment program.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment program structure determining how payments are calculated and distributed.

attributes.name: rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the base rate indicating how the rate is applied in payment calculations.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Method used for recognizing revenue associated with this payment program in accordance with accounting standards.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment program is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment program indicating whether it is operational and available for use.

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the tax treatment classification for payments under this program for compliance and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or justification for terminating or suspending the payment program.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the payment program configuration for tracking changes and maintaining audit history.

attributes.name: superseded_payment_program_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payment_program (superseded_payment_program_id)

products.name: payment_proposal
products.description: Master reference table for payment_proposal. Referenced by proposal_run_id.

attributes.name: payment_proposal_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payment_proposal

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any additional adjustments (positive or negative) applied to the payment amount, such as credits, debits, or corrections.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment proposal requires explicit management approval before execution.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payment proposal was approved.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this payment proposal.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the company bank account from which the payment will be disbursed.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The organizational unit or legal entity code within the enterprise that is responsible for this payment.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center to which this payment expense is allocated for internal financial reporting and budgeting.

attributes.name: created_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this payment proposal record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment proposal record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The early payment discount amount that can be taken if payment is made by the discount due date.

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to qualify for early payment discount terms.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which payment must be made to the vendor to avoid penalties or late fees.

attributes.name: executed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payment was actually executed and funds were disbursed.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account number to which this payment will be posted in the chart of accounts.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total invoice amount before any deductions, discounts, or adjustments.

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is an intercompany transaction between legal entities within the same corporate group.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the invoice document that this payment proposal settles or partially settles.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this payment proposal record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment proposal record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The final payment amount after applying discounts, withholding taxes, and adjustments. This is the amount proposed for disbursement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, instructions, or context related to this payment proposal.

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: Code indicating if the payment is blocked from execution, and the reason for the block (e.g., dispute, compliance hold).

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism proposed for executing the payment (e.g., wire transfer, ACH, check).

attributes.name: payment_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to this payment proposal for sequencing and cash flow management.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or remittance advice identifier to be included with the payment for vendor reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_term_code
attributes.description: Code representing the contractual payment terms (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30) governing this proposal.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment processing system or bank when the payment was executed.

attributes.name: proposal_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the payment proposal was created or submitted for approval.

attributes.name: proposal_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the payment proposal, formatted as PP-NNNNNNNN.

attributes.name: proposal_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this payment proposal to a specific proposal run batch execution.

attributes.name: proposal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment proposal in the approval and execution workflow.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the payment proposal was rejected, if applicable.

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_date
attributes.description: The target date on which the payment is scheduled to be executed if approved.

attributes.name: sox_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment proposal has passed all Sarbanes-Oxley internal control checks and segregation of duties requirements.

attributes.name: vendor_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor bank account to which the payment will be sent.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier to whom payment is proposed.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of tax withheld at source as required by tax regulations for this payment.

attributes.name: revised_payment_proposal_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payment_proposal (revised_payment_proposal_id)

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Human capital management domain owning employee records, recruitment, payroll, benefits, talent development, and organizational structure via SAP SuccessFactors. Covers full-time staff, part-time event crew, broadcast crews, league officials, and seasonal workers. Manages OSHA safety compliance and CBA labor agreement obligations. SSOT for all workforce identity and HR data.

products.name: employee
products.description: SSOT master record for all workforce members across Sports Entertainment — full-time staff, part-time event crew, broadcast crews, league officials, and seasonal workers. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors HCM. Captures legal name, employment type, hire date, termination date, job classification, cost center assignment, work location, employment status, FLSA classification, union membership flag, CBA agreement reference, and identity verification status. This is the authoritative workforce identity record referenced by all HR sub-domains.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each workforce member record in the Sports Entertainment enterprise. Primary key for the employee master record sourced from SAP SuccessFactors HCM.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central

attributes.name: employing_corporate_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to legal.corporate_entity. Business justification: In multi-entity sports organizations (league holdco, team entities, broadcast subsidiaries), each employee is employed by a specific legal entity for tax withholding, statutory reporting (W-2, IR35),
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee_id of the direct line manager for this employee, enabling organizational hierarchy traversal. Used for approval workflows, performance management chains, and org chart generation. Self-referencing FK within the employee product.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Organizational Management

attributes.name: ada_accommodation_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has an active ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) workplace accommodation in place. Drives facility assignment, equipment provisioning, and event deployment planning. Classified as confidential to protect employee privacy.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); GDPR Article 9; SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent background check was completed for this employee. Used to determine background check currency for venue access, broadcast facility credentialing, and league compliance requirements.
attributes.references: League Security Protocols; OSHA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: The employee's annual base salary or hourly rate as applicable, in the local currency of the work location. Stored as a raw compensation figure for payroll processing, budget planning, and CBA compliance verification. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Compensation; CBA; SOX; FLSA

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The top-level business unit within Sports Entertainment to which the employee belongs (e.g., League Operations, Broadcast Network, Venue Management, Fan Engagement, Merchandise). Used for high-level workforce segmentation and executive reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Organizational Management

attributes.name: cba_agreement_code
attributes.description: The reference code identifying the specific Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) governing this employee's terms of employment. Applicable to unionized staff including broadcast crews, venue operations workers, and league officials. Null for non-union employees.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL League Governance; NLRA

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The SAP cost center code to which the employee's labor costs are allocated. Links workforce costs to the financial controlling structure in SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling). Critical for EBITDA reporting, budget variance analysis, and event cost attribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling); SAP SuccessFactors HCM; SOX

attributes.name: credential_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee's primary professional credential, certification, or work authorization expires (e.g., broadcast technician certification, venue safety certification, work visa). Triggers renewal workflows and may restrict event deployment if expired.
attributes.references: OSHA; ADA; League Governance Bodies (FIFA/NFL/NBA); SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system of record for this employee record. Primarily 'successfactors' for SAP SuccessFactors HCM-sourced records. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability across the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: The employee's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for age verification, benefits eligibility determination, and compliance with minor labor laws. Required for CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) age-related provisions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; CBA Labor Agreements; SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The organizational department code to which the employee is assigned, as defined in the SAP SuccessFactors organizational structure. Used for workforce segmentation, reporting hierarchies, and budget allocation across business units such as Broadcast, Venue Operations, Ticketing, and Fan Engagement.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Organizational Management; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the employee's employment relationship with Sports Entertainment. Drives access provisioning, payroll activation, and workforce reporting. 'pending_start' indicates a hired employee who has not yet commenced work.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central; OSHA; CBA

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the employment relationship. Distinguishes full-time staff, part-time event crew, seasonal workers, independent contractors, league officials, and broadcast crews — all of which are managed within the Sports Entertainment workforce. Drives benefits eligibility, payroll processing rules, and FLSA classification logic.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); CBA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central

attributes.name: ethnicity_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the employee's self-identified ethnicity, as voluntarily provided. Used exclusively for EEOC regulatory reporting and DEI workforce analytics. Classified as restricted sensitive personal data under GDPR Article 9. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product per EEOC categories]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; EEOC (Equal Employment Opportunity Commission); SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: The employee's classification under the U.S. Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), determining overtime eligibility and minimum wage applicability. 'exempt' employees are not entitled to overtime; 'non_exempt' employees are. Critical for payroll compliance and labor law audits.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); U.S. Department of Labor; CBA

attributes.name: gender_identity
attributes.description: The employee's self-identified gender, as voluntarily provided and stored in SAP SuccessFactors. Used for DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion) workforce analytics and regulatory EEO reporting. Classified as restricted sensitive personal data under GDPR Article 9. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: male|female|non_binary|prefer_not_to_say|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; EEOC (Equal Employment Opportunity Commission); SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the employee commenced employment with Sports Entertainment, as recorded in SAP SuccessFactors. Used for tenure calculations, benefits vesting schedules, and CBA seniority determinations.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central; CBA; FLSA

attributes.name: identity_verification_status
attributes.description: The current status of the employee's identity verification process, including background checks and document validation. Required for credentialing, venue access control, and compliance with league security protocols. 'verified' is required before event deployment.
attributes.references: OSHA; ADA; League Security Protocols (NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL); SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: is_union_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is a member of a labor union. Drives CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) applicability, union dues deduction processing, and labor relations reporting. Critical for compliance with league-specific CBA obligations (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL CBAs).
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NLRA (National Labor Relations Act); SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: The standardized job classification code from the Sports Entertainment job catalog, as maintained in SAP SuccessFactors. Maps to a specific job family, grade, and FLSA classification. Examples include codes for event operations staff, broadcast technicians, league officials, and venue management roles.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Job Classification; FLSA; CBA

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The human-readable job title associated with the employee's current position within Sports Entertainment (e.g., 'Broadcast Technician', 'Event Operations Manager', 'League Official', 'Venue Safety Officer'). Used in org charts, event rosters, and credential displays.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central; CBA

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: The employee's legal given name as recorded on government-issued identification. Used for payroll, tax filings, and compliance reporting. Must match identity verification documents.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: The employee's legal family/surname as recorded on government-issued identification. Used for payroll, tax filings, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central

attributes.name: national_id_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (SHA-256) of the employee's government-issued national identification number (e.g., SSN, SIN, NIN). Stored as a hash to support identity deduplication and background check verification without retaining the raw value. Raw value is stored in the HR vault system.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; SOX; SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central

attributes.name: nationality_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the employee's nationality. Required for international event deployment, visa processing, and compliance with league international player/staff regulations (e.g., FIFA, IOC international staff rules).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; FIFA; IOC; GDPR Article 9; SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: osha_safety_trained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has completed the required OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) safety training for their role. Mandatory for venue operations staff, event crew, and broadcast crews working in physical environments. Blocks event deployment if false.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Learning

attributes.name: osha_training_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee most recently completed OSHA-required safety training. Used to determine training currency and trigger renewal notifications per OSHA compliance schedules.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Learning

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid (e.g., weekly for event crew, bi-weekly for full-time staff). Drives payroll processing schedules in SAP SuccessFactors Payroll and determines pay period boundaries for labor cost accruals.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Payroll; FLSA; CBA

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: The compensation grade band assigned to the employee's position within the Sports Entertainment pay structure, as defined in SAP SuccessFactors Compensation. Determines salary range eligibility, bonus targets, and benefits tier. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Compensation; CBA; SOX

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is compensated on a salaried, hourly, per diem, or stipend basis. Determines payroll calculation method and overtime eligibility rules. Seasonal event crew and broadcast crews are typically hourly or per diem.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Payroll; FLSA; CBA

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the employee prefers to be addressed by in day-to-day operations, communications, and internal directories. May differ from legal name. Used in scheduling, broadcast crew lists, and event rosters.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the employee record was first created in the Sports Entertainment data platform (Silver Layer). Represents the data ingestion audit trail timestamp in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Audit Trail

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to the employee record in the Sports Entertainment data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance under SOX and GDPR.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Audit Trail

attributes.name: salary_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the employee's base salary amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency payroll processing across Sports Entertainment's global operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Payroll; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: successfactors_person_code
attributes.description: The natural/business key assigned by SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central to uniquely identify the person across all employment instances. Used for system-of-record cross-referencing and HR integrations.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee's employment relationship with Sports Entertainment ended. Null for active employees. Used for offboarding workflows, final pay calculations, benefits cessation, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central; FLSA; CBA

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for the end of the employment relationship. Used for attrition analytics, CBA compliance reporting, and workforce planning. Null for active employees.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central; CBA; OSHA

attributes.name: work_authorization_type
attributes.description: The type of work authorization held by the employee, relevant for international staff across Sports Entertainment's global operations. Drives I-9/equivalent compliance, visa tracking, and international event deployment eligibility.
attributes.references: USCIS I-9; GDPR; CCPA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central

attributes.name: work_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the employee's primary work location country. Drives applicable labor law, tax jurisdiction, GDPR/CCPA privacy obligations, and CBA applicability for global Sports Entertainment operations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR; CCPA; FLSA; CBA

attributes.name: work_email
attributes.description: The official corporate email address assigned to the employee for business communications, system access, and identity federation. Primary digital contact channel for internal HR and operational notifications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the primary physical work location assigned to the employee (e.g., a specific venue, broadcast facility, league office, or remote designation). Used for OSHA safety compliance, ADA accommodation tracking, and event crew deployment planning.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM — Employee Central; OSHA; ADA

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: The employee's primary work telephone number in E.164 international format. Used for operational contact, emergency notifications, and broadcast/event crew coordination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; ITU-T E.164

products.name: position
products.description: Organizational position master defining approved headcount slots and job classification within the Sports Entertainment org structure. Captures position title, job code, job family (Event Operations, Broadcast Production, Athlete Services, Venue Management), job level, FLSA status (exempt/non-exempt), EEO-1 category, pay grade band, department, reporting line, FTE allocation, position type (permanent, seasonal, event-day), budget approval status, open/filled status, union eligibility flag, and CBA applicability. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Position Management and Job Catalog. Enables workforce planning, headcount governance, compensation banding, compliance reporting, and workforce segmentation across leagues, venues, broadcast, and corporate functions.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for an approved organizational position slot within the Sports Entertainment workforce structure. Primary key for the position master record in SAP SuccessFactors Position Management.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary work location (venue, office, broadcast facility) associated with this position. Used for venue-based workforce planning, OSHA site compliance, and ADA accessibility reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; OSHA; ADA

attributes.name: incumbent_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee currently assigned to fill this position. Null if the position is vacant. Enables position-to-person mapping for org chart, payroll, and workforce reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: location_facility_id
