attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Payroll records are processed by payroll area which maps to organizational units. payroll_record has payroll_area_code as a string but no org_unit_id FK. Linking payroll_record.org_unit_id → org_unit.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll run batch that produced this record. Enables grouping of all employee pay results processed in the same payroll execution cycle.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_jurisdiction. Business justification: Payroll tax withholding (state income tax, local tax, jock tax for traveling athletes) depends on the tax jurisdiction where work is performed. Sports organizations with multi-state operations must ap
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number of the employee's primary bank for direct deposit disbursement. Nine-digit identifier required for ACH payment processing. Stored for payroll disbursement and audit purposes.
attributes.references: NACHA (National Automated Clearing House Association); PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: base_pay_amount
attributes.description: The regular base salary or hourly wage earnings component for the pay period, excluding overtime, differentials, and supplemental pay. Core compensation component sourced from the employee's pay structure in SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: benefit_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total employee pre-tax and post-tax benefit deductions for the pay period, including health insurance premiums, dental, vision, 401(k) contributions, FSA/HSA contributions, and other voluntary benefit elections.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125 (Cafeteria Plan); ERISA; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits

attributes.name: broadcast_differential_amount
attributes.description: Additional shift differential pay earned by broadcast crew members for specialized broadcast production work. Reflects premium compensation for technical broadcast roles per applicable CBA or employment agreements.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: cba_agreement_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) governing this employee's compensation terms at the time of the payroll record. Applicable to unionized Sports Entertainment workforce; determines wage rates, overtime rules, and differential eligibility.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NLRA (National Labor Relations Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payroll record was first created in the SAP SuccessFactors Payroll system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and payroll compliance reporting per SOX requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: direct_deposit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's net pay for this payroll record was disbursed via direct deposit (True) or by physical check (False). Used for payment method tracking and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; NACHA (National Automated Clearing House Association)

attributes.name: employer_fica_amount
attributes.description: Employer's matching share of FICA (Social Security 6.2% + Medicare 1.45%) contributions for the pay period. Represents a labor cost to Sports Entertainment beyond gross pay; required for IRS Form 941 and financial labor cost reporting.
attributes.references: IRS FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act); IRS Publication 15; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's engagement type at the time of this payroll record. Determines applicable tax treatment, benefit eligibility, and CBA obligations for Sports Entertainment workforce categories including event crew, broadcast crews, and seasonal workers.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: event_day_differential_amount
attributes.description: Additional shift differential pay earned for hours worked on event days (game days, concert days, live events). Specific to Sports Entertainment operations where event-day staffing commands premium compensation per CBA or employment agreements.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: federal_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Total federal income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for the pay period per IRS withholding tables and the employee's W-4 filing status. Required for IRS Form 941 and W-2 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: fica_medicare_amount
attributes.description: Employee's share of Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Medicare tax withheld for the pay period. Calculated at the statutory rate (1.45%), with additional 0.9% for high earners. Required for IRS Form 941 and W-2 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act); IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: fica_social_security_amount
attributes.description: Employee's share of Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Social Security tax withheld for the pay period. Calculated at the statutory rate (6.2%) up to the annual wage base limit. Required for IRS Form 941 and W-2 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act); IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: garnishment_amount
attributes.description: Total court-ordered or legally mandated wage garnishment deductions applied to the employee's pay for the period. Includes child support, tax levies, creditor garnishments, and student loan garnishments per applicable court orders.
attributes.references: Consumer Credit Protection Act (CCPA Title III); IRS Tax Levy; SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total pre-tax compensation earned by the employee for the pay period, including base pay, overtime, shift differentials, and all other earnings components before any deductions. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: is_union_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee was a union member at the time of this payroll record. Determines applicability of CBA wage rates, union dues deductions, and labor agreement compliance obligations.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NLRA (National Labor Relations Act)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payroll record was most recently modified in the SAP SuccessFactors Payroll system. Tracks corrections, reversals, and amendments for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: local_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Total local/municipal income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for the pay period. Applicable in jurisdictions with local income taxes (e.g., city taxes in markets where Sports Entertainment operates venues).
attributes.references: Local Tax Authorities; SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total take-home pay disbursed to the employee after all tax withholdings, benefit deductions, union dues, garnishments, and other deductions have been subtracted from gross pay. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: overnight_differential_amount
attributes.description: Additional shift differential pay earned for hours worked during overnight shifts (typically midnight to 6 AM). Applicable to venue operations, security, and broadcast crews working overnight at Sports Entertainment facilities.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total number of overtime hours worked by the employee during the pay period, as defined by FLSA thresholds (hours exceeding 40 per workweek) or applicable CBA provisions for Sports Entertainment event and broadcast crews.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: overtime_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total premium compensation paid for overtime hours worked during the pay period. Calculated at the applicable overtime rate (typically 1.5x base rate) per FLSA or CBA requirements.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: pay_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the employee's net pay was disbursed via direct deposit or check. Used for cash flow reporting and payroll audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which the employee is paid. Determines the pay period structure and is tied to the employee's employment agreement or Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: pay_group_code
attributes.description: SAP SuccessFactors pay group identifier that clusters employees sharing the same payroll processing schedule, pay frequency, and payroll area (e.g., FT-STAFF, PT-EVENT, BROADCAST-CREW, LEAGUE-OFFICIAL).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll record. Defines the closing boundary of the earnings window for compensation calculation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll record. Together with pay_period_end_date defines the earnings window for which compensation is calculated.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The specific disbursement method used to deliver net pay to the employee. Provides granular payment channel detail beyond the direct_deposit_flag for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; NACHA (National Automated Clearing House Association); PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: payroll_area_code
attributes.description: SAP SuccessFactors payroll area code identifying the organizational payroll processing unit. Aligns with legal entity, country, and pay schedule groupings for multi-entity Sports Entertainment operations.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: payroll_run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payroll processing run was executed in SAP SuccessFactors. Distinct from pay_date; used for payroll audit trails and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: regular_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total regular (non-overtime) hours worked by the employee during the pay period. Used for hourly pay calculation, FLSA compliance tracking, and workforce capacity reporting.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration)

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employee's elective deferral contribution to qualified retirement plans (401(k), 403(b)) deducted from pay for the period. Tracked separately from general benefit deductions for IRS annual contribution limit compliance and plan reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Section 401(k); ERISA; IRS Form 5500

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this payroll record within the payroll processing workflow. Tracks progression from initial calculation through financial posting or reversal.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payroll run that produced this record. Regular runs follow the standard pay schedule; off-cycle and supplemental runs address corrections, bonuses, or termination pay outside the normal cycle.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: state_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Total state income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for the pay period per applicable state tax authority requirements. Varies by state of employment; critical for multi-state Sports Entertainment operations.
attributes.references: State Tax Authorities; SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: total_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions applied to gross pay for the period, including taxes, FICA, union dues, garnishments, and benefit deductions. Reconciliation field: gross_pay_amount minus total_deductions_amount equals net_pay_amount.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: union_dues_amount
attributes.description: Total union dues deducted from the employee's pay for the period per Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) obligations. Applicable to unionized Sports Entertainment workforce including event crew, broadcast technicians, and league officials.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NLRA (National Labor Relations Act)

attributes.name: ytd_federal_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Cumulative federal income tax withheld from the employee's pay from the start of the calendar year through this pay period. Required for IRS Form W-2 Box 2 reporting and annual tax reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Form W-2

attributes.name: ytd_fica_social_security_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative employee FICA Social Security tax withheld from the start of the calendar year through this pay period. Used to track against the annual Social Security wage base limit and for IRS Form W-2 Box 4 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act); IRS Form W-2

attributes.name: ytd_gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay earned by the employee from the start of the calendar year through the end of this pay period. Required for FICA wage base tracking, W-2 preparation, and annual compensation reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Employee benefits enrollment record capturing elected benefit plans for each workforce member at Sports Entertainment. Tracks benefit plan type (medical, dental, vision, 401k, life insurance, disability, FSA, HSA, EAP), coverage tier (employee only, employee+spouse, family), enrollment effective date, annual election amount, employer contribution, employee contribution, and open enrollment period. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Benefits. Supports benefits cost reporting, ACA compliance, and total rewards analysis.

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each benefit enrollment record in the Sports Entertainment workforce benefits system. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific benefit plan offered by Sports Entertainment (e.g., Blue Shield PPO, Delta Dental, Fidelity 401k). Links to the benefit plan catalog.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

attributes.name: carrier_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.vendor. Business justification: Benefit carriers (health insurers, retirement plan providers) in sports-entertainment are registered vendors with formal contracts. Linking benefit enrollments to vendor enables contract compliance tr
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Employer benefit contributions (health, retirement, COBRA) are charged to cost centers for labor cost reporting and budget variance analysis. Sports organizations require cost center assignment on ben
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce member (employee, seasonal worker, broadcast crew, league official) who elected this benefit plan. Links to the employee master record in SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: employment_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employment_contract. Business justification: Benefit eligibility and plan selection are governed by employment contract terms — specifically contract_type, fte_ratio, cba_covered, and employment_category. Linking benefit_enrollment.employment_co
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Benefit plan costs post to specific GL accounts (employee benefits expense, employer FICA liability, retirement contribution). Finance teams in sports organizations need this link for benefits accrual
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: open_enrollment_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annual or qualifying open enrollment window during which this election was made. Supports benefits cost reporting by enrollment cycle.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ACA (Affordable Care Act) Compliance

attributes.name: aca_offer_of_coverage_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Offer of Coverage Code
attributes.description: IRS-defined code indicating the type of minimum essential coverage (MEC) offered to the employee and their dependents for ACA Form 1095-C Line 14 reporting. Values correspond to IRS ACA offer codes (1A through 1F).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1095-C Line 14; ACA (Affordable Care Act) Section 4980H; IRS Instructions for Forms 1094-C and 1095-C

attributes.name: annual_election_amount
attributes.description: Total annual dollar amount elected by the employee for the benefit plan. Primarily applicable to FSA, HSA, and 401k contribution elections. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; IRS Publication 969 (HSA/FSA limits); IRS 401k contribution limits

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has a valid beneficiary designation on file for this benefit plan (life insurance, 401k, disability). Absence of a beneficiary designation triggers HR follow-up workflow. True = designation on file; False = missing.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ERISA Section 404; DOL Beneficiary Designation Rules

attributes.name: carrier_member_number
attributes.description: Unique member identification number assigned by the insurance carrier or benefit provider to the enrolled employee. Used for claims processing, eligibility verification, and carrier file transmissions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment Transaction

attributes.name: cba_plan_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit enrollment is governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) rather than the standard Sports Entertainment benefits program. CBA-governed plans may have different contribution rates, eligibility rules, and carrier arrangements.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); ERISA Section 302; NLRA (National Labor Relations Act)

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) continuation coverage upon termination of this enrollment. Triggers COBRA notification workflow within the required 14-day window.
attributes.references: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act); DOL COBRA Regulations; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

attributes.name: cobra_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the COBRA election notice was sent to the employee following a qualifying event. Required for DOL compliance; Sports Entertainment must notify within 14 days of the plan administrator being notified of the qualifying event.
attributes.references: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) Section 606; DOL COBRA Regulations

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which insurance or benefit coverage ends for the employee and enrolled dependents. Used for COBRA notification triggering and ACA compliance gap analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act); ACA (Affordable Care Act)

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which insurance or benefit coverage begins for the employee and any enrolled dependents. May differ from effective_date in cases of retroactive enrollment or carrier processing delays.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ACA (Affordable Care Act); ERISA

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage elected by the employee, determining which dependents are covered under the plan. Options include employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, or full family coverage.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ACA (Affordable Care Act) Section 4980H

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was first created in the SAP SuccessFactors Benefits system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Controls; ERISA Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this enrollment record. Supports global workforce operations across international markets. Typically USD for domestic employees.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents (spouse, children, domestic partner) enrolled under this benefit plan. Drives coverage tier validation and premium calculation. Does not include the employee themselves.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; IRS Publication 501 (Dependents)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit coverage becomes active for the employee. Determines the start of the coverage period for ACA compliance reporting and payroll deduction scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ACA (Affordable Care Act) Section 4980H; IRS Form 1095-C

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee made or confirmed their benefit election. Distinct from the effective date; captures the actual decision event for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ERISA Section 404

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Annual dollar amount contributed by the employee toward the benefit plan premium or election. Used in total rewards analysis and payroll deduction calculations. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; IRS Publication 15-B; ERISA

attributes.name: employee_work_classification
attributes.description: Employment classification of the workforce member at the time of enrollment. Determines benefit eligibility rules; full-time employees receive full benefits while part-time, seasonal, and event crew may have restricted eligibility per CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) terms.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); ACA (Affordable Care Act) Section 4980H

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Annual dollar amount contributed by Sports Entertainment toward the employee's benefit plan. Supports benefits cost reporting, EBITDA analysis, and total compensation benchmarking. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; IRS Publication 15-B; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Financial Controls

attributes.name: employer_match_rate
attributes.description: Sports Entertainment's employer matching contribution rate for retirement plan enrollments, expressed as a decimal percentage of the employee's contribution (e.g., 0.5000 = 50% match up to the match cap). Applicable only to 401k plan type enrollments.
attributes.references: IRS Section 401(k); ERISA; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this benefit enrollment record, used in correspondence with carriers, brokers, and employees. Format: ENR-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Reason or trigger that initiated this benefit enrollment. Distinguishes between annual open enrollment, new hire enrollment, qualifying life event (QLE) changes, rehire reinstatement, or administrative corrections.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; IRS Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Rules; ERISA

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the benefit enrollment record. Active indicates the employee is currently enrolled; waived indicates the employee opted out; terminated indicates coverage has ended.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ERISA; ACA (Affordable Care Act)

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is required to submit Evidence of Insurability (EOI) / medical underwriting for this enrollment (e.g., supplemental life insurance above guaranteed issue amount). True = EOI required; False = not required.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ERISA; Carrier Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Evidence of Insurability (EOI) submission and carrier review process. Applicable only when evidence_of_insurability_required is True. Pending coverage may be limited until EOI is approved.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ERISA; Carrier Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: fsa_rollover_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of unused FSA funds rolled over from the prior plan year under IRS rollover provisions. Applicable only to FSA plan type enrollments. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Notice 2013-71 (FSA Rollover Rule); IRS Publication 969; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Insurance group number assigned by the carrier to Sports Entertainment's benefit plan. Used on insurance cards and for carrier eligibility file transmissions (HIPAA 834).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; HIPAA EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment Transaction

attributes.name: hsa_contribution_limit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Savings Account (HSA) Annual Contribution Limit
attributes.description: IRS-mandated annual contribution limit applicable to this employee's HSA enrollment based on coverage tier (self-only vs. family) and age (catch-up contributions for age 55+). Stored for compliance validation against annual_election_amount. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 969; IRS Revenue Procedure (annual HSA limit updates); ACA (Affordable Care Act)

attributes.name: is_aca_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee meets the ACA employer mandate eligibility threshold (typically 30+ hours per week for 120+ days). Drives IRS Form 1095-C reporting obligations for Sports Entertainment as an Applicable Large Employer (ALE).
attributes.references: ACA (Affordable Care Act) Section 4980H; IRS Form 1095-C; IRS Form 1094-C

attributes.name: is_tobacco_user
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee self-reported as a tobacco user during enrollment. Affects premium surcharge calculations for medical plans under ACA wellness program rules. True = tobacco user; False = non-tobacco user.
attributes.references: ACA (Affordable Care Act) Section 2705; HIPAA Wellness Program Rules; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was most recently updated in the SAP SuccessFactors Benefits system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change audit tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Controls; ERISA Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: per_pay_period_deduction
attributes.description: Employee's benefit premium deduction amount per payroll cycle. Derived from the annual employee contribution divided by the number of pay periods; stored here as the operational payroll deduction value. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan elected by the employee. Covers medical, dental, vision, retirement savings (401k), life insurance, disability, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA), and Employee Assistance Program (EAP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|401k|life_insurance|disability|fsa|hsa|eap — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; IRS Publication 15-B; ERISA

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar or fiscal year for which this benefit enrollment is in effect (e.g., 2024). Used for annual benefits cost reporting, ACA employer mandate compliance, and year-over-year total rewards analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; IRS Form 1095-C; ACA (Affordable Care Act)

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualifying life event occurred that triggered the mid-year enrollment change. Required for IRS compliance validation of the 30/60-day election window.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Rules; ERISA Section 603

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_type
attributes.description: Type of qualifying life event (QLE) that triggered a mid-year enrollment change outside of open enrollment. Applicable only when enrollment_source is qualifying_life_event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|divorce|birth|adoption|death|loss_of_coverage|relocation|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Rules; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; ERISA Section 603

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_rate
attributes.description: Employee's elected contribution rate as a percentage of gross pay for 401k or other retirement savings plan enrollment. Stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.0600 = 6%). Applicable only to retirement plan type enrollments.
attributes.references: IRS Section 401(k); ERISA; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

attributes.name: safe_harbor_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Safe Harbor Code
attributes.description: IRS-defined safe harbor code for ACA Form 1095-C Line 16 reporting, indicating the reason an employer shared responsibility payment may not apply (e.g., employee not employed, enrolled in coverage, not full-time). Values correspond to IRS ACA safe harbor codes (2A through 2F).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1095-C Line 16; ACA (Affordable Care Act) Section 4980H; IRS Instructions for Forms 1094-C and 1095-C

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit coverage ends for the employee. Populated upon voluntary waiver, employment termination, or plan discontinuation. Null for currently active enrollments.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module; COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act); ERISA

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the employee for waiving (opting out of) a benefit plan. Required for ACA minimum essential coverage (MEC) compliance tracking and workforce analytics. Populated only when enrollment_status is waived. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: covered_by_spouse|covered_by_parent|other_employer_coverage|military_coverage|medicare|medicaid|voluntary_waiver — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACA (Affordable Care Act) Section 4980H; IRS Form 1095-C; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

attributes.name: wellness_program_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has enrolled in Sports Entertainment's wellness program in conjunction with this benefit plan. Wellness participation may affect premium discounts under ACA-compliant wellness incentive programs.
attributes.references: ACA (Affordable Care Act) Section 2705; HIPAA Wellness Program Regulations; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Module

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Employee leave and absence request record managing all time-off events at Sports Entertainment. Captures leave type (FMLA, PTO, sick, bereavement, jury duty, military, parental, event-day comp time), request date, leave start date, leave end date, approved hours/days, approval status, approving manager, FMLA eligibility flag, intermittent leave flag, and return-to-work date. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance. Supports FMLA compliance, absence trend analysis, and event staffing gap identification.

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each leave and absence request record in SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance. Primary key for the leave_request data product.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce employee record of the direct manager or HR delegate responsible for approving or denying this leave request. Used for approval workflow routing and absence accountability.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: employment_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employment_contract. Business justification: Leave entitlements — FMLA eligibility, paid leave treatment, CBA-governed leave provisions — are defined in the employment contract. Linking leave_request.employment_contract_id → employment_contract.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to a specific sports or entertainment event in the event domain that this leave request may impact. Populated when the leave overlaps with a scheduled event requiring the employee's role (e.g., game day, concert, broadcast). Supports event staffing gap identification.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; Event Domain SSOT

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to a specific sports or entertainment event in the event domain that this leave request may impact. Populated when the leave overlaps with a scheduled event requiring the employee's role (e.g., game day, concert, broadcast). Supports event staffing gap identification.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; Event Domain SSOT

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: leave_request stores department_code as a denormalized string. Replacing with org_unit_id → org_unit.org_unit_id normalizes the organizational context of the leave, enabling org-level absence reportin
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: leave_request currently stores job_position_code as a denormalized string. Replacing with position_id → position.position_id normalizes the position reference, enabling leave impact analysis by positi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_leave_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce employee record in SAP SuccessFactors for whom this leave request is submitted. Links to the employee master in the workforce domain.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: tertiary_leave_backfill_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce employee record of the individual assigned to cover the absent employee's duties during the leave period. Null if no backfill has been assigned or if backfill_required = False.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: ada_accommodation_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Accommodation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave request is associated with an ADA reasonable accommodation request. True = ADA accommodation process initiated; False = no ADA accommodation required. Triggers the interactive process with HR and legal for venue and operational role accommodations.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); EEOC (Equal Employment Opportunity Commission)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the approving manager or HR delegate formally approved or denied the leave request. Used to measure approval turnaround time and ensure timely FMLA designation notice (within 5 business days of sufficient information).
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.300; SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the leave request through the HR approval lifecycle. PENDING indicates awaiting manager action; APPROVED indicates authorized absence; DENIED indicates rejected by manager or HR; CANCELLED indicates voided before start; IN_REVIEW indicates escalated to HR; WITHDRAWN indicates employee-initiated cancellation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: approved_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar or working days approved for this leave request, expressed as a decimal to accommodate partial-day approvals. Used for absence trend analysis, payroll deduction calculations, and FMLA entitlement tracking (12-week annual cap).
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: approved_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours approved for this leave request. Used for intermittent FMLA tracking (where leave is taken in hourly increments), part-time employee proration, and event-day comp time calculations for broadcast crews and event staff.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: backfill_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temporary replacement or backfill resource must be sourced to cover the employee's responsibilities during the leave period. True = backfill needed; False = coverage not required. Triggers workforce planning and contingent labor procurement workflows.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM; OSHA (venue safety staffing minimums)

attributes.name: cba_agreement_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement governing the employee's leave entitlements and conditions. Null for non-union employees. Ensures leave terms are applied per the correct union contract (e.g., broadcast crew union, venue operations union).
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NLRA (National Labor Relations Act)

attributes.name: certification_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the employee must submit required medical certification documentation to HR. Typically 15 calendar days from the date HR requests certification per FMLA regulations. Null when certification is not required.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.305

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Controlling cost center code associated with the employee's organizational unit at the time of the leave request. Used for financial impact allocation of paid leave costs and absence-related overtime backfill expenses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this leave request record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation provided by the approving manager or HR when a leave request is denied. Null when approval_status is not DENIED. Required for CBA grievance defense and FMLA interference claim mitigation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: INSUFFICIENT_NOTICE|INSUFFICIENT_DOCUMENTATION|OPERATIONAL_NEED|INELIGIBLE|DUPLICATE_REQUEST|POLICY_VIOLATION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); EEOC (Equal Employment Opportunity Commission)

attributes.name: employee_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the employee at the time of submission providing additional context for the leave request. Confidential HR data. Must not contain PHI (medical details should be captured via formal certification process only). Restricted to HR and the approving manager.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; CCPA; SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: employee_work_schedule
attributes.description: Work schedule classification of the employee at the time of the leave request. Determines applicable leave entitlements, proration rules, and staffing gap impact. Covers full-time staff, part-time event crew, broadcast crews, league officials, and seasonal workers per the workforce domain scope.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HCM; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); OSHA

attributes.name: fmla_designation_notice_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Designation Notice Date
attributes.description: The date on which HR issued the FMLA Designation Notice (WH-382) to the employee, confirming whether the leave qualifies as FMLA-protected. Must be issued within 5 business days of receiving sufficient information per DOL regulations. Null for non-FMLA leave types.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.300; DOL WH-382

attributes.name: fmla_hours_used
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Hours Used
attributes.description: Cumulative FMLA-designated hours consumed by this specific leave request against the employee's annual 480-hour (12-week) FMLA entitlement. Populated only when is_fmla_eligible = True. Used for FMLA entitlement balance tracking and DOL compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825; DOL (Department of Labor)

attributes.name: hr_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by HR personnel during the review and processing of the leave request. May include documentation status, escalation notes, or compliance observations. Confidential HR data restricted to HR personnel only.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; CCPA; SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: is_fmla_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Eligibility Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee meets FMLA eligibility criteria at the time of the request: employed for at least 12 months, worked 1,250 hours in the prior 12 months, and works at a location with 50+ employees within 75 miles. True = eligible; False = not eligible. Drives FMLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825

attributes.name: is_intermittent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave is taken intermittently (in separate blocks of time or by reducing the normal work schedule) rather than as a continuous absence. True = intermittent leave; False = continuous leave. Intermittent FMLA requires separate hourly tracking and is common for chronic conditions among event-day staff.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.202

attributes.name: is_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved leave is compensated (paid) or uncompensated (unpaid). True = paid leave; False = unpaid leave. Drives payroll processing in SAP SuccessFactors and determines whether PTO balance is decremented.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: jury_duty_court_name
attributes.description: Name of the court or tribunal issuing the jury summons for jury duty leave requests. Null for non-jury-duty leave types. Used to validate the legitimacy of the jury duty claim and for payroll differential calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: leave_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date on which the employee is scheduled to be absent under this leave request. Null for open-ended leaves pending medical certification. Used to calculate approved leave duration and plan workforce coverage.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act)

attributes.name: leave_reason
attributes.description: General business reason or description provided by the employee for the leave request. Kept at a high level to avoid PHI exposure (e.g., 'personal medical', 'family care', 'military deployment'). Confidential HR data restricted to HR personnel and the approving manager. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PERSONAL_MEDICAL|FAMILY_CARE|MILITARY_DEPLOYMENT|BEREAVEMENT|CIVIC_DUTY|PARENTAL_BONDING|PERSONAL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; CCPA; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act)

attributes.name: leave_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date on which the employee is scheduled to be absent under this leave request. Used for event staffing gap analysis and payroll processing.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act)

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave category as defined by HR policy and applicable labor law. Values include: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act), PTO (Paid Time Off), SICK, BEREAVEMENT, JURY_DUTY, MILITARY, PARENTAL, COMP_TIME (event-day compensatory time). Drives eligibility rules, pay treatment, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FMLA|PTO|SICK|BEREAVEMENT|JURY_DUTY|MILITARY|PARENTAL|COMP_TIME — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); OSHA; SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: medical_certification_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required medical certification documentation has been received and accepted by HR. True = received; False = pending or not received. Used to track FMLA compliance deadlines (employee has 15 calendar days to provide certification).
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.305

attributes.name: medical_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical certification form (e.g., FMLA WH-380-E or WH-380-F) is required to support this leave request. True = certification required; False = not required. Drives HR compliance workflow and document collection tracking.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) WH-380; DOL (Department of Labor)

attributes.name: military_order_number
attributes.description: Official military deployment order number provided by the employee to support a military leave request under USERRA (Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act). Null for non-military leave types. Confidential HR document reference.
attributes.references: USERRA (Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act); FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act)

attributes.name: pay_treatment
attributes.description: Specifies the compensation treatment applied during the leave period. FULL_PAY = 100% salary continuation; PARTIAL_PAY = reduced pay per policy or CBA; UNPAID = no compensation; STD = Short-Term Disability benefit; LTD = Long-Term Disability benefit. Used by payroll to apply correct earnings codes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); OSHA

attributes.name: phased_return_plan
attributes.business_glossary_term: Phased Return to Work Plan Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has an approved phased or gradual return-to-work plan following the leave (e.g., reduced hours for first two weeks). True = phased return approved; False = full-duty return. Common for medical and parental leave returns in sports operations.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: pto_hours_deducted
attributes.description: Number of accrued PTO hours deducted from the employee's PTO balance for this leave request. Applicable when leave type is PTO or when employer requires concurrent PTO usage during FMLA leave. Feeds into SAP SuccessFactors leave balance management.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the employee formally submitted the leave request. Used to measure advance notice compliance per CBA and FMLA notice requirements (typically 30-day advance notice for foreseeable leave).
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the leave request, formatted as LR-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in employee communications, manager approvals, and FMLA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act)

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: The confirmed or expected calendar date on which the employee is scheduled to return to active duty following the leave. May differ from leave_end_date + 1 due to weekends, holidays, or phased return arrangements. Critical for event staffing and broadcast crew scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act)

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance to this leave request. Preserved for data lineage, reconciliation, and bi-directional sync between the Silver Layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; Data Governance — Lineage Standards

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone) at which the employee submitted the leave request in SAP SuccessFactors. Serves as the authoritative BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this transaction and is used to enforce advance notice compliance windows.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this leave request record was most recently modified in the Silver Layer data product. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED timestamp for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

products.name: shift_assignment
products.description: Workforce time and attendance record capturing both scheduled shifts and actual hours worked at Sports Entertainment events, venues, and broadcast operations. For scheduling: shift date, start/end time, shift type (event-day, broadcast, venue operations, office, overnight), assigned location, role during shift, scheduled hours. For time reporting: actual hours worked, regular/overtime/double-time breakdown, event-day premium hours, on-call hours, travel time, break deductions. Workflow: timesheet submission date, manager approval status, payroll processing status, overtime flag, no-show flag. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance. Feeds directly into payroll processing and supports CBA overtime compliance, FLSA audit trails, OSHA hours-of-service compliance, and event staffing labor cost tracking.

attributes.name: shift_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shift assignment record in the workforce time and attendance system. Primary key for the shift_assignment data product sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance.

attributes.name: credential_assignment_id

This link supports the pre-shift credential verification workflow, enabling supervisors to

attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; Sports Entertainment Event Management

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Reference to the organizational position or job role the employee is fulfilling during this shift (e.g., Event Coordinator, Broadcast Technician, Venue Security Officer). Drives role-based labor cost allocation.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandise.retail_location. Business justification: Retail merchandise staff shifts are assigned to specific store/kiosk/pop-up locations for labor scheduling, sales-per-labor-hour reporting, and event-day staffing plans. `assigned_location` is a plain

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_staffing_plan. Business justification: Individual security officer shift assignments must be traceable to the event-level security staffing plan they fulfill. This link enables plan-vs-actual headcount reporting, SLA fill-rate tracking aga
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the venue or facility where the shift is performed. Used for venue-level labor cost tracking and OSHA hours-of-service compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual clock-out timestamp recorded when the employee ended the shift. Used to calculate actual hours worked, overtime determination, and FLSA audit trails. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; FLSA 29 CFR Part 785

attributes.name: actual_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total compensable hours worked during the shift after deducting unpaid break time. Feeds directly into payroll processing. Supports FLSA audit trails and CBA overtime compliance calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; FLSA 29 CFR Part 785

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual clock-in timestamp recorded when the employee began the shift, captured via time clock, mobile check-in, or supervisor entry in SAP SuccessFactors. Used for FLSA audit trails and tardiness tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; FLSA 29 CFR Part 785

attributes.name: assigned_location
attributes.description: Specific location within the venue or facility where the employee is assigned during the shift (e.g., 'Gate 4 Entry', 'Press Box Level 3', 'Broadcast Truck Bay 2', 'Main Office Floor 5'). Supports venue operations management and OSHA safety compliance.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shift assignment. 'scheduled' = shift planned but not yet started; 'confirmed' = employee acknowledged; 'in_progress' = shift actively underway; 'completed' = shift finished and time recorded; 'cancelled' = shift removed before start; 'no_show' = employee did not report. Drives payroll processing and CBA compliance workflows.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; CBA Labor Agreement

attributes.name: break_deduction_hours
attributes.description: Total unpaid break time deducted from gross hours to arrive at compensable actual hours worked. Includes meal breaks and rest periods per FLSA and applicable state labor laws.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 785; OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904

attributes.name: cba_rule_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) provision or rule set applied to this shift for pay calculation (e.g., overtime thresholds, rest period requirements, event-day premiums). Critical for union labor compliance and grievance resolution.
attributes.references: CBA Labor Agreement; NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shift assignment record was first created in SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance. Provides audit trail for record provenance and SOX financial controls. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the hourly rate and labor cost amounts on this shift record (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Supports multi-currency payroll for international league operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI)

attributes.name: double_time_hours
attributes.description: Hours worked at 2x the regular pay rate, typically triggered by CBA provisions for extended shifts, consecutive days worked, or specific event-day conditions. Feeds into payroll processing and labor cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; CBA Labor Agreement

attributes.name: event_day_premium_hours
attributes.description: Hours eligible for event-day premium pay as defined in CBA agreements for staff working live sports or entertainment events. Distinct from standard overtime; reflects sports-entertainment industry-specific compensation structures.
attributes.references: CBA Labor Agreement; SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: FLSA exemption classification for the employee on this shift. Determines whether overtime pay provisions apply. 'non_exempt' employees are entitled to FLSA overtime protections; exempt categories are not. Required for FLSA audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 541; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: Employee's base hourly compensation rate applicable to this shift in local currency. Used as the base for regular, overtime, and double-time pay calculations. Classified as confidential financial data.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; CBA Labor Agreement; FLSA 29 CFR Part 778

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total gross labor cost for this shift assignment calculated as actual hours worked multiplied by applicable pay rates (regular + overtime + double-time + premiums). Feeds event staffing labor cost tracking and EBITDA reporting via SAP S/4HANA CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: manager_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the timesheet for this shift. 'pending' = awaiting manager review; 'approved' = manager confirmed hours; 'rejected' = returned for correction; 'escalated' = routed to HR or payroll for exception handling. Required for payroll processing gate.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: manager_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manager approved or rejected the timesheet for this shift. Provides audit trail for SOX financial controls and payroll processing compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: no_show_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee failed to report for a scheduled shift without prior notification. True when assignment_status = 'no_show'. Triggers HR attendance management workflows and may affect CBA disciplinary provisions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; CBA Labor Agreement

attributes.name: on_call_hours
attributes.description: Hours the employee was designated on-call and available for deployment, compensated per CBA on-call provisions. Common for broadcast crews, medical staff, and event operations personnel.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; FLSA 29 CFR Part 785; CBA Labor Agreement

attributes.name: osha_hours_of_service_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: OSHA Hours of Service Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift triggers an OSHA hours-of-service review due to extended duration, insufficient rest between shifts, or hazardous work environment conditions. True when OSHA thresholds are approached or exceeded.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; OSHA General Duty Clause Section 5(a)(1)

attributes.name: overtime_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift contains overtime hours requiring premium pay calculation. True when overtime_hours > 0. Used as a quick filter for CBA overtime compliance reporting and payroll exception management.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 778; CBA Labor Agreement

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Hours worked beyond the standard threshold (typically 8 hours/day or 40 hours/week) compensated at 1.5x the regular rate per FLSA and CBA provisions. Critical for payroll accuracy and CBA overtime compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; FLSA 29 CFR Part 778; CBA Labor Agreement

attributes.name: pay_grade_code
attributes.description: Pay grade or compensation band code applicable to the employee for this shift, sourced from SAP SuccessFactors compensation management. Determines base hourly rate for payroll calculation. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Management; CBA Labor Agreement

attributes.name: payroll_period
attributes.description: Payroll period identifier to which this shift record is assigned for compensation processing (e.g., '2024-11-W2' for bi-weekly or '2024-11-M' for monthly). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA payroll run cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Payroll; SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance

attributes.name: payroll_processing_status
attributes.description: Status of this shift record within the payroll processing pipeline. 'not_submitted' = pending manager approval; 'submitted' = sent to payroll; 'processed' = included in payroll run; 'on_hold' = flagged for manual review; 'error' = processing failure requiring correction. Feeds SAP S/4HANA FI payroll integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Hours worked at the standard straight-time pay rate, not exceeding the CBA or FLSA threshold for overtime. Component of the pay calculation triplet (regular + overtime + double-time = actual hours worked).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; FLSA 29 CFR Part 778; CBA Labor Agreement

attributes.name: role_during_shift
attributes.description: Specific functional role the employee performs during this shift (e.g., 'Head Usher', 'Broadcast Director', 'Security Supervisor', 'Concessions Lead'). May differ from the employee's primary position for cross-trained or flex-deployed staff.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Planned end date and time of the shift as defined in the workforce schedule. Used to calculate scheduled hours, identify overtime risk, and plan event-day crew rotations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time and Attendance; CBA Labor Agreement

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the employee is scheduled to work during this shift, derived from scheduled start and end times minus planned breaks. Used for pre-event labor cost forecasting and CBA compliance checks.

products.name: position_cost_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the funding contract between a position and a cost center in Sports Entertainment's workforce and financial planning model. It captures the split-funding arrangement by which a position's labor costs are distributed across one or more cost centers at defined allocation percentages and effective date ranges. Each record links one position to one cost center with attributes — allocation percentage, effective dates, budget approval status, headcount plan year, and pay grade — that exist only in the context of this specific position-to-cost-center funding relationship. Sourced from SAP CO labor distribution and SuccessFactors Position Management.. Existence Justification: In Sports Entertainment organizations, positions are routinely split-funded across multiple cost centers — e.g., a Head of Broadcast Operations charged 60% to the Broadcast Production cost center and 40% to the Venue Operations cost center. Conversely, each cost center funds multiple positions simultaneously. This split-funding arrangement is an actively managed operational record with its own attributes (allocation percentage, effective dates, budget approval status) that belong to neither the position nor the cost center alone.

products.name: jurisdiction_license
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory licensing contract between an employee and a gaming jurisdiction. It captures the specific license or authorization held by an individual workforce member within a given gaming regulatory jurisdiction, including their assigned compliance role, the jurisdiction-issued license number, the effective and expiry dates of the authorization, and the current license status. Each record is an independently managed compliance artifact — created when a license application is approved, updated on renewal or status change, and retired on expiry or revocation. This is the SSOT for employee-level gaming regulatory authorization across all jurisdictions.. Existence Justification: In Sports Entertainment's gaming compliance operations, specific employees (compliance officers, legal counsel, regulatory affairs staff) hold individual licenses or authorizations in multiple gaming jurisdictions simultaneously (e.g., NJ, PA, NV, CO), and each jurisdiction has multiple licensed employees operating within it. This is an actively managed operational relationship — the business must track which employee is licensed in which jurisdiction, under what role, with what license number, effective dates, and current status. This is not derivable from transactional data; it is a directly managed compliance record.
