attributes.description: The number of minutes of inactivity after which a fan session on this digital touchpoint is automatically terminated. Configurable per platform type and SLA tier. Drives security compliance and PCI-DSS session management requirements.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS v4.0 — Requirement 8.2.8 (Session Idle Timeout); GDPR Article 32

attributes.name: supported_languages
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of BCP-47 language codes supported by this digital touchpoint for UI localization (e.g., 'en-US, es-MX, fr-FR, pt-BR'). Drives content localization workflows, fan experience personalization, and international market expansion planning.
attributes.references: BCP-47 Language Tags (IETF RFC 5646); Adobe Experience Platform — Localization

attributes.name: supported_os_versions
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of operating system versions officially supported by this touchpoint (e.g., 'iOS 16+, iOS 17' or 'Android 12, Android 13, Android 14'). Null for non-mobile/non-OS-dependent platforms. Used for compatibility testing and fan support triage.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Connect Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of ISO 3166-1 country or region codes defining the geographic markets in which this IP asset is licensed for display on this touchpoint. Supports geo-restriction enforcement at the channel level.
attributes.references: Identified in detection phase relationship_data

attributes.name: ticketing_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this digital touchpoint supports ticket browsing, purchase, and mobile ticket delivery. Drives integration with Ticketmaster/AXS ticketing systems and determines PCI-DSS payment scope for the channel.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS — Channel Integration Standards; PCI-DSS v4.0

attributes.name: touchpoint_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code assigned to the digital channel (e.g., TP-IOSAPP-001, TP-WEBPRT-002). Used as the business identifier across all domain attribution and reporting. Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform channel configuration.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Channel Configuration Standards

attributes.name: touchpoint_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the digital channel (e.g., 'Sports Entertainment iOS App', 'Fan Web Portal', 'OTT Streaming Player — Roku'). Used in dashboards, SLA reports, and omnichannel orchestration configurations.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Channel Taxonomy

attributes.name: touchpoint_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the digital channel. 'active' indicates the channel is live and serving fans; 'maintenance' indicates scheduled downtime; 'deprecated' indicates the channel is being sunset; 'pilot' indicates limited-release testing. Drives SLA monitoring and omnichannel routing decisions.
attributes.references: SLA (Service Level Agreement) Operations Framework; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this digital touchpoint record was most recently modified in the platform registry. Follows ISO 8601 format. Used for change detection in downstream ETL pipelines, audit compliance, and SLA configuration drift monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and Time Representation; SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act (Audit Trail Requirements)

attributes.name: uptime_target_pct
attributes.description: The contractually committed or operationally targeted uptime percentage for this digital touchpoint (e.g., 99.95). Expressed as a percentage. Used in SLA compliance reporting and infrastructure capacity planning.
attributes.references: SLA (Service Level Agreement) Operations Framework; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: usage_type
attributes.description: Describes how the IP asset is used on the digital touchpoint — e.g., as a display brand mark, watermark, authentication screen logo, or in-content overlay. Belongs to the license grant, not to either entity alone.
attributes.references: Identified in detection phase relationship_data

products.name: fan_account
products.description: Platform-layer account representing a registered fan's digital identity on Sports Entertainment properties. Owns authentication credentials, account status (active/suspended/deactivated/merged), linked identity providers (SSO, social login, Apple/Google), account tier (free/premium/VIP), subscription flags, ARPU baseline, LTV score bucket, CAC attribution source, device limit policy, and omnichannel consent preference summary. Distinct from the fan domain's CRM profile — this entity owns the digital access layer, commercial relationship metrics, and platform-level account governance.

attributes.name: fan_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the fan's digital platform account on Sports Entertainment properties. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 - Data Element Naming and Identification

attributes.name: data_controller_corporate_entity_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Controller Corporate Entity Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to legal.corporate_entity. Business justification: Fan accounts are held with a specific corporate entity acting as GDPR data controller or CCPA business. Legal and privacy teams must identify the contracting corporate entity per fan account for data
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: merged_into_account_fan_account_id
attributes.description: When account_status is 'merged', this field holds the platform_fan_account_id of the surviving/target account into which this account was consolidated. Enables identity resolution lineage tracking and prevents duplicate fan profiles in analytics.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Identity Resolution Policy; Adobe Experience Platform Identity Graph

attributes.name: preferred_franchise_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to league.franchise. Business justification: Fan accounts track team affiliation as a primary personalization, ticketing, and loyalty signal. preferred_team_code is a denormalized franchise reference. Replacing it with preferred_franchise_id ena
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: account_deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fan account was deactivated (fan-initiated or admin-initiated). Null for active accounts. Used for GDPR right-to-erasure scheduling, data retention policy enforcement, and churn cohort analysis.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; Sports Entertainment Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fan's platform account. 'active' — fully operational; 'suspended' — temporarily restricted (e.g., fraud hold, payment failure); 'deactivated' — fan-initiated or admin closure; 'merged' — consolidated into another account; 'pending_verification' — awaiting email or identity confirmation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; Sports Entertainment Platform Governance Policy

attributes.name: account_suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the current or most recent account suspension. Populated only when account_status is 'suspended'. Used for customer service case management, fraud operations, and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Platform Governance Policy; PCI DSS Requirement 10 (audit logs)

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Commercial tier of the fan's platform account governing feature entitlements, content access, and service levels. 'free' — basic access; 'premium' — paid subscription with enhanced content and features; 'vip' — highest tier with exclusive benefits, hospitality entitlements, and dedicated support.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Fan Engagement and Personalization Policy; Adobe Experience Platform Audience Segmentation

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fan account by the nature of the registrant. 'individual' covers standard adult fans; 'corporate' covers business/hospitality accounts; 'youth' covers under-18 accounts subject to COPPA/GDPR-K restrictions; 'family' covers linked household accounts.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8 (child consent); CCPA; Sports Entertainment Platform Account Policy

attributes.name: active_device_count
attributes.description: Current count of registered/active devices linked to this fan account. Compared against device_limit to enforce concurrent streaming restrictions and flag potential account sharing violations.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment DRM Policy; OTT Platform Device Management

attributes.name: aep_profile_reference
attributes.description: Unified profile identifier assigned by Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) for this fan, enabling real-time personalization, audience segmentation, and cross-channel activation across Sports Entertainment digital properties.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Real-Time Customer Profile; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: arpu_baseline_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) Baseline Amount
attributes.description: The baseline Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) figure in the platform's operating currency, representing the fan's average monthly revenue contribution across all digital channels (subscriptions, DTC purchases, PPV events). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD module and used as a KPI baseline for digital performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD (Sales and Distribution); Sports Entertainment Digital KPI Framework; ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) Standard

attributes.name: cac_source
attributes.description: The marketing channel or campaign source attributed to acquiring this fan account, used for Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) analysis and Return on Investment (ROI) reporting. Examples: 'organic_search', 'paid_social', 'email_campaign', 'referral', 'event_activation', 'dtc_app_store'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic_search|paid_social|email_campaign|referral|event_activation|dtc_app_store|affiliate|direct — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Attribution; Sports Entertainment Marketing Analytics Policy; DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) Strategy

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has exercised their CCPA right to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information. When true, the fan's data must not be included in any third-party data sale or sharing activation.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.120; Sports Entertainment Privacy Compliance Policy

attributes.name: consent_data_sharing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has consented to sharing their behavioural and profile data with Sports Entertainment's commercial partners (sponsors, broadcasters, merchandise partners) for personalization and targeted advertising. Governs data activation in Adobe Experience Platform audience segments.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 and Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; Sports Entertainment Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: consent_marketing_email
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive marketing email communications from Sports Entertainment. Required for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis and CAN-SPAM compliance. Drives Salesforce CRM email campaign eligibility.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 and Article 7; CAN-SPAM Act; CCPA Section 1798.120; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: consent_push_notification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has granted permission for push notifications on their registered mobile devices. Governs mobile app engagement campaigns, live event alerts, and personalized content recommendations via the Sports Entertainment mobile platform.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: consent_recorded_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fan's most recent consent preferences were captured or updated. Provides the audit trail required by GDPR Article 7(1) to demonstrate that consent was freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); CCPA Section 1798.120; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the fan's registered location. Used for geo-based broadcast rights enforcement (RSN blackouts, DRM geo-restrictions), GDPR/CCPA jurisdiction determination, and regional content licensing compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3 (territorial scope); CCPA; FCC Broadcast Regulation; DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the platform fan account record was first created in the system. Serves as the authoritative audit creation marker for data lineage, GDPR processing records, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; ISO/IEC 27001; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the fan account's billing and revenue currency (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Supports multi-currency ARPU and LTV reporting across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting)

attributes.name: device_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of concurrent devices permitted to stream or access content under this fan account, as defined by the account tier's entitlement policy. Enforced at the platform session management layer to comply with broadcast rights and DRM licensing terms.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy; FCC Broadcast Regulation; OTT Platform SLA

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The fan-chosen display name or username shown across digital touchpoints including the mobile app, web portal, and fan engagement platform. May differ from the legal name held in the CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: dtc_channel_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fan account was acquired or is primarily engaged through a Direct-To-Consumer (DTC) digital channel (e.g., Sports Entertainment's own app or web portal) as opposed to a third-party platform or RSN. Key segmentation flag for DTC strategy performance reporting.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) Strategy; Adobe Experience Platform Channel Attribution

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary email address associated with the fan's platform account. Used for authentication, transactional notifications, marketing communications, and identity resolution across Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; PCI DSS Requirement 3

attributes.name: external_account_ref
attributes.description: Externally-known account identifier surfaced to the fan across digital touchpoints (e.g., displayed in the fan portal, mobile app, and Adobe Experience Platform profile). Serves as the business-facing account number distinct from the internal surrogate key.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Identity Namespace; Salesforce CRM Account Object

attributes.name: gdpr_data_subject_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Subject Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fan account is subject to GDPR regulations based on their registered country or detected location. When true, GDPR-specific data handling, consent management, and right-to-erasure workflows are enforced.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 (territorial scope); GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure); Sports Entertainment Data Privacy Policy

attributes.name: identity_provider
attributes.description: The authentication identity provider (IdP) used to create or link this fan account. 'native' — Sports Entertainment-managed credentials; 'google'/'apple'/'facebook'/'twitter' — social login OAuth providers; 'sso_enterprise' — corporate SSO for B2B/hospitality accounts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: native|google|apple|facebook|twitter|sso_enterprise|microsoft — promote to reference product if additional providers are onboarded]
attributes.references: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect (OIDC) Standard; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: is_email_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has completed email address verification via a confirmation link or OTP. Unverified accounts may have restricted access to ticketing, payments, and premium content per platform policy.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Platform Account Verification Policy; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: is_mfa_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan has enrolled in Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for their platform account. MFA enrollment is required for VIP-tier accounts and recommended for all accounts with stored payment methods per PCI DSS requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 8.3; NIST SP 800-63B; Sports Entertainment Platform Security Policy

attributes.name: is_subscription_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan currently holds an active paid subscription (premium or VIP tier) on the Sports Entertainment platform. Drives content entitlement checks, OTT access gates, and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) reporting.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Subscription and Entitlement Policy; SEC Financial Reporting (ARR disclosure)

attributes.name: last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the fan's most recent successful authentication event on any Sports Entertainment digital property (web portal, mobile app, OTT platform). Key signal for churn prediction, re-engagement campaigns, and dormant account governance.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Behavioral Data; GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation — retained per retention policy)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to any field on this platform fan account record. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trails, and data freshness monitoring in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; ISO/IEC 27001; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: linked_season_ticket_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this platform fan account is linked to one or more season ticket accounts in the Archtics venue seating and inventory management system. Enables cross-domain fan identity resolution between the digital platform and ticketing systems.
attributes.references: Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management; Ticketmaster/AXS Ticketing and Access Control

attributes.name: ltv_score_bucket
attributes.description: Categorical Lifetime Value (LTV) score bucket assigned to the fan account based on predictive modelling in Adobe Experience Platform. 'low' — minimal engagement/spend; 'medium' — moderate; 'high' — strong recurring revenue; 'champion' — top-tier fans with highest LTV and advocacy potential. Used for personalization, offer targeting, and retention investment prioritization.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Predictive Scoring; Sports Entertainment Fan Analytics Policy; LTV (Lifetime Value) Framework

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recently recorded Net Promoter Score (NPS) for this fan, captured via post-event or periodic surveys. Ranges from -100 to 100. Used as a KPI for fan satisfaction, loyalty programme design, and digital experience improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: NPS (Net Promoter Score) Methodology; Sports Entertainment Fan Experience KPI Framework

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS survey response was recorded for this fan. Used to determine survey recency, avoid survey fatigue (minimum interval enforcement), and align NPS trends with event or campaign timelines.
attributes.references: NPS (Net Promoter Score) Methodology; Sports Entertainment Fan Engagement Policy

attributes.name: ppv_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fan account is eligible to purchase Pay-Per-View (PPV) events based on account tier, verified payment method, geographic rights, and age verification status. Drives PPV purchase flow gating on the OTT platform.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment PPV (Pay-Per-View) Entitlement Policy; FCC Broadcast Regulation; DRM Policy

attributes.name: preferred_locale
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code representing the fan's preferred language and regional format settings (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_FR', 'es_MX'). Drives content localization, notification language, and regional broadcast rights enforcement across OTT and digital platforms.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; GDPR Article 12 (communication in clear language); Sports Entertainment Localization Policy

attributes.name: preferred_sport
attributes.description: The fan's self-declared or algorithmically inferred primary sport preference (e.g., 'football', 'basketball', 'soccer', 'baseball'). Drives content personalization, event recommendations, and audience segmentation in Adobe Experience Platform for targeted sponsorship activations.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Fan Segmentation; Sports Entertainment Personalization Engine Policy

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the fan completed account registration on the Sports Entertainment digital platform. Used for cohort analysis, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) attribution, and Lifetime Value (LTV) baseline calculations.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Digital Platform Onboarding Policy; GDPR Article 30 (records of processing)

attributes.name: salesforce_contact_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier linking this platform account to the corresponding Contact record in Salesforce CRM, enabling omnichannel fan relationship management and CRM-driven personalization.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Fan and Sponsor Relationship Management

attributes.name: subscription_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fan's current subscription period expires or is scheduled to renew. Null for open-ended or auto-renewing subscriptions until cancellation is confirmed. Drives renewal notifications and churn risk flagging.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Subscription Billing Policy; SEC Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

attributes.name: subscription_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific subscription plan the fan is enrolled in (e.g., 'PREMIUM_MONTHLY', 'VIP_ANNUAL', 'OTT_BUNDLE'). Maps to the subscription plan catalogue managed in the platform billing system and drives entitlement resolution.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Subscription Plan Catalogue; OTT (Over-The-Top Streaming) Platform Policy

attributes.name: subscription_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fan's current subscription period commenced. Used for billing cycle management, renewal scheduling, and cohort-based Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) analysis.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Subscription Billing Policy; SEC Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

products.name: auth_session
products.description: Transactional record of each authenticated fan session across digital touchpoints. Captures session token, authentication method (password, SSO, biometric, social OAuth), device fingerprint, IP geolocation, session start/end timestamps, touchpoint channel, MFA status, session termination reason (logout, timeout, forced), and GDPR/CCPA consent version acknowledged at login. Supports SLA monitoring, fraud investigation, and GDPR right-to-erasure audit trails.

attributes.name: auth_session_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each authenticated fan session record across all digital touchpoints. Primary key for the auth_session data product.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 – Information Security Management

attributes.name: digital_touchpoint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.digital_touchpoint. Business justification: Every authenticated session occurs on a specific digital touchpoint (mobile app, web portal, etc.). auth_session.touchpoint_channel is a denormalized STRING; replacing it with digital_touchpoint_id FK
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: fan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific digital platform instance (e.g., NFL App, NBA League Pass, Sports Entertainment Fan Portal) through which the session was initiated. Supports multi-platform SLA monitoring and platform-level engagement analytics.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Digital Platform Architecture; Adobe Experience Platform – Property Configuration

attributes.name: fan_fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated fan (registered user) who initiated this session. Links to the fan master record in Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform fan profile.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM – Fan Profile Object

attributes.name: fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated fan (registered user) who initiated this session. Links to the fan master record in Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform fan profile.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM – Fan Profile Object

attributes.name: platform_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific digital platform instance (e.g., NFL App, NBA League Pass, Sports Entertainment Fan Portal) through which the session was initiated. Supports multi-platform SLA monitoring and platform-level engagement analytics.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Digital Platform Architecture; Adobe Experience Platform – Property Configuration

attributes.name: privacy_request_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier of a GDPR right-to-erasure or CCPA deletion request that triggered session invalidation or data suppression for this record. Null if no erasure request applies. Supports regulatory compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 – Right to Erasure; CCPA §1798.105 – Right to Delete

attributes.name: app_version
attributes.description: The version of the Sports Entertainment mobile app or web portal client used during the session (semantic versioning format, e.g., 4.2.1). Supports release impact analysis, bug triage, and forced-upgrade policy enforcement.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Digital Platform Release Management Policy

attributes.name: auth_method
attributes.description: The mechanism used by the fan to authenticate at session initiation. Includes password-based login, Single Sign-On (SSO) via identity provider, biometric (fingerprint/face), social OAuth (Google, Apple, Facebook), magic link email, or passkey (FIDO2). Supports fraud analysis and authentication method adoption reporting.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B – Digital Identity Guidelines; GDPR Article 32

attributes.name: ccpa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Applicability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether CCPA regulations apply to this session based on the fan's geolocation (California, USA). Drives downstream opt-out enforcement and consumer rights request workflows.
attributes.references: CCPA §1798.100; California Attorney General CCPA Regulations

attributes.name: concurrent_session_count
attributes.description: The number of active sessions for the same fan account at the time this session was initiated. Used to enforce concurrent session limits (e.g., OTT streaming entitlement enforcement), detect credential sharing, and support fraud investigation.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment OTT (Over-The-Top Streaming) Platform Policy; PCI DSS v4.0 – Requirement 8

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (UTC) when the fan acknowledged the privacy consent notice during this session's login flow. Provides an immutable audit record for GDPR and CCPA compliance and right-to-erasure investigations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 30 – Records of Processing Activities; CCPA §1798.100

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the privacy consent notice (GDPR/CCPA) that the fan acknowledged at the time of login for this session (e.g., 'v3.2-GDPR', 'v2.1-CCPA'). Critical for GDPR right-to-erasure audit trails and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 – Conditions for Consent; CCPA §1798.100; GDPR Article 17 – Right to Erasure

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this auth_session record was first written to the Silver Layer data store. Distinct from session_start_timestamp which records the business event time. Used for data lineage, ETL audit, and SLA compliance on data freshness.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 – Audit Logging; Sports Entertainment Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: device_fingerprint
attributes.description: A hashed composite identifier derived from device hardware and software attributes (OS, browser, screen resolution, etc.) used to recognize returning devices without persistent cookies. Supports fraud investigation and concurrent session detection. Stored as a one-way hash; not reversible to raw device attributes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 – Personal Data Definition; CCPA §1798.140; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: device_os
attributes.description: The operating system of the device used during the session (e.g., iOS 17.2, Android 14, Windows 11, macOS 14). Supports platform compatibility analysis and security vulnerability tracking.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform – Device Context

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of the physical device used to initiate the session. Supports device-level analytics, fraud pattern detection, and platform optimization for fan engagement across digital touchpoints.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform – Device Taxonomy

attributes.name: entitlement_tier
attributes.description: The fan's subscription or access entitlement tier active at the time of session initiation (e.g., free, basic, premium, VIP, enterprise). Determines feature access, content availability, and OTT streaming rights during the session. Supports ARPU segmentation and LTV analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform – Entitlement Management; Sports Entertainment DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) Platform Policy

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: A numeric risk score (0–100) assigned at session initiation by the fraud detection engine based on device fingerprint, IP reputation, behavioral signals, and authentication anomalies. Higher scores indicate greater fraud risk. Supports fraud investigation and adaptive authentication policies.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 – Requirement 10 (Logging and Monitoring); ISO/IEC 27001 – Threat Assessment

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR regulations apply to this session based on the fan's geolocation (geo_country_code within EU/EEA). Drives downstream data processing rules, right-to-erasure workflows, and data residency enforcement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 – Territorial Scope; GDPR Article 17 – Right to Erasure

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code derived from IP geolocation at session start (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for broadcast rights enforcement, GDPR/CCPA jurisdiction determination, and regional fan engagement analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FCC Broadcast Regulation; GDPR Article 3 – Territorial Scope

attributes.name: geo_region
attributes.description: Sub-national region or state derived from IP geolocation (e.g., California, Ontario, Bavaria). Supports CCPA applicability determination, Regional Sports Network (RSN) rights enforcement, and regional fan engagement segmentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; CCPA §1798.100; RSN Rights Distribution Policy

attributes.name: identity_provider_session_reference
attributes.description: The session or correlation identifier issued by the external identity provider (SSO/OAuth) for this authentication event (e.g., Okta session ID, Azure AD correlation ID). Used to correlate Sports Entertainment sessions with IdP audit logs for security investigations.
attributes.references: OAuth 2.0 RFC 6749; OpenID Connect Core 1.0; ISO/IEC 27001 – Audit Logging

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The public IP address of the fan's device at session initiation. Used for geolocation derivation, fraud detection, and broadcast rights geo-restriction enforcement. May constitute personal data under GDPR in EU jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 30 – IP Address as Personal Data; CCPA §1798.140; FCC Broadcast Geo-Restriction Rules

attributes.name: is_bot_suspected
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated bot detection (e.g., CAPTCHA failure, behavioral anomaly scoring) flagged this session as potentially non-human at initiation. Used for fraud investigation, ticket scalping prevention, and platform abuse mitigation.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 – Requirement 6.4 (Web Application Protection); Sports Entertainment Fraud Prevention Policy

attributes.name: is_trusted_device
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device used for this session was previously registered as a trusted device by the fan, enabling reduced friction authentication (e.g., MFA bypass). Supports adaptive authentication and fan experience personalization.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B – Authenticator Assurance; Sports Entertainment Digital Platform Authentication Policy

attributes.name: login_attempt_count
attributes.description: The number of authentication attempts made before this session was successfully established. A value greater than 1 indicates prior failed attempts. Used for brute-force detection, account lockout policy enforcement, and security incident investigation.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B – Authentication Attempt Limits; ISO/IEC 27001 – Access Control

attributes.name: mfa_method
attributes.description: The specific second-factor method used when MFA was required. 'sms_otp' is SMS one-time password; 'email_otp' is email one-time password; 'totp_app' is time-based OTP via authenticator app; 'push_notification' is in-app push approval; 'none' when MFA was not required or bypassed.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; ISO/IEC 27001 – Access Control

attributes.name: mfa_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) was required and the outcome at session initiation. 'not_required' means MFA policy did not apply; 'passed' means MFA challenge was successfully completed; 'failed' means MFA challenge was not completed (session may have been blocked); 'bypassed' means MFA was skipped via trusted device or admin override.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B – Authenticator Assurance Level; GDPR Article 32 – Security of Processing

attributes.name: oauth_scope
attributes.description: The permission scopes granted to the session token during OAuth-based authentication (e.g., 'openid profile email ticketing:read'). Defines what resources and APIs the session is authorized to access. Supports least-privilege access auditing.
attributes.references: OAuth 2.0 RFC 6749 – Scope; GDPR Article 5 – Data Minimisation

attributes.name: referrer_url
attributes.description: The URL or deep-link from which the fan navigated to the authentication page (e.g., a promotional email link, a sponsor landing page, a social media post). Supports fan acquisition attribution, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) analysis, and campaign effectiveness reporting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform – Attribution; Sports Entertainment CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Attribution Policy

attributes.name: session_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total elapsed time in seconds between session_start_timestamp and session_end_timestamp. Null if the session is still active. Used for fan engagement depth analysis, SLA compliance reporting, and Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) correlation studies.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Digital Platform SLA Policy; Adobe Experience Platform – Engagement Metrics

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (UTC) when the session was closed, expired, or terminated. Null if the session is still active. Used to compute session duration and identify abnormally long or short sessions.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: session_invalidation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (UTC) when the session token was explicitly invalidated by a security event (e.g., password reset, admin revocation, GDPR erasure request). Distinct from session_end_timestamp which records normal closure. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure audit trails and security incident timelines.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 – Right to Erasure; ISO/IEC 27001 – Incident Response; OWASP Session Management

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (UTC) when the fan successfully authenticated and the session was established. Principal business event timestamp for SLA measurement and session duration analytics.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 30 – Records of Processing Activities

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the authenticated session. 'active' indicates an ongoing session; 'expired' indicates timeout; 'terminated' indicates explicit logout or forced closure; 'invalidated' indicates security-triggered revocation; 'suspended' indicates temporary hold pending re-authentication.
attributes.references: OWASP Session Management Cheat Sheet; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: session_token
attributes.description: Cryptographically generated bearer token issued at authentication that uniquely identifies the active session. Used for SLA monitoring, fraud investigation, and session continuity across digital touchpoints. Treated as a sensitive identifier per GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: OWASP Session Management Cheat Sheet; GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140

attributes.name: sso_provider
attributes.description: The identity provider used when auth_method is 'sso' or 'social_oauth' (e.g., Google, Apple, Facebook, Microsoft Azure AD, Okta). Null when direct password authentication is used. Supports SSO adoption analytics and identity provider SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: OAuth 2.0 RFC 6749; OpenID Connect Core 1.0; GDPR Article 28 – Processor Agreements

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason the session ended. 'logout' indicates fan-initiated sign-out; 'timeout' indicates inactivity expiry; 'forced' indicates administrative or security-triggered closure; 'token_revoked' indicates the token was invalidated (e.g., password change); 'concurrent_limit' indicates session killed due to concurrent session policy enforcement.
attributes.references: OWASP Session Management Cheat Sheet; GDPR Article 17 – Right to Erasure

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this auth_session record was last modified in the Silver Layer (e.g., when session_end_timestamp or termination_reason was populated upon session closure). Supports data lineage and change tracking.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 – Audit Logging; Sports Entertainment Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The HTTP User-Agent string reported by the fan's browser or app client at session initiation (e.g., 'Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_2...'). Used for device classification, browser compatibility analysis, and fraud pattern detection.
attributes.references: RFC 7231 – HTTP/1.1 Semantics; Adobe Experience Platform – Device Detection

attributes.name: auto_renew
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement is configured to automatically renew upon expiry (e.g., recurring subscription-based entitlements). True = auto-renew enabled; False = one-time or manually renewed. Drives subscription lifecycle management.

attributes.name: concurrent_access_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active sessions permitted under this entitlement (e.g., 1 for PPV single-screen, 3 for family subscription tier). Enforced by the session management layer across mobile, web, and OTT touchpoints.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this entitlement record was first persisted in the platform data store. Used for data lineage, SLA monitoring, and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the entitlement_value_amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency markets and international fan base reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: device_type_restriction
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of device types on which this entitlement may be consumed (e.g., smartphone|tablet|smart_tv|desktop|console). Null indicates no device restriction. Enforced by the DRM and session management layer.

attributes.name: download_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan is permitted to download the entitled content for offline viewing under this entitlement. Governed by the DRM license type and content rights window. True = offline download allowed; False = streaming only.
attributes.references: DRM — Digital Rights Management; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: drm_license_type
attributes.description: The Digital Rights Management (DRM) license scheme applied to this entitlement for content protection. Governs how the content can be decrypted and rendered on the fan's device. Values: widevine (Google/Android), fairplay (Apple), playready (Microsoft), clear (unprotected), multi_drm (adaptive multi-scheme).
attributes.references: DRM — Digital Rights Management; FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date and time from which this entitlement is valid and access may be granted. Aligns with subscription activation, PPV event start, or promotional window open. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: Internal Platform Data Standard; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date and time after which this entitlement expires and access is denied. Null for open-ended entitlements (e.g., lifetime loyalty grants). Used by access control engines to enforce time-bounded access windows.
attributes.references: Internal Platform Data Standard; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: entitlement_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this entitlement record, used in customer communications, support tickets, and access control audit logs. Format: ENT- followed by 6–20 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: entitlement_source_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier from the originating source system that triggered this entitlement (e.g., Ticketmaster order ID for PPV purchase, Salesforce opportunity ID for sponsor grant, promotional code string for marketing campaign). Enables traceability back to the originating transaction.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster / AXS; Salesforce CRM; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the entitlement. Controls whether access is granted at runtime. active=currently valid and accessible; suspended=temporarily blocked; expired=past effective_until date; revoked=administratively cancelled; pending=granted but not yet effective; consumed=single-use entitlement fully used.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; GDPR Article 17; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: entitlement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the source mechanism that granted this entitlement. Drives access control logic and revenue attribution. Values: subscription (recurring tier), ppv_purchase (Pay-Per-View one-time purchase), sponsor_grant (sponsor-funded access), loyalty_milestone (loyalty program reward), promotional_code (marketing promo), complimentary (manually granted). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: subscription|ppv_purchase|sponsor_grant|loyalty_milestone|promotional_code|complimentary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: entitlement_value_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value attributed to this entitlement at the time of grant, expressed in the currency indicated by currency_code. Used for sponsor ROI reporting, ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) analysis, and LTV (Lifetime Value) modelling. For complimentary or loyalty grants, this reflects the fair market value.
attributes.references: ROI — Return on Investment; ARPU — Average Revenue Per User; LTV — Lifetime Value; SAP S/4HANA FI; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: feature_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the platform feature or content capability being entitled. Used for access control routing and analytics segmentation. Values: streaming (live/VOD streams), premium_content (exclusive editorial/library), ticketing (early purchase windows, VIP access), merchandise (exclusive drops), ar_vr (augmented/virtual reality experiences), loyalty (reward redemption). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: streaming|premium_content|ticketing|merchandise|ar_vr|loyalty — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: geo_blackout_code
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this entitlement is explicitly blocked due to broadcast blackout rules or rights restrictions (e.g., RSN blackout zones). Takes precedence over geo_restriction_code.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; RSN — Regional Sports Network; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: geo_restriction_code
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this entitlement is valid (e.g., USA|CAN|GBR). Null indicates no geographic restriction. Enforced at the CDN and OTT access layer to comply with broadcast rights windows and GDPR/CCPA jurisdictional requirements.
attributes.references: FIFA; FCC; GDPR; CCPA; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the effective_until date during which the entitlement remains accessible before hard expiry. Used to accommodate payment retry windows for subscription renewals and to improve fan retention metrics.
attributes.references: Internal Platform Data Standard; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: granted_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world business event timestamp when this entitlement was issued to the fan account — i.e., when the purchase was completed, the loyalty milestone was reached, or the sponsor grant was applied. Distinct from the record audit created timestamp.
attributes.references: Internal Platform Data Standard; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_code
attributes.description: The fan loyalty program tier code at the time this entitlement was granted (e.g., BRONZE, SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM). Populated when entitlement_type is loyalty_milestone. Used for loyalty analytics and milestone validation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, manual override justifications, or support case references associated with this entitlement record. Used by platform operations and fan support teams for case management and audit documentation.
attributes.references: Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: offline_access_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan may access the entitled content or feature while the device is offline (e.g., cached content, offline loyalty wallet). Distinct from download_permitted — covers broader offline capability beyond downloaded files.
attributes.references: Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: parental_rating_code
attributes.description: Content rating classification applied to this entitlement's associated feature or content asset. Used to enforce parental controls and age-gating at the access layer. Follows US broadcast and film rating standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: G|PG|PG-13|R|NC-17|TV-Y|TV-G|TV-PG|TV-14|TV-MA — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: personalization_segment_code
attributes.description: Adobe Experience Platform audience segment code associated with this entitlement, used to drive personalized content recommendations, targeted offers, and omnichannel fan engagement orchestration. Enables DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) personalization at the entitlement level.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; DTC — Direct-To-Consumer; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: promotional_code
attributes.description: The marketing or sponsor promotional code that was redeemed to generate this entitlement. Populated only when entitlement_type is promotional_code. Used for campaign attribution, redemption rate reporting, and sponsor ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: resolution_cap
attributes.description: Maximum video resolution permitted under this entitlement for streaming content. Used to differentiate subscription tiers (e.g., Basic=SD, Premium=4K). Enforced by the CDN and OTT delivery layer.
attributes.references: OTT — Over-The-Top Streaming; CDN — Content Delivery Network; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this entitlement was revoked or suspended. Populated only when entitlement_status is revoked or suspended. Used for compliance audit trails, fraud investigation, and fan support case management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fraud_detected|payment_failure|rights_expired|admin_override|duplicate_grant|policy_violation|fan_request — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; CCPA; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: revoked_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this entitlement was revoked or suspended. Populated only when entitlement_status is revoked or suspended. Used for compliance reporting and fan dispute resolution timelines.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; CCPA; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: sla_tier_code
attributes.description: Service Level Agreement (SLA) tier assigned to this entitlement, governing platform performance guarantees such as stream start time, uptime, and support response time. Values: standard, premium, vip, enterprise. Used for SLA monitoring and breach reporting.
attributes.references: SLA — Service Level Agreement; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement can be transferred or gifted to another fan account. True = transferable (e.g., gifted PPV access, sponsor-granted VIP passes); False = non-transferable (bound to the original fan account). Enforced by the access control engine.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this entitlement record (e.g., status change, usage limit adjustment, geographic restriction update). Used for change tracking and compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Running count of the number of times this entitlement has been consumed or accessed to date. Compared against usage_limit to determine whether the entitlement is exhausted. Updated by the access control engine on each successful access event.
attributes.references: Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: usage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total number of times this entitlement may be consumed or accessed (e.g., 1 for a single-use PPV token, 5 for a multi-use loyalty reward redemption). Null indicates unlimited usage within the effective date window.
attributes.references: Internal Platform Data Standard

attributes.name: breach_penalty_type

attributes.name: counterparty_name

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA policy record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the SLA policy becomes binding and enforceable. Used to determine the active window for SLA monitoring, breach detection, and penalty calculation. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_FROM category for the MASTER_AGREEMENT role.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the SLA policy expires or is no longer binding. Nullable for open-ended policies. Used in contract lifecycle management and renewal workflows. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category for the MASTER_AGREEMENT role.

attributes.name: escalation_tier_1_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes after incident detection at which the incident is escalated to Tier 1 support (e.g., on-call engineering team). Part of the multi-tier escalation chain defined in the SLA policy.

attributes.name: escalation_tier_2_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes after incident detection at which the incident is escalated to Tier 2 support (e.g., senior engineering or vendor escalation). Triggers executive notification for broadcast-critical or VIP-tier SLAs.
attributes.references: ITIL v4 Incident Management; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: exclusion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of events or conditions explicitly excluded from SLA uptime calculations (e.g., force majeure, scheduled maintenance, third-party CDN outages beyond contractual control). Used in breach dispute resolution.

attributes.name: external_policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier from the external system of record (e.g., Salesforce Contract ID, SAP SD Contract Number) that corresponds to this SLA policy. Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the primary geographic market this SLA policy applies to (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). For global policies, use 'GLB' as a convention. Supports multi-market regulatory reporting and regional SLA differentiation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; CCPA; FCC

attributes.name: governing_regulation
attributes.description: Primary regulatory framework or governing body standard that this SLA policy must comply with (e.g., 'FCC', 'GDPR', 'PCI-DSS', 'SOX', 'CCPA'). Used to route breach events to the correct compliance reporting workflow.
attributes.references: FCC; GDPR; PCI-DSS; SOX; CCPA; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: incident_resolution_time_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum time in minutes within which a detected incident must be fully resolved before a breach penalty is applied. Distinct from response time — this measures end-to-end resolution, not initial acknowledgement.
attributes.references: ITIL v4 Incident Management; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: incident_response_time_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum time in minutes within which the operations team must acknowledge and begin responding to a detected incident before an escalation is triggered. Defines the first escalation window in the incident management workflow.
attributes.references: ITIL v4 Incident Management; ISO/IEC 20000-1; SLA Escalation Standards

attributes.name: is_broadcast_critical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA policy governs a broadcast-critical service (e.g., live OTT streaming, RSN feed distribution) requiring the highest availability and fastest failover commitments. When True, triggers enhanced monitoring and executive escalation paths.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; OTT Distribution Agreements; ISO/IEC 20000-1

attributes.name: is_regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether SLA compliance data for this policy must be included in regulatory reporting submissions (e.g., FCC broadcast availability reports, GDPR data processing SLA disclosures). When True, breach events are automatically flagged for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; GDPR Article 28 Processor Obligations; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA policy record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: maintenance_window_end
attributes.description: Daily end time (HH:MM in 24-hour UTC format) of the scheduled maintenance window during which downtime is excluded from SLA uptime calculations. Paired with maintenance_window_start to define the exclusion window.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 20000-1; ITIL v4 Change Management

attributes.name: maintenance_window_start

attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Audit Standard

attributes.name: data_steward_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated data steward accountable for the accuracy, compliance, and lifecycle management of this segment definition. Required for GDPR accountability and internal data governance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 24; Internal Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: definition_logic
attributes.description: Full textual or serialized expression of the inclusion/exclusion criteria that determine segment membership. May contain SQL-like predicates, Adobe Experience Platform Profile Query Language (PQL) expressions, or Salesforce CRM filter logic. Critical for auditability and reproducibility of audience targeting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Profile Query Language (PQL); GDPR Article 13 (transparency)

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this segment definition becomes active and eligible for campaign activation and audience targeting. Supports time-bounded audience strategies such as seasonal campaigns, playoff promotions, and event-specific targeting windows.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Internal Campaign Calendar

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this segment definition expires and is no longer eligible for activation. Null indicates an open-ended segment with no planned expiry. Used to enforce time-limited audience strategies and GDPR data minimisation obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) (storage limitation); Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: fan_segment_description
attributes.description: Free-text business description of the segment's purpose, intended use cases, and strategic rationale. Used in campaign briefs, sponsorship activation proposals, and data governance documentation to communicate segment intent to non-technical stakeholders.
attributes.references: Internal Data Catalog Standard; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: fan_segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fan segment definition. 'active' = segment is live and eligible for activation; 'draft' = segment is being configured and not yet published; 'inactive' = segment has been paused; 'archived' = segment is retired and no longer used; 'under_review' = segment is pending compliance or business approval.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation)

attributes.name: gdpr_processing_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Processing Basis
attributes.description: Legal basis under GDPR Article 6 under which fan personal data is processed for this segment. Required for all segments targeting fans in EU/EEA markets. Must be documented prior to segment activation. Values align to GDPR Article 6(1) lawful bases.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes defining the geographic markets included in this segment (e.g., 'USA,CAN,GBR'). Drives geo-targeted campaign delivery, broadcast rights compliance, and regional sponsorship activation boundaries.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR Article 3 (territorial scope); FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: is_dtc_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is approved for use in Direct-To-Consumer (DTC) marketing campaigns including subscription upsell, merchandise promotions, and Over-The-Top (OTT) streaming offers.
attributes.references: Internal DTC Campaign Policy; CCPA; GDPR

attributes.name: is_pii_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the segment definition logic or activation payload includes or exposes Personally Identifiable Information (PII) attributes. Triggers enhanced GDPR/CCPA compliance controls, data minimisation review, and restricted channel activation policies.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1); CCPA Section 1798.140; PCI DSS (if payment data involved)

attributes.name: is_sponsorship_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is approved and available for use in sponsor-funded targeted campaigns and sponsorship activation programs. Segments may be ineligible due to GDPR consent restrictions, audience sensitivity (e.g., minors), or contractual exclusions.
attributes.references: Internal Sponsorship Activation Policy; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: last_evaluated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the segment membership was most recently evaluated and the membership roster was last refreshed. Used to assess data freshness and SLA compliance for campaign activation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Internal SLA Monitoring

attributes.name: ltv_tier
attributes.description: Categorical Lifetime Value (LTV) tier assigned to this segment based on the aggregate projected revenue contribution of its members over their fan relationship lifecycle. Used for prioritization of engagement investment, VIP experience allocation, and sponsorship audience premium pricing.
attributes.references: Internal Fan LTV Framework; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: max_age
attributes.description: Maximum age (in years) of fans eligible for inclusion in this segment, as defined in the segment criteria. Used in conjunction with min_age to define demographic targeting bands for campaigns and sponsorship activations.
attributes.references: Internal Audience Targeting Policy; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: membership_count
attributes.description: Point-in-time count of fan profiles currently qualifying for and active within this segment. Refreshed on each segment evaluation cycle. Used for campaign sizing, reach estimation, and sponsorship audience guarantees.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Internal Audience Reporting Standard

attributes.name: membership_refresh_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently the segment membership roster is re-evaluated and updated against the current fan profile data. Determines the freshness of audience targeting and impacts platform compute resource allocation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Segment Evaluation; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: min_age
attributes.description: Minimum age (in years) of fans eligible for inclusion in this segment, as defined in the segment criteria. Used to enforce age-gating for alcohol sponsorship activations, gambling promotions, and COPPA/GDPR child data protection compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8 (child consent); COPPA; Internal Compliance Policy

attributes.name: nps_baseline
attributes.description: Baseline Net Promoter Score (NPS) for fans within this segment, derived from fan satisfaction surveys and feedback data. Used to benchmark engagement quality, identify at-risk segments, and measure the impact of targeted experience programs.
attributes.references: Internal Fan Experience KPI Standard; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the segment definition, GDPR processing basis, and membership criteria must be reviewed and revalidated by the data steward and compliance team. Supports periodic data governance review cycles.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (accountability); Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: segment_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the data signals used to define segment membership logic. Behavioral = app/web interaction patterns; Demographic = age, gender, location; Transactional = purchase and ticketing history; Psychographic = interest and affinity signals; Geographic = market or region-based; Hybrid = combination of multiple signal types.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; IAB Audience Taxonomy

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the segment used across Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Salesforce CRM, and campaign management systems. Serves as the stable cross-system reference key.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Segment Naming Convention; Salesforce CRM Segment Object

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable business name of the fan audience segment (e.g., 'High-Value Season Ticket Holders', 'Lapsed Casual Fans', 'Gen-Z Digital-First Subscribers'). Used in campaign briefings, sponsorship activation decks, and Direct-To-Consumer (DTC) orchestration.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the segment membership is determined and maintained. 'static' = manually curated fixed list; 'dynamic' = continuously evaluated rule-based membership; 'ai_generated' = machine-learning model output from Adobe Experience Platform; 'rule_based' = explicit Boolean logic criteria; 'lookalike' = algorithmically expanded audience based on seed segment.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Segment Builder; GDPR Article 22 (automated decision-making)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record in which this segment was originally defined and is mastered. Determines the authoritative system for segment membership refresh and definition updates.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: sport_affinity
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sports or leagues (e.g., 'NFL,NBA,MLS') that fans in this segment have demonstrated primary affinity toward, based on content consumption, ticketing, and merchandise purchase signals. Used for cross-sport content personalization and league-specific sponsorship targeting.
attributes.references: Internal Fan Affinity Model; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: suppression_list_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a suppression list (e.g., opt-out, unsubscribe, do-not-contact) has been applied to this segment to exclude fans who have exercised data rights or communication preferences. Critical for GDPR and CCPA compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 (right to object); CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated business taxonomy tags applied to this segment for discoverability, filtering, and governance classification within the data catalog and Adobe Experience Platform segment library (e.g., 'playoff,high_value,email_campaign,sponsorship').
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Internal Data Catalog Taxonomy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fan segment record was most recently modified, including changes to definition logic, status, activation channels, or compliance attributes. Used for change tracking and downstream data pipeline refresh triggers.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Audit Standard

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number of the segment definition. Incremented each time the segment definition logic, criteria, or key attributes are materially changed. Enables version-controlled audience reproducibility for campaign post-analysis and compliance audits.
attributes.references: Internal Segment Governance Policy; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.description: Reference to the subscription plan product definition (e.g., OTT streaming pass, premium app tier, PPV season package, bundled content+ticketing). Links to the plan reference product.

Used for Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) attribution, channel ROI analysis, and omnichannel orchestration reporting in Adobe Experience Platform.
