attributes.name: aep_profile_reference
attributes.description: Unified profile identifier from Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) linked to this subscription's entitlement record. Enables personalisation, segmentation, and omnichannel orchestration across fan touchpoints.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Identity Service; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: arpu_contribution
attributes.description: Monthly Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) contribution attributed to this subscription, normalised to a monthly basis regardless of billing cycle. Used as a KPI baseline for digital platform performance reporting and Lifetime Value (LTV) modelling.
attributes.references: ARPU Industry Standard; Workday Adaptive Planning Digital KPI Framework

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscription is configured to automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle without requiring explicit fan action. True = auto-renew enabled; False = manual renewal required. Critical for revenue predictability and churn risk modelling.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Subscription Object; FTC Negative Option Rule

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which the subscriber is billed for the digital subscription. Determines renewal cadence, Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) calculation period, and invoice generation schedule in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Subscription Billing; ARPU Industry Standard

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subscriber requested cancellation of the digital subscription. Null for active subscriptions. Used in churn cohort analysis and GDPR/CCPA data retention scheduling.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Subscription Object; GDPR Article 17; CCPA §1798.105

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Standardised reason code captured at the point of cancellation. Drives product improvement, win-back campaign targeting, and churn root-cause analytics. Sourced from Salesforce CRM cancellation survey field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_too_high|content_not_relevant|technical_issues|switched_competitor|gifted_expired|no_longer_interested|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Subscription Object; NPS Industry Standard

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber has exercised their California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) right to opt out of the sale of personal information. True = opted out; False = no opt-out exercised. Applicable to California-resident subscribers.
attributes.references: CCPA §1798.120; CPRA Amendment

attributes.name: churn_risk_tier
attributes.description: Categorical churn risk classification assigned to the subscription based on engagement signals, payment history, and behavioural patterns scored in Adobe Experience Platform. Drives proactive retention campaign targeting and win-back prioritisation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Predictive Scoring; LTV Industry Standard

attributes.name: concurrent_streams_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous streams permitted under this subscription plan. Enforced by the OTT streaming platform to prevent credential sharing and protect broadcast rights. Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform entitlement configuration.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Entitlement Schema; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: content_access_tier
attributes.description: Entitlement tier defining the breadth of content accessible under this subscription (e.g., basic live streams only, standard VOD library, premium exclusive content, VIP all-access, PPV-only). Drives Digital Rights Management (DRM) enforcement in the content delivery layer.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Entitlement Schema; DRM Industry Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the digital subscription record was first created in the source system (Salesforce CRM). Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED anchor for the master agreement entity. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Audit Fields; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the subscription is billed (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, AUD). Supports multi-currency revenue consolidation and FX reporting in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Multi-Currency

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the promotional or loyalty discount applied to the subscription charge in the current billing period. Supports promotional ROI analysis and net revenue reporting. Zero if no discount applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: engagement_score
attributes.description: Composite fan engagement score (0–100) computed by Adobe Experience Platform from content consumption, session frequency, feature usage, and social interactions. Used as a leading indicator for churn risk and upsell propensity modelling.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Engagement Scoring; NPS Industry Standard

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the current subscription term expires and entitlements are revoked if not renewed. Represents the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL anchor for the master agreement lifecycle. Nullable for open-ended rolling subscriptions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Subscription Object; Adobe Experience Platform Entitlement Schema

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber has provided valid GDPR consent for processing of personal data associated with this digital subscription. True = consent given; False = consent withheld or withdrawn. Mandatory for EU market subscribers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(a); GDPR Article 7; CCPA §1798.100

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the geographic market in which the subscription is sold and content rights are enforced. Drives broadcast rights geo-blocking, tax jurisdiction assignment, and GDPR/CCPA compliance scoping.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA §1798.100; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: last_login_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subscriber most recently authenticated and accessed the digital platform. Key engagement signal for churn risk scoring, dormant account identification, and GDPR data retention policy application.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Session Management; GDPR Article 5(1)(e) Storage Limitation

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent successful payment received for this subscription. Used to identify at-risk accounts with lapsed payments and to validate billing cycle compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Processing; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: net_charge
attributes.description: Net amount billed to the fan after applying discounts and adding taxes (subscription_charge - discount_amount + tax_amount). Represents the actual cash collected per billing cycle and the ARPU contribution for this subscription.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; ARPU Industry Standard

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response from the subscriber, on a 0–10 scale. Captures fan satisfaction and likelihood to recommend the digital platform. Sourced from Salesforce CRM survey response object.
attributes.references: NPS Industry Standard; Salesforce CRM Survey Object

attributes.name: offline_download_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscription plan entitles the fan to download content for offline viewing. True = offline downloads permitted; False = streaming only. Relevant for Digital Rights Management (DRM) policy enforcement.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Entitlement Schema; DRM Industry Standard

attributes.name: payment_failure_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of failed payment attempts for the current subscription term. Used to trigger dunning workflows, suspension logic, and churn risk escalation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI payment processing logs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Dunning; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: payment_method_token
attributes.description: Tokenised reference to the fan's stored payment instrument (credit/debit card, digital wallet) used for recurring billing. The actual card data is held in the PCI-DSS-compliant payment vault; this field stores only the opaque token. Never contains raw card numbers.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.4; PCI SSC Tokenisation Guidelines

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Category of payment instrument used for subscription billing. Supports payment failure analysis, preferred-method reporting, and fraud risk segmentation. Distinct from payment_method_token which is the instrument reference.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Processing

attributes.name: promo_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric promotional or discount code applied at subscription sign-up or renewal (e.g., partner bundle code, seasonal campaign code, NIL athlete promo). Used to attribute subscriber acquisition to specific marketing campaigns and measure Return on Investment (ROI).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Attribution; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: promo_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the promotional offer applied to this subscription (e.g., 'Season Opener 30% Off', 'Bundle with Season Ticket'). Supports marketing reporting and fan communication.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled renewal date on which the billing cycle resets and the subscription term is extended. Used for proactive churn intervention, renewal campaign targeting, and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Subscription Object; Workday Adaptive Planning Revenue Forecast

attributes.name: salesforce_subscription_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the Salesforce CRM subscription object (18-character Salesforce ID). Enables bi-directional traceability between the silver-layer data product and the operational system of record for reconciliation and lineage.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Subscription Object; Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the digital subscription became effective and entitlements were first activated. Represents the EFFECTIVE_FROM anchor for the master agreement lifecycle. Sourced from Salesforce CRM 'Start_Date__c'.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Subscription Object

attributes.name: subscription_charge
attributes.description: Gross base recurring charge for the subscription plan before any discounts or taxes are applied, expressed in the billing currency. Used as the ARPU numerator and revenue recognition input in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: subscription_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable subscription reference number assigned at creation. Used in fan-facing communications, billing statements, and customer service interactions. Sourced from Salesforce CRM subscription object field 'Subscription_Number__c'.

attributes.name: subscription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the digital subscription. Drives entitlement enforcement, billing triggers, and churn analytics. 'trialing' indicates a free-trial period; 'suspended' indicates a temporary hold (e.g., payment failure). Sourced from Salesforce CRM subscription status field.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Subscription Object; GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure on cancellation)

attributes.name: subscription_type

attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Entitlement Schema; DTC Industry Classification

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: trial_end_date

attributes.name: scheduling_rule
attributes.description: Defines the dispatch timing logic for the campaign. attributes.name: total_sent
attributes.description: Cumulative count of notification messages dispatched to fans across all enabled channels for this campaign. Updated in near-real-time as delivery progresses. Represents the raw send volume before delivery confirmation.

attributes.description: Average user rating (1.00 to 5.00) for this release version as reported by the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. Tracks fan satisfaction with each release and informs product prioritization.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: app_store_review_count
attributes.description: Total number of user reviews submitted for this release version on the applicable app store. Provides statistical confidence context for the app_store_rating value.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: app_store_submission_reference
attributes.description: External identifier assigned by the Apple App Store or Google Play Store upon submission of the release for review. Used to track review status and correspondence with platform operators.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which formal approval was granted for this release to proceed to production. Distinct from release_timestamp (when it went live) — supports change management audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Change Management Policy

attributes.name: build_number
attributes.description: Internal monotonically-increasing build identifier generated by the CI/CD pipeline. Uniquely identifies the compiled artifact submitted to the app store or deployed to web infrastructure. Distinct from the user-facing version number.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: crash_rate_pct
attributes.description: Observed percentage of sessions that resulted in an application crash for this release version (e.g., 0.0125 = 1.25%). Key quality signal monitored post-release to trigger rollback decisions. Sourced from crash analytics tooling.
attributes.references: Internal SLA Policy; Apple App Store Review Guidelines (crash rate thresholds)

attributes.name: crash_rate_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable crash rate percentage defined for this release before an automatic rollback or escalation is triggered. Distinct from the observed crash_rate_pct — this is the target/SLA value.
attributes.references: Internal SLA Policy; Internal Release Management Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this release record was first created in the release management system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: deprecation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this release version is officially deprecated and fans on this version are required or encouraged to upgrade. Supports end-of-life planning and minimum supported version enforcement.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy; Internal Release Management Standard

attributes.name: drm_policy_updated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Digital Rights Management (DRM) Policy Updated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this release includes changes to Digital Rights Management (DRM) configuration or enforcement logic. True = DRM policy changes are included, requiring broadcast rights compliance review.
attributes.references: DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy; FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal Broadcast Rights Standard

attributes.name: feature_changelog
attributes.description: Structured summary of new features, enhancements, and resolved defects included in this release. Published to app store listing pages and internal stakeholder communications. Supports fan-facing release notes and product marketing.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: feature_flag_set
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of feature flag keys activated or deactivated in this release (e.g., 'ppv_checkout_v2,loyalty_wallet,live_poll_v3'). Enables dark launches and progressive feature enablement without a new release.
attributes.references: Internal Release Management Standard; Adobe Experience Platform Feature Management

attributes.name: gdpr_changes_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Changes Included Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this release includes changes to consent management, data processing flows, or privacy controls relevant to GDPR compliance. True = Data Protection Officer review required prior to release.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 25 (Privacy by Design); GDPR Article 7 (Consent); CCPA

attributes.name: geo_restriction_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this release is restricted or exclusively available (e.g., 'USA,CAN,GBR'). Supports broadcast blackout compliance and regional feature gating.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR (EU data residency); FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: is_forced_update
attributes.description: Indicates whether fans are required to update to this release before continuing to use the application. Typically set for critical security patches or breaking API changes. True = mandatory upgrade enforced.
attributes.references: Internal Release Management Standard; PCI-DSS Requirement 6 (security patch management)

attributes.name: is_rollback
attributes.description: Indicates whether this release record represents a rollback to a prior version following a quality or stability incident. True = this release reverts the platform to a previous known-good state.
attributes.references: Internal Release Management Standard; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: minimum_os_version
attributes.description: The lowest operating system version on which this release is supported (e.g., iOS 15.0, Android 11.0). Drives device compatibility messaging and fan support triage.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: pci_scope_change
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry (PCI) Scope Change Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this release modifies payment processing flows, tokenization logic, or any component within PCI-DSS scope. True = PCI SSC compliance review and re-assessment may be required.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS Requirement 6 (Develop and Maintain Secure Systems); PCI SSC

attributes.name: platform_type
attributes.description: Target operating platform or device category for this release. Determines the distribution channel and applicable app store submission requirements.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the release was made publicly available or pushed to the target platform's distribution channel. This is the principal business event date for the release.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: release_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the business purpose and scope of this release. Provides context beyond the structured changelog for stakeholder communications and governance documentation.
attributes.references: Internal Release Management Standard

attributes.name: release_environment
attributes.description: Target deployment environment for this release record: development (internal engineering), staging (pre-production validation), or production (live fan-facing environment).
attributes.references: Internal Release Management Standard

attributes.name: release_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing or internal name assigned to the release (e.g., 'Summer Fan Experience Update', 'Season Opener Release'). Used in communications and release notes.
attributes.references: Internal Release Management Standard

attributes.name: release_notes_url
attributes.description: URL linking to the full release notes document or changelog page for this release. Used by internal teams, partners, and API consumers to review detailed change information.
attributes.references: Internal Release Management Standard

attributes.name: release_number
attributes.description: Externally-known semantic version number of the release following major.minor.patch convention (e.g., 4.12.3). Used as the primary business identifier for the release across app stores and internal communications.
attributes.references: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 (semver.org)

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the release from initial draft through app store review, staged rollout, full live deployment, and eventual deprecation or rollback. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|in_rollout|live|rolled_back|deprecated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policy; Internal Release Management Standard

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the release was deployed or made live on the target platform. Supports SLA measurement and incident correlation.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: release_type
attributes.description: Classification of the release by scope of change: major (breaking changes or significant new features), minor (backward-compatible new features), patch (bug fixes), hotfix (emergency production fix), or rollback (reverting to a prior version).
attributes.references: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 (semver.org); Internal Release Management Standard

attributes.name: rollout_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the eligible user base currently receiving this release as part of a staged or phased rollout strategy (0.00 to 100.00). Enables controlled deployment and risk mitigation for high-traffic fan-facing platforms.
attributes.references: Google Play Developer Policy; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Internal Release Management Standard

attributes.name: rollout_strategy
attributes.description: Deployment strategy applied for this release: immediate (100% of users at once), staged (incremental percentage increase), canary (small subset for early validation), beta (opt-in test group), or forced_update (mandatory upgrade blocking prior versions).
attributes.references: Internal Release Management Standard; Google Play Developer Policy

attributes.name: security_scan_status
attributes.description: Status of the automated security vulnerability scan performed on this release build prior to deployment. Passed = no critical or high vulnerabilities detected. Failed = release blocked pending remediation.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS Requirement 6.3 (Security Vulnerabilities); OWASP Mobile Security Testing Guide

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this release record. Used for change tracking and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: hotfix_of_app_release_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on app_release (hotfix_of_app_release_id)

products.name: search_query
products.description: Fan search query records across platform properties — search term, results returned, result clicked, search context (pre-event, in-venue, content browse), and zero-result flags.

attributes.name: search_query_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fan search query record captured across platform digital touchpoints.

attributes.name: ab_test_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active A/B test experiment applied to this search query, enabling controlled measurement of search algorithm or UI variants on fan engagement.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: auth_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the platform authentication session during which the search was performed, enabling session-level search behaviour analysis.

attributes.name: digital_touchpoint_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital touchpoint (mobile app, web portal, in-venue kiosk, OTT platform) on which the search was executed.

attributes.name: event_fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific sports or entertainment event associated with the search context (e.g., the game or concert the fan is searching within). Null for non-event-contextual searches.

attributes.name: fan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated fan account that submitted the search query. Null for unauthenticated/anonymous sessions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: fan_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fan.fan_profile. Business justification: Search behavior analysis for CRM segmentation, content gap reporting, and personalization requires linking search queries to the canonical fan profile. A digital analytics team in sports-entertainment
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: fan_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fan segment active at the time of the search, used by the Adobe Experience Platform personalisation engine to rank and filter search results.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific sports or entertainment event associated with the search context (e.g., the game or concert the fan is searching within). Null for non-event-contextual searches.

attributes.name: personalization_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.personalization_profile. Business justification: search_query has no FK to personalization_profile despite search being a key personalization signal. Linking search queries to the fan's personalization profile enables search result personalization,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ab_test_variant_key
attributes.description: The specific variant identifier (e.g., control, variant_a, variant_b) assigned to this search query within the referenced A/B test experiment.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: aep_event_reference
attributes.description: The Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Experience Event identifier corresponding to this search query, enabling bi-directional reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and AEP for personalisation and analytics.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: app_version
attributes.description: Version of the fan-facing application (mobile app or OTT app) from which the search was submitted. Used to correlate search quality issues with specific app releases.
attributes.references: Platform Digital Touchpoint

attributes.name: autocomplete_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search query was submitted via an autocomplete suggestion rather than a fully typed term. Autocomplete adoption rate is a key search UX metric.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: ccpa_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this search query record is subject to California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) obligations. Governs opt-out of sale and data deletion rights for California residents.
attributes.references: CCPA

attributes.name: clicked_result_position
attributes.description: The rank position (1-based) of the search result item that the fan clicked or tapped. Null if no result was selected. Used to measure search relevance and click-through quality.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: clicked_result_reference
attributes.description: The business entity identifier of the search result item that was clicked (e.g., event ID, athlete ID, content asset ID, merchandise SKU). Stored as STRING to accommodate cross-domain entity types.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: clicked_result_type
attributes.description: The entity type of the search result that was clicked, enabling cross-domain click analysis (e.g., event, athlete, content_asset, ticket, merchandise, venue, team). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: event|athlete|content_asset|ticket|merchandise|venue|team — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this search query record was first ingested into the Silver layer data product. Used for data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 8601

attributes.name: data_retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this search query record is eligible for deletion or anonymisation per applicable data retention policies (GDPR, CCPA). Supports automated data lifecycle management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e); CCPA

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of device used to submit the search query. Supports device-level search experience optimisation and A/B test segmentation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: filter_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan applied one or more faceted filters (e.g., sport type, date range, price range) in conjunction with this search query.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: filter_criteria
attributes.description: Serialised representation of the filter parameters applied alongside the search query (e.g., sport=NFL, date_from=2025-01-01, price_max=150). Stored as a delimited string for Silver layer compatibility.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this search query record is subject to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) obligations based on the fan's geographic location at query time. Governs data retention and erasure eligibility.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the fan's location at the time of the search, derived from IP geolocation or device locale. Supports geo-specific search relevance tuning and broadcast blackout compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 3; broadcast.blackout_rule

attributes.name: geo_region
attributes.description: Sub-national region or state/province of the fan at the time of the search (e.g., CA, NY, ON). Supports Regional Sports Network (RSN) content relevance and venue proximity search ranking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; broadcast.blackout_rule

attributes.name: is_authenticated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan was authenticated (logged in) at the time of the search. Authenticated searches enable personalised result ranking via AEP; unauthenticated searches use anonymous relevance models.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: is_result_clicked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fan clicked on any search result following this query. False indicates a no-click search, which may signal poor relevance or fan abandonment.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: is_zero_result
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search query returned zero results. True when result_count = 0. Critical KPI for search quality monitoring, content gap identification, and fan experience improvement programmes.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: normalised_query_text
attributes.description: Lowercased, trimmed, and stop-word-reduced version of the raw query text used for search analytics, trending term identification, and personalisation engine (AEP) input.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: platform_channel
attributes.description: The digital channel through which the search was submitted: mobile_app, web_portal, smart_tv, in_venue_kiosk, OTT app, or voice_assistant. Supports omnichannel search analytics.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: query_language_code
attributes.description: BCP-47 language tag detected or declared for the search query (e.g., en-US, es-MX, fr-FR), supporting multilingual search analytics across global markets.
attributes.references: BCP-47; ISO 639-1

attributes.name: query_reference_code
attributes.description: Business-facing externally referenceable code for this search query record, used in analytics reporting and Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) event correlation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: query_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the search query execution: completed (results returned), zero_result (no matches found), error (system failure), cancelled (fan abandoned before results), timeout (exceeded SLA threshold).
attributes.references: Platform SLA Policy

attributes.name: query_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the fan submitted the search query. Principal business event timestamp for this record.
attributes.references: ISO 8601

attributes.name: query_type
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the search was initiated: keyword (typed text), voice (speech-to-text), barcode_scan (merchandise/ticket scan), filter_browse (faceted navigation), autocomplete_selection (suggestion tapped).
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: raw_query_text
attributes.description: The verbatim search string entered by the fan, preserved exactly as submitted before any normalisation or stemming. May contain PII if a fan types a personal name; classified confidential for data governance. Subject to GDPR data minimisation review.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: referrer_url
attributes.description: The URL of the page or screen from which the fan navigated to the search interface. Supports funnel analysis and search entry-point optimisation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: response_time_ms
attributes.description: End-to-end search response latency in milliseconds from query submission to results rendered on the fan's device. Used for SLA compliance monitoring against platform response time thresholds.
attributes.references: Platform SLA Policy

attributes.name: result_count
attributes.description: Total number of results returned by the search engine for this query. A value of 0 indicates a zero-result query, which is a key signal for search quality and content gap analysis.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: search_algorithm_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the search ranking algorithm or index configuration active at the time of the query. Enables retrospective analysis of algorithm changes on search quality metrics.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: search_context
attributes.description: Business context in which the search was performed: pre_event (fan planning before attending), in_venue (fan inside venue during event), content_browse (browsing broadcast/OTT content), post_event (reviewing after event), general (no specific event context).
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Archtics

attributes.name: search_domain
attributes.description: The primary business domain scope of the search query: events, athletes, content (broadcast/OTT), tickets, merchandise, venues, teams, or general cross-domain. Drives search index routing and analytics segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: events|athletes|content|tickets|merchandise|venues|teams|general|sponsors|news — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this search query record in the Silver layer, supporting incremental processing and audit.
attributes.references: ISO 8601

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) campaign tag present in the session at the time of the search, linking search behaviour to marketing campaign attribution.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: refined_search_query_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on search_query (refined_search_query_id)

Owns complete amendment history (amendment number, type, scope changes, price adjustments, term extensions, financial impact delta, approval authority, SOX audit trail) and renewal lifecycle (renewal trigger dates, renewal type — auto-renewal/renegotiated/terminated, revised terms, new TCV, approval status). SSOT for all contract modifications and renewals. Distinct from sponsorship agreements (revenue-generating) — covers cost-side vendor obligations. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD/MM contract management.

attributes.name: approval_authority

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract received final internal approval from the designated approval authority. Part of the SOX audit trail for procurement governance. Distinct from execution_date (when parties signed) and effective_date (when obligations begin).
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA MM Release Strategy

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews upon expiration without requiring affirmative action. True = auto-renews; False = requires explicit renewal action. Drives renewal workflow alerts and procurement calendar management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: auto_renewal_term_months
attributes.description: The duration in months for each auto-renewal period when auto_renewal_flag is True. Null when auto_renewal_flag is False. Used to project future contract obligations and budget forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: contract_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the scope of goods or services covered by the contract. Captures the business purpose, key deliverables, and operational context (e.g., 'Provision of CDN services for OTT streaming platform across North American markets').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; IFRS 15 Performance Obligation Identification

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor service contract between this franchise and vendor expires or is scheduled to terminate. Enables procurement teams to manage renewal pipelines per franchise-vendor pair.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract reference number assigned by SAP S/4HANA MM contract management (e.g., 4500012345). Used for cross-system reconciliation, legal correspondence, and audit trails. Maps to SAP contract document number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement (EKKO-EBELN); SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor service contract between this franchise and vendor becomes effective. Belongs to the engagement, not to either master record, as the same vendor may have different start dates with different franchises.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vendor contract. draft = under authoring; pending_approval = submitted for internal sign-off; active = fully executed and in force; suspended = temporarily paused; expired = past end date without renewal; terminated = ended before natural expiry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Release Strategy; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: contract_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title or short name of the contract as referenced in legal documents and internal procurement systems (e.g., 'Broadcast Technology Services MSA — Vendor XYZ 2024'). Used for search, reporting, and document management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-KTEXT

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contract instrument. MSA = Master Service Agreement; SOW = Statement of Work; NDA = Non-Disclosure Agreement; framework_agreement = umbrella procurement framework; amendment = modification to an existing contract; purchase_order = transactional PO under an MSA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSA|SOW|NDA|framework_agreement|amendment|purchase_order|letter_of_intent — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Category (EKKO-BSART); IFRS 15

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor contract record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Part of the SOX audit trail for contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-AEDAT

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this contract (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency vendor relationships across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: data_processing_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Data Processing Agreement is in place with this vendor, required when the vendor processes personal data on behalf of Sports Entertainment. True = DPA executed. Mandatory for GDPR Article 28 compliance and CCPA vendor management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28; CCPA Section 1798.100; PCI-DSS Requirement 12.8

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract becomes legally binding and obligations commence. Maps to SAP validity start date (EKKO-KDATB). Used for SLA activation, payment term calculation, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-KDATB; IFRS 15; SOX

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor holds an exclusive arrangement for the specified service category with this franchise, preventing the franchise from engaging competing vendors for the same service scope during the contract term.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all parties formally signed and executed the contract. May differ from effective_date (e.g., signed in December, effective January 1). Critical for SOX audit trail and legal enforceability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract naturally expires if not renewed. Maps to SAP validity end date (EKKO-KDATE). Nullable for open-ended evergreen contracts. Drives renewal trigger and procurement workflow alerts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-KDATE; IFRS 15

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction whose laws govern interpretation and enforcement of the contract (e.g., US-NY for New York, US-CA for California, GB for United Kingdom). Determines applicable regulatory frameworks including GDPR, CCPA, and local commercial law.
attributes.references: GDPR; CCPA; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); SOX

attributes.name: indemnification_cap
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate liability cap for indemnification obligations under the contract, expressed in contract currency. Critical for legal risk management and financial exposure assessment. Typically expressed as a multiple of TCV.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; OSHA Liability Standards; Legal Risk Management

attributes.name: insurance_min_coverage
attributes.description: Minimum required insurance coverage amount the vendor must maintain, expressed in contract currency. Null when insurance_required_flag is False. Used for vendor compliance verification and risk management.
attributes.references: OSHA; ADA; ISO 20121

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract requires the vendor to maintain specified insurance coverage (e.g., general liability, workers compensation, professional indemnity). True = insurance certificates required. Supports OSHA and ADA compliance for venue service vendors.
attributes.references: OSHA; ADA; ISO 20121 Event Safety

attributes.name: ip_ownership
attributes.description: Defines the IP ownership arrangement for any intellectual property created or used under this contract. sports_entertainment = SE owns all IP; vendor = vendor retains IP; joint = shared ownership; licensed_to_se = vendor licenses IP to SE; licensed_to_vendor = SE licenses IP to vendor. Critical for DRM and content rights management.
attributes.references: IP (Intellectual Property) Law; DRM (Digital Rights Management) Standards; FIFA/IOC IP Frameworks

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal amendment to this contract. Used for contract currency monitoring and procurement review scheduling. Null if no amendments have been executed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: pci_compliance_required_flag

attributes.references: PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard); PCI SSC

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Maximum financial penalty amount per breach event as specified in the contract, expressed in contract currency. Null when penalty_clause_flag is False. Used for financial risk quantification and vendor management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: penalty_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract contains financial penalty provisions for SLA breaches or non-performance. True = penalty clauses exist; False = no financial penalties. Drives vendor performance monitoring priority and risk assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Terms; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_status

A vendor may be preferred for one franchise but only approved for another based on local performance history.

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO-EKORG; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before expiration_date by which the business must notify the vendor of intent to renew or not renew. Drives procurement workflow trigger dates and prevents unintended auto-renewals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management

attributes.name: renewal_trigger_date
attributes.description: Calculated date by which the renewal decision must be made, derived from expiration_date minus renewal_notice_days. Stored as a business attribute to support procurement calendar alerts and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the most recent or anticipated renewal action. auto_renewal = renewed automatically per contract terms; renegotiated = renewed with revised terms; terminated = not renewed and contract ended; pending = renewal decision not yet made.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Lifecycle

attributes.name: scope_of_services
attributes.description: Structured summary of the specific services, deliverables, or goods covered under this contract. Distinct from contract_description (which is narrative) — this field captures the formal contractual scope statement used for SLA measurement and performance tracking.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA MM SOW Management

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: The service category under which this vendor is engaged by this franchise. Defines the scope of services provided within this specific franchise-vendor relationship. A vendor may appear in multiple engagement records for the same franchise under different service categories.
attributes.references: Aligns with vendor.primary_category taxonomy in the partner domain

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: The SLA tier classification assigned to this contract, defining the expected service performance level. Platinum/Gold tiers typically carry stricter uptime, response time, and penalty provisions. Used for vendor performance benchmarking and SLA breach tracking.
attributes.references: SLA (Service Level Agreement) Industry Standards; ISO 20121

attributes.name: sla_uptime_pct

attributes.name: sox_relevant_flag

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days of advance written notice required by either party to terminate the contract without cause. Critical for procurement planning and vendor transition management. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Terms; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) precedent

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: The total committed financial obligation of the contract over its full term, expressed in the contract currency. TCV = Total Contract Value. Includes all base fees, minimum commitments, and scheduled payments. Excludes optional extensions unless exercised. Used for EBITDA impact analysis and budget planning in Workday Adaptive Planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IFRS 15; SOX Section 404; Workday Adaptive Planning

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA MM; Databricks CDC

attributes.name: vendor_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the vendor type covered by this contract. Segments vendor spend by operational domain (e.g., broadcast_partner for RSN/OTT distribution deals, venue_services for HVAC/BMS providers, technology_vendor for API/CDN/DAM platform vendors). attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group (EKKO-MATKL); ISO 20121

Used for broadcast uptime SLAs, venue HVAC maintenance SLAs, IT infrastructure SLAs, and catering delivery SLAs.

attributes.name: applicable_event_type
attributes.description: The type of sports or entertainment event to which this SLA applies (e.g., 'NFL Regular Season', 'PPV Boxing', 'Concert', 'FIFA World Cup Qualifier'). Allows SLA terms to vary by event tier and commercial significance. Null if the SLA applies universally across all events.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Event Management Framework; FIFA Regulations

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the internal authority who formally approved this SLA definition (e.g., VP of Procurement, Director of Broadcast Operations). Supports SOX financial controls and audit trail requirements for public entities.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); SAP S/4HANA MM — Release Strategy

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SLA definition was formally approved and authorised for enforcement. Supports SOX audit trail and contract governance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA definition automatically renews at the end of its effective period (True) or requires explicit renegotiation and re-execution (False). Supports contract lifecycle management and renewal pipeline planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Contract Renewal; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SLA definition record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and compliance reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; SOX; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: critical_threshold
attributes.description: The critical breach level at which the SLA violation triggers escalated penalties or contract termination clauses (e.g., 99.0 for uptime, 60 for response time in minutes). Distinct from target_threshold — this is the floor below which severe consequences apply.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA MM — Contract Penalty Conditions

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which performance data for this SLA is sourced (e.g., 'Dalet Galaxy' for broadcast workflow SLAs, 'SAP S/4HANA MM' for procurement SLAs, 'Archtics' for venue operations SLAs). Supports data lineage and audit traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Dalet Galaxy; Archtics; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: The agreed mechanism for resolving disputes arising from SLA breach claims. Internal_review uses internal governance; mediation involves a neutral third party; arbitration uses binding arbitration; litigation uses courts; cas_arbitration refers to the Court of Arbitration for Sport for sports-specific disputes.
attributes.references: CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); ISO 20000-1; Sports Entertainment Legal Framework

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this SLA definition becomes binding and enforceable against the vendor. Aligns with the contract commencement date or a specific service activation milestone.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Scheduling Agreement; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SLA definition ceases to be binding. Null for open-ended SLAs that remain active until the parent contract terminates. Used for SLA renewal tracking and contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Scheduling Agreement; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: escalation_tier
attributes.description: The escalation level triggered when this SLA is breached. Tier_1 routes to the vendor account manager; Tier_2 escalates to the vendor operations director; Tier_3 involves legal/procurement; Executive escalates to C-suite. Drives automated alerting workflows.
attributes.references: ITIL v4 Incident Management; Sports Entertainment Vendor Management Framework

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern this SLA and any disputes arising from it (e.g., USA, GBR, FRA). Critical for multi-market sports entertainment operations spanning NFL, FIFA, and international broadcast territories.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; CCPA; Sports Entertainment Legal Framework

attributes.name: grace_period_value
attributes.description: The allowable tolerance period or buffer before a breach is formally recorded and penalties are triggered. Expressed in the unit defined by metric_unit (e.g., 5 minutes grace on a 30-minute response time SLA). Null if no grace period applies.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; ITIL v4

attributes.name: internal_owner_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the internal Sports Entertainment department or cost centre responsible for managing and enforcing this SLA (e.g., 'BROADCAST-OPS', 'VENUE-MGMT', 'IT-INFRA', 'PROCUREMENT'). Enables SLA ownership accountability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Cost Centre; Sports Entertainment Vendor Management Framework

attributes.name: is_event_day_sla
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Event Day Service Level Agreement (SLA) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA definition applies specifically during live event windows (True) or covers standard operational periods (False). Event-day SLAs typically carry stricter thresholds and faster escalation for broadcast uptime, venue HVAC, and catering services.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Vendor Management Framework; OSHA Venue Safety

attributes.name: is_regulatory_mandated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA is required by a regulatory or governing body (True) rather than being a purely commercial arrangement (False). Examples include FCC broadcast uptime requirements, ADA venue accessibility service standards, or OSHA safety response time mandates.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; ADA Venue Accessibility; OSHA Venue Safety

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SLA definition record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, data freshness validation, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently vendor performance against this SLA is measured and recorded (e.g., real_time for broadcast uptime monitoring, daily for catering delivery, monthly for IT infrastructure availability). Drives the cadence of SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; ITIL v4

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the agreed method used to measure vendor performance against this SLA (e.g., 'Automated monitoring via CDN uptime probe', 'Vendor-submitted delivery manifests cross-referenced against POS receipts', 'Ticketing system incident log timestamps'). Ensures consistent and auditable compliance evaluation.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; ITIL v4

attributes.name: metric_type
attributes.description: The type of performance metric this SLA definition measures. Determines how vendor compliance is evaluated: uptime_pct for broadcast/IT availability, response_time for incident acknowledgement, resolution_time for fault closure, delivery_lead_time for merchandise/catering supply, availability_pct for venue services, error_rate_pct for broadcast signal quality.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; ITIL v4 Service Management

attributes.name: metric_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the SLA metric (e.g., 'percent' for uptime, 'minutes' for response time, 'hours' for resolution time, 'days' for delivery lead time). Required to correctly interpret target and critical threshold values.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; ITIL v4

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, exceptions, or contextual information relevant to this SLA definition that are not captured in structured fields (e.g., 'Excludes force majeure events', 'Applies only during NFL season weeks 1–18', 'Subject to annual CPI adjustment').
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; Sports Entertainment Vendor Management Framework

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days' notice required by either party to terminate or renegotiate this SLA before its expiry date. Critical for procurement planning and vendor transition management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Contract Terms; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: penalty_cap_value
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative penalty amount that can be applied to the vendor under this SLA within a single reporting period. Protects against disproportionate penalties in long-term vendor relationships. Expressed in penalty_currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Contract Penalty Conditions; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the penalty value (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-market operations across global sports entertainment leagues and broadcast rights territories.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: penalty_structure_type
attributes.description: The type of financial or contractual remedy applied when the vendor breaches this SLA. Fixed_fee applies a flat monetary penalty; percentage_of_contract deducts a percentage of the contract value; service_credit issues a credit against future invoices; termination_right grants the right to terminate the contract; none indicates no financial penalty.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Contract Penalty Conditions; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: penalty_value
attributes.description: The monetary amount or percentage rate applied as a penalty upon SLA breach. Interpretation depends on penalty_structure_type: a flat currency amount for fixed_fee, a percentage rate (0–100) for percentage_of_contract or service_credit. Null if penalty_structure_type is 'none'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Contract Penalty Conditions; PCI-DSS (for payment-related SLAs)

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The aggregation window over which SLA compliance is formally reported to stakeholders and used for penalty calculation (e.g., monthly for broadcast uptime, quarterly for venue maintenance). May differ from measurement_frequency.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA FI — Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this SLA definition with the vendor. Supports proactive contract management and renegotiation planning ahead of renewal windows.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; Sports Entertainment Vendor Management Framework

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: High-level operational category of the vendor service governed by this SLA. Drives routing to the appropriate operations team and enables cross-category SLA benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast|venue_operations|it_infrastructure|catering|merchandise|ticketing|security|transportation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Vendor Management Framework; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: service_subcategory
attributes.description: Granular classification within the service category (e.g., 'OTT Stream Delivery' under Broadcast, 'HVAC Preventive Maintenance' under Venue Operations, 'POS System Uptime' under IT Infrastructure). Enables fine-grained SLA reporting.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Vendor Management Framework

attributes.name: sla_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this SLA definition across procurement and vendor management systems. Used as the business-facing reference in contracts and vendor communications (e.g., SLA-BCAST-20240001).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Outline Agreement; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: sla_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the scope, obligations, and context of this SLA definition. Provides business users with qualitative context beyond the structured metric fields (e.g., 'Governs uptime of OTT streaming infrastructure during live broadcast windows for Tier 1 RSN partners').

attributes.name: sla_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the SLA definition (e.g., 'Broadcast Uptime SLA — Tier 1 OTT Partner', 'Venue HVAC Maintenance Response SLA'). Used in reporting dashboards and vendor scorecards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Outline Agreement

attributes.name: sla_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA definition. Draft indicates the SLA is under negotiation; active means it is currently enforced; suspended means enforcement is temporarily paused; expired means the effective period has ended; terminated means the SLA has been cancelled.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Outline Agreement Status; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: sla_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this SLA definition (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Tracks amendments and renegotiations over the contract lifecycle. Enables audit trail of SLA term changes.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA MM — Contract Version Management

attributes.name: target_threshold
attributes.description: The primary performance target the vendor must achieve to be considered compliant with this SLA (e.g., 99.9 for 99.9% uptime, 30 for 30-minute response time). Expressed in the unit defined by metric_unit.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1; SAP S/4HANA MM — Service Entry Sheet

attributes.name: threshold_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the metric must be at or above the target (minimum — e.g., uptime %) or at or below the target (maximum — e.g., response time in minutes). Required to correctly evaluate compliance for both performance and time-based SLAs.
attributes.references: ITIL v4 Service Management; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: vendor_responsibility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific vendor team, department, or contact role accountable for delivering against this SLA (e.g., 'OPS-NOC' for network operations centre, 'FIELD-TECH' for on-site technicians). Used for vendor escalation routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master; Salesforce CRM Vendor Contact

products.name: sla_measurement
products.description: Periodic SLA performance measurement records capturing actual vendor performance against agreed thresholds for Sports Entertainment operations. Records measurement period (daily/weekly/monthly/per-event), actual metric value, target value, variance percentage, breach flag, breach severity (minor/major/critical), consecutive breach count, measurement source system (network monitoring, IoT sensors, manual inspection), and auto-generated penalty trigger. Covers broadcast uptime measurements during live events, venue HVAC response times, catering delivery punctuality, and security deployment readiness. Feeds vendor performance scorecards and automated penalty calculation workflows.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SLA measurements for broadcast uptime, venue services, and event-day vendor performance are recorded by specific employees. Linking to employee enables measurement integrity audits and accountability

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: SLA measurement records in sports-entertainment are ingested and computed by analytics pipeline runs (e.g., post-event broadcast SLA aggregation pipelines). Linking each measurement to its producing p
