attributes.name: sla_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SLA contract or vendor agreement under which this measurement is captured. Links to the governing partner contract record.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier whose performance is being measured in this record (e.g., broadcast uptime provider, HVAC contractor, catering supplier).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: vendor_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor performance scorecard period into which this measurement rolls up. Enables aggregation of individual measurements into periodic vendor performance scorecards for executive reporting and contract reviews.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: venue_id
attributes.description: Reference to the venue or facility where the SLA service is being delivered and measured (e.g., arena, stadium, broadcast facility).
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Venue Domain

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.description: The measured actual performance value for the SLA metric during the measurement period (e.g., 99.7 for 99.7% actual uptime, 45 for 45-minute actual HVAC response). Core quantitative result of the measurement.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's actual performance breached the contractually agreed SLA threshold during this measurement period. True = breach occurred; False = SLA met or exceeded.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management

attributes.name: breach_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the SLA breach when breach_flag is True: minor (within tolerance band), major (significant deviation requiring escalation), critical (severe breach triggering immediate remediation and potential contract penalty). Null when no breach.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management; ITIL v4 Incident Severity

attributes.name: broadcast_event_type
attributes.description: For broadcast-related SLA measurements, classifies the type of broadcast event being monitored (e.g., live_game, PPV (Pay-Per-View), OTT (Over-The-Top Streaming) stream, RSN (Regional Sports Network) broadcast). Null for non-broadcast service categories.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; Sports Entertainment Broadcast Domain

attributes.name: consecutive_breach_count
attributes.description: Running count of consecutive measurement periods in which this SLA metric has been breached without recovery. Used to trigger escalation thresholds and cumulative penalty clauses in vendor contracts.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SLA measurement record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: data_completeness_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the measurement period for which actual performance data was successfully collected (e.g., 95.0 means data was available for 95% of the period). Values below threshold may invalidate the measurement per SLA contract terms.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Data Quality; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: dispute_raised_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has formally disputed the accuracy or validity of this SLA measurement. When True, measurement_status transitions to 'disputed' and the record is held from penalty processing pending resolution.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport)

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the vendor's stated reason for disputing this SLA measurement (e.g., data collection error, force majeure event, measurement methodology disagreement). Populated only when dispute_raised_flag is True.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: force_majeure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA breach or underperformance during this period was attributed to a force majeure event (e.g., natural disaster, power grid failure, government-mandated shutdown). Force majeure breaches are typically excluded from penalty calculations per contract terms.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management; Sports Entertainment Vendor Contract Standard

attributes.name: measurement_confidence_score
attributes.description: A 0–100 score indicating the reliability and completeness of the data used to produce this measurement (e.g., 100 = fully automated sensor data with no gaps; 60 = partial manual data with some estimated values). Supports data quality governance and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Data Quality; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the measurement window: daily (24-hour rolling), weekly (7-day), monthly (calendar month), or per_event (scoped to a single Sports Entertainment event).
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: measurement_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this measurement record, used in vendor communications, audit trails, and penalty dispute resolution. Format: SLA-MEAS-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: measurement_source_system
attributes.description: The system or method used to capture the actual performance data for this measurement (e.g., network_monitoring for broadcast uptime, iot_sensor for HVAC readings, manual_inspection for security deployment checks). Supports data lineage and audit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: network_monitoring|iot_sensor|manual_inspection|ticketing_system|broadcast_monitoring|pos_system|third_party_audit — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management; SOX Section 404 Data Lineage

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the measurement record: pending (awaiting data confirmation), confirmed (validated by operations team), disputed (vendor has raised a challenge), voided (measurement invalidated), finalized (accepted by all parties and locked for penalty processing).
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the SLA measurement data was captured or finalized in the source system. Represents the principal real-world event time for this measurement record.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes recorded by the measurement team regarding anomalies, context, or special circumstances affecting this SLA measurement (e.g., 'Partial outage due to scheduled maintenance window', 'Measurement adjusted for pre-agreed exclusion period').
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The calculated financial penalty amount (in the contract currency) triggered by this SLA breach, as determined by the penalty formula in the vendor contract. Populated only when penalty_trigger_flag is True. Business-confidential vendor financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; PCI-DSS; SOX

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the penalty_amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency vendor contracts across global Sports Entertainment markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: penalty_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Auto-generated flag indicating whether this measurement record has triggered a financial penalty calculation workflow per the vendor contract terms. True = penalty workflow initiated; False = no penalty triggered.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: period_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time marking the end of the SLA measurement window. Together with period_start_timestamp defines the full measurement interval.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: period_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time marking the beginning of the SLA measurement window. Used to align measurements with event schedules and broadcast windows.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: The contractually mandated date by which the vendor must submit or complete a remediation plan for the SLA breach. Null when remediation_required_flag is False.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: remediation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is contractually required to submit a remediation plan following this measurement breach. Drives the remediation workflow in vendor performance management.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the vendor service being measured. Enables cross-vendor benchmarking within service categories (e.g., all broadcast partners, all venue HVAC contractors). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast|venue_operations|catering|security|technology|merchandise|transportation|medical — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Procurement Category

attributes.name: sla_metric_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific SLA metric being measured (e.g., BROADCAST_UPTIME_PCT, HVAC_RESPONSE_MIN, CATERING_DELIVERY_PUNCTUALITY_PCT, SECURITY_DEPLOYMENT_READINESS_PCT). Drives metric-specific threshold lookups and penalty rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BROADCAST_UPTIME_PCT|HVAC_RESPONSE_MIN|CATERING_DELIVERY_PCT|SECURITY_READINESS_PCT|NETWORK_LATENCY_MS|TICKETING_SYSTEM_UPTIME_PCT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: sla_metric_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the SLA metric being measured (e.g., 'Broadcast Uptime Percentage', 'HVAC Response Time', 'Catering Delivery Punctuality'). Used in vendor scorecards and executive reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: The contractual service tier level applicable to this measurement, which determines the strictness of thresholds and the severity of penalty escalation (e.g., platinum for Tier-1 broadcast partners during championship events, standard for routine venue services).
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The contractually agreed threshold value for the SLA metric during this measurement period (e.g., 99.9 for 99.9% uptime, 30 for 30-minute HVAC response time). Sourced from the governing SLA contract.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which both target_value and actual_value are expressed (e.g., percentage for uptime, minutes for response time, count for incidents). Ensures correct interpretation of metric values across service categories.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SLA measurement record was most recently modified (e.g., status change, dispute update, penalty recalculation). Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 20000-1

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage deviation of actual_value from target_value, calculated as ((actual_value - target_value) / target_value) * 100. Negative values indicate underperformance. Used in penalty calculation workflows and vendor scorecards.
attributes.references: ISO 20000-1 Service Management

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Formal procurement purchase orders issued to vendors for goods and services including line-item detail (material/service, quantity, unit price, delivery schedule, goods receipt quantity, invoice verification status). Captures PO number, PO type (standard, blanket, emergency), order date, requested delivery date, delivery address (venue or facility), total order value, currency, payment terms, approval status, and goods receipt status. Supports three-way matching (PO/goods receipt/invoice) for accounts payable processing. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing module (EKKO/EKPO). Covers procurement for venue operations, broadcast equipment, merchandise inventory, and event services.

attributes.name: delivery_country_code

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date

attributes.name: goods_receipt_quantity

attributes.name: gross_order_value

attributes.name: incoterms_code

Corresponds to SAP EKKO.INCO1. Critical for international procurement of broadcast equipment and merchandise inventory.

attributes.name: invoice_verification_date

attributes.name: invoiced_amount

attributes.name: invoiced_quantity

attributes.name: is_blanket_release

attributes.name: is_goods_receipt_required

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKPO.WEPOS; PCI-DSS AP Controls

attributes.name: is_invoice_receipt_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoice verification is required for this purchase order before payment can be released. Corresponds to SAP EKPO.REPOS. When False, automatic payment may be triggered upon goods receipt (e.g., evaluated receipt settlement).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKPO.REPOS; PCI-DSS Payment Controls

attributes.name: net_order_value
attributes.description: Total net value of the purchase order before taxes, representing the sum of all line item net amounts (quantity × unit price minus discounts). Corresponds to SAP EKKO.NETWR. Used for spend analytics, budget consumption tracking, and EBITDA impact reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.NETWR; SOX Section 302 Financial Reporting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with the purchase order, such as event-specific delivery requirements, broadcast setup instructions, or vendor coordination notes. Corresponds to SAP PO header text.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM PO Header Text

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The date on which the purchase order was formally created and issued. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.BEDAT (document date). Principal business event date for procurement reporting and lead-time analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.BEDAT

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key defining the agreed payment schedule with the vendor (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Corresponds to SAP EKKO.ZTERM. Drives accounts payable due date calculation and early payment discount capture.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI EKKO.ZTERM; PCI-DSS Payment Controls

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric purchase order number assigned by SAP S/4HANA MM at time of PO creation. Corresponds to EKKO.EBELN. Used for three-way matching (PO/goods receipt/invoice) in accounts payable processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.EBELN; PCI-DSS Procurement Controls

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment lifecycle status of the purchase order reflecting goods receipt and invoice verification progress. Open: no goods received; Partially Delivered: partial goods receipt posted; Fully Delivered: all line items goods-receipted; Invoiced: vendor invoice matched and verified; Closed: three-way match complete and payment processed; Cancelled: order voided.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.ELIKZ / EKKO.EINDT; PCI-DSS AP Controls

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order by procurement method. Standard: single discrete order; Blanket: framework release order against a master agreement; Emergency: expedited order bypassing standard approval workflow; Consignment: vendor-managed inventory arrangement; Service: service entry sheet-based order for labor or managed services. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.BSART.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.BSART; ISO 20121 Procurement

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority classification of the purchase order indicating procurement urgency. Routine: standard lead time acceptable; Urgent: accelerated processing required (e.g., event imminent); Emergency: immediate procurement bypassing standard workflow (e.g., equipment failure before broadcast). Drives SLA and approval escalation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SLA Management; OSHA Emergency Procurement

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: Business category of goods or services being procured. Examples include venue operations, broadcast equipment, merchandise inventory, event services, technology, facilities maintenance (HVAC/BMS), and catering. Supports spend analytics and category management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: venue_operations|broadcast_equipment|merchandise_inventory|event_services|technology|facilities_maintenance|catering|security|transportation|marketing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group (EKPO.MATKL); ISO 20121

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: SAP purchasing group (buyer group) code identifying the individual buyer or team responsible for this purchase order. Corresponds to EKKO.EKGRP. Used for buyer workload analysis and procurement accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.EKGRP

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code
attributes.description: SAP purchasing organization code responsible for negotiating and managing this purchase order. Corresponds to EKKO.EKORG. Represents the organizational unit (e.g., league office, venue group, broadcast division) with procurement authority.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.EKORG

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the ordering department requires delivery of goods or completion of services. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.EINDT (delivery date). Used for SLA tracking and event readiness planning (e.g., broadcast equipment must arrive before event production schedule).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.EINDT; SLA Management

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The 10-digit SAP internal document number for this purchase order as stored in EKKO.EBELN. Serves as the source system identifier for lineage tracing and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.EBELN; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the purchase order (VAT, GST, sales tax) as calculated by SAP tax determination. Supports accounts payable tax reporting and cross-border tax compliance for international procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Determination; GDPR; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way matching process between the purchase order, goods receipt, and vendor invoice. Not Started: no GR or invoice posted; PO Only: PO created, no GR; PO GR Matched: GR posted against PO; Fully Matched: PO, GR, and invoice all reconciled; Exception: discrepancy requiring manual resolution. Core accounts payable control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Three-Way Match; PCI-DSS AP Controls; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this purchase order record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform convention. Tracks PO amendments, approval status changes, and delivery date revisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.AEDAT; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5

products.name: partner_goods_receipt
products.description: Records of physical or digital goods and services received from vendors against purchase orders at Sports Entertainment facilities. Captures receipt date, receiving location (stadium, arena, concert venue, warehouse, broadcast facility), received quantity, accepted quantity, rejected quantity, rejection reason code, quality inspection result (pass/conditional/fail), inspector name, and SAP posting status. Covers merchandise inventory receipts, broadcast equipment deliveries, venue maintenance supplies, event production materials, and catering provisions. Enables three-way matching (PO/GR/Invoice) and triggers accounts payable invoice verification.

attributes.name: partner_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each goods receipt record in the partner domain. Primary key for the partner_goods_receipt data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: company_code_id

attributes.description: Reference to the SAP cost center to which the goods receipt cost is allocated. Enables departmental cost tracking across venue operations, broadcast, event production, and merchandise functions.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Reference to the Sports Entertainment facility where goods were physically received — stadium, arena, concert venue, warehouse, or broadcast facility. Drives inventory posting to the correct plant/storage location.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational vendor contract or supply agreement under which this goods receipt was generated. Supports contract compliance tracking and SLA performance measurement.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier master record from whom the goods or services were received. Enables vendor performance tracking, SLA monitoring, and accounts payable processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (LFA1/LIFNR)

attributes.name: accepted_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of received goods that passed quality inspection and was accepted into unrestricted stock. Used for inventory posting, accounts payable invoice matching, and vendor quality performance scoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Usage Decision Accepted Quantity

attributes.name: bill_of_lading
attributes.description: The carrier's bill of lading or waybill number for the shipment. Used for freight tracking, carrier SLA compliance, and logistics dispute resolution for physical goods deliveries to Sports Entertainment venues and warehouses.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) — Incoterms; SAP S/4HANA MM — Bill of Lading (BOLNR)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this goods receipt record was first created in the system, including timezone offset. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Entry Date/Time (CPUDT/CPUTM); SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary values on this goods receipt (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency operations across global Sports Entertainment markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency (WAERS)

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The vendor's delivery note or packing slip reference number accompanying the shipment. Used for reconciliation between the vendor's dispatch documentation and the Sports Entertainment goods receipt record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Delivery Note (LIEFN)

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the vendor delivery note or packing slip accompanying the shipment. May differ from receipt_date when goods arrive after the vendor's dispatch date. Used for document reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Document Date (BLDAT)

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP material document number assigned to this goods receipt posting (e.g., 5000012345). Used as the primary business identifier for three-way matching (Purchase Order / Goods Receipt / Invoice) and accounts payable invoice verification workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Document Number (MBLNR)

attributes.name: gr_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the SAP material document was posted (e.g., 2024). Combined with gr_document_number to form the unique SAP material document key (MBLNR + MJAHR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Document Year (MJAHR)

attributes.name: gr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt document. 'posted' indicates the SAP material document has been successfully created and inventory updated. 'reversed' indicates a cancellation posting has been made. 'blocked' indicates the receipt is on hold pending quality resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Document Status

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the quality inspection of the received goods was completed. Used to measure inspection cycle time (receipt_date to inspection_date) and SLA compliance for quality clearance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Lot Completion Date; ISO 9001

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The SAP Quality Management inspection lot number created automatically upon goods receipt posting when quality inspection is required for the material. Links the goods receipt to the detailed quality inspection record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Lot (QALS-PRUEFLOS)

attributes.name: is_partial_delivery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt represents a partial fulfillment of the purchase order line (True) with further deliveries expected, or a complete delivery (False). Drives open PO quantity tracking and delivery completion monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Partial Delivery Indicator

attributes.name: is_return_delivery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt record represents a return delivery to the vendor (True) rather than an inbound receipt (False). Return deliveries reverse inventory and trigger vendor debit memo processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Return Delivery Indicator (RETOURE)

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the goods or service item received as defined in the SAP material master. Provides context for receiving staff, quality inspectors, and accounts payable teams without requiring a material master lookup.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Description (MAKTX)

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: SAP material group code classifying the type of goods received (e.g., merchandise inventory, broadcast equipment, venue maintenance supplies, event production materials, catering provisions). Enables spend analytics and category management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Group (MATKL)

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The SAP material master number identifying the specific goods or service item received (e.g., merchandise SKU, broadcast equipment part number, venue maintenance supply, catering provision). Used for inventory management and three-way matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master (MATNR)

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP inventory movement type code governing how the goods receipt affects stock (e.g., 101 = GR for PO into unrestricted stock, 103 = GR into GR blocked stock, 105 = Release from GR blocked stock). Determines the accounting entries generated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 101|103|105|122|161|501 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Movement Type (BWART)

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the goods were received on or before the SLA required delivery date (True = on time, False = late). Derived from comparison of receipt_date vs sla_required_delivery_date. Used for vendor KPI scorecarding and SLA performance reporting.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Vendor SLA Framework; SAP S/4HANA MM — Delivery Performance

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of goods originally ordered on the purchase order line item. Used to calculate over/under delivery variances and assess vendor fulfillment accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — PO Order Quantity (MENGE)

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The SAP plant code representing the Sports Entertainment operational unit (stadium, arena, broadcast facility, warehouse) where the goods receipt is posted. Determines the inventory valuation area and cost center assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Plant (WERKS)

attributes.name: quality_inspection_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the quality inspection performed on the received goods. 'pass' = all goods accepted; 'conditional' = partial acceptance with conditions; 'fail' = goods rejected; 'not_required' = inspection waived per material master settings. Drives usage decision in SAP QM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Lot Usage Decision (QMEL); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: receipt_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the type of goods or services received, aligned to Sports Entertainment operational domains. Enables domain-specific reporting across merchandise inventory, broadcast equipment deliveries, venue maintenance supplies, event production materials, and catering provisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: merchandise|broadcast_equipment|venue_supplies|event_production|catering|technology|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Procurement Category Taxonomy

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the physical or digital goods were received at the Sports Entertainment facility. This is the principal real-world event date used for inventory valuation, SLA compliance measurement, and accounts payable aging.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Posting Date (BUDAT)

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the goods receipt was physically recorded or system-posted, including timezone offset. Used for intraday SLA tracking and broadcast equipment delivery time compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Entry Time (UZEIT)

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity of goods physically received at the Sports Entertainment facility against the purchase order line. This is the gross quantity before quality inspection acceptance or rejection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Quantity in Unit of Entry (ERFMG)

attributes.name: rejected_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of received goods that failed quality inspection and was rejected. Triggers vendor return process, debit memo creation, and vendor performance deduction. Must equal received_quantity minus accepted_quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Usage Decision Rejected Quantity

attributes.name: rejection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional detail on the reason for goods rejection, supplementing the rejection_reason_code. Captured by the receiving inspector and used for vendor dispute resolution and return-to-vendor documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Defect Text; Sports Entertainment Vendor Quality Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the reason goods were rejected during quality inspection (e.g., DAMAGED, WRONG_SPEC, SHORT_EXPIRY, WRONG_QTY, CONTAMINATED). Populated only when rejected_quantity > 0. Drives vendor performance analytics and return-to-vendor workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAMAGED|WRONG_SPEC|SHORT_EXPIRY|WRONG_QTY|CONTAMINATED|WRONG_ITEM|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Defect Code (QMEL); Sports Entertainment Vendor Quality Standards

attributes.name: sap_posting_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the goods receipt has been successfully posted in SAP S/4HANA, is pending posting, failed due to a system error, or has been reversed. Critical for accounts payable invoice verification and three-way matching readiness.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Movement Posting Status

attributes.name: sla_required_delivery_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Required Delivery Date
attributes.description: The contractually committed delivery date per the vendor SLA or purchase order schedule line. Compared against receipt_date to determine on-time delivery performance and SLA compliance for vendor scorecarding.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Schedule Line Delivery Date (EINDT); Sports Entertainment Vendor SLA Framework

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: The SAP storage location code within the receiving plant where accepted goods are physically stored (e.g., MERCH-WH01 for merchandise warehouse, BCAST-EQ01 for broadcast equipment store). Drives inventory placement and warehouse management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location (LGORT)

attributes.name: total_gr_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the accepted goods receipt posting in the company code currency (accepted_quantity × valuation_price). Posted to the GR/IR clearing account in SAP FI and used for accounts payable invoice verification.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure in which quantities (ordered, received, accepted, rejected) are expressed (e.g., EA=Each, KG=Kilogram, L=Litre, M=Metre, BOX, PAL=Pallet). Aligned to SAP base unit of measure codes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); ISO 80000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this goods receipt record, including timezone offset. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Change Document (CDHDR); SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: valuation_price
attributes.description: The unit price at which the received goods are valued in SAP inventory accounting, derived from the purchase order price or moving average price. Used for inventory valuation and accounts payable three-way matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-IM — Valuation Price (DMBTR/MENGE); IFRS 2 Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency to the company code local currency at the time of posting. Relevant for invoices from international vendors.

attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned invoice number as submitted by the vendor on the invoice document. Used for vendor reconciliation and three-way match. Corresponds to BELNR in SAP RBKP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP.BELNR); PCI-DSS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the vendor invoice through the accounts payable lifecycle. Drives processing actions and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|under_review|approved|rejected|posted|paid|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Workflow; SOX Section 404; Internal AP Policy

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type indicating whether it is a standard vendor invoice, credit memo (vendor credit), debit memo, recurring service invoice, advance payment request, or proforma invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Document Type (BLART); GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: is_duplicate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice has been identified as a potential or confirmed duplicate of another invoice from the same vendor for the same period and amount. Supports duplicate payment prevention controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Duplicate Invoice Check; SOX Section 404; Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: is_payment_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment on this invoice is currently blocked from processing. True if a payment block is active; False if the invoice is clear for payment. Enables quick filtering of blocked invoices in AP dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (ZLSPR); Internal AP Policy

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the vendor invoice record was last modified in the source system. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net invoice amount converted to the company code local currency using the exchange rate at posting date. Used for consolidated financial reporting and EBITDA calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; IFRS IAS 21; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net payable amount on the invoice after tax and any applicable deductions. Represents the actual liability to be settled with the vendor. Gross amount minus tax amount.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; GAAP; IFRS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or description explaining why payment on this invoice has been blocked (e.g., price discrepancy, missing GR, disputed quantity, pending approval). Corresponds to ZLSPR in SAP. Null if no block is active.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP.ZLSPR); Internal AP Policy; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was actually made to the vendor. Used for days payable outstanding (DPO) calculation, cash flow reporting, and vendor payment performance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Run (F110); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor to comply with agreed payment terms and avoid late payment penalties. Derived from invoice date plus payment terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (ZFBDT); GAAP Accounts Payable

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which payment will be or was made to the vendor (e.g., ACH bank transfer, wire transfer, check, corporate card, direct debit). Corresponds to ZLSCH in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP.ZLSCH); PCI-DSS; Internal Treasury Policy

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The payment document number or bank reference assigned when the invoice was settled. Links the invoice to the outgoing payment transaction for reconciliation. Null if not yet paid.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Document (BKPF); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code agreed with the vendor (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30), defining the due date and any early payment discount conditions. Corresponds to ZTERM in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP.ZTERM); GAAP Accounts Payable

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted in the financial accounting system (SAP S/4HANA). Determines the fiscal period for accounting recognition. Corresponds to BUDAT in SAP RBKP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP.BUDAT); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why the invoice was rejected during the approval workflow (e.g., incorrect amount, missing PO reference, duplicate invoice, unauthorized service). Null if not rejected.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Workflow; Internal AP Policy; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The internal SAP FI document number assigned upon posting of the vendor invoice in SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable. Enables direct traceability back to the source ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP.BELNR / BUKRS / GJAHR)

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the goods or services being invoiced (e.g., broadcast_technology, venue_operations, merchandise_supply, facility_management, it_services, catering, security). Enables spend analytics by category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast_technology|venue_operations|merchandise_supply|facility_management|it_services|catering|security|talent_management — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group (MATKL); Internal Procurement Category Taxonomy

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) included in or applied to the vendor invoice. Corresponds to WMWST in SAP RBKP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP (RBKP.WMWST); GAAP; IFRS; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way matching process comparing the Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt (GR), and vendor invoice to validate that goods/services were ordered, received, and correctly billed. Core AP control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-IV Three-Way Match (RBKP/RSEG/EKPO/EKBE); SOX Section 404; GAAP

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax (e.g., backup withholding, foreign vendor withholding) deducted from the invoice payment. Relevant for international vendor payments and IRS/tax authority compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Withholding Tax (WITH_ITEM); IRS Publication 515; OECD Tax Guidelines

products.name: vendor_payment
products.description: Payment transactions disbursed to vendors against approved invoices. Captures payment date, payment method (ACH, wire, check, virtual card), payment amount, currency, bank account reference, payment run ID, clearing document number, and payment status. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI payment run (F110). Supports cash flow management, EBITDA reporting, and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: vendor_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each vendor payment transaction record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the vendor_payment data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Run (F110)

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity (company code) executing this payment. Supports multi-entity financial reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code (OX02)

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center bearing the expense for this vendor payment. Supports EBITDA reporting and departmental cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting (KS01)

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger account to which this payment is posted (e.g., accounts payable clearing account, bank outgoing account). Supports financial reporting and GL reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI GL Account (FS00); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: partner_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner_goods_receipt. Business justification: vendor_payment stores goods_receipt_number (STRING) as a denormalized reference. Adding partner_goods_receipt_id → partner_goods_receipt.partner_goods_receipt_id enables direct payment-to-GR traceabil
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: partner_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.purchase_order. Business justification: vendor_payment stores purchase_order_number (STRING) as a denormalized reference. Adding partner_purchase_order_id → purchase_order.partner_purchase_order_id formalizes the payment-to-PO link for proc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center associated with this vendor payment for management accounting and EBITDA reporting by business unit (e.g., Events, Broadcasting, Venue Operations, Merchandise).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting (KE51); GAAP

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor contract under which this payment obligation was created. Supports contract-level payment tracking and spend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier, broadcast partner, venue service provider, technology vendor, or third-party contractor) receiving this payment. Links to the partner domain vendor master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master (LFA1)

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved accounts payable invoice against which this payment is being disbursed. Links to the finance.ap_invoice data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable (BKPF/BSEG)

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Vendor payments for capital projects (stadium renovations, broadcast infrastructure upgrades) are settled against WBS elements for project cost tracking and capitalization. This is a standard SAP proj
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of the payment prior to execution. 'pending' = awaiting approver action; 'approved' = authorized for payment; 'rejected' = payment rejected by approver; 'auto_approved' = system-approved within pre-authorized limits. Supports SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow Approval; SOX Section 404; Sports Entertainment Delegation of Authority

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user ID of the individual who authorized this payment. Required for SOX segregation of duties compliance and internal audit trail. Populated when approval_status is 'approved'.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Sports Entertainment Delegation of Authority Policy

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was formally approved for execution. Supports SOX audit trail and segregation of duties verification. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the vendor's bank account used for this payment (e.g., last 4 digits of account number or bank account ID from SAP vendor master). Full account details are stored in the secure payment vault per PCI-DSS requirements. Supports payment reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Bank Details (LFBK); PCI-DSS Requirement 3.4

attributes.name: bank_routing_reference
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the bank routing/sort code or SWIFT/BIC code associated with the vendor's bank for this payment. Supports international wire payment routing and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Bank Details (LFBK); SWIFT BIC Standard; PCI-DSS Requirement 3

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI clearing document number (AUGBL) that records the offsetting of the open payable item upon payment execution. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Clearing (F-44); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this vendor payment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF-CPUDT)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which the payment is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF-WAERS)

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the invoice due_date and the actual payment_date. Positive value indicates late payment; zero or negative indicates on-time or early payment. Used for vendor relationship management and payment performance KPI reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI AP Aging; Sports Entertainment Vendor Management Policy

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Cash discount amount deducted from the invoice total for early payment within the discount terms (e.g., 2/10 net 30). Captured from SAP payment terms (SKFBT). Supports working capital optimization and vendor relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms (OBB8); GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: discount_taken_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an early payment discount was applied to this payment transaction. True = discount was taken; False = no discount applied. Used for cash discount analytics and working capital reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which the invoice must be paid per the agreed payment terms. Used to assess on-time payment performance, manage cash flow forecasting, and evaluate vendor relationship health.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms (BSEG-ZFBDT); GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied at the time of payment to convert the transaction currency to the company code local currency. Relevant for international vendor payments (e.g., FIFA-affiliated suppliers, overseas broadcast partners).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Exchange (OB08); GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal posting period (01–12 for regular periods, 13–16 for special closing periods) within the fiscal year. Used for period-end financial close and EBITDA reporting. Corresponds to SAP MONAT field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF-MONAT); SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this payment is recorded for financial reporting purposes. Used for period-end close, EBITDA reporting, and SOX financial controls. Corresponds to SAP GJAHR field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF-GJAHR); SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount converted to the company code's local (functional) currency using the exchange_rate at time of payment. Used for consolidated financial reporting and EBITDA calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BSEG-DMBTR); GAAP ASC 830; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company code's functional/local currency (e.g., USD for US entities). Used for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Currency

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual net amount received by the vendor after deduction of withholding tax (payment_amount minus withholding_tax_amount). Used for vendor remittance advice and accounts payable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BSEG-DMBTR); GAAP ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount disbursed to the vendor in the transaction currency. Represents the total funds transferred before any withholding tax deductions. Used for cash flow management and vendor spend reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BSEG-WRBTR); GAAP ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a payment is blocked or placed on hold. 'dispute' = invoice under dispute; 'sla_breach' = vendor SLA breach under review; 'compliance_hold' = compliance or regulatory review; 'duplicate_check' = potential duplicate payment detected; 'approval_pending' = awaiting additional approval; 'none' = no block applied.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Block (MRBR); SOX Section 404; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which the payment instruction was initiated. 'automated' = SAP F110 automatic payment run; 'manual' = manually posted payment (F-53); 'portal' = vendor self-service portal; 'treasury_system' = initiated via treasury management system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Processing; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the payment was executed and disbursed to the vendor. Used for cash flow management, payment aging analysis, and EBITDA period reporting. Corresponds to SAP ZFBDT (baseline date for payment).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF-BUDAT); SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism used to disburse funds to the vendor. ACH = Automated Clearing House electronic transfer; wire = international/domestic wire transfer; check = paper check; virtual_card = single-use virtual payment card; EFT = Electronic Funds Transfer; direct_debit = bank direct debit. Sourced from SAP payment method (ZLSCH).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Method (FBZP); PCI-DSS Requirement 3; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known payment document number generated by SAP S/4HANA FI during the payment run (F110). Used for reconciliation with bank statements and vendor remittance advice. Corresponds to the SAP clearing document number (AUGBL).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Run (F110); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Free-text or structured reference included on the payment instruction to the bank (e.g., invoice number, PO number, remittance description). Appears on vendor bank statements to facilitate vendor-side reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (BKPF-XBLNR); NACHA CCD/CTX Addenda

attributes.name: payment_run_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the SAP F110 automatic payment run batch that generated this payment. Used to group all payments executed in the same payment run for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Automatic Payment Program (F110)

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor payment transaction. 'initiated' = payment instruction created; 'processing' = submitted to bank; 'cleared' = confirmed by bank; 'failed' = bank rejection; 'reversed' = payment reversed/voided; 'on_hold' = payment blocked pending review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Run (F110); PCI-DSS Requirement 9

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment by business purpose. 'standard' = routine invoice payment; 'advance' = prepayment before invoice; 'partial' = partial settlement of invoice; 'final' = final payment closing the payable; 'emergency' = expedited out-of-cycle payment; 'intercompany' = payment between related entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI AP; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number of the reversal/cancellation posting that offsets this payment. Populated only when reversal_flag is True. Provides complete audit trail for reversed transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Reversal (FB08); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment has been reversed or voided after initial posting. True = payment reversed; False = payment stands. Reversed payments require a corresponding reversal document for audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Reversal (FB08); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for reversing or voiding this payment (e.g., duplicate payment, incorrect amount, wrong vendor, bank rejection, contract cancellation). Populated only when reversal_flag is True. Required for audit and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Reason (OB29); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this payment record was sourced. Primarily SAP S/4HANA FI payment run (F110). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this vendor payment record was last modified (e.g., status update, reversal posting, block removal). Supports data lineage tracking and Silver Layer change detection. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The bank value date on which funds are credited to the vendor's bank account. May differ from payment_date due to banking processing times. Critical for accurate cash position reporting and treasury management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Treasury; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: vendor_category
attributes.description: Business category of the vendor receiving payment, reflecting the operational domain served (e.g., broadcast_partner, venue_services, merchandise_supplier, technology_vendor, event_contractor, media_production, catering, security). Supports spend analytics by vendor category and domain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast_partner|venue_services|merchandise_supplier|technology_vendor|event_contractor|media_production|catering|security — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Classification; Sports Entertainment Procurement Policy

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the gross payment before disbursement to the vendor. Applicable for certain vendor categories (e.g., athlete agents, international contractors). Required for tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Extended Withholding Tax (WTMG); IRS Form 1099; GDPR Article 5

products.name: rfp

Supports strategic sourcing for broadcast technology, venue services, merchandise manufacturing, and IT platform procurement.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date on which the procurement decision was finalised and the contract was awarded to the selected vendor. Null if the RFP has not yet reached the Awarded status.

attributes.name: awarded_contract_value

attributes.name: broadcast_rights_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the procurement involves broadcast technology, OTT platform services, or media rights distribution infrastructure. Triggers additional FCC and DRM compliance review steps.
attributes.references: FCC — Broadcast Regulation; DRM Governance; Dalet Galaxy

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the RFP was cancelled, if applicable. Null for non-cancelled RFPs. Supports procurement analytics and lessons-learned reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Document

attributes.name: clarification_deadline
attributes.description: Last date by which prospective vendors may submit written questions or requests for clarification on the RFP requirements. Supports transparent and compliant procurement.
attributes.references: ISO 20121 — Event Sustainability Procurement; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: contract_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the estimated and awarded contract values are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency procurement across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: Expected duration of the resulting contract in whole months. Used for financial planning, SLA scheduling, and renewal forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Contract Validity Period

attributes.name: contract_type

attributes.name: delivery_location

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable

attributes.name: is_incumbent_eligible

attributes.name: issue_date

attributes.name: issuing_department

attributes.name: osha_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Compliance Required Flag

attributes.name: pci_dss_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor must demonstrate PCI-DSS compliance as part of the evaluation criteria. Applicable for ticketing, POS, and payment processing technology procurement.
attributes.references: PCI SSC — PCI-DSS; Ticketmaster / AXS

attributes.name: price_weight_pct
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to price/cost in the overall vendor evaluation scoring model. Together with technical and other weights, must sum to 100%. Supports transparent and auditable procurement scoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Evaluation Schema

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: Standardised spend category classifying the type of goods or services being procured (e.g., Broadcast Technology, Venue Services, Merchandise Manufacturing, IT Platform, Facility Management, Talent Services). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast_technology|venue_services|merchandise_manufacturing|it_platform|facility_management|talent_services|marketing_services|security_services — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Group / Spend Category

attributes.name: procurement_method
attributes.description: Method used to conduct the procurement. Open: any vendor may respond; Restricted: only pre-qualified vendors invited; Sole Source: single vendor without competition; Negotiated: direct negotiation with selected vendors.
attributes.references: ISO 20121 — Sustainable Procurement; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: proposals_received_count
attributes.description: Actual number of vendor proposals received by the submission deadline. Compared against vendors_invited_count to measure vendor engagement and market competitiveness.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Quotation Receipt

attributes.name: requires_nda
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors must execute a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before receiving the full RFP documentation. Common for broadcast rights, IP-sensitive technology, and NIL-related procurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Partner Agreement Tracking; IP / DRM Governance

attributes.name: rfp_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the business need, scope of work, deliverables, and objectives of the procurement. Used by evaluators and vendors to understand requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Long Text / Purchasing Document

attributes.name: rfp_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the RFP at issuance, used in all vendor communications and procurement correspondence (e.g., RFP-2024-00123). Aligns with SAP MM purchasing document numbering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Document Number

attributes.name: rfp_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the RFP. Draft: under internal preparation; Issued: distributed to vendors; Evaluation: proposals under review; Awarded: contract awarded to winning vendor; Cancelled: procurement discontinued.

attributes.name: sla_weight_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Evaluation Weight Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to Service Level Agreement (SLA) commitments in the vendor evaluation scoring model. Reflects the operational importance of service reliability for broadcast, venue, and IT procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Evaluation Schema; SLA Governance

attributes.name: submission_deadline
attributes.description: Exact date and time by which vendor proposals must be received. Proposals submitted after this timestamp are typically disqualified. Stored with timezone offset to support global vendor participation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Validity End Date / Procurement SLA

attributes.name: sustainability_weight_pct
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to environmental and social sustainability criteria in the vendor evaluation scoring model. Aligns with ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 20121 — Event Sustainability Management Systems

attributes.name: technical_weight_pct
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to technical capability and solution quality in the vendor evaluation scoring model. Complements price_weight_pct and other criteria weights.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Evaluation Schema

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the Request for Proposal, summarising the scope of goods or services being procured (e.g., 'Broadcast Technology Infrastructure Refresh FY2025').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Document Header Text

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the RFP record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and Silver Layer incremental load processing on Databricks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Change Document; Databricks Lakehouse

attributes.name: vendors_invited_count
attributes.description: Total number of prospective vendors formally invited to respond to this RFP. Supports competitive procurement governance and sourcing strategy analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Quotation / RFQ Vendor Count

products.name: rfp_response
products.description: Vendor bid submissions in response to issued RFPs. Captures responding vendor, submission date, proposed price, proposed delivery timeline, technical compliance score, commercial compliance score, evaluator notes, shortlist flag, and award recommendation. Enables competitive bid evaluation and vendor selection documentation for procurement governance and audit trails.

attributes.name: rfp_response_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each vendor bid submission in response to an issued RFP. Primary key for the rfp_response data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Document

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal staff member or procurement officer responsible for evaluating and scoring this bid submission.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Employee Master

attributes.name: evaluator_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal staff member or procurement officer responsible for evaluating and scoring this bid submission.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Employee Master

attributes.name: rfp_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent RFP document that solicited this vendor bid. Links the response back to the originating procurement event.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Request for Quotation (RFQ)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier entity that submitted this bid response. Links to the partner/vendor master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (LFA1)

attributes.name: award_justification
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the procurement evaluator documenting the rationale for recommending or not recommending this bid for contract award. Required for procurement governance and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record

attributes.name: best_and_final_offer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission represents the vendor's Best and Final Offer (BAFO) following negotiation rounds. BAFO submissions are the definitive pricing and terms used for final award decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Quotation Negotiation; SOX — Procurement Controls

attributes.name: bid_validity_date
attributes.description: The date until which the vendor's bid submission remains valid and binding. After this date, the vendor may revise pricing or withdraw the offer. Critical for procurement timeline management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Quotation Validity End Date (ANGDT)

attributes.name: clarification_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the vendor must respond to any clarification requests raised by the procurement team. Null if no clarification has been requested.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Quotation Deadline

attributes.name: clarification_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the procurement team has issued a formal clarification request to the vendor regarding their bid submission. Tracks the need for additional information before evaluation can be completed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Quotation Clarification

attributes.name: commercial_compliance_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) assigned by the evaluation panel reflecting the degree to which the vendor's bid meets the commercial requirements of the RFP, including pricing competitiveness, payment terms, and contractual risk allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Evaluation (ME61); PCI SSC

attributes.name: contract_duration_days
attributes.description: The total number of calendar days the vendor proposes for the contract or service engagement period, from start date to delivery date. Used for comparative timeline evaluation across bids.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Validity Period

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFP response record was first captured in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 20121 — Event Sustainability Management; SOX — Financial Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the proposed price and any financial values in this bid submission (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Key

attributes.name: disqualification_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a bid was disqualified or rejected during the evaluation process. Null if the bid was not disqualified. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_compliant_technical|non_compliant_commercial|late_submission|incomplete_documentation|conflict_of_interest|debarred_vendor|pricing_anomaly|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Rejection Reason; SOX — Procurement Controls

attributes.name: diversity_certification
attributes.description: Vendor's declared diversity or inclusion certification status as submitted in the bid. attributes.references: ISO 20121 — Event Sustainability; SEC — ESG Reporting

attributes.name: evaluation_methodology
attributes.description: The procurement evaluation approach applied to score and rank this bid submission (e.g., weighted criteria scoring for broadcast rights bids, lowest price for commodity merchandise supply).

attributes.name: evaluation_round
attributes.description: Sequential round number of the procurement evaluation process in which this bid was assessed (e.g., 1 = initial screening, 2 = technical deep-dive, 3 = best and final offer). Supports multi-stage procurement workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Quotation Comparison Round

attributes.name: evaluator_notes
attributes.description: Structured or free-text notes recorded by the assigned evaluator during the bid review process, capturing observations on vendor capability, risk factors, and compliance gaps.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Evaluation Notes; ISO 20121

attributes.name: gdpr_compliance_confirmed
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Compliance Confirmed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has confirmed compliance with GDPR data protection requirements as part of their bid submission. Mandatory for technology vendors and any vendor processing fan or employee personal data in EU markets.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_confirmed

attributes.name: is_award_recommended

attributes.name: is_shortlisted

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: overall_evaluation_score

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: procurement_category

products.name: ip_license_grant
products.description: This association product represents the contractual IP License Grant between a vendor_contract and an ip_portfolio asset. It captures the specific authorization within a vendor agreement that grants a vendor rights to use a defined intellectual property asset under defined terms — including grant type, scope, territory, exclusivity, royalty rate, and license term dates. Each record links one vendor_contract to one ip_portfolio asset and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific vendor-IP pairing. Serves as the SSOT for all IP licensing provisions embedded within vendor commercial agreements.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, vendor contracts (e.g., broadcast technology, merchandise, digital platform agreements) routinely include IP licensing provisions that grant vendors rights to use specific trademarks, logos, broadcast rights, or other IP assets. A single vendor contract can license multiple IP assets simultaneously (e.g., a broadcast technology vendor licensed to use the league logo, team marks, and broadcast rights), and a single IP asset (e.g., the league trademark) can be licensed across many vendor contracts. The business actively manages these IP license grants as distinct operational records with their own terms, territory, exclusivity, and royalty rates.

products.name: vendor_activation
products.description: This association product represents the operational Activation event between a fixture and a vendor. It captures the per-fixture engagement of an external vendor to deliver a specific service at a live event — including the service category, activation role, governing contract reference, accreditation clearance status, and on-site timing window. Each record links one fixture to one vendor for one service deployment, with attributes that exist only in the context of this fixture-vendor engagement and cannot reside on either the fixture or vendor master alone.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment operations, a single fixture (match, concert, PPV event) requires MANY vendors simultaneously — catering, security, AV/broadcast, merchandise, medical, transportation — each activated for that specific event. Conversely, a single vendor (e.g., a security firm or catering company) operates across MANY fixtures per season. The business actively manages per-fixture vendor activations as operational records with their own lifecycle: activation role, service category, accreditation status, and timing windows that belong to neither the fixture nor the vendor master alone.

products.name: vendor_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Role-based assignment between an internal employee and an external vendor. It captures which employees are responsible for managing, liaising with, or overseeing a given vendor relationship, in what capacity, and for what period. Each record links one employee to one vendor with a defined role, scope, and tenure — attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment and cannot reside on either the employee or vendor master record alone.. Existence Justification: In sports-entertainment operations, employees actively manage vendor relationships across multiple domains — a procurement manager handles multiple broadcast technology vendors, a venue operations director manages multiple facility service providers, and a legal counsel oversees multiple contractor agreements simultaneously. Conversely, a single vendor (e.g., a broadcast technology partner) interacts with multiple internal employees across procurement, legal, finance, and operations departments. This is an operational 'Account Management Assignment' concept that the business actively creates, updates, and terminates — it is not derivable from transactional data alone.
