'prior_year_actuals' = based on last year's performance; 'board_mandate' = top-down directive from board; 'market_benchmark' = benchmarked against industry peers (e.g., NFL, NBA league averages); 'zero_based' = built from zero; 'negotiated' = agreed between BU and finance; 'statistical_model' = derived from predictive analytics pipeline.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Planning Methodology; ISO 20121

attributes.name: target_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this KPI target record, used in planning documents, board presentations, and cross-system references. Format: KT- followed by 4-12 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Plan Reference Codes

attributes.name: target_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether higher or lower values represent better performance. 'maximize' = higher is better (e.g., revenue, NPS, viewership); 'minimize' = lower is better (e.g., CAC, injury rate, churn); 'maintain' = value should stay within a defined band (e.g., compliance rate).
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — KPI Polarity; Adobe Experience Platform — Analytics Framework

attributes.name: target_period_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the KPI target period ends. Defines the close boundary for variance analysis. May align with fiscal year-end, season end, or event date.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Planning Period; SAP S/4HANA FI — Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: target_period_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the KPI target period begins. Defines the start boundary for variance analysis between actuals and this plan.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Planning Period; SAP S/4HANA FI — Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: target_setting_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this KPI target was formally established and recorded. Distinct from the system audit timestamp; represents the business event of target-setting.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Plan Submission Date; SOX — Financial Controls

attributes.name: target_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this KPI target record. 'draft' = under construction; 'pending_approval' = submitted for sign-off; 'approved' = formally approved but period not yet started; 'active' = current operative target; 'superseded' = replaced by a revised target; 'cancelled' = withdrawn.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Plan Status Workflow; SOX — Financial Controls

attributes.name: target_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the KPI target by business function. 'financial' = revenue, EBITDA, ARR, ARPU; 'operational' = venue utilization, broadcast uptime; 'fan_engagement' = NPS, LTV, CAC; 'compliance' = regulatory adherence rates; 'sustainability' = ISO 20121 metrics; 'workforce' = headcount, retention.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — KPI Taxonomy; ISO 20121; GDPR

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The planned or committed target value for the KPI for the specified business unit and period. This is the primary performance expectation against which actuals will be compared in variance analysis. No actuals are stored here.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Plan Value; SOX — Financial Controls

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this KPI target record was most recently modified. Updated on every revision, approval status change, or data correction. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; Enterprise Data Governance — Audit Trail

attributes.name: variance_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage deviation from the target_value before the KPI is flagged as off-track in dashboards and reports. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5% tolerance). Enables nuanced variance analysis without false alerts.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Variance Rules; KPI Dashboard Configuration

attributes.name: revised_kpi_target_id

attributes.name: deployment_status

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date on which this model-market deployment became operationally active. Marks the start of the period during which the model version governs the specified market scope.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: The date on which this model-market deployment was retired, superseded, or deactivated. Null if the deployment is currently active. Together with effective_from_date, defines the full operational window of this deployment record.

attributes.name: explainability_method
attributes.description: The model interpretability technique applied to generate feature-level explanations for predictions (e.g., 'shap' for SHAP values). Required for regulatory AI transparency obligations and business stakeholder trust in model outputs.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 22 Automated Decision-Making; ISO/IEC 22989 AI Concepts and Terminology; Sports Entertainment AI Ethics Policy

attributes.name: feature_count
attributes.description: Total number of input features used in the final trained model. Used for model complexity governance, regulatory explainability assessments, and computational resource planning.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Governance Standards; ISO/IEC 22989 AI Concepts and Terminology

attributes.name: feature_set_summary
attributes.description: High-level narrative description of the input feature categories used in the model (e.g., 'Ticket purchase recency/frequency/monetary, content streaming engagement, social media sentiment, venue attendance history, merchandise purchase behavior'). Not a full feature list — that resides in the feature store.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Feature Store Documentation Standards

attributes.name: is_challenger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version is currently deployed as a challenger in an A/B or champion/challenger evaluation. True = challenger model receiving a traffic split for comparative evaluation against the champion.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Champion/Challenger Testing Framework

attributes.name: is_champion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this model version is the current champion (primary production model) in a champion/challenger evaluation framework. True = champion model actively serving predictions; False = challenger or non-active model. Only one model per category should be champion at any time.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Champion/Challenger Testing Framework

attributes.name: last_deployed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this model version was most recently promoted to its current deployment environment (staging or production). Used for deployment audit trails and rollback reference.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform MLOps Deployment Audit Standards

attributes.name: last_trained_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent model training run was completed. Used to calculate model age, assess staleness risk, and trigger retraining alerts when the elapsed time exceeds the retraining_frequency threshold.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Lifecycle Standards

attributes.name: market_segment_scope
attributes.description: The specific sub-scope or segment of the betting market to which this deployment applies. May narrow the deployment to a subset of the market — e.g., applying the churn model only to live in-play markets for NFL fixtures, or only to futures markets above a defined stake threshold. Allows fine-grained deployment targeting within a market definition.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: minimum_acceptable_metric
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable value for the primary performance metric below which the model is flagged for retraining or retirement. Enforces model quality governance and prevents degraded predictions from reaching production.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Governance Standards; Sports Entertainment Analytics KPI Policy

attributes.name: model_application_type
attributes.description: The operational purpose for which this fan behavior model is being applied to this betting market scope. Determines how the model output is consumed — e.g., LIABILITY_CALIBRATION uses the model score to adjust max stake limits, PERSONALIZATION uses it to surface or suppress market visibility for specific fan segments.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: model_artifact_path
attributes.description: The storage path or URI to the serialized model artifact (e.g., MLflow model registry path, S3/ADLS URI). Confidential as it reveals internal infrastructure topology. Used by MLOps pipelines to load the model for scoring.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Data Architecture Standards; Adobe Experience Platform MLflow Integration

attributes.name: model_category
attributes.description: Business use-case category that classifies the model's primary analytical purpose within the Sports Entertainment fan analytics ecosystem. Drives routing to the appropriate business unit and KPI dashboard. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: churn_propensity|upsell_likelihood|attendance_prediction|content_affinity|sponsorship_affinity|merchandise_propensity|loyalty_tier_prediction|sentiment_classification — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Fan Engagement Framework; Salesforce CRM Analytics Standards

attributes.name: model_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the model, used in cross-system references, API calls, and reporting (e.g., 'FBM-CHURN-001'). Unique across the model registry.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Registry Standards

attributes.name: model_description
attributes.description: Extended narrative description of the model's methodology, design rationale, key assumptions, known limitations, and intended use boundaries. Serves as the primary documentation artifact in the model registry for business and technical stakeholders.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Documentation Standards; ISO/IEC 22989 AI Concepts and Terminology

attributes.name: model_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the fan behavior model (e.g., 'Fan Churn Propensity v3', 'Upsell Likelihood Q4 2024'). Used as the primary display label in dashboards and model governance documentation.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Registry Standards

attributes.name: model_type
attributes.description: Machine learning paradigm used by the model. Classification models predict discrete outcomes (e.g., churn yes/no); regression models predict continuous values (e.g., attendance count); clustering models segment fans into groups; recommendation models suggest content or products.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform AI/ML Framework; ISO/IEC 22989 AI Concepts and Terminology

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the model following major.minor.patch convention (e.g., '2.1.0'). Incremented on retraining, feature changes, or hyperparameter updates. Enables version-controlled model governance and rollback capability.
attributes.references: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 (semver.org); Adobe Experience Platform Model Versioning Policy

attributes.name: model_version_applied
attributes.description: The specific semantic version of the fan behavior model (e.g., 2.1.0) that was active for this deployment record. Captured at deployment time to preserve a point-in-time audit trail independent of the current model_version on the parent fan_behavior_model registry record, which may have been updated since.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: output_score_label
attributes.description: The name of the score or prediction output field produced by this model when applied to fan records (e.g., 'churn_probability_score', 'upsell_likelihood_score', 'predicted_attendance_count'). Used to map model output to downstream CRM and activation systems.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Output Standards; Salesforce CRM Integration Specification

attributes.name: output_score_range_max
attributes.description: The maximum possible value of the model's output score (e.g., 1.0 for probability scores, 100 for index scores). Used for output validation, dashboard axis configuration, and downstream system integration.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Output Standards

attributes.name: output_score_range_min
attributes.description: The minimum possible value of the model's output score (e.g., 0.0 for probability scores, -1.0 for sentiment scores). Used for output validation, dashboard axis configuration, and downstream system integration.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Output Standards

attributes.name: platform_environment
attributes.description: The ML platform or compute environment where this model is trained and served (e.g., 'databricks' for Databricks Lakehouse, 'aep_native' for Adobe Experience Platform native ML). Informs infrastructure cost allocation and operational support routing.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Technology Architecture Standards; Adobe Experience Platform Integration Guide

attributes.name: primary_metric_value
attributes.description: The numeric score achieved on the primary performance metric during the most recent model evaluation on the holdout/test dataset (e.g., AUC-ROC of 0.847). Used for champion/challenger comparison and model governance thresholds.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Evaluation Standards

attributes.name: primary_performance_metric
attributes.description: The principal evaluation metric used to assess model quality and compare versions (e.g., 'auc_roc' for classification, 'rmse' for regression, 'ndcg' for recommendation). Drives champion/challenger selection decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: auc_roc|f1_score|precision|recall|rmse|mae|accuracy|silhouette_score|ndcg — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Evaluation Standards; ISO/IEC 22989 AI Concepts and Terminology

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this model version was or is scheduled to be retired and removed from active scoring. Null for active models. Required for model lifecycle governance and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Lifecycle Standards; Sports Entertainment Analytics Governance Policy

attributes.name: retraining_frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled cadence at which the model is retrained on fresh data to prevent model drift (e.g., 'monthly' for churn models, 'quarterly' for attendance prediction). Drives MLOps pipeline scheduling and data engineering SLAs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|event_triggered|on_demand — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform MLOps Governance Standards; Sports Entertainment Analytics Model Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: scoring_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently the model generates predictions against the fan population (e.g., 'daily' batch scoring for churn propensity, 'real_time' for content recommendation). Drives infrastructure scheduling and SLA commitments.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Scoring Pipeline Standards; Sports Entertainment Analytics SLA Policy

attributes.name: target_fan_segment
attributes.description: Description of the fan population this model is designed to score (e.g., 'Season ticket holders with 2+ years tenure', 'All registered fans in North American markets', 'OTT streaming subscribers'). Defines the model's applicable audience scope.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Audience Segmentation Standards; Salesforce CRM Fan Segmentation Policy

attributes.name: target_variable
attributes.description: The outcome variable or label the model is trained to predict (e.g., 'churn_within_90_days', 'ticket_upsell_conversion', 'event_attendance_count'). Defines the model's prediction objective and is critical for model documentation and reproducibility.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Model Documentation Standards; ISO/IEC 22989 AI Concepts and Terminology

attributes.name: training_data_end_date

attributes.name: training_data_start_date

attributes.name: training_dataset_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the dataset(s) used to train the model, including data sources (e.g., Ticketmaster transaction history, Adobe Experience Platform fan profiles, Salesforce CRM engagement data), observation window, and population scope.

attributes.name: training_record_count
attributes.description: Number of fan records (observations) included in the training dataset. Provides context for model statistical power, generalizability, and minimum data volume compliance checks.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: validation_metric_value

attributes.name: percentile_band

attributes.name: score_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this score was generated by the model run. Used for temporal filtering, trend analysis, and determining score freshness in CRM and personalization platforms.

attributes.description: Difference between the current score_value and the previous_score_value (current minus previous). Positive values indicate score improvement; negative values indicate score decline. Used to identify fans with rapidly changing behavioral signals for priority intervention.

attributes.name: score_population_size
attributes.description: Total number of fan records scored in the same model run. Used to contextualize the percentile rank and validate that the scoring pipeline processed the expected volume of fans.

attributes.name: score_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of this fan's score within the scored population for the same model run, ordered from highest to lowest score_value. Rank 1 = highest scoring fan. Used for top-N audience selection in marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: score_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this score record. attributes.name: score_trend
attributes.description: Directional trend classification of the fan's score over recent model runs. 'improving' = score_delta positive and significant; 'stable' = score_delta within noise threshold; 'declining' = score_delta negative and significant; 'new' = no prior score exists for comparison.

attributes.name: score_type

attributes.name: score_value

attributes.name: scoring_horizon_days
attributes.description: The forward-looking prediction window in days for which this score is valid (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 365). For propensity scores, this is the window within which the predicted event is expected to occur. For LTV scores, this is the value accumulation horizon.

attributes.name: training_cohort
attributes.description: Label identifying the fan population cohort used to train the model that produced this score (e.g., 'NBA_2023_Season', 'Global_All_Sports_2024'). Supports model governance and ensures scores are interpreted within the correct population context.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Analytics Model Registry

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fan_score record was last modified (e.g., status update, suppression flag change). Supports change data capture and audit trail requirements in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: demographic_segment_code

attributes.name: demographic_universe_size
attributes.description: The total estimated population size of the demographic segment universe in the measured market, as defined by the measurement provider. Used as the denominator for calculating rating percentages. Sourced from Nielsen or Comscore universe estimates.

attributes.name: geographic_market_code

Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for national markets or Nielsen DMA codes for US sub-national markets (e.g., 'US-NYC' for New York DMA, 'GBR' for United Kingdom national). Supports market-level rights valuation and sponsorship ROI analysis.

attributes.name: grp

GRP (Gross Rating Points) is the standard advertising currency metric used by sponsors and media buyers to evaluate the total weight of a broadcast buy. attributes.name: household_rating
attributes.description: The percentage of all television households in the measured market that were tuned to this broadcast during the measurement window. attributes.references: Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: is_live_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audience measurement record pertains to a live broadcast of a sports or entertainment event (True) or a recorded/replay/VOD broadcast (False). Live event measurements command premium CPM rates and are treated differently in rights valuation models.
attributes.references: Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards; Sports Entertainment Broadcast Standards

attributes.name: is_ppv
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audience measurement record is for a PPV (Pay-Per-View) broadcast (True) or a standard broadcast (False). PPV audience measurement uses different methodologies and is reported separately for rights valuation and revenue attribution.

attributes.name: live_viewers
attributes.description: The number of viewers who watched the broadcast live (same-day, same-time as the original airing). Distinct from time-shifted viewers. Live viewership is the primary metric for live sports events and is used in real-time sponsorship exposure calculations.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the audience measurement was recorded or the broadcast window occurred. Used for day-level reporting, trend analysis, and alignment with Nielsen overnight ratings release schedules.
attributes.references: Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards; Sports Entertainment Reporting Standards

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: The statistical methodology used to derive the audience measurement. Panel-based uses a representative sample audience panel (Nielsen People Meter); census-based uses complete server-side stream counts; hybrid combines panel and census data; modeled uses statistical inference; self-reported relies on partner-submitted data.
attributes.references: Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards; Comscore Measurement Methodology; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: measurement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing qualitative context about this audience measurement record, such as methodology caveats, data quality flags, extraordinary circumstances affecting viewership (e.g., weather events, competing programming), or notes from the measurement provider regarding revisions.

attributes.name: measurement_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned by the measurement provider (e.g., Nielsen report code, Comscore measurement ID, internal OTT telemetry batch reference). Used for cross-referencing with third-party measurement reports.

attributes.name: measurement_source
attributes.description: The organization or system that produced this audience measurement. Nielsen provides linear TV panel-based ratings; Comscore provides digital and cross-platform measurement; internal_ott refers to first-party OTT telemetry from the Sports Entertainment streaming platform; Adobe_AEP refers to Adobe Experience Platform analytics; partner_reported refers to data submitted by broadcast partners; manual refers to manually entered estimates.

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the audience measurement record. attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world date and time at which the audience measurement observation was captured or the measurement window began. Represents the business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: measurement_window_end
attributes.description: The end date and time of the audience measurement window. Combined with measurement_window_start to define the total measurement duration. Used for AMA (Average Minute Audience) calculation and broadcast window performance analysis.

attributes.name: measurement_window_start
attributes.description: The start date and time of the audience measurement window. For live events this is the broadcast start time; for time-shifted viewing this is the start of the measurement interval. Used to calculate AMA (Average Minute Audience) and other time-based metrics.

attributes.name: ott_concurrent_streams
attributes.description: The number of simultaneous active OTT (Over-The-Top) streaming sessions at the peak measurement point during the broadcast window. attributes.name: peak_concurrent_viewers

attributes.name: persons_rating
attributes.description: The percentage of all persons in the measured demographic universe who were watching this broadcast during the measurement window. attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business user who approved this forecast output for publication and distribution. Populated when is_approved is True. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; Workday Adaptive Planning — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level (expressed as a percentage, e.g., 80.00, 90.00, 95.00) associated with the lower and upper confidence interval bounds. Indicates the probability that the actual value will fall within the stated interval.
attributes.references: Statistical Forecasting Standards — ISO 3534-1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast output record was first written to the Silver layer data store. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, SLA monitoring, and pipeline observability.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment — Data Governance and Audit Policy; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable when the forecasted metric is a monetary value (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Null for non-monetary metrics such as attendance headcount or viewership. Required for multi-currency FP&A consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Data governance classification level assigned to this forecast output record, indicating sensitivity and access control requirements. Financial forecasts are typically 'confidential' or 'restricted' prior to publication. Aligns with GDPR, CCPA, and SOX data governance requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; SOX — Financial Controls; Sports Entertainment Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: forecast_granularity
attributes.description: The temporal or business granularity at which this forecast output is expressed. Determines how the forecast period start and end dates should be interpreted and how outputs should be aggregated for reporting.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Planning Granularity

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the forecast run execution date and the forecast period start date. Indicates how far into the future the forecast was made; shorter horizons typically yield higher accuracy. Used for model performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Horizon Metadata

attributes.name: forecast_output_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this forecast output record. 'draft' indicates preliminary output not yet approved; 'published' indicates approved and distributed to consumers; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer run; 'archived' indicates retained for historical reference; 'under_review' indicates pending validation.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Lifecycle

attributes.name: forecast_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the time period covered by this forecast output. Defines the upper boundary of the forecast window. Must be greater than or equal to forecast_period_start_date.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Period Definition

attributes.name: forecast_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the time period covered by this forecast output. Combined with forecast_period_end_date, defines the exact window for which the point forecast and confidence intervals apply.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Period Definition

attributes.name: forecast_run_code
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the forecast run that produced this output (e.g., FCR-2024Q3-TICK-001). Used by FP&A and commercial teams to reference specific forecast cycles in reports and communications.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Run Code Convention

attributes.name: forecast_scenario_label
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the planning scenario under which this forecast was produced (e.g., 'Base Case', 'Optimistic', 'Pessimistic', 'COVID-Impact', 'Stadium-Expansion'). Populated primarily for scenario-type forecasts to distinguish multiple concurrent scenario runs.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Scenario Planning

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast output by its planning purpose. 'baseline' is the standard model-generated forecast; 'scenario' is a what-if or sensitivity analysis output; 'stretch' is an aspirational target-aligned forecast; 'revised' is an updated forecast replacing a prior baseline; 'consensus' is a management-approved blended forecast.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Type Classification

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the geographic market or territory for which this forecast was produced (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'AUS'). Supports multi-market FP&A consolidation and regional performance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 — Country Codes

attributes.name: is_actuals_available
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the actual realized value has been loaded for this forecast output record. True when actual_value is populated; False when the forecast period has not yet closed or actuals have not yet been ingested.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Actuals Integration

attributes.name: is_approved
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this forecast output has been reviewed and approved by an authorized business owner (e.g., FP&A lead, VP of Finance). Approved forecasts are eligible for distribution to executive dashboards and external reporting.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; Workday Adaptive Planning — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: lower_confidence_interval
attributes.description: The lower bound of the statistical confidence interval around the point forecast. Represents the pessimistic scenario boundary at the specified confidence level (e.g., 80% or 95%). Used by FP&A for downside risk planning.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Confidence Interval

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the forecast values (point forecast, confidence intervals, actuals) are expressed (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'headcount', 'thousands_viewers', 'units'). Critical for correct interpretation and aggregation of forecast outputs across different metric types.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; Sports Entertainment Analytics Domain Taxonomy

attributes.name: metric_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the forecasted business metric. Supports cross-domain aggregation and dashboard filtering across FP&A, venue operations, and commercial teams. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue|attendance|viewership|merchandise|sponsorship|digital_engagement|broadcast|concessions — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment — Analytics Domain Taxonomy

attributes.name: metric_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the business metric being forecasted (e.g., 'Ticket Revenue', 'Event Attendance', 'Viewership', 'Merchandise Units Sold'). Denormalized from the KPI definition for direct consumption by reporting tools without requiring a join.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Metric Catalogue

attributes.name: model_accuracy_score
attributes.description: The accuracy metric (e.g., Mean Absolute Percentage Error — MAPE, or R-squared) recorded for the model at the time this forecast was generated, based on back-testing or prior period validation. Provides consumers with a quality signal for the forecast output.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment — Analytics Model Governance Policy

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the forecasting model that produced this output (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3.1'). Enables reproducibility audits and comparison of forecast accuracy across model versions. Supports model governance and MLOps lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment — Analytics Model Governance Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for analyst commentary, caveats, or contextual notes associated with this forecast output (e.g., 'Adjusted for stadium renovation impact', 'Excludes PPV revenue', 'Based on pre-sale ticket data only'). Supports qualitative context for quantitative forecast values.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Commentary

attributes.name: point_forecast_value
attributes.description: The central (best-estimate) forecast value for the business metric over the defined forecast period. Represents the model's single-point prediction (e.g., expected ticket revenue in USD, expected attendance headcount, expected viewership in thousands).
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Output Value

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast output was published and made available to downstream consumers (FP&A, venue operations, commercial teams, executive dashboards). Null for draft or under-review records.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Distribution

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast output record was last modified, including updates to actuals, variance fields, status changes, or approval state. Used for incremental processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment — Data Governance and Audit Policy; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: upper_confidence_interval
attributes.description: The upper bound of the statistical confidence interval around the point forecast. Represents the optimistic scenario boundary at the specified confidence level. Used by commercial teams for upside opportunity planning.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Forecast Confidence Interval

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage difference between the actual realized value and the point forecast value, calculated as (actual_value - point_forecast_value) / point_forecast_value * 100. Populated once actuals are available. Used by FP&A for KPI reporting and model performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Variance Analysis; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: variance_value
attributes.description: Absolute difference between the actual realized value and the point forecast value (actual_value minus point_forecast_value). Populated once actuals are available. Positive values indicate the actuals exceeded the forecast; negative values indicate underperformance. Used for model accuracy assessment.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning — Variance Analysis; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sporting or entertainment event that this wager is associated with (e.g., NFL game, UFC bout, NBA match). Used for event-level wagering aggregation and settlement.
attributes.references: Sports Wagering Regulatory Framework

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the regulatory jurisdiction under which this wager was accepted (e.g., Nevada, New Jersey, United Kingdom). Determines applicable tax rates, reporting obligations, and responsible gaming rules.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Regulations; UKGC Licensing Conditions

attributes.name: regulatory_report_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the regulatory filing or suspicious activity report (SAR) that this wager was included in, if applicable. Used for AML compliance tracking and regulatory audit trail. Null if no regulatory report has been filed for this wager.
attributes.references: FinCEN SAR Filing Requirements; State Gaming Commission AML Reporting; Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: retail_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical retail sportsbook location (e.g., stadium sportsbook, casino floor) where the wager was placed. Null for digital channel wagers. Used for venue-level revenue reporting and compliance.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Retail Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: revenue_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Wagers generate GGR attributed to revenue streams by sport_type, league_code, and distribution_channel. This link enables real-time GGR attribution to finance.revenue_stream for financial reporting, r
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gaming.gaming_session. Business justification: A wager is placed within the context of a gaming session. Linking wager to gaming_session enables session-level wagering analytics, responsible gaming monitoring (session spend tracking), and regulato
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_jurisdiction. Business justification: Wagers include tax_withheld_amount and are subject to jock_tax and entertainment_tax by jurisdiction. finance.tax_jurisdiction is the authoritative tax rate source for per-wager withholding calculatio
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of any bonus or promotional credit applied to this wager. Tracked separately from real-money stake for regulatory gross gaming revenue (GGR) reporting and bonus liability accounting.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Financial Reporting; AGA Standards

attributes.name: cashout_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount offered and accepted by the bettor when exercising the early cash-out option. Null if the wager was not cashed out. Represents the sportsbook's real-time liability reduction value.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Financial Reporting; AGA Best Practices

attributes.name: cashout_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the bettor exercised the early cash-out option, if applicable. Null if the wager was not cashed out early. Used for cash-out feature analytics and liability management.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Technical Standards; AGA Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this wager record was first created in the sportsbook system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this wager (stake, payout, settlement). Supports multi-currency sportsbook operations across international jurisdictions (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; UKGC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: device_fingerprint
attributes.description: Anonymized or hashed identifier of the device used to place the wager. Used for fraud detection, multi-accounting prevention, and geolocation compliance verification. Not a direct personal identifier but may be used to identify individuals in combination with other data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; State Gaming Commission Anti-Fraud Requirements

attributes.name: geolocation_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the bettor was physically located at time of wager placement. Used for international jurisdiction compliance and cross-border wagering restriction enforcement.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; State Gaming Commission Geolocation Requirements; UKGC Licensing Conditions

attributes.name: geolocation_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (or equivalent jurisdiction code) where the bettor was physically located at time of wager placement, as verified by geolocation service. Critical for confirming the bettor is within a licensed wagering jurisdiction.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Geolocation Requirements; Wire Act Compliance

attributes.name: geolocation_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor's physical location was successfully verified by the geolocation service at time of wager placement. False may indicate a geolocation failure or VPN/proxy detection, requiring compliance review.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Geolocation Requirements; Wire Act Compliance

attributes.name: integrity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wager has been flagged for sports integrity review due to suspicious betting patterns (e.g., unusual odds movement, match-fixing indicators). Flagged wagers are reported to relevant sports governing bodies (FIFA, NFL, NBA integrity units) and gaming regulators.
attributes.references: INTEGRITY UNIT Reporting Requirements; FIFA Integrity Regulations; IOC Anti-Corruption Framework; CAS Arbitration Standards

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the wager was placed. Used for geolocation verification to confirm the bettor is within a licensed jurisdiction at time of placement. Subject to privacy regulations in EU and California jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; State Gaming Commission Geolocation Requirements

attributes.name: is_free_bet
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wager was funded by a promotional free bet credit rather than real money from the bettor's account. Free bets are excluded from certain regulatory gross gaming revenue calculations.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Promotional Wagering Rules; AGA Responsible Marketing Standards

attributes.name: is_live_bet
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wager was placed as an in-play (live) bet after the event commenced, as opposed to a pre-game bet. Live bets carry different risk profiles and are subject to specific regulatory requirements in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission In-Play Betting Regulations; UKGC Technical Standards

attributes.name: leg_count
attributes.description: The number of individual selections (legs) included in this wager. For straight bets this is 1; for parlays and teasers this is 2 or more. Used for parlay payout validation and risk management.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Technical Standards; AGA Standards

attributes.name: odds_at_placement
attributes.description: The decimal odds offered to the bettor at the exact moment the wager was placed. Locked in at placement time and used for payout calculation. Stored in decimal format (e.g., 2.50 = evens +100 American odds) regardless of display format shown to bettor.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Technical Standards; UKGC Technical Standards

attributes.name: odds_format
attributes.description: The odds display format presented to the bettor at time of placement (e.g., 'american' for +150/-110, 'decimal' for 2.50, 'fractional' for 3/2). Stored for display reconciliation and international market compliance.
attributes.references: UKGC Technical Standards; State Gaming Commission Regulations

attributes.name: operator_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the licensed sportsbook operator or brand under which this wager was accepted. Supports multi-brand or white-label sportsbook operations and operator-level regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Licensing Requirements; AGA Standards

attributes.name: placement_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) when the wager was accepted and confirmed by the sportsbook platform. This is the principal business event timestamp and is critical for in-play betting validation, regulatory reporting, and audit trails.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Reporting Requirements; UKGC Technical Standards

attributes.name: potential_payout
attributes.description: The maximum gross payout amount the bettor would receive if the wager wins, calculated as stake_amount multiplied by odds_at_placement. Captured at placement time for liability management and bettor communication.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Financial Reporting; AGA Standards

attributes.name: potential_profit
attributes.description: The net profit the bettor would receive if the wager wins, calculated as potential_payout minus stake_amount. Represents the bettor's net gain and is used in responsible gaming exposure monitoring.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Financial Reporting; Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: The promotional or bonus code applied to this wager, if any. Used to track the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, bonus offers, and acquisition promotions. Null if no promotion was applied.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Promotional Wagering Rules; CRM Campaign Tracking

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number presented to the bettor on their bet slip or receipt. Used for customer service inquiries, dispute resolution, and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Reporting Requirements; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: responsible_gaming_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wager triggered a responsible gaming alert or intervention at time of placement (e.g., exceeded deposit limit, velocity threshold, or self-exclusion proximity check). Used for regulatory compliance reporting and player protection monitoring.
attributes.references: NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Commission Responsible Gaming Requirements; UKGC Social Responsibility Conditions

attributes.name: selection_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the bettor's selection within the betting market (e.g., 'Kansas City Chiefs to win', 'Over 48.5 total points', 'LeBron James to score 30+ points'). Captured at time of placement for audit and display purposes.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: self_exclusion_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wager was placed despite a self-exclusion or cooling-off period being active on the bettor's account. Should always be False for compliant operations; True values require immediate regulatory escalation.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Self-Exclusion Program Requirements; UKGC Social Responsibility Conditions

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount paid out to the bettor upon settlement. For winning wagers this equals the gross payout; for losing wagers this is zero; for void/push wagers this equals the stake returned. Null until the wager is settled.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; State Gaming Commission Financial Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the wager outcome was determined and the settlement amount was applied to the bettor's account. Null for pending wagers. Used for settlement cycle reporting and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Reporting Requirements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: stake_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount wagered by the bettor at time of placement, in the transaction currency. Represents the bettor's financial exposure and is the basis for hold calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; State Gaming Commission Financial Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: The amount of tax withheld from the settlement payout at source, as required by applicable jurisdiction tax laws (e.g., US federal withholding on large winnings per IRS Form W-2G thresholds). Zero if no withholding applies.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525 (Gambling Winnings); State Tax Regulations; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: ticket_terminal_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific betting terminal, kiosk, or point-of-sale device used to place the wager. Used for terminal-level reconciliation, fraud detection, and equipment audit trails in retail and kiosk channels.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Equipment Certification Requirements; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this wager record was last modified in the sportsbook system (e.g., status change from pending to settled). Used for change data capture and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why a wager was voided. Null for non-voided wagers. Used for operational reporting, bettor communication, and regulatory audit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: event_cancelled|event_postponed|market_error|odds_error|bettor_request|regulatory_order|system_error|integrity_concern — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Reporting Requirements; AGA Standards

attributes.name: wager_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wager. 'pending' indicates the event has not yet concluded; 'won'/'lost' reflect settled outcomes; 'void' indicates cancellation (e.g., event postponed); 'cashed_out' reflects early cash-out by bettor; 'pushed' indicates a tie/refund outcome.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Regulations; UKGC Technical Standards

attributes.name: wager_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wager structure. 'straight' is a single-selection bet; 'parlay' combines multiple selections for higher payout; 'teaser' adjusts point spreads; 'prop' is a proposition bet on specific in-game events; 'futures' bets on season-long outcomes; 'round_robin' is a series of parlays. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: straight|parlay|teaser|prop|futures|round_robin|if_bet|reverse — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Gaming Association (AGA) Standards; State Gaming Commission Regulations

attributes.name: cashout_of_wager_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on wager (cashout_of_wager_id)

Links to fan.fan_profile via FK in the linking step.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable account number assigned to the bettor at registration. Used in customer communications, statements, and support interactions. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this account.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: account_status

'self_excluded' indicates a responsible gaming restriction initiated by the bettor or operator. attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Operational tier classification of the bettor account. VIP accounts receive enhanced limits and concierge service. Professional accounts are subject to enhanced scrutiny and may have reduced maximum payouts per regulatory requirements. Restricted accounts have operator-imposed limitations.
attributes.references: Internal VIP Program Policy; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the gaming account by platform type: sportsbook (fixed-odds wagering), fantasy (daily/season-long fantasy sports), combined (both sportsbook and fantasy), or exchange (peer-to-peer betting exchange). Drives product entitlements and regulatory reporting scope.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Product Taxonomy

attributes.name: affiliate_code
attributes.description: Affiliate or partner referral code applied at account registration. Used to attribute the account acquisition to a specific affiliate partner for commission calculation and partnership performance reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Affiliate Program Policy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: age_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor has passed mandatory age verification confirming they meet the minimum legal gambling age for their registration jurisdiction. Accounts with False status are restricted from wagering activity.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; WADA; IOC

attributes.name: age_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bettor's age was successfully verified. Null if age verification has not been completed. Required for regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: balance
attributes.description: Current real-money balance available in the bettor's account for wagering, expressed in the account's base currency. Excludes bonus funds. Updated in real time following deposits, withdrawals, wager placements, and settlements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; SOX

attributes.name: bonus_balance
attributes.description: Current promotional or bonus credit balance in the bettor's account. Bonus funds are subject to wagering requirements before withdrawal and are tracked separately from real-money balance per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; Internal Promotions Policy

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the bettor account was permanently closed, either by the bettor's request or operator action. Null for active accounts. Required for regulatory record retention and audit trails.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the bettor account record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Serves as the authoritative audit creation timestamp for this record.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the bettor account's base currency (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). All balance and limit fields are denominated in this currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Bettor's date of birth as provided during registration and confirmed through KYC. Used for age verification, responsible gaming age-gating, and regulatory compliance. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: deposit_limit_daily
attributes.description: Maximum amount the bettor is permitted to deposit within a rolling 24-hour period. Set by the bettor or operator as a responsible gaming control. Null indicates no limit is set. Enforced at the platform level.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: deposit_limit_monthly
attributes.description: Maximum amount the bettor is permitted to deposit within a rolling 30-day period. A responsible gaming control that can be set by the bettor or mandated by the operator or regulator. Null indicates no limit is set.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: deposit_limit_weekly
attributes.description: Maximum amount the bettor is permitted to deposit within a rolling 7-day period. A responsible gaming control that can be set by the bettor or mandated by the operator or regulator. Null indicates no limit is set.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary email address registered on the bettor account. Used for account communications, promotional offers, responsible gaming notifications, and two-factor authentication. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the bettor as provided during registration and confirmed through KYC. Used for identity matching, regulatory reporting, and tax documentation (e.g., W-2G forms for large winnings).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; IRS W-2G Requirements; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: geolocation_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor's physical location has been verified as within a licensed jurisdiction at the time of account registration or most recent login. Required for compliance with state-level online gaming regulations that restrict wagering to in-state bettors.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; FCC

attributes.name: identity_document_expiry
attributes.description: Expiry date of the identity document submitted for KYC. Used to trigger re-verification workflows when documents approach or pass expiry, ensuring ongoing KYC compliance.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Requirements; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: identity_document_reference
attributes.description: Tokenized or masked reference to the government-issued identity document number used for KYC verification. The full document number is stored in the secure KYC vault; this field holds only the vault reference token to enable audit linkage without exposing raw PII.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; PCI DSS v4.0; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: identity_document_type
attributes.description: Type of government-issued identity document submitted for KYC verification. Determines the applicable document validation rules and expiry tracking requirements.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Requirements; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification process for this account. Accounts must achieve 'verified' status before full wagering privileges are granted. 'expired' indicates previously verified documents have lapsed and re-verification is required.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Requirements; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bettor's identity was successfully verified through the KYC process. Null if KYC has not been completed. Used for compliance audit trails and re-verification scheduling.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Requirements; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to any field on this bettor account record. Used for change data capture, audit trails, and data freshness monitoring in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: loss_limit_daily
attributes.description: Maximum net loss the bettor is permitted to incur within a rolling 24-hour period. A responsible gaming control that triggers account suspension when reached. Null indicates no limit is set.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor has consented to receive marketing communications including promotional offers, odds boosts, and event notifications. Governs CRM outreach eligibility per GDPR and CCPA consent requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the bettor account was formally opened and activated following successful KYC verification. Used for account age calculations, promotional eligibility, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; SOX

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary mobile or landline phone number registered on the bettor account. Used for two-factor authentication, responsible gaming outreach, and account recovery. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; TCPA

attributes.name: preferred_sport
attributes.description: The bettor's self-declared or system-inferred primary sport of interest (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, UFC, FIFA). Used for personalization of odds feeds, promotional targeting, and fantasy league recommendations.
attributes.references: Internal Fan Engagement Policy; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: promo_code_used
attributes.description: Promotional or welcome offer code entered by the bettor at account registration. Used to apply welcome bonuses, track promotional campaign effectiveness, and calculate bonus liability.
attributes.references: Internal Promotions Policy; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: registration_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code for the jurisdiction (state, province, or country) under which this account was registered and is licensed to operate. Determines applicable regulatory framework, tax obligations, and responsible gaming requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; GDPR; CCPA

attributes.name: registration_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code where the bettor account was registered. Used for state-level regulatory reporting, tax withholding, and geofencing compliance. Complements registration_jurisdiction for sub-national precision.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: responsible_gaming_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor account has been flagged by the responsible gaming monitoring system for elevated risk of problem gambling behavior. Triggers enhanced monitoring, outreach, and potential limit reviews by the responsible gaming team.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: responsible_gaming_flag_date
attributes.description: Date on which the responsible gaming flag was most recently set on this account. Used to track the duration of elevated monitoring and schedule periodic reviews.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: self_exclusion_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bettor's self-exclusion period is scheduled to end. Null for indefinite exclusions or accounts with no exclusion. Used to trigger re-activation eligibility workflows.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: self_exclusion_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bettor's self-exclusion period began. Null if no self-exclusion is active or has ever been applied. Required for regulatory compliance and re-activation eligibility calculations.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: self_exclusion_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor has enrolled in a self-exclusion program. 'voluntary' means bettor-initiated exclusion; 'mandatory' means regulator or operator-imposed exclusion; 'expired' means a prior exclusion period has ended. Accounts with active exclusion are blocked from wagering.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the bettor account was originally registered. Used for customer acquisition cost (CAC) attribution, affiliate commission calculations, and channel performance analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Marketing Attribution Policy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: tax_id_reference
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the bettor's tax identification number (e.g., SSN or ITIN in the US) stored in the secure KYC vault. Required for IRS W-2G tax reporting on winnings exceeding regulatory thresholds. The raw TIN is never stored in this field.
attributes.references: IRS W-2G Requirements; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: two_factor_auth_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor has enabled two-factor authentication (2FA) on their account. Relevant for security posture reporting and may be mandated by certain jurisdictions for high-value accounts.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: w2g_threshold_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor has met the IRS W-2G reportable winnings threshold ($600 or more at 300:1 odds or greater, or $1,200+ for certain game types) within the current tax year. Triggers tax documentation workflows.
attributes.references: IRS W-2G Requirements; State Gaming Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: wager_limit_daily
attributes.description: Maximum total wager amount the bettor is permitted to place within a rolling 24-hour period. A responsible gaming control. Null indicates no limit is set.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Requirements; NCPG Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: referred_by_bettor_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on bettor_account (referred_by_bettor_account_id)

attributes.name: trade_deadline_flag

attributes.name: trade_review_deadline
attributes.description: The date and time by which league members must cast veto votes or the commissioner must act before the trade is automatically approved and processed. Applicable only to trade transactions in leagues with a review window.

attributes.name: trade_value_score_initiating
attributes.description: Algorithmic trade fairness score representing the estimated fantasy value of assets sent by the initiating team in a trade, based on player rankings, projected points, and market data at transaction time. Used for lopsided trade detection and commissioner review flagging.

attributes.name: trade_value_score_receiving
attributes.description: Algorithmic trade fairness score representing the estimated fantasy value of assets received by the initiating team in a trade. Compared against trade_value_score_initiating to compute trade imbalance ratio for lopsided trade alerts and commissioner review.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Analytics Standard; SportsCode / Hudl

attributes.name: transaction_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to this transaction, used in user-facing confirmations, dispute resolution, and audit trails. Follows the format TXN- followed by 8-20 alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transaction: pending (submitted, awaiting processing or veto window), approved (accepted by system or commissioner), vetoed (rejected by commissioner or league vote), processed (fully executed and roster updated), cancelled (withdrawn by initiating team before processing).

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the fantasy team submitted or initiated this transaction. This is the principal business event timestamp used for waiver priority ordering, FAAB auction timing, and trade proposal sequencing.
attributes.references: Internal Gaming Operations Standard

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the roster move: waiver_claim (athlete claimed off waivers using priority), free_agent_pickup (athlete added from free agency without waiver process), drop (athlete released to waivers or free agency), trade (bilateral exchange between two fantasy teams), commissioner_move (administrative roster adjustment by commissioner).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this transaction record was most recently modified, such as when status changed from pending to processed or when a commissioner override was applied.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: veto_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of veto votes required to block this transaction in the league's democratic veto system. Captured at transaction time to preserve the rule in effect when the transaction was submitted, as league settings may change.

attributes.name: veto_vote_count
attributes.description: Number of veto votes cast against this transaction by league members in leagues using a democratic veto system. Compared against the league's veto threshold to determine if the transaction is blocked. Null for non-veto leagues.

attributes.name: waiver_priority_after

attributes.name: waiver_priority_used

attributes.name: waiver_processing_day

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating

attributes.name: bonus_credit_balance
attributes.description: Current balance of promotional bonus credits awarded to the bettor (e.g., free-bet credits, deposit match bonuses, loyalty rewards). Bonus credits are subject to wagering requirements before conversion to withdrawable funds.

attributes.name: bonus_wagering_progress_amount

attributes.name: close_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gaming wallet record was first created in the platform ledger system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for the Silver layer record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code denominating all monetary balances in this wallet (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). A bettor may hold separate wallets per currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: deposit_limit_daily
attributes.description: Maximum real-money deposit amount permitted within a rolling 24-hour period for this wallet, as set by the bettor or enforced by the operator under responsible gaming obligations. NULL indicates no limit is set.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG (National Council on Problem Gambling)

attributes.name: deposit_limit_monthly
attributes.description: Maximum real-money deposit amount permitted within a rolling 30-day period for this wallet. Regulators in many jurisdictions mandate operators to offer and honor monthly deposit limits.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG

attributes.name: deposit_limit_weekly
attributes.description: Maximum real-money deposit amount permitted within a rolling 7-day period for this wallet. Part of the responsible gaming self-exclusion and limit-setting framework.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG

attributes.name: dormancy_date
attributes.description: Date on which the wallet was classified as dormant. Used to calculate escheatment timelines and trigger unclaimed property reporting to state authorities.
attributes.references: State Unclaimed Property Laws; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: dormancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the wallet has been classified as dormant due to inactivity beyond the operator-defined dormancy threshold (typically 12 months with no transactions). Dormant wallets may be subject to inactivity fees or unclaimed property escheatment.
attributes.references: State Unclaimed Property Laws; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: geolocation_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor's most recent session passed geolocation verification confirming they were physically located within a licensed jurisdiction at the time of wagering. True = compliant; False = geolocation check failed or bypassed.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; Wire Act Compliance

attributes.name: kyc_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor's identity has been fully verified through the Know Your Customer (KYC) process. True = verified; False = pending or failed. Unverified wallets may have restricted deposit and withdrawal capabilities.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; FATF Recommendations; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: last_deposit_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent real-money deposit credited to this wallet. Used for dormancy analysis, responsible gaming velocity checks, and AML monitoring.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: last_transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent financial transaction (deposit, withdrawal, wager placement, wager settlement, bonus credit) recorded against this wallet. Used for dormancy detection and responsible gaming monitoring.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: last_withdrawal_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent withdrawal processed from this wallet. Used for dormancy analysis and AML monitoring.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: lifetime_bonus_awarded_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all promotional bonus credits ever awarded to this wallet. Used for marketing ROI analysis, bonus liability reporting, and responsible gaming assessments.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; AGA Responsible Gaming Standards

attributes.name: lifetime_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all real-money deposits made into this wallet since account creation. Used for responsible gaming monitoring, AML thresholds, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: lifetime_withdrawal_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all real-money withdrawals processed from this wallet since account creation. Used for AML monitoring, tax reporting (e.g., IRS Form W-2G), and responsible gaming analytics.
attributes.references: AML/BSA Compliance; IRS Form W-2G; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: loss_limit_daily
attributes.description: Maximum net loss amount permitted within a rolling 24-hour period for this wallet. When reached, further wagering is blocked until the period resets. Supports responsible gaming mandates.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG

attributes.name: open_date

attributes.name: reference_number

attributes.description: Hashed or tokenized identifier representing the unique combination of device attributes (browser, OS, hardware) used to initiate the transaction. Supports multi-account fraud detection and responsible gaming self-exclusion enforcement.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction amount from the transaction currency to the operator's base reporting currency at the time of the transaction. attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Processing fee charged to the bettor for this transaction (e.g., withdrawal processing fee, currency conversion fee). Zero if no fee applies. Expressed in the transaction currency. Used for revenue recognition and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: geolocation_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor's physical location was successfully verified as being within the permitted jurisdiction at the time of the transaction. attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the bettor initiated this transaction. Used for geolocation verification to enforce jurisdiction-based wagering restrictions, fraud detection, and AML monitoring.

attributes.name: kyc_verified

attributes.name: pre_transaction_balance
attributes.description: The bettor's wallet balance immediately before this transaction was applied. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for ledger integrity verification, dispute resolution, and responsible gaming spend analysis.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; AML/BSA 31 U.S.C. § 5318; State Gaming Commission Regulations

attributes.name: processing_latency_ms
