attributes.references: NCPG National Problem Gambling Standards; UKGC Social Responsibility Code; State Gaming Commission RG Requirements

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why a transaction was reversed or cancelled (e.g., chargeback, duplicate transaction, system error, fraud confirmed, bettor request). Populated only when transaction_status is reversed or cancelled. Required for dispute management and audit trail.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SOX Section 404; State Gaming Commission Regulations

attributes.name: self_exclusion_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor had an active self-exclusion or cooling-off period in effect at the time of this transaction. True = self-exclusion was active (transaction should have been blocked — used for compliance breach investigation); False = no active self-exclusion. Critical for responsible gaming regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: NCPG National Problem Gambling Standards; UKGC Social Responsibility Code; State Gaming Commission Self-Exclusion Requirements

attributes.name: tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Amount of tax withheld from this transaction by the gaming operator on behalf of the applicable tax authority (e.g., federal withholding on large wager settlements in the US per IRS Form W-2G threshold). Zero for non-taxable transactions. Required for IRS and state tax regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2G; IRS Publication 525; State Gaming Tax Regulations; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary value of the fund movement in the transaction currency. Always expressed as a positive number; the direction of the movement (debit or credit) is determined by transaction_type and debit_credit_indicator. Used for AML transaction monitoring thresholds and responsible gaming spend limits.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; AML/BSA 31 U.S.C. § 5318; SOX Section 404; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference code assigned to this transaction. Used for customer service inquiries, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting. Sourced from the gaming platform ledger.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SOX Section 404; AML/BSA 31 U.S.C. § 5318

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the wallet transaction: pending (initiated, awaiting processing), completed (successfully settled), failed (processing error), reversed (rolled back after completion), cancelled (voided before processing), under_review (flagged for AML or responsible gaming review).
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; AML/BSA 31 U.S.C. § 5318; State Gaming Commission Regulations

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the fund movement event occurred in the gaming platform. This is the principal business event time used for financial reconciliation, AML monitoring, and responsible gaming spend tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; AML/BSA 31 U.S.C. § 5318; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fund movement event: deposit (funds added from external payment method), withdrawal (funds sent to external account), wager_stake (funds deducted for a placed bet), wager_settlement (funds credited or debited upon bet outcome), bonus_credit (promotional funds added), bonus_forfeiture (unused bonus funds removed), adjustment (manual correction by operations). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deposit|withdrawal|wager_stake|wager_settlement|bonus_credit|bonus_forfeiture|adjustment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AML/BSA 31 U.S.C. § 5318; GDPR Article 5; State Gaming Commission Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wallet transaction record was last modified, such as a status change from pending to completed or a reversal event. Supports audit trail and Silver layer change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(e); PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10

attributes.name: wallet_type
attributes.description: Classifies the wallet segment affected by this transaction: real_money (actual deposited funds), bonus (promotional bonus credits), promotional (free-bet or free-play credits), pending_withdrawal (funds earmarked for withdrawal but not yet disbursed). Determines wagering eligibility and withdrawal rules.
attributes.references: State Gaming Commission Regulations; UKGC Remote Gambling and Software Technical Standards

attributes.name: reversal_wallet_transaction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on wallet_transaction (reversal_wallet_transaction_id)

products.name: jurisdiction
products.description: Reference master for all gaming regulatory jurisdictions in which Sports Entertainment holds or is pursuing a sports wagering or fantasy sports operating license. Captures jurisdiction code, jurisdiction name (state/province/country), license type (sports wagering, DFS, iGaming), regulatory body name, license number, license status (active, pending, suspended, expired), license expiry date, tax rate on gross gaming revenue (GGR), and applicable responsible gaming mandates. SSOT for jurisdiction-level compliance configuration.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each gaming regulatory jurisdiction record. Primary key for the gaming_jurisdiction reference master.

attributes.name: governing_body_id

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_id

attributes.name: aml_reporting_threshold
attributes.description: Monetary threshold (in jurisdiction currency) above which a single wagering transaction or cumulative patron activity must be reported to the regulatory authority under Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements (e.g., USD 10,000 per FinCEN CTR rules). Null if no statutory threshold applies.
attributes.references: FinCEN Currency Transaction Report (CTR) Rules; Bank Secrecy Act; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: application_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which Sports Entertainment submitted the initial or renewal license application to the regulatory authority. Used to track application pipeline and regulatory processing timelines.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: college_sports_wagering_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether wagering on college and university sporting events is permitted in this jurisdiction. Several jurisdictions prohibit wagering on in-state college teams or all college sports. True = college sports wagering authorized; False = prohibited.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NCAA Governance; WADA

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the sovereign nation in which this jurisdiction resides (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN, AUS). Supports geographic segmentation and cross-border regulatory analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the legal tender used in this jurisdiction for wagering, tax remittance, and financial reporting (e.g., USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, EUR).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: data_localization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction mandates that patron data and wagering transaction records must be stored within the geographic boundaries of the jurisdiction. True = data must remain in-jurisdiction; False = no localization requirement. Impacts cloud infrastructure and data residency architecture.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 44-49 (Data Transfers); CCPA; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: deposit_limit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction mandates that operators offer or enforce patron deposit limits as part of responsible gaming compliance. True = deposit limits are a regulatory requirement; False = not mandated.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Framework; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: dfs_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether Daily Fantasy Sports (DFS) contests are legally permitted in this jurisdiction. True = DFS authorized; False = not authorized. Drives DFS product availability and platform configuration.
attributes.references: State DFS Regulatory Statutes; FTC Guidelines

attributes.name: geolocation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time geolocation verification is required to confirm the patron is physically located within the jurisdiction at the time of wagering. True = geolocation check mandatory; False = not required.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; FCC Regulations

attributes.name: ggr_tax_rate
attributes.description: Statutory tax rate applied to Gross Gaming Revenue (GGR) in this jurisdiction, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.1300 = 13%). GGR is defined as total wagers accepted minus winnings paid to players. Used in financial planning, P&L modeling, and tax remittance calculations.
attributes.references: State Gaming Tax Statutes; SOX Section 302; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: in_play_wagering_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether in-play (live) wagering on ongoing sporting events is permitted in this jurisdiction. Some jurisdictions restrict wagering to pre-game markets only. True = in-play wagering authorized; False = pre-game only.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NFL / NBA League Office Governance

attributes.name: integrity_fee_rate
attributes.description: Rate (expressed as a decimal percentage of handle or GGR) payable to sports leagues or governing bodies as a sports integrity fee or data royalty mandated by the jurisdiction (e.g., 0.0025 = 0.25%). Null if no integrity fee is required. Relevant for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS league data agreements.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NFL / NBA / MLB / NHL League Office Governance; CAS

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code uniquely identifying the jurisdiction (e.g., US-NJ for New Jersey, US-NV for Nevada, GB for Great Britain, ON for Ontario). Used as the business-facing key across compliance configuration and reporting systems.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 / ISO 3166-2; GDPR; CCPA

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the gaming regulatory jurisdiction (e.g., State of New Jersey, Province of Ontario, United Kingdom). Used in regulatory filings, compliance reports, and operator-facing documentation.

attributes.name: kyc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification is mandated by the regulatory authority before a patron may place wagers in this jurisdiction. True = KYC mandatory; False = KYC not required.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/KYC Requirements; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; GDPR

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date on which Sports Entertainment commenced live wagering operations in this jurisdiction following license activation. Null if operations have not yet launched (e.g., license is pending). Used for market entry tracking and revenue attribution.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: max_single_wager_limit
attributes.description: Maximum monetary amount (in jurisdiction currency) permitted for a single wager as mandated by the regulatory authority. Null if no statutory cap exists. Used to configure wagering platform risk controls and patron-facing bet limits.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; PCI-DSS

attributes.name: min_age_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum legal age (in years) required for a patron to participate in sports wagering or fantasy sports in this jurisdiction (e.g., 18 or 21). Enforced at account registration and KYC verification.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; GDPR Article 8 (Child Data Protection); CCPA

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance team annotations regarding jurisdiction-specific regulatory nuances, pending legislative changes, special conditions attached to the license, or operational constraints not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: official_data_mandate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction requires operators to use official league-supplied data feeds for in-play wagering markets (as opposed to third-party data providers). True = official data required; False = no mandate. Impacts data vendor contracts and API integration requirements.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NFL / NBA / MLB / NHL League Office Governance; API SLA Standards

attributes.name: online_wagering_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether online and mobile sports wagering is permitted in this jurisdiction, as distinct from retail (in-person) wagering. True = online/mobile wagering authorized; False = retail only.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; FCC Regulations; OTT / DTC Platform Compliance

attributes.name: promotional_deduction_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction permits deduction of promotional credits and free-play bonuses from gross gaming revenue before calculating the taxable GGR base. True = deductions permitted; False = gross revenue taxed without promotional deductions.
attributes.references: State Gaming Tax Statutes; AGA Responsible Gaming Framework

attributes.name: prop_bet_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether proposition bets (prop bets) on individual player or game-specific outcomes are permitted in this jurisdiction. Some jurisdictions restrict prop bets on college athletes or specific leagues. True = prop bets authorized; False = restricted.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NCAA Governance; NFL / NBA League Office

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gaming jurisdiction record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gaming jurisdiction record was most recently modified. Used for change detection, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: region_or_state
attributes.description: Name of the sub-national administrative region, state, or province within the country (e.g., New Jersey, Nevada, Ontario, England). Null for country-level jurisdictions. Supports state-level regulatory mapping.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which Sports Entertainment must submit regulatory compliance and financial reports to the governing authority in this jurisdiction. Drives automated report generation scheduling.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; SOX Section 302; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: responsible_gaming_mandates
attributes.description: Free-text description of applicable responsible gaming compliance mandates imposed by the regulatory authority in this jurisdiction, including deposit limits, loss limits, session time limits, cooling-off periods, and problem gambling helpline display requirements.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Framework; NCPG; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; GDPR

attributes.name: retail_wagering_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether retail in-person sports wagering at licensed physical locations (e.g., sportsbooks at venues or casinos) is permitted in this jurisdiction. True = retail wagering authorized; False = not authorized.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; OSHA Venue Safety

attributes.name: self_exclusion_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the mandatory responsible gaming self-exclusion program administered by the regulatory authority in this jurisdiction (e.g., New Jersey Self-Exclusion Program, GamStop UK). Operators must integrate with this program as a condition of licensure.
attributes.references: AGA Responsible Gaming Framework; State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; NCPG (National Council on Problem Gambling)

attributes.name: sports_wagering_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether fixed-odds sports wagering is legally permitted in this jurisdiction under the current license. True = sports wagering authorized; False = not authorized. Drives product availability configuration.
attributes.references: PASPA Repeal (Murphy v. NCAA 2018); State Gaming Regulatory Statutes

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for license suspension or revocation as communicated by the regulatory authority. Populated only when license_status is 'suspended' or 'revoked'. Used for legal and compliance case management.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Statutes; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); SOX

attributes.name: tax_remittance_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which GGR tax payments must be remitted to the regulatory authority in this jurisdiction. Drives accounts payable scheduling and cash flow planning in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.
attributes.references: State Gaming Tax Statutes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: superseded_by_limit_responsible_gaming_limit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the newer responsible_gaming_limit record that replaced this one when a limit was modified or updated. Null if this is the current active limit. Enables full limit history chain reconstruction for regulatory audit.

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this responsible gaming limit transitioned to active status and began enforcement. May differ from requested_timestamp due to mandatory regulatory cooling-off periods before limit reductions take effect.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: cooling_off_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which a mandatory regulatory cooling-off period ends, after which a limit increase or self-exclusion reversal may take effect. Null for limit decreases and new limits that take effect immediately.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this responsible gaming limit record was first persisted in the system of record. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code applicable to the limit_amount field (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Null for non-monetary limit types such as session_time, cooling_off, and self_exclusion.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; PCI SSC

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this responsible gaming limit record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and Silver Layer provenance in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this responsible gaming limit becomes binding and enforceable. For player-initiated reductions, regulators may require a mandatory delay (cooling-off) before the reduced limit takes effect.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this responsible gaming limit ceases to be enforceable. Null for permanent or open-ended limits such as lifetime self-exclusion. After this date the limit_status transitions to expired.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: interaction_channel
attributes.description: The platform or interface through which the bettor or operator submitted the responsible gaming limit request. Supports omnichannel analytics and regulatory channel-specific reporting requirements.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; Adobe Experience Platform; Internal Digital Platform Standards

attributes.name: is_permanent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this responsible gaming limit is designated as permanent with no expiry date. True for lifetime self-exclusions and permanent bans. False for time-bound limits. Drives expiry_date nullability logic and regulatory reporting classification.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG National Self-Exclusion Standards

attributes.name: limit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary ceiling or numeric threshold set by the limit. For deposit, loss, and wager limit types this is a currency amount. For session_time limits this field is null and limit_duration_minutes is used instead. For self_exclusion and cooling_off this field is null.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; PCI SSC; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: limit_change_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit record represents an increase, decrease, new establishment, or reinstatement of a previously revoked limit. Regulators typically require immediate enforcement of limit decreases but allow a cooling-off period before increases take effect.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: limit_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration in minutes applicable to time-based limit types such as session_time, cooling_off, and self_exclusion. For monetary limit types (deposit, loss, wager) this field is null.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: limit_period
attributes.description: The rolling or fixed time window over which the limit amount or duration is measured and enforced. For example, a daily deposit limit resets every 24 hours, while a lifetime self-exclusion has no reset.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: limit_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this responsible gaming limit record, used for regulatory reporting, audit trails, and customer-facing communications.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority Reporting Standards; SOX

attributes.name: limit_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating party that established this responsible gaming limit. Player_initiated means the bettor voluntarily set the limit. Operator_imposed means the gaming operator applied the limit based on internal responsible gaming policies. Regulator_mandated means the applicable gaming regulatory authority required the limit.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: limit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the responsible gaming limit. Pending indicates the limit has been requested but not yet enforced (e.g., awaiting cooling-off period before reduction takes effect). Active means the limit is currently enforced. Suspended means temporarily paused by operator or regulator. Revoked means cancelled. Expired means the limit reached its end date.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards; SOX

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the responsible gaming control applied to the bettor account. Defines the nature of the restriction: deposit limits cap funds added, loss limits cap net losses, wager limits cap individual bet amounts, session_time limits cap continuous play duration, cooling_off imposes a temporary break, and self_exclusion is a voluntary or mandated ban from wagering activity.
attributes.references: NCPG National Council on Problem Gambling Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; WADA; CAS

attributes.name: operator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator-entered notes or justification related to this responsible gaming limit, particularly for operator_imposed or regulator_mandated limits. Used for internal case management and regulatory audit documentation.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; SOX; Internal Compliance Policy

attributes.name: player_acknowledgement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor has explicitly acknowledged and confirmed the responsible gaming limit through the platform interface. True means the player confirmed; False means acknowledgement is pending. Required for audit and GDPR consent documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards

attributes.name: player_acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the bettor explicitly acknowledged and confirmed the responsible gaming limit. Null if player_acknowledgement_flag is False. Critical for GDPR consent audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; State Gaming Regulatory Authority

attributes.name: previous_limit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary limit amount that was in effect immediately before the current limit was set. Enables regulators and auditors to assess whether a limit change represents an increase or decrease, which has different cooling-off period implications.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards; SOX

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory notification for this limit event has been transmitted to the applicable gaming authority. True means notification has been sent; False means notification is pending or not yet required.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; SOX; GDPR Article 33

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the regulatory notification for this responsible gaming limit event was transmitted to the applicable gaming authority. Null if regulatory_notification_sent is False.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; SOX; GDPR Article 33

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the bettor or operator submitted the request to establish or modify this responsible gaming limit. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for audit and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which this responsible gaming limit is due for review by the operator's responsible gaming team. Applicable primarily to operator_imposed and regulator_mandated limits to ensure ongoing appropriateness.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; NCPG Standards; Internal Responsible Gaming Policy

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this responsible gaming limit was revoked or cancelled. Null for limits that are active, pending, or expired. Required for regulatory audit trails when limit_status is revoked.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; SOX; Internal Compliance Policy

attributes.name: revocation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this responsible gaming limit was revoked or cancelled. Null for limits that are active, pending, or expired. Supports regulatory reporting on limit lifecycle events.
attributes.references: State Gaming Regulatory Authority; SOX

attributes.name: risk_trigger_code
attributes.description: Coded identifier of the responsible gaming risk indicator or algorithm trigger that prompted an operator_imposed or regulator_mandated limit. Examples include spend velocity alerts, session duration thresholds, or self-reported problem gambling indicators. Null for player_initiated limits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spend_velocity|session_duration|self_reported|third_party_referral|regulatory_directive|behavioral_pattern — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCPG Standards; State Gaming Regulatory Authority; Internal Responsible Gaming Policy

attributes.name: self_exclusion_program

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: The official document number from the submitted identity document (e.g., passport number, national ID number, driver's license number). attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of identity or supporting document submitted by the bettor for verification. attributes.name: escalation_reason

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KYC verification was escalated to senior compliance review or regulatory authority. Distinct from verification_timestamp. Used for SLA tracking of escalation resolution timelines.
attributes.references: AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations; SOX

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this KYC verification record expires and the bettor's verified status lapses. Distinct from reverification_due_date (which is the deadline for completing a new check) and document_expiry_date (which is the document's own validity). Driven by jurisdiction-specific periodic review schedules.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: is_initial_verification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the first KYC verification performed for the bettor account (True) or a subsequent periodic re-verification or triggered re-check (False). Used to distinguish onboarding KYC from ongoing monitoring verifications in regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why a KYC verification was rejected (e.g., EXPIRED_DOC, MISMATCH_NAME, POOR_IMAGE_QUALITY, SANCTIONS_HIT, FRAUD_SUSPECTED, INCOMPLETE_SUBMISSION). attributes.references: AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; FATF Recommendations; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of why the KYC verification was rejected or escalated. Complements the rejection_reason_code with additional context for compliance agents and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: reverification_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the bettor must complete a new KYC verification cycle. Triggered by document expiry, regulatory periodic review requirements, risk-based re-screening schedules, or changes in bettor risk profile. Null if no re-verification is currently scheduled.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the compliance agent during manual review of this KYC verification. Captures qualitative observations, decision rationale, and any additional context not captured in structured fields. Supports audit trail and regulatory examination.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned to the bettor account as a result of this KYC verification, based on AML risk-based approach guidelines. Drives enhanced due diligence requirements, monitoring frequency, and transaction limits. Aligned with FATF risk-based approach.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: sanctions_hit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bettor matched any entry on a sanctions list (e.g., OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated List, UN Sanctions) during KYC screening. A confirmed sanctions hit requires immediate account restriction and regulatory notification.
attributes.references: OFAC; FATF Recommendations; AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system or platform from which this KYC verification record was ingested into the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between operational systems (e.g., Jumio, Onfido, Salesforce CRM) and the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; AML/KYC Regulatory Standards

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the bettor submitted their KYC documents or initiated the verification request. Used to measure verification turnaround time and SLA compliance from submission to decision.
attributes.references: AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: verification_attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of how many times the bettor has attempted KYC verification for this verification type on their account. Used to enforce maximum attempt limits, detect fraud patterns, and trigger escalation workflows after repeated failures.
attributes.references: AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations; Responsible Gaming Frameworks

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The technical or procedural method used to perform the verification. document_upload involves bettor-submitted documents; biometric uses facial recognition or liveness checks; bureau_check uses third-party identity bureaus (Jumio, Onfido); database_check queries government or credit databases; manual_review involves a compliance agent.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: verification_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this KYC verification case, used for correspondence with regulators, third-party bureaus (e.g., Jumio, Onfido), and internal audit trails.
attributes.references: AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the KYC verification record. pending: awaiting review or processing; approved: verification passed and account cleared; rejected: verification failed; escalated: referred to senior compliance or regulator; expired: verification lapsed and re-verification is required.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world timestamp when the KYC verification decision (approved, rejected, escalated) was made. Distinct from record creation timestamp. Critical for regulatory reporting of verification timelines and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; AML/KYC Regulatory Standards; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: verification_type
attributes.description: Category of KYC check being performed. Determines the regulatory obligation being fulfilled: identity confirms who the bettor is, age confirms legal gambling eligibility, address confirms residency, source_of_funds confirms AML compliance, enhanced_due_diligence applies to high-risk or high-value accounts.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Gaming License Obligations

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version counter for this KYC verification record, supporting optimistic concurrency control and change history tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Incremented on each status change or material update.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; SOX; AML/KYC Regulatory Standards

products.name: market_jurisdiction_availability
products.description: This association product represents the Authorization contract between betting_market and gaming_jurisdiction. It captures the explicit regulatory authorization (or exclusion) of a specific wagering market within a specific gaming jurisdiction, including availability lifecycle status, effective date range, jurisdiction-specific stake overrides, and exclusion reasons. Each record links one betting_market to one gaming_jurisdiction and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific market-jurisdiction pairing. This entity replaces the denormalized jurisdiction_availability and jurisdiction_exclusion STRING fields on betting_market and serves as the SSOT for compliance teams managing market geo-restriction matrices.. Existence Justification: In licensed sportsbook operations, each betting market must be explicitly authorized for each jurisdiction where it is offered — a single market (e.g., NFL moneyline) is available in multiple jurisdictions (NJ, PA, CO), and each jurisdiction hosts hundreds of active markets. Compliance teams actively manage this matrix, controlling availability status, effective dates, jurisdiction-specific stake limits, and exclusion reasons. The relationship is a recognized operational concept called 'Market Jurisdiction Availability' or 'Market Geo-Restriction' that is created, updated, and audited as part of regulatory compliance workflows.

attributes.name: market_jurisdiction_availability_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Market Jurisdiction Availability - Market Jurisdiction Availability Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the market_jurisdiction_availability association
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.name: betting_market_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Market Jurisdiction Availability - Betting Market Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the wagering market definition being authorized or restricted in this jurisdiction
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Market Jurisdiction Availability - Gaming Jurisdiction Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the gaming regulatory jurisdiction in which this market's availability is being governed
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory lifecycle state of this wagering market within the specific jurisdiction. AVAILABLE = market is open and accepting wagers; SUSPENDED = temporarily halted pending review; RESTRICTED = available with conditions; EXCLUDED = explicitly prohibited; PENDING_APPROVAL = awaiting regulatory sign-off.
attributes.references: Regulatory compliance status taxonomy

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date on which this market became (or is scheduled to become) available or restricted in this jurisdiction. Supports regulatory audit trails and effective-dated compliance configuration.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this market's availability authorization expires or was revoked in this jurisdiction. NULL indicates no scheduled expiry (open-ended authorization). Used for time-bounded regulatory approvals.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why this market is excluded or restricted in this jurisdiction (e.g., regulatory prohibition on prop bets, college sports wagering ban, integrity concern). Populated when availability_status is EXCLUDED or RESTRICTED.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of jurisdiction codes (US state, country, or regulatory zone codes) where this market is legally available for wagering (e.g., 'NJ,NV,PA,CO,UK,MT'). Drives geo-restriction logic at the platform layer for GDPR, CCPA, and state gaming compliance. [Moved from betting_market: This comma-separated STRING field is a denormalized multi-value encoding of the M:N relationship between betting_market and gaming_jurisdiction. It should be fully replaced by the market_jurisdiction_availability association entity, which provides normalized, queryable, and auditable per-jurisdiction availability records.]
attributes.references: GDPR; CCPA; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies; FCC

attributes.name: jurisdiction_exclusion
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of jurisdiction codes explicitly excluded from this market due to regulatory prohibition or operator policy (e.g., 'UT,HI,WA'). Complements jurisdiction_availability for precise geo-restriction enforcement. [Moved from betting_market: This comma-separated STRING field is a denormalized multi-value encoding of jurisdiction exclusions. It should be replaced by records in market_jurisdiction_availability with availability_status = EXCLUDED and a populated exclusion_reason, enabling proper regulatory audit trails and compliance reporting.]
attributes.references: GDPR; CCPA; State Gaming Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: jurisdiction_specific_max_stake
attributes.description: Maximum wager amount permitted for this specific market within this specific jurisdiction, expressed in the jurisdiction's currency. Overrides the global max_stake_amount on betting_market when a jurisdiction imposes a stricter or different limit. NULL indicates the global market limit applies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 currency per gaming_jurisdiction.currency_code

attributes.name: background_check_status

attributes.name: barcode_value

attributes.name: biometric_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credential_number

attributes.name: last_drill_date

attributes.name: law_enforcement_agency

attributes.name: crowd_density_category

attributes.name: current_occupancy_count
attributes.description: The number of persons physically present within the access zone at the time of the snapshot. Derived from gate scan aggregation, manual count, or sensor feed as indicated by the data_source field.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the reliability status of the occupancy count in this snapshot. valid = confirmed accurate reading; estimated = interpolated due to sensor gap; suspect = anomalous reading under review; missing = no data received; corrected = manually adjusted post-capture. attributes.name: data_source

attributes.references: ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management; Ticketmaster/AXS Access Control

attributes.name: egress_count
attributes.description: The number of persons who exited the access zone since the previous snapshot interval. Sourced from gate scan aggregation or sensor directional flow data. Critical for monitoring evacuation progress during emergency response scenarios.

attributes.name: event_phase

attributes.name: incident_flag

attributes.name: incident_type

attributes.name: law_enforcement_present

attributes.name: manual_override

attributes.name: max_capacity

attributes.name: occupancy_pct

attributes.name: security_level

attributes.name: sensor_device_code

attributes.name: snapshot_interval_seconds

attributes.description: Description of specific provisions within this plan for evacuating and sheltering guests and staff with disabilities, including wheelchair-accessible evacuation routes, Areas of Rescue Assistance (ARA), and mobility assistance protocols.
attributes.references: ADA Standards for Accessible Design; NFPA 101 Life Safety Code; DOJ ADA Title III

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Description of the communication systems and protocols used during plan activation, including radio frequencies, PA system codes, mass notification system triggers, and social media blackout procedures.
attributes.references: NIMS ICS Communications Unit; FCC Emergency Alert System (EAS); DHS National Response Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this emergency response plan record was first created in the Sports Entertainment security data platform. Supports audit trail and regulatory document control requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 20121; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: crowd_capacity_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum crowd attendance count at which this plan's enhanced protocols are activated (e.g., plans may have tiered activation based on event size). Supports DHS Special Event Assessment Rating (SEAR) classification.
attributes.references: DHS Special Event Assessment Rating (SEAR); NIMS; Local Fire Marshal Occupancy Limits

attributes.name: dhs_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Approval Date
attributes.description: Date on which DHS formally approved this emergency response plan. Null if approval is pending, not required, or rejected.
attributes.references: DHS Special Event Assessment Rating (SEAR)

attributes.name: dhs_approval_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Approval Status
attributes.description: Regulatory approval status of this plan with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. Required for events classified under DHS Special Event Assessment Rating (SEAR) Tier I-III.
attributes.references: DHS Special Event Assessment Rating (SEAR); DHS National Response Framework

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this version of the emergency response plan becomes operationally binding. Used to determine which plan version is active for a given event date.
attributes.references: DHS National Incident Management System (NIMS); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: evacuation_route_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of primary and secondary evacuation routes for this plan, including ADA-accessible routes, assembly points, and crowd flow management corridors. Aligned with venue floor plan and ADA compliance requirements.
attributes.references: NFPA 101 Life Safety Code; ADA Standards for Accessible Design; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this emergency response plan version expires and must be reviewed or renewed. Null for open-ended plans. Drives regulatory renewal workflows and compliance alerts.
attributes.references: DHS National Incident Management System (NIMS); Local Fire Marshal Annual Review Requirements

attributes.name: fire_marshal_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the local fire marshal formally approved this emergency response plan. Null if approval is pending, not required, or rejected.
attributes.references: NFPA 101 Life Safety Code; Local Fire Marshal Regulations

attributes.name: fire_marshal_approval_status
attributes.description: Regulatory approval status of this plan with the local fire marshal authority. Required for all venue events under NFPA 101 and local fire codes. Drives event permit issuance.
attributes.references: NFPA 101 Life Safety Code; Local Fire Marshal Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: fire_marshal_contact
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the local fire marshal office responsible for approving and coordinating fire evacuation components of this plan. Required for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Local Fire Marshal Regulations; NFPA 101 Life Safety Code; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: incident_command_structure
attributes.description: Description of the Incident Command System (ICS) hierarchy governing this plan, including Incident Commander role, Operations Section Chief, Safety Officer, and Public Information Officer designations per NIMS ICS standards.
attributes.references: NIMS Incident Command System (ICS); DHS National Response Framework

attributes.name: incident_commander_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated Incident Commander responsible for directing emergency response operations under this plan. Confidential operational security information.
attributes.references: NIMS ICS; DHS National Response Framework

attributes.name: incident_commander_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the designated Incident Commander (e.g., 'Director of Event Security', 'VP Venue Operations'). Used in regulatory filings and law enforcement coordination documents.
attributes.references: NIMS ICS; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: last_drill_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent tabletop exercise or full-scale drill conducted to validate this emergency response plan. Required for OSHA compliance and DHS preparedness certification.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; DHS Active Shooter Preparedness Program; NIMS

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this emergency response plan record. Used for change tracking, regulatory audit trails, and Silver Layer data lineage in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 20121; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: law_enforcement_agency
attributes.description: Name of the primary law enforcement agency coordinating with Sports Entertainment under this plan (e.g., 'Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department', 'NYPD Special Events Unit'). Required for DHS Special Event Assessment Rating (SEAR) submissions.
attributes.references: DHS Special Event Assessment Rating (SEAR); NIMS Unified Command

attributes.name: law_enforcement_contact
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number or radio channel for law enforcement coordination during activation of this plan. Confidential operational security data restricted to authorized security personnel.
attributes.references: DHS National Response Framework; NIMS Unified Command

attributes.name: media_blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan includes a media and social media blackout protocol during initial activation to prevent panic, protect operational security, and manage public communications through official channels only.
attributes.references: DHS Active Shooter Preparedness Program; FCC Emergency Alert System; NIMS Public Information Officer Guidelines

attributes.name: medical_triage_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of designated medical triage zones established under this plan for mass casualty incident (MCI) response. Drives medical resource pre-positioning and EMS coordination planning.
attributes.references: FEMA Mass Casualty Incident (MCI) Response Guidelines; AHA Emergency Cardiovascular Care Standards

attributes.name: multi_venue_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emergency response plan applies to multiple venues simultaneously (e.g., a league-wide severe weather protocol). When True, venue_id represents the primary venue and additional venues are linked in a separate association table.
attributes.references: DHS National Incident Management System (NIMS); FEMA CPG 101

attributes.name: mutual_aid_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or name of the mutual aid agreement with external agencies (neighboring jurisdictions, hospitals, EMS providers) that supports this plan. Enables cross-agency resource sharing during large-scale incidents.
attributes.references: NIMS Mutual Aid Agreements; DHS National Response Framework; FEMA CPG 101

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory review and update of this emergency response plan. Drives compliance calendar alerts and ensures plans remain current with regulatory changes and venue modifications.
attributes.references: DHS National Incident Management System (NIMS); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; ISO 20121

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this emergency response plan across venues and regulatory submissions (e.g., ERP-FIRE-2024-001). Used in DHS filings, local fire marshal submissions, and law enforcement coordination documents.
attributes.references: DHS National Incident Management System (NIMS); Local Fire Marshal Regulations

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.description: Secure URL to the full emergency response plan document stored in the Sports Entertainment Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. Access restricted to authorized security and compliance personnel. Confidential operational security document.
attributes.references: DHS National Incident Management System (NIMS); SOX Section 302 (Document Control); ISO 20121

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the emergency response plan (e.g., 'Active Shooter Response Plan – Allegiant Stadium 2024'). Used in operational briefings, staff training materials, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: DHS Active Shooter Preparedness Program; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: plan_owner_department
attributes.description: Organizational department responsible for this emergency response plan (e.g., 'Venue Security Operations', 'Event Safety and Compliance', 'Facilities Management').
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; ISO 20121

attributes.name: plan_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Sports Entertainment staff member accountable for maintaining, updating, and submitting this emergency response plan. Confidential internal personnel data.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; SOX Section 302 (Document Accountability)

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the emergency response plan. 'Active' indicates the plan is operationally deployed; 'superseded' indicates a newer version has replaced it; 'retired' indicates the plan is no longer applicable.
attributes.references: DHS National Incident Management System (NIMS); ISO 20121

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the emergency scenario this plan governs. Drives protocol selection, command structure, and law enforcement coordination requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active_shooter|bomb_threat|mass_casualty|fire_evacuation|severe_weather|medical_emergency — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: DHS National Incident Management System (NIMS); FEMA Comprehensive Preparedness Guide (CPG) 101

attributes.name: primary_triage_zone_location
attributes.description: Physical location description of the primary medical triage zone within the venue (e.g., 'Gate A Concourse Level 1', 'Field Level South End Zone'). Used by EMS and medical staff during MCI activation.
attributes.references: FEMA MCI Response Guidelines; NIMS ICS Medical Unit

attributes.name: public_address_code
attributes.description: Standardized code word or phrase used in venue public address announcements to signal activation of this plan without causing public panic (e.g., 'Code Alpha' for medical emergency, 'Code Bravo' for security threat).
attributes.references: DHS Active Shooter Preparedness Program; NIMS ICS Public Information Officer Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic and regulatory jurisdiction governing this plan (e.g., 'Clark County, Nevada', 'City of New York, NY', 'Federal – DHS Tier 1'). Determines which regulatory bodies must approve the plan.
attributes.references: DHS National Response Framework; Local Fire Marshal Regulations; OSHA Regional Offices

attributes.name: sear_tier
attributes.business_glossary_term: DHS Special Event Assessment Rating (SEAR) Tier
attributes.description: DHS Special Event Assessment Rating tier assigned to events covered by this plan. Tier 1 represents the highest national significance (e.g., Super Bowl, Olympics); Tier 3 represents significant regional events. Determines federal resource allocation and coordination requirements.
attributes.references: DHS Special Event Assessment Rating (SEAR) Program

attributes.name: shelter_in_place_zone
attributes.description: Designated venue area(s) for shelter-in-place protocols, applicable for severe weather, active threat, or hazmat scenarios. Includes interior hardened areas, concourse corridors, and below-grade spaces.
attributes.references: FEMA Shelter-in-Place Guidelines; DHS Active Shooter Preparedness; NIMS

attributes.name: threat_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the emergency scenario addressed by this plan, aligned with DHS threat level taxonomy. Drives resource pre-positioning, law enforcement notification thresholds, and public communication protocols.
attributes.references: DHS National Terrorism Advisory System (NTAS); NIMS

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version identifier for this iteration of the emergency response plan (e.g., '2.1.0'). Enables tracking of plan revisions, regulatory re-submissions, and audit trails across plan lifecycle.
attributes.references: DHS National Incident Management System (NIMS); SOX Section 302 (Document Control)

attributes.name: activation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this emergency activation event (e.g., EMA-2024-000123). Used in after-action reports, law enforcement coordination, and regulatory filings. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: activation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the emergency activation. Tracks progression from initial activation through resolution or transfer to external authority. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the emergency response plan was formally activated. This is the principal real-world business event timestamp (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category). Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; ISO 20121; NFPA 101

attributes.name: after_action_report_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or URL linking to the formal After-Action Report (AAR) completed following this emergency activation. The AAR documents lessons learned, response effectiveness, and corrective actions. Required for OSHA, ISO 20121, and league governance compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; NIMS After-Action Review Standards; ISO 20121; League Governance Requirements

attributes.name: after_action_report_status
attributes.description: Current completion status of the After-Action Report (AAR) for this emergency activation. Tracks compliance with mandatory post-incident review requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; NIMS After-Action Review Standards; ISO 20121

attributes.name: all_clear_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the all-clear signal was officially issued, indicating the emergency has been resolved and normal operations may resume. Null if the activation has not yet been resolved. Used to calculate response duration.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; NIMS ICS Demobilization Standards; ISO 20121

attributes.name: broadcast_interrupted
attributes.description: Indicates whether live broadcast operations (TV, OTT, radio) were interrupted or suspended as a result of this emergency activation. Relevant for media rights compliance, FCC reporting, and broadcast partner SLA management.
attributes.references: FCC Emergency Alert System Rules; Broadcast Rights Agreements; FCC 47 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: command_post_location
attributes.description: Physical location description of the Incident Command Post (ICP) established for this emergency activation (e.g., 'Gate C Security Office', 'Parking Lot B Mobile Command Unit'). Critical for coordinating multi-agency response and documenting ICS compliance.
attributes.references: NIMS ICS Standards; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; DHS National Response Framework

attributes.name: confirmed_fatalities_count
attributes.description: Total number of confirmed fatalities recorded as a direct result of the emergency incident. Triggers mandatory OSHA fatality reporting within 8 hours, executive notification, and regulatory investigation protocols.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.39 Fatality Reporting; OSHA 300 Log; Local Coroner Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: confirmed_injuries_count
attributes.description: Total number of confirmed injuries (non-fatal) recorded as a direct result of the emergency incident. Used for OSHA 300 log reporting, insurance claims, and after-action analysis.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 Recordkeeping; OSHA 300 Log; ISO 20121

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this emergency activation record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 20121

attributes.name: drill_exercise
attributes.description: Indicates whether this activation record represents a planned emergency drill or tabletop exercise rather than an actual emergency event. Allows filtering of drill records from operational incident analytics and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38 (requires periodic drills); NFPA 101; ISO 20121

attributes.name: ems_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether Emergency Medical Services (EMS) was formally notified as part of this emergency activation. Mandatory documentation for mass casualty and medical emergency plan types.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; NIMS Medical Support Standards

attributes.name: estimated_occupancy_at_activation
attributes.description: Estimated number of persons (fans, staff, athletes, media) present in the venue at the time of emergency activation. Critical for resource allocation, casualty ratio calculations, and post-event safety analysis. Serves as the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category for this non-monetary TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; NFPA 101 Occupancy Load Standards; ADA

attributes.name: evacuation_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether a full or partial venue evacuation was initiated as part of this emergency activation. Drives crowd management protocol tracking and post-event safety audit requirements.
attributes.references: NFPA 101 Life Safety Code; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; ADA Evacuation Accessibility Standards

attributes.name: evacuation_type
attributes.description: Specifies the scope of evacuation executed during this emergency activation: full venue, partial (specific sections), sector-specific (single zone), or none. Applicable only when evacuation_initiated is True.
attributes.references: NFPA 101; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; ADA Evacuation Standards

attributes.name: event_cancelled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Sports Entertainment event was fully cancelled (not resumed) as a result of this emergency activation. Triggers ticketing refund workflows, force majeure clauses, and insurance claim processes.
attributes.references: Ticketmaster/AXS Refund Policy; League Governance Rules; ISO 20121; Force Majeure Contract Provisions

attributes.name: event_suspended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Sports Entertainment event (game, concert, match) was formally suspended or halted as a result of this emergency activation. Impacts ticketing refund obligations, broadcast rights, and league governance reporting.
attributes.references: League Governance Rules (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA); ISO 20121

attributes.name: false_alarm
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emergency activation was subsequently determined to be a false alarm (no actual emergency existed). Critical for tracking false alarm rates, system calibration, and regulatory reporting to fire/police authorities.
attributes.references: NFPA 72; Local False Alarm Ordinances; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: fbi_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) was formally notified as part of this emergency activation. Required for terrorism, active shooter, and bomb threat plan types per federal reporting obligations.
attributes.references: DHS National Response Framework; FBI Venue Security Protocols; 18 U.S.C. § 2332

attributes.name: fire_department_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fire department was formally notified as part of this emergency activation. Required for NFPA 101 and OSHA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: NFPA 101 Life Safety Code; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: incident_commander_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated Incident Commander (IC) who assumed operational control of the emergency response under the Incident Command System (ICS). May differ from the activating authority if command was transferred.
attributes.references: NIMS ICS Standards; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: incident_severity_level
attributes.description: Standardized severity classification of the emergency incident at time of activation (Level 1 = minor/localized to Level 5 = catastrophic/mass casualty). Drives resource mobilization, agency notification requirements, and executive escalation protocols.
attributes.references: NIMS Incident Complexity Types; DHS National Response Framework; OSHA

attributes.name: incident_trigger_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific incident, condition, or threat that triggered the emergency plan activation. Captures the initiating event details for after-action review and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; ISO 20121; NIMS ICS-201 Incident Briefing

attributes.name: insurance_claim_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an insurance claim has been filed in connection with this emergency activation. Triggers financial reporting workflows and links to the finance domain for claim tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; Internal Risk Management Policy; ISO 20121

attributes.name: lockdown_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether a venue lockdown (perimeter secured, no entry/exit permitted) was initiated as part of this emergency activation. Critical for active shooter and terrorism threat plan types.
attributes.references: DHS Active Shooter Guidelines; FBI Venue Security Protocols; OSHA

attributes.name: medical_transports_count
attributes.description: Number of individuals transported by EMS or other medical transport to off-site medical facilities during or immediately following the emergency activation. Supports EMS coordination reporting and insurance documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; NIMS Medical Support Standards; EMS Coordination Agreements

attributes.name: other_agencies_notified
attributes.description: Free-text or comma-separated list of additional agencies notified beyond police, fire, EMS, and FBI (e.g., 'DHS, ATF, Local Emergency Management, Red Cross, FEMA'). Captures full notification scope for compliance and after-action review.
attributes.references: NIMS; DHS National Response Framework; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of emergency response plan activated. Determines the response protocol, agencies notified, and command structure engaged. attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; NFPA 101; DHS Active Shooter Guidelines; NIMS

attributes.name: police_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether law enforcement (police) was formally notified as part of this emergency activation. Required for regulatory compliance documentation and after-action reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.38; Local Law Enforcement Coordination Agreements

attributes.name: regulatory_report_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a mandatory regulatory report (e.g., OSHA fatality/hospitalization report, FCC emergency alert report, local authority notification) has been filed for this emergency activation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.39; FCC 47 CFR Part 11; Local Emergency Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or tracking identifier for the regulatory report filed with the applicable authority (OSHA, FCC, local emergency management). Populated only when regulatory_report_filed is True.

products.name: footage_camera_scope
products.description: This association product represents the scoping event between a surveillance_footage_request and a surveillance_camera. It captures which specific cameras are included in a footage request and the per-camera retrieval details — time window, format, file size, and redaction status — that exist only in the context of a specific request-camera pairing. Each record links one surveillance_footage_request to one surveillance_camera and tracks the operational fulfillment state for that camera's footage within the request.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment security operations, a single footage request routinely spans multiple cameras (e.g., an incident investigation covering entrance cameras, concourse cameras, and VIP area cameras simultaneously). Conversely, a single camera will be referenced by many different footage requests over time — law enforcement requests, internal investigations, insurance claims. The business actively manages which specific cameras are included in each request, with per-camera attributes such as the footage time window, file size, format, and redaction status that belong to neither the request nor the camera alone.

attributes.name: domain_tld

attributes.name: drm_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Digital Rights Management (DRM) controls are applied to this IP asset for digital distribution and enforcement purposes. Particularly relevant for broadcast content copyrights and digital media assets distributed via OTT (Over-The-Top) and IPTV platforms.
attributes.references: DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy; DMCA (Digital Millennium Copyright Act); Broadcast Rights Distribution Standards

attributes.name: enforcement_watch_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether an active trademark or IP watch service is monitoring for potential infringements, conflicting applications, or unauthorized use of this IP asset. True = watch service active; False = no active monitoring.
attributes.references: USPTO; WIPO; Internal IP Enforcement Policy

attributes.name: estimated_valuation_usd
attributes.description: Estimated fair market value of the IP asset in US dollars as assessed by internal finance or external IP valuation specialists. Used for balance sheet reporting, licensing fee benchmarking, and M&A due diligence. Classified confidential as commercially sensitive.
attributes.references: ASC 350 (Intangible Assets); IFRS IAS 38; SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IP registration or protection period expires if not renewed. Null for perpetual rights (e.g., trade secrets). Used to trigger renewal workflows and risk alerts.
attributes.references: USPTO; WIPO; Lanham Act § 8 & § 9; 35 U.S.C. § 154

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IP application was formally filed with the relevant IP authority. Establishes priority date for trademark and patent rights. Critical for determining seniority in opposition proceedings.
attributes.references: USPTO; WIPO Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property; 35 U.S.C. § 111

attributes.name: first_use_anywhere_date
attributes.description: Date on which the trademark or service mark was first used anywhere (not limited to commerce). Distinct from use_in_commerce_date; establishes the earliest possible priority date for common law trademark rights.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Breadth of geographic coverage for this IP asset's protection. Indicates whether protection is limited to a single country (national), covers a region (regional), spans multiple countries (international), or is worldwide via WIPO Madrid Protocol or PCT.

attributes.name: internal_reference_code
attributes.description: Internal docket or reference code assigned by Sports Entertainment's legal department for tracking this IP asset in internal matter management and ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA legal module). Enables cross-referencing with internal legal matter tracking.

attributes.name: ip_class_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the goods or services covered under the Nice Classification code, as filed with the IP authority. Provides specificity beyond the class number for enforcement and licensing scope determination.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code identifying the legal jurisdiction in which the IP asset is registered or applied for (e.g., US, EU, GB, AU). Supports multi-jurisdictional portfolio management across global sports-entertainment markets.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; WIPO Madrid Protocol; EUIPO; USPTO

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent renewal of the IP registration was completed and accepted by the IP authority. Supports renewal history tracking and compliance verification.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP § 1604; Lanham Act § 8 & § 9; 35 U.S.C. § 41

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP portfolio record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and downstream data pipeline incremental load processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: licensing_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IP asset is approved and available for licensing to third parties (e.g., merchandise licensees, broadcast partners, sponsors). True = eligible for licensing; False = restricted to internal use or subject to licensing moratorium.
attributes.references: Internal IP Licensing Policy; NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) Regulations; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: mark_type
attributes.description: Specific form of the trademark or service mark (e.g., word mark, design/logo mark, composite mark, sound mark, color mark, motion mark). Applicable to trademark and service mark asset types only. Null for patents, copyrights, and domain names.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP § 807; Lanham Act; WIPO

attributes.name: nice_class_code
attributes.description: International Nice Classification class number (1–45) applicable to trademark and service mark registrations.
