attributes.references: WIPO Nice Agreement Concerning the International Classification of Goods and Services (Nice Classification, 12th Edition); USPTO TMEP § 1401

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for legal team annotations, prosecution history notes, enforcement observations, or other contextual information relevant to this IP asset that does not fit structured fields. Not intended for legally binding statements.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Department Policy

attributes.name: opposition_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an opposition or cancellation proceeding has been filed against this IP asset by a third party, or filed by Sports Entertainment against a conflicting application. True = opposition proceeding active or on record.
attributes.references: USPTO TTAB (Trademark Trial and Appeal Board); WIPO; Lanham Act § 13

attributes.name: patent_type
attributes.description: Classification of patent by type (utility, design, plant, provisional). Applicable to patent asset types only. Null for trademarks, copyrights, and domain names. Determines protection term and maintenance fee schedule.
attributes.references: 35 U.S.C. § 101 (Utility); § 171 (Design); § 163 (Plant); USPTO

attributes.name: priority_claim_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 country code of the jurisdiction in which the original priority application was filed. Used in conjunction with priority_claim_date for Paris Convention priority assertions.
attributes.references: WIPO Paris Convention; ISO 3166-1; PCT

attributes.name: priority_claim_date
attributes.description: Date of the earliest priority claim asserted for this IP asset under the Paris Convention or PCT (Patent Cooperation Treaty). Null if no priority claim is made. Determines seniority in multi-jurisdictional filings.
attributes.references: WIPO Paris Convention; PCT (Patent Cooperation Treaty); 35 U.S.C. § 119

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IP asset was officially registered or granted by the relevant IP authority. Marks the commencement of full legal protection and enforcement rights.
attributes.references: USPTO; WIPO; EPO; Lanham Act § 7

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration or application number assigned by the relevant IP authority (e.g., USPTO registration number, EPO patent number, WIPO Madrid Protocol number). Externally known unique identifier for the asset.
attributes.references: USPTO; WIPO; EPO; EUIPO

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the IP asset registration with the governing IP authority. Drives renewal workflows, enforcement eligibility, and portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP; WIPO; EPO Guidelines; Lanham Act

attributes.name: renewal_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline by which renewal filings and fees must be submitted to maintain active IP protection. May precede expiration_date by a statutory grace period. Drives automated renewal reminders and outside counsel task assignments.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP § 1604; Lanham Act § 8 & § 9; 35 U.S.C. § 41

attributes.name: renewal_term_years
attributes.description: Duration in years of each renewal period for this IP asset as prescribed by the applicable IP authority and asset type (e.g., 10 years for US trademarks, 20 years for utility patents from filing date). Drives automated expiration and renewal deadline calculations.
attributes.references: USPTO; Lanham Act § 8 & § 9; 35 U.S.C. § 154; WIPO

attributes.name: use_in_commerce_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: IP First Use in Commerce Date
attributes.description: Date on which the trademark or service mark was first used in interstate or international commerce. Required for US trademark registrations under the Lanham Act. Establishes common law rights and supports opposition proceedings.
attributes.references: Lanham Act § 1(a); USPTO TMEP § 901

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the estimated valuation was last assessed or updated. Supports staleness detection for financial reporting and triggers revaluation workflows per accounting policy.
attributes.references: ASC 350; IFRS IAS 38; SOX Section 302

products.name: trademark_registration
products.description: Granular trademark registration record for each mark filed or registered by Sports Entertainment across global jurisdictions. Captures mark name, mark type (word, figurative, combined, 3D), Nice class codes, filing jurisdiction (USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO Madrid Protocol), application number, registration number, filing date, publication date, registration date, renewal date, opposition period end date, current prosecution status, associated IP portfolio reference, and assigned trademark counsel. Tracks the full prosecution lifecycle from application through registration and maintenance.

attributes.name: trademark_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each trademark registration record within the Sports Entertainment IP portfolio management system. Serves as the primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned trademark attorney or outside counsel responsible for prosecuting and maintaining this registration.

attributes.name: ip_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IP portfolio grouping under which this trademark registration is managed. Enables portfolio-level reporting and aggregation across marks.
attributes.references: Internal IP Portfolio Governance Framework

attributes.name: outside_counsel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned trademark attorney or outside counsel responsible for prosecuting and maintaining this registration.
attributes.references: Internal Outside Counsel Management Policy

attributes.name: application_basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under which the trademark application was filed. Use in Commerce (Section 1(a)) requires current use; Intent to Use (Section 1(b)) is for marks not yet in use; Foreign Registration (Section 44(e)) is based on a home country registration; Madrid Protocol (Section 66(a)) is for international designations.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §806; 15 U.S.C. §1051; Lanham Act §§1(a), 1(b), 44(e), 66(a)

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: The official application serial number assigned by the intellectual property office upon receipt of the trademark filing. This is the externally-known identifier used to track the application during prosecution before registration is granted.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §503; EUIPO EUTMR Article 32; WIPO Madrid Protocol Rule 11

attributes.name: associated_brand_category
attributes.description: Business category of the Sports Entertainment brand asset associated with this trademark registration. Classifies the mark by its commercial function within the enterprise's brand architecture (e.g., league brand, team brand, event brand, venue brand, broadcast brand). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: league|team|athlete|event|venue|broadcast|merchandise|digital — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Brand Architecture Framework; NIL — Name Image and Likeness Policy

attributes.name: cancellation_proceeding_reference
attributes.description: The official case number for any cancellation or invalidation proceeding filed against this trademark registration before the relevant IP office's trial board. Null if no cancellation proceeding is pending or has been filed.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §1507; 15 U.S.C. §1064; EUIPO EUTMR Article 63; CAS Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: color_claim
attributes.description: Description of specific colors claimed as a feature of the trademark, if applicable. Identifies the color(s) that form part of the mark and the elements to which those colors apply. Null for marks filed in black and white without color claims.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §807.07; EUIPO Guidelines Part B Section 2.5; WIPO Standard ST.60

attributes.name: disclaimer_text
attributes.description: Statement disclaiming exclusive rights to specific non-distinctive elements within the trademark (e.g., generic or descriptive words, geographic terms). Required by IP offices when a mark contains elements that cannot be exclusively owned. Affects enforcement scope.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §1213; 15 U.S.C. §1056; EUIPO Guidelines Part B Section 4

attributes.name: drm_licensing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trademark is subject to active Digital Rights Management (DRM) licensing arrangements, including digital broadcast, streaming, or online platform licensing agreements. Relevant for Sports Entertainment's OTT and digital content distribution operations.
attributes.references: Internal IP Licensing Policy; DRM — Digital Rights Management Industry Standard

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the trademark application was received and accorded a filing date by the intellectual property office. Establishes priority rights and is the reference date for calculating opposition periods and examination timelines.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §201; EUIPO EUTMR Article 32; WIPO Madrid Protocol Rule 11

attributes.name: filing_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The intellectual property office or treaty system under which this trademark application was filed (e.g., USPTO for United States, EUIPO for European Union, WIPO for Madrid Protocol international designations, CIPO for Canada, IPO for United Kingdom). Uses standard office abbreviation codes.
attributes.references: WIPO Madrid Protocol; USPTO 15 U.S.C. §1051; EUIPO Regulation (EU) 2017/1001

attributes.name: first_use_anywhere_date
attributes.description: The date on which the trademark was first used anywhere (not limited to commerce) in connection with the covered goods or services. Distinct from first use in commerce; used in USPTO applications to establish the earliest possible use date for priority purposes.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §903; 15 U.S.C. §1051(a)(2); Lanham Act §45

attributes.name: goods_services_description
attributes.description: The formal identification of goods and/or services covered by the trademark registration as specified in the application. This description defines the scope of trademark protection and must align with the Nice Classification codes. Critical for enforcement and licensing scope determination.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §1402; EUIPO Guidelines Part B Section 3; WIPO Nice Agreement

attributes.name: international_registration_number
attributes.description: The international registration number assigned by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) International Bureau for marks filed under the Madrid Protocol or Madrid Agreement. Applicable only to international trademark filings; null for national-only registrations.
attributes.references: WIPO Madrid Protocol Article 7; WIPO Madrid Agreement Article 4

attributes.name: is_incontestable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trademark has achieved incontestable status under Section 15 of the Lanham Act (USPTO) by filing a Declaration of Incontestability after five consecutive years of continuous use in commerce following registration. Incontestable marks have stronger legal protection against certain challenges.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §1605; 15 U.S.C. §1065; Lanham Act §15

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the primary national jurisdiction of the trademark filing. For multi-country filings under WIPO Madrid Protocol, this reflects the base country of origin. Used for geographic rights management and enforcement scoping.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WIPO Madrid Protocol Article 2

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent renewal of the trademark registration was completed and accepted by the relevant IP office. Used to calculate the current registration term and verify maintenance compliance.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §1601; EUIPO EUTMR Article 53; WIPO Madrid Protocol Article 7

attributes.name: licensed_to_third_party
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trademark has been licensed to one or more third parties (e.g., merchandise licensees, broadcast partners, sponsors) under a trademark license agreement. Triggers additional monitoring and quality control obligations for the licensor.
attributes.references: Internal IP Licensing Policy; Lanham Act §45; EUIPO EUTMR Article 25

attributes.name: madrid_designation_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes for countries designated under a WIPO Madrid Protocol international registration. Applicable only to international filings; null for national-only registrations. Defines the geographic scope of international protection sought.
attributes.references: WIPO Madrid Protocol Article 3ter; WIPO Madrid Agreement Article 3ter

attributes.name: mark_description
attributes.description: Formal written description of the trademark mark as submitted to the IP office, particularly required for figurative, combined, 3D, sound, and color marks. Describes the visual or non-visual elements of the mark for examination and publication purposes.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §808; EUIPO Guidelines Part B Section 2.2; WIPO Standard ST.60

attributes.name: mark_name
attributes.description: The textual name or verbal element of the trademark as filed with the relevant intellectual property office (e.g., USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO). For figurative-only marks, this field captures the descriptive title used internally.
attributes.references: USPTO TMEP §1202; EUIPO Guidelines Part B; WIPO Madrid Agreement

attributes.name: mark_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trademark by its nature as recognized by international IP offices. Word marks protect text only; figurative marks protect logos/images; combined marks protect text plus device; 3D marks protect shape; sound and color marks protect non-visual identifiers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: word|figurative|combined|3d|sound|color — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WIPO Standard ST.60; USPTO TMEP §1202; EUIPO Guidelines Part B Section 2

attributes.name: nice_class_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Nice Classification class numbers (1–45) under which the trademark is filed, identifying the goods and services covered by the mark. Sports Entertainment marks typically span classes 25 (clothing), 28 (sporting goods), 41 (entertainment services), and 38 (broadcasting). Multiple classes indicate broader protection scope.
attributes.references: WIPO Nice Agreement (11th Edition); USPTO TMEP §1401; EUIPO Guidelines Part B Section 3

attributes.name: official_filing_fee_usd
attributes.description: The official government filing fee paid to the intellectual property office at the time of application or renewal, expressed in US dollars. Used for IP portfolio cost tracking, budget planning, and financial reporting of trademark maintenance expenditures.
attributes.references: USPTO Fee Schedule 37 C.F.R. §2.6; EUIPO Fee Regulation; WIPO Madrid Protocol Fee Schedule; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: opposition_case_reference
attributes.description: The official case or proceeding number assigned by the IP office's trial board (e.g., USPTO TTAB) for any opposition proceeding filed against this trademark application. Null if no opposition has been filed.
attributes.references: USPTO TTAB Rules 37 C.F.R. Part 2; EUIPO EUTMR Article 46; WIPO Madrid Protocol Rule 17

attributes.name: opposition_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a third-party opposition has been filed against this trademark application during the opposition period. When true, the prosecution is suspended pending resolution of the opposition proceeding before the relevant IP office's trial board.

attributes.name: opposition_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statutory opposition period closes following publication of the trademark application. After this date, absent a filed opposition, the mark proceeds to registration. Critical for prosecution timeline management and docketing.

attributes.name: owner_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the trademark owner's domicile or principal place of business as recorded with the IP office. Required for international filings and determines eligibility under certain treaty provisions.

attributes.name: owner_entity_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the entity recorded as the owner of the trademark registration with the IP office. May be a parent company, subsidiary, or operating entity of Sports Entertainment. Critical for enforcement standing and licensing authority.

attributes.name: owner_entity_type
attributes.description: Legal classification of the trademark owner entity as recorded with the IP office. Determines the legal capacity to own and enforce trademark rights and affects filing requirements.

attributes.name: priority_date

attributes.name: prosecution_notes

attributes.name: prosecution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the trademark application or registration through the prosecution process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|published|registered|abandoned|cancelled|expired — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: publication_date

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: renewal_due_date

attributes.name: use_in_commerce_date

attributes.name: broadcast_rights_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enforcement action involves unauthorized broadcast, streaming, or redistribution of Sports Entertainment media rights content (e.g., PPV piracy, RSN blackout violations, OTT unauthorized retransmission). Links to broadcast rights deal enforcement.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Regulation; Communications Act; Internal Media Rights Policy; broadcast.media_rights_deal

attributes.name: counterfeit_goods_seized_quantity
attributes.description: Number of counterfeit merchandise units (e.g., jerseys, caps, licensed product SKUs) seized or identified as part of the enforcement action. Applicable to merchandise and licensing enforcement actions. Null for non-goods enforcement types.
attributes.references: Lanham Act 15 U.S.C. § 1116; CBP Recordation Program; Internal Merchandise Licensing Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this enforcement action record was first created in the legal data platform. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to damages_sought_amount and settlement_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-jurisdictional enforcement actions involving international IP disputes.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration; WIPO Financial Rules

attributes.name: damages_sought_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of damages, injunctive relief, or statutory penalties sought by Sports Entertainment (or claimed against it in defensive actions). Expressed in the currency indicated by currency_code. Used for financial risk exposure reporting and EBITDA impact analysis.
attributes.references: Lanham Act 15 U.S.C. § 1117; Copyright Act 17 U.S.C. § 504; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: docket_number
attributes.description: Official court, tribunal, or administrative docket/case number assigned by the filing venue (e.g., USPTO TTAB opposition number, federal court civil action number, WIPO case number). Used for external tracking and legal correspondence.
attributes.references: USPTO TTAB Rules 37 C.F.R. § 2.101; Federal Rules of Civil Procedure; WIPO UDRP Rules

attributes.name: drm_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enforcement action involves circumvention of Digital Rights Management (DRM) technology protecting broadcast content, OTT streams, or digital media assets. Triggers DMCA anti-circumvention provisions under 17 U.S.C. § 1201.
attributes.references: DMCA 17 U.S.C. § 1201; FCC Broadcast Regulation; Internal DRM Policy; Dalet Galaxy MAM

attributes.name: enforcement_channel
attributes.description: The institutional venue or platform through which the enforcement action is being pursued (e.g., USPTO TTAB for trademark oppositions, WIPO for UDRP domain disputes, platform takedown for DMCA notices on social media or streaming services). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: uspto_ttab|federal_court|wipo|platform_takedown|customs_cbp|state_court|international_tribunal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USPTO TTAB Rules of Practice; WIPO UDRP Policy; DMCA 17 U.S.C. § 512; CBP Recordation Program

attributes.name: enforcement_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether Sports Entertainment is the initiating party (offensive — asserting its IP rights) or the responding party (defensive — defending against a third-party IP claim). Critical for legal strategy reporting and risk exposure analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Strategy Framework; CAS Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the enforcement action was escalated from an administrative or pre-litigation channel to formal litigation or a higher-priority enforcement track. Null if no escalation has occurred. Supports lifecycle stage analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Escalation Policy; Federal Rules of Civil Procedure

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal legal filing, notice, or complaint was submitted to the relevant enforcement channel (USPTO, court, WIPO, or platform). Distinct from initiated_date which captures the internal decision date.
attributes.references: USPTO Rules of Practice 37 C.F.R.; Federal Rules of Civil Procedure Rule 3; WIPO UDRP Rules

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enforcement action is limited to domestic (USA) markets, specific international jurisdictions, or has global scope. Informs treaty applicability (Madrid Protocol, Berne Convention) and multi-jurisdictional coordination requirements.
attributes.references: Madrid Protocol; Berne Convention; Paris Convention; WIPO; Internal IP Enforcement Policy

attributes.name: infringing_asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the infringing material, product, domain, or content that is the subject of the enforcement action (e.g., counterfeit jersey bearing NFL team logo, unauthorized streaming of PPV broadcast, domain name mimicking official team website). Essential for legal pleadings and evidence documentation.
attributes.references: Lanham Act 15 U.S.C. § 1114; DMCA 17 U.S.C. § 512; WIPO UDRP Policy

attributes.name: infringing_url
attributes.description: Specific URL, domain name, or digital location of the infringing content or asset. Critical for DMCA platform takedown notices, UDRP domain disputes, and OTT piracy enforcement actions.
attributes.references: DMCA 17 U.S.C. § 512(c)(3); WIPO UDRP Policy; FCC Broadcast Regulation

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which Sports Entertainment formally initiated or received the IP enforcement action (e.g., date a cease-and-desist letter was sent, a DMCA notice was filed, or a complaint was served). Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: USPTO Rules of Practice; WIPO UDRP Rules; DMCA 17 U.S.C. § 512

attributes.name: injunction_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a preliminary or permanent injunction was granted as part of the enforcement action outcome. True when injunctive relief was awarded; False otherwise. Critical for IP portfolio protection reporting.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure Rule 65; Lanham Act 15 U.S.C. § 1116

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal legal team observations, strategy notes, and case developments not captured in structured fields. Subject to attorney-client privilege. Restricted to authorized legal personnel.
attributes.references: Attorney-Client Privilege Doctrine; Internal Legal Records Policy; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ip_right_type
attributes.description: Category of intellectual property right being enforced (e.g., trademark for league logos, copyright for broadcast content, right of publicity for athlete NIL). Drives applicable legal framework and jurisdiction rules.
attributes.references: Lanham Act; Copyright Act 17 U.S.C.; Patent Act 35 U.S.C.; WIPO; NIL Regulations

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the legal jurisdiction in which the enforcement action is filed or adjudicated. May differ from respondent domicile (e.g., a UDRP filed in USA against a registrant in CHN).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WIPO UDRP Policy; Federal Rules of Civil Procedure

attributes.name: jurisdiction_detail
attributes.description: Specific court, tribunal, or administrative body name and district/circuit where the action is filed (e.g., 'U.S. District Court, S.D.N.Y.', 'WIPO Arbitration and Mediation Center', 'USPTO TTAB'). Complements jurisdiction_country_code with granular venue information.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure; USPTO TTAB Rules; WIPO UDRP Policy

attributes.name: legal_fees_incurred_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative outside counsel and filing fees incurred for this enforcement action to date. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA CO cost center postings. Used for ROI analysis of IP enforcement program and outside counsel budget management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Financial Controls; Internal Legal Budget Policy

attributes.name: nil_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: Name Image and Likeness (NIL) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enforcement action involves unauthorized use of an athlete's Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL). Triggers specific NIL agreement review and athlete notification obligations under applicable state NIL laws and CBA provisions.
attributes.references: NIL State Legislation; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); Internal Athlete Management Policy

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Final result of the enforcement action upon resolution. Drives IP portfolio strategy, outside counsel performance evaluation, and legal risk reporting. Null while action is active.
attributes.references: Internal Legal KPI Framework; CAS Arbitration Rules; Federal Rules of Civil Procedure

attributes.name: outside_counsel_matter_number
attributes.description: The matter reference number assigned by the outside law firm to this enforcement action in their billing and matter management system. Used for invoice reconciliation and SLA tracking against outside counsel engagement letters.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Vendor Management Policy; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Invoice Management

attributes.name: platform_name
attributes.description: Name of the digital platform, marketplace, or service provider where the infringing activity was identified (e.g., YouTube, Amazon, eBay, Twitch, Facebook). Used for platform-specific takedown workflows and repeat-infringer tracking.
attributes.references: DMCA 17 U.S.C. § 512; Digital Services Act (EU); Internal DRM Policy

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this enforcement action based on IP asset value, reputational risk, and financial exposure. Drives resource allocation, outside counsel engagement level, and executive escalation thresholds.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Risk Management Framework; Internal KPI Standard

attributes.name: repeat_infringer
attributes.description: Indicates whether the respondent party has been the subject of a prior IP enforcement action by Sports Entertainment. True signals a pattern of infringement, which may support enhanced damages claims and escalated enforcement strategy.
attributes.references: DMCA 17 U.S.C. § 512(i); Lanham Act 15 U.S.C. § 1117; Internal IP Enforcement Policy

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the enforcement action reached final resolution — whether by settlement, court judgment, administrative decision, withdrawal, or platform confirmation of takedown. Null if action is still active.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure; WIPO UDRP Policy; Internal Legal Closure Standard

attributes.name: respondent_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the respondent party's primary jurisdiction or domicile (e.g., USA, GBR, CHN). Used for international enforcement strategy, treaty applicability, and jurisdictional routing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WIPO Madrid Protocol; Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property

attributes.name: respondent_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the individual, company, or entity against whom the enforcement action is directed. Captured directly on the action record for legal correspondence and reporting independent of CRM party linkage.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Internal Legal Records Policy

attributes.name: response_deadline_date
attributes.description: Statutory or procedural deadline by which the respondent must respond, or by which Sports Entertainment must file a reply. Critical for docket management and SLA compliance with outside counsel.
attributes.references: USPTO TTAB Rules 37 C.F.R. § 2.101; Federal Rules of Civil Procedure Rule 12; WIPO UDRP Rules

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value agreed upon in a settlement agreement, if applicable. May represent payment to or from Sports Entertainment. Null if no settlement was reached. Feeds financial accrual reporting in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302; Internal Legal Settlement Policy

attributes.name: settlement_terms_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of key settlement terms including non-monetary obligations (e.g., domain transfer, content removal, licensing grant, injunction compliance, royalty arrangement). Complements settlement_amount with qualitative terms.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Settlement Policy; CAS Arbitration Rules; WIPO Mediation Rules

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to this enforcement action record. Supports audit trail and change tracking. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: escalated_ip_enforcement_action_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ip_enforcement_action (escalated_ip_enforcement_action_id)

SSOT for all litigation matters distinct from compliance arbitration cases.

attributes.name: litigation_case_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each litigation matter record in the Sports Entertainment legal portfolio. Primary key for the litigation_case data product.

attributes.name: related_event_fixture_id
attributes.description: Reference to a specific sports or entertainment event that is the subject of or directly related to this litigation matter (e.g., a personal injury claim arising from a specific game or concert). Links to the event master for operational context and insurance claim correlation.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ADA Title III

attributes.name: answer_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which Sports Entertainment must file its answer, motion to dismiss, or other responsive pleading. Critical for legal calendar management and avoiding default judgments.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 12(a); State Civil Procedure Rules

attributes.name: appeal_deadline_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which a notice of appeal must be filed following an adverse judgment or arbitration award. Critical for legal calendar management to preserve appellate rights. Applicable when case_status = 'appeal' or following an adverse disposition.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 4 (Appellate); Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure; CAS Procedural Rules

attributes.name: case_name
attributes.description: Official caption or style of the case as it appears on court filings (e.g., 'Sports Entertainment LLC v. Acme Promotions Inc.'). Used for identification in legal registers, board reports, and outside counsel communications.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 10(a); CAS Procedural Rules

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned docket or case number issued by the court, tribunal, or arbitration body (e.g., 2024-CV-00123-SDNY). Serves as the primary external business identifier for the matter and is used in all court filings, correspondence, and legal management systems.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP); CAS Procedural Rules

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the litigation matter. Drives financial reserve adjustments, reporting obligations, and workflow assignments. Valid values: pre_litigation (matter identified but no formal filing), discovery (formal discovery phase), trial (active trial proceedings), appeal (post-judgment appellate proceedings), settled (settlement reached), closed (matter fully resolved and closed).
attributes.references: FRCP; SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K Item 103

attributes.name: case_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal matter by nature of the claim or dispute. Drives routing to specialist in-house counsel, reserve methodology, and regulatory disclosure requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial_dispute|employment_claim|personal_injury|antitrust|labor_arbitration|regulatory_enforcement|intellectual_property|contract_breach — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABA Litigation Section Standards; GDPR Article 83; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: cba_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this litigation or arbitration matter arises from or is governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) between Sports Entertainment and a players association or labor union. True = CBA-governed matter requiring specialized labor relations handling.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement); NLRB Rules

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Privilege and confidentiality classification of the litigation matter record. Governs access controls, data sharing restrictions, and document production obligations. Attorney-client privileged and work-product records are protected from disclosure in discovery.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.6; FRCP Rule 26(b)(3); GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: court_or_tribunal
attributes.description: Full name of the court, arbitration panel, regulatory body, or tribunal where the matter is pending (e.g., 'U.S. District Court – SDNY', 'American Arbitration Association', 'Court of Arbitration for Sport', 'NLRB'). Used for docketing, service of process tracking, and legal calendar management.
attributes.references: FRCP; CAS Procedural Rules; NLRA; FCC Enforcement Bureau Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this litigation case record was first created in the legal matter management system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX internal controls documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 20121; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts on this litigation record (estimated_exposure_amount, reserve_amount, settlement_amount, legal_fees_incurred). Supports multi-currency reporting for international matters (e.g., FIFA, CAS, UEFA proceedings).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 21; ASC 830

attributes.name: discovery_cutoff_date
attributes.description: Court-ordered deadline by which all fact discovery (depositions, document production, interrogatories) must be completed. Drives legal hold management, e-discovery workflows, and outside counsel scheduling.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 26(f); FRCP Rule 16(b)

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final disposition of the matter was reached (settlement execution date, judgment entry date, or arbitration award date). Triggers reserve release, legal hold lift, and financial close-out workflows.
attributes.references: ASC 450-20; SOX Section 302; FRCP

attributes.name: disposition_type
attributes.description: The manner in which the litigation matter was ultimately resolved. Populated when case_status transitions to 'settled' or 'closed'. Used for litigation outcome analytics, reserve release, and post-matter review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: settlement|judgment_for_plaintiff|judgment_for_defendant|dismissal_with_prejudice|dismissal_without_prejudice|arbitration_award|consent_decree — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FRCP; AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules; CAS Procedural Rules; SEC Regulation S-K Item 103

attributes.name: estimated_exposure_amount
attributes.description: Legal team's current best estimate of the maximum potential financial liability (damages, penalties, fees) if the matter is decided adversely to Sports Entertainment. Used for financial reserve setting, EBITDA impact analysis, and SEC disclosure materiality assessments under ASC 450.
attributes.references: ASC 450 (Contingencies); SEC Regulation S-K Item 103; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: expert_disclosure_date
attributes.description: Court-ordered deadline for disclosure of expert witnesses and their reports under FRCP Rule 26(a)(2). Relevant for damages quantification experts, sports science experts, and industry standard-of-care witnesses.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 26(a)(2); Federal Rules of Evidence Rule 702

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the complaint, petition, or initiating pleading was formally filed with the court or tribunal. Anchors the statute of limitations analysis, case age reporting, and litigation timeline tracking.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 3; SEC Regulation S-K Item 103

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: The substantive law that governs the dispute (e.g., 'New York', 'California', 'English Law', 'Swiss Law'). Determines applicable statutes of limitations, damages caps, and procedural requirements for the matter.
attributes.references: Restatement (Second) of Conflict of Laws; CAS Procedural Rules

attributes.name: insurance_claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number assigned by the insurer upon tender of the litigation matter. Used to track insurance recovery, monitor insurer defense obligations, and reconcile indemnification payments against reserve amounts.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; PCI SSC

attributes.name: is_class_action
attributes.description: Indicates whether this matter is a class action or collective action lawsuit. Class actions carry significantly higher exposure, require specialized defense strategy, and trigger enhanced reserve and disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 23; SEC Regulation S-K Item 103

attributes.name: is_material
attributes.description: Indicates whether this litigation matter meets the SEC materiality threshold requiring disclosure in public financial filings (10-K, 10-Q) under SEC Regulation S-K Item 103. Set by in-house counsel in consultation with finance. True = material disclosure required.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 103; SOX Section 302; ASC 450-20

attributes.name: is_under_legal_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether a litigation hold (preservation notice) has been issued for this matter, requiring suspension of normal document retention and destruction policies. True = active legal hold in place. Critical for e-discovery compliance and spoliation risk management.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 37(e); Zubulake v. UBS Warburg (e-discovery standards); GDPR Article 17(3)(e)

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction in which the matter is filed or arbitrated (e.g., 'Southern District of New York', 'California Superior Court – Los Angeles', 'CAS – Lausanne', 'FIFA Disciplinary Committee'). Determines applicable procedural rules, governing law, and regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FRCP; CAS Procedural Rules; FIFA Disciplinary Code; GDPR Article 79

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this litigation case record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(2); ISO 20121

attributes.name: legal_fee_budget
attributes.description: Approved budget for outside counsel and litigation-related expenses for this matter, as set during matter intake or annual legal budget planning in Workday Adaptive Planning. Compared against legal_fees_incurred for variance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday Adaptive Planning; Outside Counsel Guidelines; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: legal_fees_incurred
attributes.description: Cumulative outside counsel and litigation-related legal fees invoiced and approved to date for this matter. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA AP module invoice postings. Used for matter budget tracking, outside counsel spend analysis, and total cost-of-litigation reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; Outside Counsel Guidelines; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: legal_hold_date
attributes.description: Date on which the litigation hold notice was formally issued to relevant custodians within Sports Entertainment. Used to establish the preservation obligation start date and demonstrate good-faith compliance with e-discovery obligations.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 37(e); Zubulake v. UBS Warburg; GDPR Article 17(3)(e)

attributes.name: opposing_counsel_firm
attributes.description: Name of the law firm representing the opposing party. Used for conflict-of-interest screening, litigation intelligence, and outside counsel relationship management.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7; State Bar Rules

attributes.name: opposing_lead_attorney
attributes.description: Full name of the lead attorney of record for the opposing party. Used for conflict checks, deposition scheduling, and litigation strategy assessments.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7

attributes.name: opposing_party_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the primary adverse party (individual, corporation, union, or regulatory body) in the litigation matter. Used for conflict-of-interest checks, counterparty risk analysis, and legal correspondence.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 10(a); ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7

attributes.name: party_role
attributes.description: Designates whether Sports Entertainment is the initiating party (plaintiff/petitioner) or responding party (defendant/respondent) in the matter. Critical for exposure assessment, litigation strategy, and financial disclosure under SEC Regulation S-K.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 7; SEC Regulation S-K Item 103

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory or governing body that initiated or is overseeing the enforcement proceeding (e.g., 'FCC', 'SEC', 'OSHA', 'WADA', 'FIFA Disciplinary Committee', 'NLRB'). Populated for regulatory enforcement matters; null for purely private litigation.
attributes.references: FCC Enforcement Bureau; SEC Enforcement Division; OSHA 29 CFR 1903; WADA Code; FIFA Disciplinary Code

attributes.name: related_business_unit
attributes.description: The Sports Entertainment business unit or division most directly involved in or affected by this litigation matter (e.g., 'Venue Operations', 'Broadcast', 'Athlete Management', 'Ticketing', 'Merchandise'). Used for cost allocation, business unit risk reporting, and operational impact assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module (Cost Center Accounting); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: Accounting reserve established in the financial statements for this litigation matter per ASC 450 probable-and-estimable criteria. Reconciled with SAP S/4HANA FI/CO module. Distinct from estimated_exposure_amount which represents the maximum possible loss.
attributes.references: ASC 450-20 (Loss Contingencies); SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date on which Sports Entertainment was formally served with process or on which it served the opposing party, establishing the response deadline and triggering internal legal escalation workflows.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 4; State Civil Procedure Rules

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Agreed monetary consideration paid or received as part of a settlement agreement resolving this litigation matter. Populated only when case_status = 'settled'. Used for financial close-out, reserve release, and post-settlement reporting.
attributes.references: ASC 450-20; SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K Item 103

attributes.name: trial_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the commencement of trial or final arbitration hearing. Used for resource planning, witness preparation scheduling, and financial reserve review triggers.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 16; AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: wada_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this matter involves a Performance Enhancing Drug (PED) violation, anti-doping rule violation, or WADA Code enforcement proceeding. True = WADA-governed matter requiring coordination with league compliance and CAS arbitration procedures.
attributes.references: WADA Code 2021; CAS Anti-Doping Division Rules; FIFA Anti-Doping Regulations

attributes.name: engagement_jurisdictions

attributes.name: engagement_start_date

attributes.name: engagement_status

attributes.name: firm_code

attributes.name: firm_name

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the in-house counsel formally approved this outside counsel engagement, authorizing commencement of services. Distinct from the engagement letter date and record creation timestamp. Required for SOX internal control documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI — Approval Workflow Timestamp

attributes.name: approved_billing_rate
attributes.description: The hourly billing rate (in USD) approved by Sports Entertainment for the lead attorney or primary timekeeper on this engagement. Applicable when billing_arrangement_type is 'hourly' or 'blended_rate'. Used for invoice validation and legal spend benchmarking.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SAP S/4HANA FI — Vendor Price Agreement

attributes.name: billing_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The fee structure agreed upon with outside counsel for this engagement. 'hourly' charges by time spent; 'flat_fee' is a fixed amount for defined scope; 'contingency' is a percentage of recovery; 'blended_rate' applies a single rate across all timekeepers; 'retainer' is a periodic fixed fee for availability.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5(a); SAP S/4HANA SD — Pricing Condition Type

attributes.name: billing_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all billing amounts for this engagement are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency legal spend management for international outside counsel engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Key

attributes.name: budget_alert_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the budget_cap_amount at which an automated budget alert notification is triggered to the approving in-house counsel and legal operations team (e.g., 80.00 for 80%). Supports proactive legal spend management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Budget Availability Control; Workday Adaptive Planning — Budget Alert Rules

attributes.name: budget_cap_amount
attributes.description: The maximum authorized spend limit approved for this outside counsel engagement, expressed in the billing currency. Triggers budget alert workflows when actual spend approaches or exceeds this threshold. Core to legal spend management and EBITDA control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Internal Order Budget; Workday Adaptive Planning — Budget Control; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: closure_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the engagement was formally closed or terminated in the system. Populated when engagement_status transitions to 'closed' or 'terminated'. Used for matter duration analytics and outside counsel cycle time KPI reporting.

attributes.name: conflict_check_completed

attributes.name: conflict_check_date

attributes.name: contingency_fee_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of any monetary recovery or settlement that outside counsel is entitled to receive when billing_arrangement_type is 'contingency'. Null for non-contingency arrangements. Governed by ABA fee reasonableness standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which outside counsel is authorized to begin performing services under this engagement. May differ from the engagement letter date if a retroactive or future start is specified.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SAP S/4HANA FI — Contract Start Date

attributes.name: engagement_closure_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the engagement was closed or terminated. Populated when engagement_status transitions to 'closed' or 'terminated'. Supports post-matter analysis and outside counsel performance reviews. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: matter_resolved|settlement|budget_exhausted|scope_change|firm_change|client_termination|regulatory_resolution|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.16; SAP S/4HANA SD — Rejection/Closure Reason Code

attributes.name: engagement_letter_date

attributes.name: engagement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to the engagement at issuance (e.g., CE-2024-000123). Used in engagement letters, invoices, and legal matter management systems to uniquely identify the engagement across departments and outside counsel firms.

attributes.name: engagement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the outside counsel engagement. attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.16; SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Status

attributes.name: expense_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum authorized amount for reimbursable expenses under this engagement, expressed in billing currency. Null if expense_reimbursement_allowed is false or if no cap is set. Prevents uncontrolled disbursement spend.

attributes.name: expense_reimbursement_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether outside counsel is authorized to bill disbursements and out-of-pocket expenses (e.g., travel, court filing fees, expert witness fees) in addition to legal fees under this engagement.

attributes.name: governing_law

attributes.name: invoice_count

attributes.name: jurisdiction

attributes.name: last_invoice_date

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
