attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the insurance claim was formally submitted to the insurer. Used to measure claim reporting timeliness against policy notice requirements and SLA obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; SOX

attributes.name: incident_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the incident occurred. Determines applicable law, regulatory reporting requirements (GDPR, CCPA, OSHA), and governing body jurisdiction (FIFA, IOC, NFL, etc.).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; OSHA; FIFA; IOC

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the underlying loss event, injury, property damage, or liability-triggering incident occurred. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for this claim. Critical for determining policy period applicability and statute of limitations.
attributes.references: OSHA; ADA; ISO 20121

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the loss event, injury, property damage, or liability-triggering incident that gave rise to the insurance claim. Provides context for claim investigation, legal review, and insurer assessment.
attributes.references: OSHA; ADA; ISO 20121

attributes.name: incident_location
attributes.description: Physical location or venue where the incident occurred (e.g., stadium name, arena section, broadcast facility, training facility). Used for venue operations risk analysis, OSHA compliance reporting, and ADA accommodation tracking.
attributes.references: OSHA; ADA; ISO 20121

attributes.name: insurer_claim_handler
attributes.description: Full name of the claims adjuster or handler assigned by the insurer to manage and investigate this specific claim. Used for direct communication, escalation tracking, and SLA monitoring with the insurer.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; SLA

attributes.name: insurer_handler_email
attributes.description: Email address of the insurer-assigned claim handler for direct correspondence and document exchange. Classified as confidential as it is a business contact at an external organization.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ISO 20121

attributes.name: investigation_close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the claim investigation was formally concluded. Used alongside investigation_start_date to calculate investigation duration for risk management KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; SOX

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal claim investigation was initiated by the insurer or internal risk management team. Used to measure investigation cycle time and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; OSHA; SOX

attributes.name: is_subrogation_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Sports Entertainment or the insurer has the right to pursue subrogation (recovery from a liable third party) in connection with this claim. True when subrogation rights exist; False otherwise. Relevant for recovery strategy and legal action planning.
attributes.references: ISO 20121; CAS; SOX

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a legal hold has been placed on documents and data related to this insurance claim due to anticipated or active litigation. True when a legal hold is active; False otherwise. Triggers data preservation obligations under SOX and litigation management protocols.
attributes.references: SOX; CAS; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, internal observations, or supplementary information recorded by the risk management or legal team during the claim lifecycle. Not intended for structured data; used for qualitative context.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the settlement payment was received from the insurer or disbursed to the claimant. Used for cash flow reporting, accounts receivable reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA FI, and insurance recovery tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GAAP; PCI SSC

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Actual monetary amount recovered from the insurer following claim resolution. May differ from settlement_amount due to deductibles, coverage sub-limits, or co-insurance provisions. Key metric for insurance recovery monitoring and ROI analysis.
attributes.references: SOX; GAAP

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the required regulatory report was submitted to the applicable governing body. Populated only when regulatory_report_required is True. Used for compliance tracking and audit evidence.
attributes.references: OSHA; WADA; SEC; FCC; SOX

attributes.name: regulatory_report_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim requires mandatory regulatory reporting to a governing body (e.g., OSHA incident report, WADA notification, SEC disclosure for material claims, FCC notification for broadcast-related incidents). True when regulatory reporting is mandated.
attributes.references: OSHA; WADA; SEC; FCC; SOX

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: Actuarial reserve amount set aside by the insurer or internal risk management to cover the estimated ultimate cost of the claim. Represents the adjustment/estimate component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Subject to periodic re-evaluation as the claim progresses.
attributes.references: SOX; GAAP; ISO 20121

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Final agreed monetary amount paid to resolve the insurance claim. Represents the net total in the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Populated only upon claim settlement or closure; null for open or denied claims.
attributes.references: SOX; GAAP; PCI SSC

attributes.name: subrogation_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount recovered through subrogation proceedings against a liable third party. Populated only when is_subrogation_applicable is True and recovery has been obtained. Reduces the net cost of the claim to Sports Entertainment.
attributes.references: SOX; GAAP; CAS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the insurance claim record. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: supplemental_to_insurance_claim_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on insurance_claim (supplemental_to_insurance_claim_id)

products.name: corporate_entity
products.description: Master record for every legal entity within the Sports Entertainment corporate structure — parent holding companies, league operating entities, franchise LLCs, venue operating companies, broadcast subsidiaries, and joint ventures. Captures entity name, entity type (LLC, LP, Corp, JV), jurisdiction of incorporation, EIN/tax ID, registered agent, registered address, formation date, dissolution date (if applicable), ownership percentage, parent entity reference, active status, and governing law. SSOT for corporate entity identity supporting governance, intercompany transactions, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: corporate_entity_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each legal entity within the Sports Entertainment corporate structure. Primary key for the corporate_entity master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Company Code Master

attributes.name: intercompany_trading_partner_corporate_entity_id
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA intercompany trading partner identifier assigned to this entity for intercompany elimination and reconciliation in consolidated financial statements. Enables automated intercompany matching in the ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Configuration; IFRS 10; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: parent_entity_corporate_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediate parent legal entity in the corporate ownership hierarchy. Null for the ultimate holding company. Enables traversal of the full corporate structure for consolidation, governance, and intercompany transaction management.
attributes.references: IFRS 10; GAAP ASC 810; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Hierarchy

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_entity_corporate_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the top-level holding company in the corporate ownership chain. Supports consolidated reporting, regulatory group filings (e.g., SEC 10-K), and EBITDA roll-up across the entire Sports Entertainment enterprise.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K; IFRS 10; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: annual_report_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the entity must file its annual report or renewal with the jurisdiction of incorporation to maintain good standing. Drives compliance calendar and legal operations workflow.
attributes.references: State/Provincial Business Registration Requirements; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: broadcast_license_holder
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity holds broadcast or media rights licenses (e.g., RSN operating subsidiary, OTT platform entity). Drives FCC regulatory compliance obligations and DRM policy applicability.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Licensing Regulations; FCC Part 73; DRM Policy

attributes.name: ccpa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity is subject to CCPA obligations based on California consumer data processing activities. Relevant for fan engagement platforms, ticketing entities, and DTC operations.
attributes.references: CCPA; California Civil Code Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consolidation_method
attributes.description: Accounting consolidation method applied to this entity in group financial statements. 'full' for wholly/majority-owned subsidiaries, 'proportional' for jointly controlled entities, 'equity' for associates, 'none' for unconsolidated entities.
attributes.references: IFRS 10; IFRS 11; GAAP ASC 810; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the corporate entity master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and governance review requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 30; ISO 20121

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was formally dissolved, wound up, or deregistered. Null for active entities. Required for historical governance records, tax filings, and intercompany transaction cutoffs.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; IRS Entity Classification; State/Provincial Dissolution Statutes

attributes.name: doing_business_as
attributes.description: Trade name or brand name under which the entity operates publicly, if different from the legal name (e.g., 'SE Arena Operations'). Relevant for marketing, fan-facing communications, and venue signage.
attributes.references: State/Provincial Business Registration

attributes.name: ein
attributes.description: IRS-assigned Employer Identification Number (EIN) / Federal Tax Identification Number for US entities. Used for tax filings, payroll, and intercompany financial transactions. Equivalent to VAT/GST registration number for non-US entities.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; SOX Section 302; PCI-DSS Requirement 3

attributes.name: entity_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the legal entity. Drives eligibility for intercompany transactions, regulatory filings, and governance workflows. 'dissolved' indicates the entity has been formally wound up.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Status

attributes.name: entity_subtype
attributes.description: Functional subclassification of the entity within the Sports Entertainment corporate hierarchy. Distinguishes parent holding companies, league operating entities, franchise LLCs, venue operating companies, broadcast subsidiaries, and joint ventures for governance and reporting purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: holding_company|league_operating|franchise|venue_operating|broadcast_subsidiary|joint_venture|management_company|licensing_entity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sports Entertainment Corporate Governance Policy; NFL/NBA/MLB League Governance Frameworks

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal structure of the entity. Drives governance rules, tax treatment, and liability exposure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LLC|LP|Corp|JV|LLP|Trust|Partnership|Sole Proprietorship — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: IRS Entity Classification; OECD Model Tax Convention; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) in which the entity's fiscal year ends. Drives financial reporting cycles, SAP S/4HANA FI period configuration, and Workday Adaptive Planning budget calendars.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; IRS Publication 538; SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: formation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was formally incorporated or organized under the laws of its jurisdiction. Establishes the entity's legal existence and is required for regulatory filings and governance records.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K; IRS Entity Classification

attributes.name: functional_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary currency in which the entity conducts its operations and maintains its books (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Required for intercompany eliminations and consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity processes personal data of EU/EEA data subjects and is therefore subject to GDPR obligations. Drives data processing record requirements, DPA agreements, and breach notification protocols.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; GDPR Article 4; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: good_standing_status
attributes.description: Current standing of the entity with its jurisdiction of incorporation, reflecting whether all required filings, fees, and reports are current. 'delinquent' or 'revoked' status may restrict the entity's ability to conduct business or enter contracts.
attributes.references: State/Provincial Secretary of State; SOX Section 302; League Governance Frameworks

attributes.name: good_standing_verified_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the entity's good standing was verified with the jurisdiction of incorporation. Supports compliance monitoring and annual governance review cycles.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; State/Provincial Secretary of State

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: The specific body of law that governs the entity's formation documents and internal affairs (e.g., 'Delaware General Corporation Law', 'New York LLC Act', 'English Law'). Critical for contract enforcement and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement) Standards; CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); SOX

attributes.name: incorporation_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or US state abbreviation (e.g., 'DE' for Delaware, 'USA' for federal) representing the jurisdiction where the entity was legally formed. Determines applicable corporate law and regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; SEC Regulation S-K; GDPR Article 3

attributes.name: is_publicly_traded
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity's securities are listed on a public stock exchange. Triggers SEC reporting obligations (10-K, 10-Q), SOX internal controls requirements, and enhanced financial disclosure standards.
attributes.references: SEC Exchange Act Section 12; SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the corporate entity master record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data governance workflows.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: league_affiliation
attributes.description: Professional sports league or governing body with which this entity is affiliated (e.g., NFL franchise LLC, NBA team operating company). Drives CBA compliance obligations, revenue sharing rules, and league governance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NFL|NBA|MLB|NHL|MLS|FIFA|UFC|ATP|independent|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NFL Governance Office; NBA League Office; MLB Commissioner's Office; NHL Board of Governors; FIFA; CBA

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the corporate entity exactly as registered with the jurisdiction of incorporation (e.g., 'Sports Entertainment Holdings, LLC'). Used in regulatory filings, intercompany agreements, and governance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code

attributes.name: nil_agreement_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Name Image and Likeness (NIL) Agreement Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity is authorized to enter into NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) agreements with athletes. Relevant for franchise LLCs and management company entities operating under NCAA or professional league NIL frameworks.
attributes.references: NIL Regulations; NCAA NIL Policy; CBA

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the entity owned by its immediate parent entity, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 100.00 for wholly owned, 51.00 for majority-owned JV). Drives consolidation treatment under GAAP/IFRS and intercompany elimination rules.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; GAAP ASC 810; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: pci_dss_scope
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS) Scope Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity is within PCI-DSS scope due to processing, storing, or transmitting payment card data (e.g., ticketing entities, merchandise e-commerce subsidiaries). Drives PCI SSC compliance program requirements.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS v4.0; PCI SSC; Ticketmaster/AXS Integration; Shopify Plus

attributes.name: principal_office_address
attributes.description: Full address of the entity's principal place of business, which may differ from the registered address. Used for operational correspondence, SEC filings, and venue/league operations coordination.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 102; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the entity's official registered office as filed with the jurisdiction of incorporation. Used in regulatory filings, legal notices, and governance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, floor, unit) of the entity's official registered office. Supplements registered_address_line1 for complete address representation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: registered_agent_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the registered agent designated to receive official legal and regulatory correspondence on behalf of the entity in its jurisdiction of incorporation. Required for maintaining good standing.
attributes.references: State/Provincial Business Registration Requirements; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City of the entity's official registered office address as filed with the jurisdiction of incorporation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: registered_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the entity's official registered office (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Drives international regulatory compliance, GDPR applicability, and cross-border tax obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the entity's official registered office address.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; USPS Postal Standards

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the entity's official registered office. Used for jurisdictional compliance, tax nexus determination, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP S/4HANA FI company code assigned to this legal entity. The SSOT identifier used in all financial accounting, controlling, and intercompany transaction postings within the ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sox_reporting_entity
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity is included in the SOX Section 302/404 internal controls assessment and financial reporting scope. Applies to publicly traded entities and their material subsidiaries.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; SEC Exchange Act

attributes.name: stock_exchange
attributes.description: Name of the stock exchange on which the entity's securities are listed. Null for private entities. Drives applicable listing standards, disclosure requirements, and investor relations obligations.
attributes.references: SEC Exchange Act; NYSE Listed Company Manual; NASDAQ Listing Rules

attributes.name: stock_ticker
attributes.description: Exchange ticker symbol for publicly traded entities (e.g., 'MSG' for Madison Square Garden Sports). Null for private entities. Used in SEC filings, investor relations, and financial market data integration.
attributes.references: SEC Exchange Act; NYSE/NASDAQ Listing Standards

attributes.name: tax_id_non_us
attributes.description: Tax registration number for entities incorporated outside the United States (e.g., VAT number, GST number, company registration number). Supports international regulatory filings and cross-border intercompany transactions.
attributes.references: OECD Model Tax Convention; GDPR Article 4; ISO 20121

attributes.name: wada_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity is subject to WADA anti-doping compliance obligations (e.g., league operating entities, franchise LLCs). Drives PED testing program administration and CAS arbitration eligibility.
attributes.references: WADA World Anti-Doping Code; CAS; CBA

attributes.name: parent_corporate_entity_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on corporate_entity (parent_corporate_entity_id)

products.name: board_resolution
products.description: Master record for all formal board of directors and member resolutions passed by Sports Entertainment corporate entities. Captures resolution number, entity reference, resolution type (approval, authorization, ratification, amendment), resolution date, meeting type (regular, special, written consent), quorum achieved flag, vote outcome (unanimous, majority, dissenting votes count), resolution subject matter, authorized signatories, effective date, and document storage reference. Supports corporate governance documentation and authorized signatory management.

attributes.name: board_resolution_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each board resolution record in the Sports Entertainment corporate governance system. Primary key for the board_resolution data product.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 20121

attributes.name: corporate_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Sports Entertainment corporate legal entity (e.g., parent company, subsidiary, joint venture) that passed this resolution. Links to the corporate entity master.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: outside_counsel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external law firm or outside counsel who advised on or drafted this resolution, if applicable. Links to the outside counsel relationship master in the legal domain.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: authorized_signatories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of individuals (by name or title) authorized by this resolution to execute agreements, sign documents, or take actions on behalf of the corporate entity. Central to authorized signatory management and contract execution workflows.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA)

attributes.name: board_committee
attributes.description: The board committee or body that passed this resolution. 'full_board' indicates the entire board of directors; other values indicate a standing committee acting within its delegated authority. Audit and compensation committee resolutions have specific SOX disclosure implications.
attributes.references: SOX Section 301; SOX Section 302; Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA)

attributes.name: chairperson_name
attributes.description: The full name of the board chairperson or committee chair who presided over the meeting at which this resolution was passed. Required for governance documentation and board minutes authentication.
attributes.references: Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: The data classification level assigned to this resolution record, governing access controls and disclosure permissions. Aligns with Sports Entertainment's data classification framework. 'restricted' applies to resolutions involving M&A, executive compensation, or litigation strategy.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; SOX Section 302; Sports Entertainment Data Classification Policy

attributes.name: corporate_secretary_name
attributes.description: The full name of the corporate secretary who certified and recorded this resolution in the official minute book. The corporate secretary's certification is the legal attestation of the resolution's authenticity.
attributes.references: Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this board resolution record was first created in the governance system. Provides the audit trail entry point for data lineage and SOX compliance purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; ISO 20121

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to any monetary authority or limit granted by this resolution (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required when signing_authority_limit is populated.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: dissenting_directors
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of director names or identifiers who voted against or formally dissented from the resolution. Required for governance documentation and potential SEC disclosure. Classified as confidential due to sensitivity of individual director voting positions.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K Item 401; Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA)

attributes.name: document_storage_reference
attributes.description: The unique path, URI, or identifier pointing to the executed resolution document stored in the corporate document management system (e.g., SharePoint, OpenText, or DAM system path). Enables direct retrieval of the signed original for legal and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 20121; DAM (Digital Asset Management) Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the resolution becomes legally operative and binding. May differ from resolution_date when the board specifies a future effective date or when regulatory approval is required before the resolution takes effect.
attributes.references: Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the authority or action granted by this resolution automatically lapses, if applicable. Null for resolutions with indefinite effect. Commonly used for time-limited authorizations such as capital raises, signing authorities, or event-specific approvals.
attributes.references: Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA)

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The Sports Entertainment fiscal year in which this resolution was passed. Used for annual governance reporting, SOX compliance documentation, and board activity analytics.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K; SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Configuration

attributes.name: governing_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/state code) whose corporate law governs the validity and interpretation of this resolution (e.g., US-DE for Delaware, GBR for United Kingdom). Determines applicable corporate law requirements.
attributes.references: Delaware General Corporation Law; Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA); GDPR Article 3

attributes.name: is_material_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether this resolution constitutes a material event requiring public disclosure under SEC reporting obligations (e.g., Form 8-K). Drives the regulatory filing workflow and investor relations notification process.
attributes.references: SEC Form 8-K; SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: is_written_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this resolution was passed via unanimous written consent of the board without a physical or virtual meeting, as permitted under applicable corporate law. Written consent resolutions have specific execution and record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: Delaware General Corporation Law Section 141(f); Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this board resolution record was most recently modified in the governance system. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; ISO 20121

attributes.name: meeting_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the board meeting was held. For written consent resolutions, this is the date the last required signature was obtained. May differ from resolution_date if the resolution was formally recorded on a different date.
attributes.references: Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA)

attributes.name: meeting_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to the board meeting at which this resolution was considered. Used to cross-reference board minutes, agenda items, and other resolutions passed at the same meeting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA)

attributes.name: meeting_type
attributes.description: The type of board meeting or process through which the resolution was passed. 'regular' is a scheduled board meeting; 'special' is a called meeting for specific matters; 'annual' is the annual general meeting; 'written_consent' is a resolution passed without a physical meeting via unanimous written consent; 'emergency' is an expedited meeting for urgent matters.
attributes.references: Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA); Delaware General Corporation Law

attributes.name: minutes_document_reference
attributes.description: The unique path, URI, or identifier pointing to the official board meeting minutes document in which this resolution is recorded. Distinct from document_storage_reference which points to the standalone resolution document.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA)

attributes.name: quorum_achieved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required quorum of board members was present or represented at the time of the vote, as defined in the entity's articles of incorporation or bylaws. A resolution passed without quorum is legally invalid.
attributes.references: Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA); Delaware General Corporation Law

attributes.name: quorum_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of board members required to be present or represented to constitute a valid quorum for this meeting, as specified in the entity's governing documents. Typically 50% or 51% but may vary by entity and resolution type.
attributes.references: Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA); Delaware General Corporation Law

attributes.name: recused_directors
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of director names or identifiers who recused themselves from the vote due to a declared conflict of interest. Required for conflict-of-interest governance documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 301; SEC Regulation S-K; Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA)

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: The reference number or identifier of the regulatory filing submitted as a result of this resolution (e.g., SEC Form 8-K accession number, FCC filing ID). Populated only when regulatory_filing_required is True and the filing has been submitted.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K; FCC Regulations; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this resolution triggers a mandatory regulatory filing obligation (e.g., SEC Form 8-K material event disclosure, FCC license transfer notification, FIFA/league governance notification). Drives compliance workflow routing.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K; FCC Regulations; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: related_resolution_number
attributes.description: The resolution_number of a prior resolution that this resolution amends, ratifies, supersedes, or is otherwise directly related to. Enables governance lineage tracking across the resolution lifecycle.
attributes.references: Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: resolution_category
attributes.description: High-level business category classifying the subject matter of the resolution. Supports governance reporting and analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: financial|legal|operational|governance|personnel|regulatory|strategic|ip_licensing|media_rights|venue|sponsorship — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 20121

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the board formally voted on and passed (or failed) this resolution. This is the principal business event date used in legal filings, regulatory submissions, and governance records.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA)

attributes.name: resolution_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier assigned to the resolution by the corporate secretary. Follows the entity-year-sequence format (e.g., SE-RES-2024-000123). Used in legal filings, board minutes, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K; ISO 20121

attributes.name: resolution_status

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP FI general ledger account code used to classify the settlement expense (e.g., legal settlements, regulatory fines, employment claims). Required for financial statement presentation under SOX and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of the settlement agreement (e.g., 'New York, USA', 'England and Wales', 'Switzerland'). Critical for multi-jurisdictional sports entertainment operations.
attributes.references: CAS; FIFA; NFL Governance Office; Internal Legal Standard

attributes.name: injunction_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the settlement includes an injunctive relief component (court order requiring or prohibiting specific conduct). True = injunction is part of the settlement terms.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Classification; CAS

attributes.name: injunction_scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the scope and duration of any injunctive relief included in the settlement (e.g., geographic restrictions, IP use prohibitions, broadcast blackout requirements). Populated only when injunction_granted = True.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Standard; DRM (Digital Rights Management); FCC

attributes.name: insurance_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the settlement amount expected to be recovered from the organization's insurance carrier(s). Net exposure = settlement_amount minus insurance_recovery_amount. Used for SAP FI reserve management and EBITDA impact reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; ASC 450; SOX

attributes.name: ip_asset_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the IP asset (trademark, patent, copyright, broadcast right) that is the subject of the settlement, if applicable. Cross-references the ip_portfolio or trademark_registration records in the legal domain.
attributes.references: Internal IP Management; DRM (Digital Rights Management); FIFA; NFL

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the settlement agreement contains a confidentiality clause restricting disclosure of terms to third parties. True = confidential terms; False = terms may be disclosed. Drives data access controls and GDPR/CCPA handling.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: is_material_settlement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this settlement meets the materiality threshold requiring disclosure in SEC financial filings or board-level reporting. True = material; triggers SOX disclosure controls and SEC reporting workflow.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Financial Reporting; Internal Materiality Policy

attributes.name: is_non_disparagement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the settlement agreement includes a non-disparagement clause prohibiting either party from making negative public statements about the other. Relevant for athlete, employee, and sponsor settlements.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Standard; CBA (Collective Bargaining Agreement)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary jurisdiction in which the settlement was reached or is enforceable. Used for GDPR, CCPA, and multi-jurisdictional regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; CCPA; FIFA; IOC

attributes.name: matter_type
attributes.description: Category of the underlying legal matter resolved by this settlement. Drives reporting segmentation across litigation, IP (Intellectual Property), employment, and regulatory domains. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: litigation|ip_dispute|employment_claim|regulatory_enforcement|contract_dispute|personal_injury|antitrust|broadcast_rights — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Legal Domain Classification; GDPR; WADA

attributes.name: nil_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: Name Image and Likeness (NIL) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the settlement relates to a Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) dispute involving an athlete or performer. Drives routing to the athlete management and NIL compliance workflows.
attributes.references: NIL (Name Image and Likeness) Regulations; Internal Athlete Management

attributes.name: non_monetary_terms_summary
attributes.description: Summary of non-monetary obligations included in the settlement, such as behavioral commitments, policy changes, reinstatement of employment, IP licensing grants, or broadcast rights modifications. Complements injunction_scope_description for mixed settlements.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Standard; WADA; CBA

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the initial or lump-sum settlement payment must be made. For installment schedules, this represents the first payment due date. Drives SAP FI payment run scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Internal Treasury Policy

attributes.name: payment_schedule_type
attributes.description: Describes how the settlement payment is structured. 'lump_sum' = single payment; 'installment' = multiple fixed payments; 'structured' = variable schedule tied to milestones; 'deferred' = payment delayed to a future date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI; Internal Treasury Policy

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory or governing body that is a party to or has oversight of the settlement (e.g., 'FCC', 'WADA', 'OSHA', 'SEC', 'NFL League Office', 'FIFA'). Null for purely private party settlements.
attributes.references: FCC; WADA; OSHA; SEC; FIFA; NFL Governance Office; IOC

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI document number associated with the settlement payment posting or accrual entry. Enables traceability between the legal settlement record and the financial ledger for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount agreed to be paid as part of the settlement. Represents the total cash consideration before any insurance recovery offsets. Zero for purely injunctive or non-monetary settlements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; ASC 450; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the parties reached agreement in principle on settlement terms, which may precede formal execution. Used for financial accrual and reserve release timing in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX Section 302; ASC 450 (Contingencies)

attributes.name: settlement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the settlement instrument. 'monetary' = cash payment only; 'injunctive' = court-ordered behavioral relief; 'consent_decree' = regulatory enforcement resolution; 'confidential' = terms sealed by agreement; 'mixed' = combination of monetary and non-monetary relief.
attributes.references: CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport); Internal Legal Classification Standard

attributes.name: settling_party_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the primary counterparty (claimant, plaintiff, or regulatory body) entering into the settlement with Sports Entertainment. Captured as a denormalized string to preserve the exact legal name at time of execution.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Internal Legal Record Standard

attributes.name: settling_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the counterparty entering the settlement. Drives compliance reporting and determines applicable regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR for individuals, FCC for regulatory bodies, FIFA/NFL governance for sports governing bodies).
attributes.references: GDPR; FCC; FIFA; NFL Governance Office

attributes.name: sports_entertainment_entity_name
attributes.description: The specific legal entity within the Sports Entertainment corporate group that is party to this settlement (e.g., a specific league subsidiary, broadcasting entity, or venue operating company). Supports multi-entity corporate structures.
attributes.references: SOX; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the settlement agreement record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: wada_case_reference
attributes.description: WADA case reference number if the settlement relates to a Performance Enhancing Drug (PED) or anti-doping violation. Enables cross-referencing with WADA's anti-doping administration and management system.
attributes.references: WADA (World Anti-Doping Agency); CAS

attributes.name: amended_settlement_agreement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on settlement_agreement (amended_settlement_agreement_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `sports_entertainment_ecm`.`_metrics`.`analytics_attribution_result`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Marketing attribution performance metrics tracking conversion revenue, channel effectiveness, and attribution model accuracy across fan journeys"
  source: "`sports_entertainment_ecm`.`analytics`.`attribution_result`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "attributed_channel"
      expr: attributed_channel
      comment: "Marketing channel credited with conversion (e.g., social, broadcast, email, digital)"
    - name: "attributed_channel_subtype"
      expr: attributed_channel_subtype
      comment: "Detailed channel subtype for granular attribution analysis"
    - name: "conversion_event_type"
      expr: conversion_event_type
      comment: "Type of conversion event (ticket purchase, merchandise order, subscription, wager)"
    - name: "attribution_model_type"
      expr: attribution_model_type
      comment: "Attribution methodology applied (first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, algorithmic)"
    - name: "fan_segment_code"
      expr: fan_segment_code
      comment: "Fan segment for cohort-based attribution analysis"
    - name: "market_region_code"
      expr: market_region_code
      comment: "Geographic market for regional attribution performance"
    - name: "device_type"
      expr: device_type
      comment: "Device type used in conversion journey (mobile, desktop, tablet, connected TV)"
    - name: "is_converting_touchpoint"
      expr: is_converting_touchpoint
      comment: "Flag indicating whether this touchpoint directly converted"
    - name: "is_first_touchpoint"
      expr: is_first_touchpoint
      comment: "Flag indicating whether this was the first touchpoint in the journey"
    - name: "attribution_run_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', attribution_run_date)
      comment: "Month of attribution run for time-series analysis"
    - name: "conversion_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', conversion_timestamp)
      comment: "Month of conversion event for trend analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_attributed_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(attributed_revenue AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue attributed to marketing touchpoints across all channels"
    - name: "total_conversion_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(conversion_revenue AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual conversion revenue generated from attributed journeys"
    - name: "total_attributed_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(attributed_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total marketing cost attributed to touchpoints in conversion journeys"
    - name: "total_touchpoint_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(touchpoint_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cost of individual touchpoints across all journeys"
    - name: "avg_credit_weight"
      expr: AVG(CAST(credit_weight AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average attribution credit weight assigned to touchpoints"
    - name: "total_conversions"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_converting_touchpoint = TRUE THEN attribution_result_id END)
      comment: "Total number of conversion events attributed"
    - name: "total_touchpoints"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of marketing touchpoints in attributed journeys"
    - name: "unique_fan_journeys"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT fan_profile_id)
      comment: "Distinct fans with attributed conversion journeys"
$$
metric_views.description: Marketing attribution performance metrics tracking conversion revenue, channel effectiveness, and attribution model accuracy across fan journeys

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `sports_entertainment_ecm`.`_metrics`.`compliance_audit_finding`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Audit finding remediation metrics tracking control deficiencies, risk ratings, remediation progress, and repeat findings"
  source: "`sports_entertainment_ecm`.`compliance`.`audit_finding`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "finding_status"
      expr: finding_status
      comment: "Current status of the audit finding (open, in remediation, closed, accepted risk)"
    - name: "risk_rating"
      expr: risk_rating
      comment: "Risk severity rating (critical, high, medium, low) for prioritization"
    - name: "finding_category"
      expr: finding_category
      comment: "Category of audit finding (control deficiency, policy violation, process gap, etc.)"
    - name: "control_domain"
      expr: control_domain
      comment: "Control domain affected (financial reporting, IT security, operations, compliance)"
    - name: "regulatory_framework"
      expr: regulatory_framework
      comment: "Regulatory framework related to the finding (SOX, GDPR, PCI-DSS, etc.)"
    - name: "auditor_type"
      expr: auditor_type
      comment: "Type of auditor who identified the finding (internal, external, regulatory)"
    - name: "repeat_finding"
      expr: repeat_finding
      comment: "Whether this is a repeat finding from prior audits indicating persistent control weakness"
    - name: "escalation_required"
      expr: escalation_required
      comment: "Whether finding requires escalation to senior management or board"
    - name: "regulatory_notification_required"
      expr: regulatory_notification_required
      comment: "Whether finding must be reported to regulatory authority"
    - name: "root_cause_category"
      expr: root_cause_category
      comment: "Root cause category (process, people, technology, policy) for systemic analysis"
    - name: "finding_year"
      expr: YEAR(identified_date)
      comment: "Year the finding was identified for trend analysis"
    - name: "remediation_overdue"
      expr: CASE WHEN target_remediation_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND finding_status != 'closed' THEN true ELSE false END
      comment: "Whether finding remediation is past target date"
  measures:
    - name: "total_findings"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of audit findings identified"
    - name: "open_findings"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN finding_status IN ('open', 'in remediation') THEN audit_finding_id END)
      comment: "Count of findings not yet closed requiring management attention"
    - name: "critical_high_findings"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk_rating IN ('critical', 'high') THEN audit_finding_id END)
      comment: "Count of critical and high-risk findings requiring immediate action"
    - name: "repeat_finding_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN repeat_finding = true THEN audit_finding_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of findings that are repeats indicating systemic control failures"
    - name: "avg_remediation_days"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(actual_remediation_date, identified_date))
      comment: "Average days to remediate findings for process efficiency measurement"
    - name: "overdue_findings"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN target_remediation_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND finding_status != 'closed' THEN audit_finding_id END)
      comment: "Count of findings past target remediation date"
    - name: "overdue_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN target_remediation_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND finding_status != 'closed' THEN audit_finding_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN finding_status != 'closed' THEN audit_finding_id END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of open findings that are overdue for escalation tracking"
    - name: "escalation_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN escalation_required = true THEN audit_finding_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of findings requiring escalation to senior management"
    - name: "regulatory_notification_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN regulatory_notification_required = true THEN audit_finding_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of findings requiring regulatory notification"
    - name: "accepted_risk_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN finding_status = 'accepted risk' THEN audit_finding_id END)
      comment: "Count of findings where management accepted the risk without remediation"
    - name: "remediation_closure_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN finding_status = 'closed' THEN audit_finding_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of findings successfully remediated and closed"
$$
metric_views.description: Audit finding remediation metrics tracking control deficiencies, risk ratings, remediation progress, and repeat findings

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `sports_entertainment_ecm`.`_metrics`.`compliance_breach_notification`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Data breach notification compliance metrics tracking GDPR 72-hour deadline adherence, affected records, authority response, and notification outcomes"
  source: "`sports_entertainment_ecm`.`compliance`.`breach_notification`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "notification_status"
      expr: notification_status
      comment: "Current status of the breach notification (draft, submitted, acknowledged, under investigation)"
    - name: "notification_type"
      expr: notification_type
      comment: "Type of notification (initial, supplementary, final)"
    - name: "breach_category"
      expr: breach_category
      comment: "Category of data breach (unauthorized access, loss, theft, accidental disclosure, ransomware)"
    - name: "breach_cause"
      expr: breach_cause
      comment: "Root cause of the breach (human error, system failure, malicious attack, third-party)"
    - name: "regulatory_framework"
      expr: regulatory_framework
      comment: "Regulatory framework requiring notification (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, state breach laws)"
    - name: "notified_authority_jurisdiction"
      expr: notified_authority_jurisdiction
      comment: "Jurisdiction of the notified supervisory authority"
    - name: "risk_level"
      expr: risk_level
      comment: "Risk level to data subjects (high, medium, low)"
    - name: "is_within_72hr_deadline"
      expr: is_within_72hr_deadline
      comment: "Whether notification was submitted within GDPR 72-hour deadline"
    - name: "affected_special_category_flag"
      expr: affected_special_category_flag
      comment: "Whether special category (sensitive) personal data was affected"
    - name: "third_party_processor_involved"
      expr: third_party_processor_involved
      comment: "Whether a third-party data processor was involved in the breach"
    - name: "pci_dss_scope_flag"
      expr: pci_dss_scope_flag
      comment: "Whether breach involved payment card data under PCI-DSS scope"
    - name: "regulatory_penalty_risk_flag"
      expr: regulatory_penalty_risk_flag
      comment: "Whether breach carries significant regulatory penalty risk"
    - name: "notification_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', notification_submitted_timestamp)
      comment: "Month notification was submitted for trend analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_breach_notifications"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of data breach notifications submitted to authorities"
    - name: "total_affected_data_subjects"
      expr: SUM(CAST(affected_data_subjects_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of data subjects affected across all breaches"
    - name: "avg_affected_data_subjects"
      expr: AVG(CAST(affected_data_subjects_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of data subjects affected per breach"
    - name: "total_affected_records"
      expr: SUM(CAST(affected_records_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of records affected across all breaches"
    - name: "avg_affected_records"
      expr: AVG(CAST(affected_records_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of records affected per breach"
    - name: "gdpr_72hr_compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_within_72hr_deadline = true THEN breach_notification_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN regulatory_framework = 'GDPR' THEN breach_notification_id END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of GDPR breaches notified within 72-hour deadline for compliance performance"
    - name: "avg_notification_lag_hours"
      expr: AVG((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(notification_submitted_timestamp) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(breach_detected_timestamp)) / 3600)
      comment: "Average hours between breach detection and authority notification"
    - name: "high_risk_breach_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk_level = 'high' THEN breach_notification_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of breaches classified as high risk to data subjects"
    - name: "special_category_breach_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN affected_special_category_flag = true THEN breach_notification_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of breaches involving sensitive personal data"
    - name: "third_party_breach_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN third_party_processor_involved = true THEN breach_notification_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of breaches involving third-party processors for vendor risk assessment"
    - name: "data_subject_notification_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN data_subject_notification_date IS NOT NULL THEN breach_notification_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of breaches where affected data subjects were directly notified"
    - name: "authority_acknowledgment_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN authority_acknowledgment_date IS NOT NULL THEN breach_notification_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN notification_submitted_timestamp IS NOT NULL THEN breach_notification_id END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of notifications acknowledged by supervisory authority"
    - name: "pci_dss_breach_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pci_dss_scope_flag = true THEN breach_notification_id END)
      comment: "Count of breaches involving payment card data requiring PCI-DSS incident response"
$$
metric_views.description: Data breach notification compliance metrics tracking GDPR 72-hour deadline adherence, affected records, authority response, and notification outcomes

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `sports_entertainment_ecm`.`_metrics`.`compliance_license_permit`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "License and permit management metrics tracking renewal timeliness, expiration risk, fee management, and regulatory compliance status"
  source: "`sports_entertainment_ecm`.`compliance`.`license_permit`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "license_status"
      expr: license_status
      comment: "Current status of the license or permit (active, expired, pending renewal, suspended, revoked)"
    - name: "license_type"
      expr: license_type
      comment: "Type of license or permit (business license, liquor license, gaming license, broadcast license, etc.)"
    - name: "license_category"
      expr: license_category
      comment: "Category of license (operational, regulatory, professional, facility)"
    - name: "regulatory_framework"
      expr: regulatory_framework
      comment: "Regulatory framework governing the license (FCC, state gaming commission, ABC board, etc.)"
    - name: "jurisdiction_country"
      expr: jurisdiction_country
      comment: "Country jurisdiction where license is issued"
    - name: "jurisdiction_region"
      expr: jurisdiction_region
      comment: "State or regional jurisdiction where license is issued"
    - name: "is_recurring"
      expr: is_recurring
      comment: "Whether license requires recurring renewal"
    - name: "is_conditional"
      expr: is_conditional
      comment: "Whether license has compliance conditions attached"
    - name: "is_transferable"
      expr: is_transferable
      comment: "Whether license can be transferred to another entity"
    - name: "renewal_status"
      expr: renewal_status
      comment: "Status of renewal process (not due, pending, submitted, approved, overdue)"
    - name: "penalty_risk_flag"
      expr: penalty_risk_flag
      comment: "Whether license carries penalty risk if expired or non-compliant"
    - name: "expiration_risk"
      expr: CASE WHEN expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) AND license_status = 'active' THEN 'expiring_90_days' WHEN expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) AND license_status = 'active' THEN 'expiring_30_days' WHEN expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE() THEN 'expired' ELSE 'current' END
      comment: "Expiration risk category for proactive renewal management"
  measures:
    - name: "total_licenses"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of licenses and permits tracked"
    - name: "active_licenses"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN license_status = 'active' THEN license_permit_id END)
      comment: "Count of currently active licenses"
    - name: "expired_licenses"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN license_status = 'expired' THEN license_permit_id END)
      comment: "Count of expired licenses requiring immediate renewal action"
    - name: "expiring_within_90_days"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) AND expiry_date > CURRENT_DATE() AND license_status = 'active' THEN license_permit_id END)
      comment: "Count of licenses expiring within 90 days for proactive renewal planning"
    - name: "expiring_within_30_days"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) AND expiry_date > CURRENT_DATE() AND license_status = 'active' THEN license_permit_id END)
      comment: "Count of licenses expiring within 30 days requiring urgent renewal action"
    - name: "total_license_fees"
      expr: SUM(CAST(license_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total license and permit fees paid or due"
    - name: "avg_license_fee"
      expr: AVG(CAST(license_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average license fee amount for budgeting"
    - name: "on_time_renewal_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN renewal_submission_date <= renewal_due_date THEN license_permit_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN renewal_submission_date IS NOT NULL THEN license_permit_id END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of licenses renewed by due date for compliance performance"
    - name: "overdue_renewal_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN renewal_due_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND renewal_status NOT IN ('approved', 'submitted') THEN license_permit_id END)
      comment: "Count of licenses with overdue renewals indicating compliance risk"
    - name: "conditional_license_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_conditional = true THEN license_permit_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of licenses with compliance conditions requiring monitoring"
    - name: "penalty_risk_license_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN penalty_risk_flag = true THEN license_permit_id END)
      comment: "Count of licenses carrying penalty risk if non-compliant"
    - name: "recurring_license_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_recurring = true THEN license_permit_id END)
      comment: "Count of recurring licenses for ongoing compliance workload planning"
$$
metric_views.description: License and permit management metrics tracking renewal timeliness, expiration risk, fee management, and regulatory compliance status

    - name: "recurring_filing_count"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `sports_entertainment_ecm`.`_metrics`.`finance_budget`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Budget planning, variance, and forecast accuracy metrics"
  source: "`sports_entertainment_ecm`.`finance`.`budget`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "budget_type"
      expr: budget_type
      comment: "Type of budget (e.g., operating, capital, project)"
    - name: "approval_status"
      expr: approval_status
      comment: "Approval status of the budget"
    - name: "scenario_type"
      expr: scenario_type
      comment: "Budget scenario type (e.g., base, optimistic, pessimistic)"
    - name: "plan_type"
      expr: plan_type
      comment: "Type of plan (e.g., annual, quarterly, rolling)"
    - name: "functional_area"
      expr: functional_area
      comment: "Functional area of the budget"
    - name: "business_unit"
      expr: business_unit
      comment: "Business unit owning the budget"
    - name: "period_granularity"
      expr: period_granularity
      comment: "Granularity of budget periods (e.g., monthly, quarterly)"
    - name: "is_intercompany"
      expr: is_intercompany
      comment: "Indicates if this is an intercompany budget"
  measures:
    - name: "total_planned_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total planned budget amount"
    - name: "total_revised_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(revised_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revised budget amount after adjustments"
    - name: "total_actuals_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actuals_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual spend against budget"
    - name: "total_forecast_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(forecast_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total forecasted amount"
    - name: "total_committed_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(committed_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total committed amount (encumbered funds)"
    - name: "budget_count"
      expr: COUNT(budget_id)
      comment: "Total number of budget line items"
    - name: "budget_utilization_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(actuals_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(revised_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of revised budget utilized by actuals"
    - name: "forecast_accuracy_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * (1.0 - ABS(SUM(CAST(forecast_amount AS DOUBLE)) - SUM(CAST(actuals_amount AS DOUBLE))) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(actuals_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0)), 2)
      comment: "Forecast accuracy as percentage (100% = perfect forecast)"
    - name: "budget_variance_amount"
      expr: SUM((CAST(revised_amount AS DOUBLE)) - (CAST(actuals_amount AS DOUBLE)))
      comment: "Total budget variance (revised minus actuals)"
    - name: "commitment_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(committed_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(revised_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of revised budget committed"
$$
metric_views.description: Budget planning, variance, and forecast accuracy metrics

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `sports_entertainment_ecm`.`_metrics`.`finance_sox_control`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "SOX control effectiveness, testing coverage, and remediation metrics"

    - name: "control_status"
      expr: control_status

      comment: "Type of SOX control (e.g., preventive, detective)"

      expr: control_category
      comment: "Category of the control"

      expr: financial_process_area
      comment: "Financial process area covered by the control"
    - name: "risk_rating"
      expr: risk_rating
      comment: "Risk rating of the control"
    - name: "is_key_control"
      expr: is_key_control
      comment: "Indicates if this is a key control"
    - name: "test_result"
      expr: test_result
      comment: "Result of the most recent control test"
    - name: "remediation_status"
      expr: remediation_status
      comment: "Status of remediation if deficiency exists"
    - name: "deficiency_classification"
      expr: deficiency_classification
      comment: "Classification of any identified deficiency"
    - name: "control_frequency"
      expr: control_frequency
      comment: "Frequency of control execution"
    - name: "testing_frequency"
      expr: testing_frequency
      comment: "Frequency of control testing"
    - name: "segregation_of_duties_flag"
      expr: segregation_of_duties_flag
      comment: "Indicates if segregation of duties is required"
  measures:
    - name: "control_count"
      expr: COUNT(sox_control_id)
      comment: "Total number of SOX controls"
    - name: "key_control_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_key_control = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Total number of key controls"
    - name: "effective_control_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN test_result = 'Effective' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of controls tested as effective"
    - name: "deficient_control_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN deficiency_classification IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of controls with identified deficiencies"
    - name: "control_effectiveness_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN test_result = 'Effective' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(sox_control_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of controls tested as effective"
    - name: "key_control_effectiveness_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_key_control = TRUE AND test_result = 'Effective' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_key_control = TRUE THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of key controls tested as effective"
    - name: "deficiency_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN deficiency_classification IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(sox_control_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of controls with deficiencies"
    - name: "remediation_completion_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN remediation_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN deficiency_classification IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)

$$

LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Secondary ticket market performance metrics including resale volume, price uplift, marketplace efficiency, and revenue share distribution"
  source: "`sports_entertainment_ecm`.`ticketing`.`resale`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "transaction_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', transaction_timestamp)
      comment: "Date of resale transaction"
    - name: "transaction_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', transaction_timestamp)
      comment: "Month of resale transaction"
    - name: "listing_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', listing_created_timestamp)
      comment: "Date when listing was created"
    - name: "lifecycle_status"
      expr: lifecycle_status
      comment: "Current lifecycle status of resale listing"
    - name: "seller_type"
      expr: seller_type
      comment: "Type of seller (individual, broker, season ticket holder, etc.)"
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Payment method used for resale transaction"
    - name: "delivery_method"
      expr: delivery_method
      comment: "Delivery method for resold tickets"
    - name: "ticket_tier"
      expr: ticket_tier
      comment: "Pricing tier of resold tickets"
    - name: "is_dynamic_pricing_applied"
      expr: dynamic_pricing_applied
      comment: "Whether dynamic pricing was applied to resale"
    - name: "is_anti_scalping_compliant"
      expr: anti_scalping_compliant
      comment: "Whether resale complies with anti-scalping regulations"
  measures:
    - name: "total_resales"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of resale transactions"
    - name: "total_resale_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(sale_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue from resale transactions"
    - name: "total_original_face_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(original_face_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total original face value of resold tickets"
    - name: "total_listing_price"
      expr: SUM(CAST(listing_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total listing price of all resale inventory"
    - name: "total_platform_fees"
      expr: SUM(CAST(platform_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total platform fees collected from resales"
    - name: "total_revenue_share"
      expr: SUM(CAST(revenue_share_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue share amount from resales"
    - name: "total_seller_proceeds"
      expr: SUM(CAST(seller_proceeds AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total proceeds paid to sellers"
    - name: "avg_sale_price"
      expr: AVG(CAST(sale_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average resale transaction price"
    - name: "avg_price_uplift_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(price_uplift_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average percentage price uplift from original face value"
    - name: "avg_revenue_share_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(revenue_share_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average revenue share rate percentage"
    - name: "price_uplift_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CAST(sale_price AS DOUBLE)) - SUM(CAST(original_face_value AS DOUBLE))) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(original_face_value AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Aggregate percentage price uplift from original face value to resale price"
    - name: "platform_fee_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(platform_fee_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(sale_price AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Platform fees as percentage of resale revenue"
    - name: "unique_sellers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT fan_profile_id)
      comment: "Number of unique sellers in resale marketplace"
    - name: "unique_buyers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_fan_fan_profile_id)
      comment: "Number of unique buyers in resale marketplace"
$$
metric_views.description: Secondary ticket market performance metrics including resale volume, price uplift, marketplace efficiency, and revenue share distribution

WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Venue rental revenue, utilization, and contract performance metrics for non-event space usage"
  source: "`sports_entertainment_ecm`.`venue`.`rental`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "event_date"
      expr: event_date
      comment: "Date of the rental event"
    - name: "event_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_date)
      comment: "Month of the rental event for monthly trend analysis"
    - name: "event_type"
      expr: event_type
      comment: "Type of event (corporate, wedding, concert, conference, etc.)"
    - name: "renter_type"
      expr: renter_type
      comment: "Type of renter (corporate, individual, non-profit, etc.)"
    - name: "rental_status"
      expr: rental_status
      comment: "Status of the rental (confirmed, pending, cancelled, completed, etc.)"
    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Payment status of the rental (paid, pending, overdue, etc.)"
    - name: "space_configuration"
      expr: space_configuration
      comment: "Configuration of the rented space (theater, banquet, classroom, etc.)"
    - name: "contract_signed_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', contract_signed_date)
      comment: "Month when rental contract was signed for pipeline analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_contract_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_contract_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total contracted revenue from venue rentals"
    - name: "total_base_rental_fee"
      expr: SUM(CAST(base_rental_fee AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total base rental fees excluding ancillary services"
    - name: "total_ancillary_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(av_service_fee AS DOUBLE) + CAST(catering_service_fee AS DOUBLE) + CAST(cleaning_service_fee AS DOUBLE) + CAST(security_service_fee AS DOUBLE) + CAST(other_ancillary_fees AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue from ancillary services (AV, catering, cleaning, security, other)"
    - name: "total_deposit_collected"
      expr: SUM(CAST(deposit_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total deposit amounts collected from renters"
    - name: "rental_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of venue rental bookings"
    - name: "avg_contract_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_contract_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average contract value per rental booking"
    - name: "avg_expected_attendance"
      expr: AVG(CAST(expected_attendance AS BIGINT))
      comment: "Average expected attendance across rental events"
    - name: "cancellation_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN cancellation_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of cancelled rental bookings"
    - name: "ancillary_revenue_rate"
      expr: AVG((CAST(av_service_fee AS DOUBLE) + CAST(catering_service_fee AS DOUBLE) + CAST(cleaning_service_fee AS DOUBLE) + CAST(security_service_fee AS DOUBLE) + CAST(other_ancillary_fees AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(CAST(total_contract_value AS DOUBLE), 0))
      comment: "Average ancillary revenue as percentage of total contract value"
$$
metric_views.description: Venue rental revenue, utilization, and contract performance metrics for non-event space usage
